# Ninjase — Overframe builds (updated in the last year)

**Source:** https://overframe.gg/user/2890/ninjase/ — author **ninjase** (Overframe user id 2890)
**Pulled:** 2026-09-07. **Scope:** every build by ninjase whose Overframe `updated` timestamp is on or after **2025-09-07** (one year prior).
**Count:** 394 builds — Warframes 193 · Primary 61 · Secondary 45 · Melee 72 · Archwing 3 · Companions 20.
Builds are grouped by category and ordered by Overframe score (popularity) within each.

## How to read each entry

- **Forma** = Overframe's forma count for the build. **Forma polarities used** counts the polarised slots by symbol.
- **Mods / slots** lists every slot: `slot number — mod name — mod rank — the polarity on that slot`. "—(no forma)" means the slot was left unpolarised. "(mod polarity mismatch...)" means the equipped mod's own polarity does not match the slot's forma, so it costs full/extra capacity.
- Polarity symbols: **V** Madurai · **D** Vazarin · **–** Naramon · **=** Zenurik · **Ω** Umbral · **⊙** Precept · **r** Unairu. Slot 9 on a Warframe/Melee entry is the **Aura / Stance** slot.
- **Guide** text is reproduced **verbatim** from the build's Overframe write-up. Item names appear as `[[Name]](/items/arsenal/ID/slug/)` links (Overframe's format) and `[[ youtube id="..." ]]` embeds are Overframe shortcodes.
- One mod could not be name-resolved from Overframe's item API and appears as "Unknown mod (OF id 2499)" in a single melee build.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

High strength [\[Revenant\]](/items/arsenal/1378/revenant/) build for high mesmer skin charges to stay invulnerable and status immune, reave to one shot enemies and optional Roar in helminth to boost reave and general weapon DPS.

**Update**
The new augment [\[Mesmer Shield\]](/items/arsenal/6059/mesmer-shield/) gives a bonus 50% strength towards Mesmer Skin and allows you to give allies 5 mesmer skin charges.

**Alternate builds**
Danse Macabre Nuke / Levelcap (Roar): https://overframe.gg/build/375101/
Reave Nuke build (marked for death): https://overframe.gg/build/374638/

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Mesmer Skin (2) at start of mission and refresh just before you lose all charges.
2. Enthrall (tap 1) enemies and let it spread and keep enthralls capped at 7 as needed. Note you can Enthrall acolytes as long as you have free thrall space so that you can Reave them easier (takes about 3-4 shots to kill).
3. Cast Reave and aim through Enthralled enemies to one-shot them and regain mesmer skin charges. Reaving also provides companion with a 1 single mesmer skin stack.
4. For non-enthralled enemies, prime with viral status and reave to one-shot (only need exactly 2 viral status to one-shot at 313% str with roar, or 9 viral status to one-shot without roar)
5. Use Danse Macabre for mob clearing if you like. This works well for non-SP but also works for very high level SP (level 1000+) where enemy damage outscales their eHP significantly. If you have energy issues, consider swapping [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/).

Video guide on playstyle: 

[[ youtube id="1cvFEtaE_W0" ]] 


# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration is helpful for reave travel duration, enthrall and mesmer skin stun, as well as for your helminth ability uptime eg roar. Duration also affects Danse Macabre drain.

**Efficiency**
You can adjust this to preference. Negative efficiency is fine if you're mostly focusing on Mesmer Skin since it only needs to be recast once every half a minute or so. Neutral to positive efficiency would make it easier to spam Reave and even Danse Macabre if you like, but [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) gives plenty of energy regeneration. Enthrall cost is basically free since it spreads and is free on an enemy stunned by mesmer skin. 

**Range**
Range is only needed for Enthrall and Reave and neutral range is mostly sufficient. You could add more range to improve Reave radius if you preferred, e.g by adding [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) over a strength mod.

**Strength**
Very high strength helps maximise the Mesmer Skin charges (19 at 313% or 22 at 373% str after Molt Augmented, and even more with additional strength sources such as [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/), Zenurik or Madurai), Reave and Roar. You need to hit certain Strength breakpoints to gain additional mesmer skin stacks as the mesmer skin count is rounded up when decimal. Every multiple of 16.6667% strength gives one additional mesmer skin charge and every 50% strength gives exactly three charges. General breakpoints above 300% strength:

- 301% to 316%: 19 charges
- 317% to 333%: 20 charges
- 334% to 350%: 21 charges
- 351% to 366%: 22 charges
- 367% to 383%: 23 charges

**Reave Specifics**
Reave one-shot strength threshold calculator (made by mineturtleofdeath) : https://www.desmos.com/calculator/gdozwoxyej
Reave one-shot spreadsheet (by me, to use click file -> make a copy, do NOT ask for edit permissions): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TEuIybgbW0PMOndEKpT1ohY_-PvgHI3YqOxunKlgHkY/edit?usp=sharing

Reave at base removes 8% of an enemies health regardless of level. This is boosted by enthrall, viral status and roar. Note this does NOT work against acolytes, demolysts and bosses such as liches/archons due to their innate damage reduction. An enthralled enemy takes 5x more damage from Reave meaning only 250% strength is required to one-shot an enthralled target. Viral increases damage by 4.25 at 10 stacks, meaning 295% strength is needed to one-shot a non-enthralled enemy after applying 10 viral status effects. 

Alternatively, if you add Roar, you need 500% strength to oneshot without any viral and 320% strength to oneshot with 1 single viral status.

**To one shot with NO viral, roar or enthrall you need 1250% strength.**

**To oneshot with ROAR but NO viral or enthrall you need exactly 500% strength. This can now be hit with external buffs such as strength shards (e.g. 4 tau str = 60%) and Madurai (40%). A [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) specter will reduce the strength requirement further and make it easier to hit, only needing 391% strength provided you stay in range**

**Flexible Options/Slots**
[\[Thrall Pact\]](/items/arsenal/5257/thrall-pact/) gives over +600% primary weapon damage at max thralls but is additive to other damage mods, nice damage boost if using primary weapons.

[\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/) is good quality of life since it speeds up casts of Reave as well as allows you to refresh Mesmer skin in between casts and within the i-frames given by shield gating. This is however more optional now since you can run cast speed amber shards and you now gain 1s i-frames upon losing a mesmer skin stack.

**Aura**
- Corrosive Projection for armor reduction which boosts damage against armored enemies by 1.8x
- Growing Power gives one additional mesmer skin charge but requires aura forma
- Enemy Radar helps track enemies from even further away adding onto universal radar
- Sprint boost for run speed (which now affects reave)

**Exilus**
Up to personal preference, use whatever u like.
- Ice Spring/Parkour mods : better mobility
- Power drift: one more mesmer skin stack
- Preparation: For quick missions, allows speed reaving/dansing through a mission

**Arcanes**
Flexible:
Molt Augmented - if you want even more strength up to 60% after 250 kills, for mesmer skin stacks
Arcane Power Ramp - can give up to 36% strength if you cast different abilities 
Molt Vigor - gives up to 45% strength if you use operator ability first, which is snapshot into your mesmer skin stacks
Molt Efficiency/Arcane Concentration - more duration for reave, thrall and roar uptime
Arcane Energize/Steadfast - helps energy economy if needed
Arcane Avenger - use in combination with [\[Combat Discipline\]](/items/arsenal/2727/combat-discipline/) only

**Archon Shards**
Amber Cast Speed Shard: at least 2 regular cast speed shards or 1 tauforged cast speed helps with mesmer skin refresh and reave spam
Crimson Strength Shard: as many +strength as you prefer for more mesmer skin and reave damage. Having 4 tauforged lets you hit 500% strength when used alongside Madurai.

**Focus School**
Madurai: Power transfer gives +50% cast speed and +40% strength for up to 20s, which is amazing for Mesmer skin and Reave, in addition to general damage boost

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Subsume over either Enthrall or Danse Macabre:
1. Roar - boosts general weapon DPS, thrall DPS and reduces amount of viral status needed to one-shot non-enthralled enemies with reave (2 viral procs at 313% strength or 1 viral proc at 373% strength or even 0 viral proc at 500% strength).
2. Xata's Whisper - void themed ability that has bonus against overguard and best for raw damage weapons
3. Pillage - armor strip improves weapon DPS against armored enemies
4. Silence - decent option for endurance in Steel path, particularly to prevent Violence from dispelling all your mesmer skin at once and making you vulnerable. You can leave range around 79-100ish e.g. just have stretch, or add augur reach too.
5. Mind Control - can create an invulnerable thrall that does more damage (shoot it to apply damage multiplier) and converts other enemies to thralls. Can add Primed Continuity
6. Grouping - You can use Ensnare/Larva/Coil Horizon or Airburst as a form of grouping so you can reave multiple enemies at once. You will want to increase range by swapping Narrow Minded and Fleeting Expertise for Primed Continuity and Overextended.
7. Sentient Wrath - provides both crowd control and damage vulnerability, which also increases the damage of reave allowing one-shot at only 1 viral proc at 313% strength.
8. Nourish - boosts thralls with viral damage, adds viral to your weapons and multiplies energy gained

# ARSENAL
A consistent AOE viral primer is the best tool to apply viral procs which will allow Reave to oneshot without enthrall.
Bubonico (alt-fire): https://overframe.gg/build/222087/bubonico/bubonico-pure-viral-primer/
Epitaph (quickshot): https://overframe.gg/build/235422/epitaph/epitaph-primer/
Kuva Nukor: https://overframe.gg/build/235421/kuva-nukor/kuva-nukor-primer/
Panzer Vulpaphyla: https://overframe.gg/build/220091/panzer-vulpaphyla/panzer-vulpaphyla/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION 

Welcome to the Thunderdome. This is a standard Khora Whipclaw farming build for endurance survival/looting missions (e.g. steel essence farm, arbitrations e.t.c.). [\[Accumulating Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/1384/accumulating-whipclaw/) and [\[Pilfering Strangledome\]](/items/arsenal/2469/pilfering-strangledome/) are standard augments to enable [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) DPS and Strangledome looting respectively. 

Infinite scaling survivability is via extreme crowd control from strangledome, ensnare, as well as shield gating using the combination of [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/), augur mods and [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/). [\[Venari Bodyguard\]](/items/arsenal/2297/venari-bodyguard/) is a further optional backup plan that negates death. At neutral efficiency with [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) and ONE augur mod, every cast of [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) generates 47.5 shield which gives about 0.6s shield gate. Exactly two casts of [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) therefore caps max shields (93 with [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/)) and gives the maximum 1.33s shield gate. If you add another two augur mods on your secondary, you can generate 67 shields which is approximately 1s shield gate from a single cast of 1.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
[\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) no longer uses statsticks on a regular melee and is now an exalted that can be modded and use arcanes. While technically the potential maximum raw damage has reduced (due to lack of incarnon bonuses and rivens), the nuking and KPM potential has increased due to the ability to use acolyte mods/galvanized mods and melee influence arcane. If you don't like faction mods, swap Primed Smite for [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/) (just note faction mods do TRIPLE DIP melee influence procs meaning they boost influence by a 1.55^3 = 3.72x multiplier. [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/) can add a flat 3m to the 10m maximum range of [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) and surpass the cap to 13m.

**Melee Vortex**
Best for looting, this is because influence can kill enemies outside of the dome while vortex will pull enemies into the dome quicker and only kill enemies in the dome. NOTE: use ARCHON CONTINUITY for corrosive procs
https://overframe.gg/build/827172/

**Melee influence**
![](https://imgur.com/sK2A487.png)

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
Due to armor and health scaling changes, [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/) [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) can now scale into endurance without armor strip or slash, relying purely on raw damage.

I have removed Spectrorage as the primary subsume as energy is not really an issue these days with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on Steel Path Survival density missions in addition to the host of possible energy regeneration methods such as [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/) Invocation, Glaxion Photon Overcharge, Primary Exhilirate, Emergence Dissipate and Zenurik. In addition, Khora basically one-shots all enemies quicker than before meaning you don't need to spam [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) as much.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast up to two strangledomes at choke points on the map (e.g. doorways, hallways entering into a room). Rotate your kills between these, allowing time for new spawned enemies to run into and be captured by the dome.
2. Spam [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) at enemies or onto the strangledome to hit all enemies in the dome and kill them.
3. Cast Ensnare onto select targets such as acolytes, as ensnare increases [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) damage
4. Keep [\[Venari\]](/items/arsenal/2409/venari/) on heal mode if you prefer to keep your team topped up on health. 

See here for video guide (old guide before statstick change): https://youtu.be/4ziV7bxU0eU?si=FtyKq8AxoHRtbVZQ

[[ youtube id="4ziV7bxU0eU?si=FtyKq8AxoHRtbVZQ" ]]

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration is mainly used to keep strangledome active so you don't have to keep recasting it. Duration is otherwise not useful for [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/), Ensnare or [\[Venari\]](/items/arsenal/2409/venari/). [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/) and Molt Efficiency give duration.

**Efficiency**
Efficiency can be neutral to positive as long as you run [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) with [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on a companion such as [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/), Panzer or a Hound, and play sufficiently high density maps such as Steel Path Survival. Getting kills on enemies tagged by [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) as well as Eximus can produce health orbs which are converted into energy orbs at a pretty rapid rate. If you don't spam [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) and only kill enemies when they are sufficiently captured by strangledome, you can also reduce your energy expenditure. Primed Flow/[\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/) is needed in order to make Violet Crit Damage shards have double effect. If you still have energy issues, consider using an energy subsume such as Lycath's [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/), Dispensary, Nourish or Spectrorage.

**Range**
Range is the most important stat for [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/), since it benefits the cast range and explosion radius of [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) (note this caps at 200% range), pull radius of Ensnare and finally the size and pull radius of Strangledome.

**Strength**
This is the least important stat since it does not affect ensnare and we do not rely on the damage of Strangledome. While strength does scale into the base damage of [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/), the augment *[\[Accumulating Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/1384/accumulating-whipclaw/)** makes up for the negative strength by allowing you to stack an extra +350% damage which is additive to the bonus provided by ability strength. Since the total amount of damage is capped at +350% and is not affected by strength, we can drop strength completely to minimum.

**Aura**
- Brief Respite - best for endurance runs where you want to stay alive using shield gating. Two casts of whipclaw at neutral efficiency caps max shields with catalyzing shields on
- Corrosive Projection - if running catalyzing shield with Augur stat stick you can use corrosive projection to maximise DPS against armored enemies
- Swift Momentum - good option if you don't own dexterity arcanes to increase combo duration to maintain whipclaw combo
- Steel Charge - gives extra mod capacity to save forma and small boost to [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) (+60% melee damage is additive to dmg mods on statstick, so may not actually contribute that much to overall whipclaw damage, particularly if you have a +dmg riven).
- Combat Discipline - Only run if you use Dispensary and drop Arcane Energize for Arcane Avenger

**Exilus**
Completely flexible slot.
Cunning drift is used to hit the range cap on Whipclaw.
Primed sure footed - best in slot prevents knockdowns. [\[Handspring\]](/items/arsenal/825/handspring/) is next best alternative. Not needed if you run Unairu Poise or Wrym
Vigilante pursuit helps increase enemy radar to track enemies 

**Flexible Slots**
Pilfering Strangledome - Use this in endurance SP survival missions where you want loot and oxygen e.g. steel essence, kuva survival and resource farming. For non-looting missions, you can replace this with either an efficiency mod (streamline/fleeting expertise), more range (stretch) or more survivability mods (Rolling Guard)

Venari Bodyguard - completely OPTIONAL mod for extra backup survivability. Prevents death once every 150s, but you can reduce this cooldown completely by simply getting about 30 to 40 kills. which should take only 20-30s. If you don't find this useful or are subsuming over Venari, simply drop this for Augur Reach or Streamline.

Catalyzing Shields - This is needed to reduce shields and give more effective i-frames per cast of whipclaw. For non-endurance or if you feel you don't need the safety of i-frames and status cleanse, swap this for either augur reach (more range) or streamline (better efficiency). Flexible for Rolling Guard.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Fury - boosts Whipclaw damage 
Arcane Aegis - optional for lazy survivability 
Molt Efficiency - more duration for Strangledome
Arcane Energize - optional for more energy
Arcane Avenger - adds flat 45% crit chance to Whipclaw

**Archon Shards**
2 Amber Cast Speed speeds up Whipclaw/Strangledome/Ensnare
3 Violet Melee Crit Damage to boost [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) further

## HELMINTH
Usually we subsume over [\[Venari\]](/items/arsenal/2409/venari/) since it is the least useful ability and [\[Venari\]](/items/arsenal/2409/venari/) is still technically around even if you subsume over it. If you are NOT looting, you could consider subsuming over Strangledome and just using Ensnare to group.

Lycath's Hunt - Kills from [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/)'s [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) counts as melee kills for Lycath's [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/), giving each [\[Whipclaw\]](/items/arsenal/7443/whipclaw/) kill a 50% chance to drop health orbs. With [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), each health orb gives 55 energy, meaning every 10 kills gives on average 275 energy. This is the highest amount of energy you can generate, and is basically overkill unless you plan on spamming Whipclaw non-stop while NOT using Strangledome. You could therefore subsume this over 4 on a pure DPS build.

Spectrorage - [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) augment allows each kill to have a 50% chance to drop energy orbs, meaning every 10 kills gives on average 125 energy.

Dispensary - creates empowered health orbs that give 100 health as well as normal energy orbs. Each empowered orb is converted into 110 energy by equilibrium.  This is an excellent way to make energy independent of enemies and spawn rates.

Nourish - adds Viral damage buff to Whipclaw AND boosts energy gain from energy/health orbs via equilibrium. Requires more strength, so add Molt Augmented and more strength mods: https://overframe.gg/build/722942/

Roar - boosts damage and triple dips influence, but does not give any energy and requires you to build strength.

Silence - shuts down annoying acolyte, eximus and thrax abilities.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

[[ youtube id="k4Mr8QTXgjc?si=yOz7MPH_p0dJPxJo" ]]

Standard AFK [\[Octavia\]](/items/arsenal/10/octavia/) build utilising mallet to attract, multiply and release enemy damage for AOE nuking, metronome for essentially permanent invisibility as well as speed and multishot buffs and amp to boost your weapon damage and mallet range. Resonator is the subsume slot if you want to helminth, but can also pick up mallet and follow you around if you prefer.

[\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is optional due to Eximus abilities eg fireblasts, as well as if you are dispelled by Violence. This can be flexible for more range, duration or strength.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
With the armor changes, [\[Octavia\]](/items/arsenal/10/octavia/) mallet can now kill levelcap enemies nearly instantly with zero armor strip. Instead of subsuming Pillage, we can consider alternatives like [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) to increase enemy movement and DPS to boost mallet damage, Silence to shut down eximus and acolytes, Nourish to further boost weapon damage and give more energy.

**Variants**
One cast full strip Pillage variant: https://overframe.gg/build/492034/

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
High duration allows easier upkeep on all abilities and buffs, all of which have decent base durations. Any duration of 200% to 250%+ is good.

**Efficiency**
Since duration is so high and each ability only needs to be cast roughly once every minute, we can drop efficiency completely. You only need to spend about 300 energy to refresh all skills, which can be easily regenerated with arcane energize combined with the rate at which enemies die from mallet. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is necessary to store a large amount of energy. Also remember that [\[Octavia\]](/items/arsenal/10/octavia/) regenerates energy on ability cast with her passive (30 energy over 30s per cast which can be refreshed but does not stack higher than 1 energy/s).

**Range**
High range is used to scale the range of mallet, which is further doubled by amp, almost to a 40m radius. Any range between 145 to 200% is fine.

**Strength**
High strength scales the damage multiplier on mallet (approx 5x) so enemies receive much more damage, the multishot/speed/armor/melee bonuses from metronome and the damage multiplier from amp. Any strength between 150-200+ is fine.

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) reduces armor and effectively increases all damage against armored enemies by 1.8x without external strip
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is useful for shield gating in case of acolytes or random damage that hits your through invisibility
[\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/) is good to monitor enemy movements and optimise casts of mallet to hit areas of highest density
Growing Power for more strength

**Exilus**
Cunning drift/power drift are optional
Primed sure footed/handspring are safe options to reduce random knockdowns

**Flexible Slots**
Rolling Guard - this is personal preference, but there will be times where you may be accidentally visible, disrupted by Violence, hit by an eximus fire blast or surrounded by nullifiers and you just need little breathing room with i-frames + status cleanse. I find [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is highly valuable particularly in endurance, and you can replace either Augur Message or Stretch for rolling guard.

Partitioned Mallet - can come in handy for blocking off two chokepoints or defending two different sides of an objective. Note you cannot place two mallets within range of each other.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Crepuscular - 30% strength and +3 flat crit multi while invisible
Molt Efficiency - Bonus duration while shields active which is easy to maintain while invisible
Aegis - decent backup survival tool 
Weapon fire rate/ damage - as needed depending on what weapon you want to use
Status resistances -e.g. toxin for infested missions, slash for grineer endurance

**Archon Shards**
Completely up to personal preference.
- ONE cast speed shard helps the feeling of recasting each buff
- TWO Parkour velocity for mobility
- TWO or more duration shards

## HELMINTH OPTIONS
Subsume over resonator for camping playstyle, subsume over amp for mobile playstyle:
- Nourish - add free viral to weapons and boosts energy generation (could allow you to drop Equilibrium)
- Silence - turns off eximus abilities and acolyte abilities for even more AFK time
- Wrathful Advance - add flat cc to melee weapons, which synergizes with amp
- Pillage - armor strip, status cleanse and shield regen for shield gating - doesn't cause knockdown or reduce enemy DPS onto mallet
- Dispensary - good for camping gameplay for energy regen, may need equilibrium for optimal use
- Bright Bonnet - more strength and energy
- Rage (from rest and rage) - If you subsume rest & rage over resonator, add calm & frenzy augment: https://overframe.gg/build/241245/octavia-prime/rage-against-the-machine-mallet-rage-octavia/
- Breach Surge - double dips Amp damage boost
- Xata's Whisper - can only be subsumed over Amp, but is a mobile buff that can double dip melee stealth multiplier (+700% dmg additive to crit multiplier, active with invisiblity)

## MANDACHORD
Octavia's Mandacord is a looping song in 4/4 time signature with 4 bars (or measures) arranged in a wheel with each bar separted by thick white lines. Each bar has 4 beats divided by thick grey lines and each beat is further divided into 4 smaller notes (sixteenth note or semiquaver). The Mallet is powered by Percussion which is separated essentially into the Kick, Snare and Hihats. The resonator is powered by the Bass which runs on a D pentatonic minor scale with the notes D0, F0, G0, A0, C0. The Metronome is powered by Melody with runs on the same notes as bass but one octave higher. 

Thanks to research by u/StygianFrame (see reddit post https://www.reddit.com/r/Warframe/comments/1ryb7qf/the_mathematically_optimal_octavia_mandachord/), the optimal Mandachord setup involves a large period of rest for percussion in order to **charge** up a damage multiplier. Having 41 rest and 23 percussion filled maximises the damage multiplier to about 480x to 800x, however this leaves a long period without dealing damage and also makes an unusual sounding song with huge break in percussion. The alternative is to have 17 rests and 47 percussion slots which results in about 200x to 400x multiplier instead (about half the effectiveness). 

For Metronome/Melody, you can run 3 sixteenth notes in a row followed by breaks of alternating 8 and 7 rests to improve efficiency of activating invisibility, however if you want to also activate the multishot buff with fully automatic guns you may want to fill all melody.

For percussion you basically want to fill the first 47 percussion slots. I'm alternating the Kick on the 1 and 3 beats and Snare on the 2 and 4 beats for a classic easy pattern, then fill in hihats but drop the first on each beat to create a "ducking" effect (makes the kick and bass pop clearer). Put a bass note on the first of each beat and play around with moving the bass up and down, or you can match bass beats to the melody. 

Instruments Used:
Percussion - Beta
Bass - Epsilon
Melody - Alpha

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast 3
- **Crouch** to beat to activate Nocturne buff to go invisible for 38s, don’t forget to refresh buff BEFORE it runs out to stay invisible
- **Jump** to the beat to activate Vivace buff for movement speed boost 
- **Shoot** to the beat to activate Opera buff for multishot boost
- **Melee** to the beat to activate Forte buff for melee damage boost

2. Cast 4 to boost damage of your weapons, your allies and the mallet damage + range
3. Cast 1, let enemies shoot it and watch the room get nuked
4. Don’t cast resonator since it might carry the mallet around to where you don't want it to go or simply draw aggro away.

## ARSENAL
You will want to use crit based weapons due to Arcane Crepuscular buffing crit damage.

[\[Octavia\]](/items/arsenal/10/octavia/)'s metronome actually plays 8 notes per second when the mandacord is filled as above. Hitting fire one of these 8 notes builds progress on the Opera multishot buff and missing a note makes you lose progress. This means if you want to spam an automatic weapon and activate the Opera multishot buff effortlessly, you will want the fire rate to be exactly 8 (or maybe close to 8). A fire rate of 4 also works but takes about four times as long to activate the buff. Many other fire rates also seem to work fine but also just take longer since it might fluctuate, but generally the faster and non-even numbered the fire rate becomes the harder it will be to proc. This excel spreadsheet I found from reddit user u/VerinSC shows how to mod many weapons to achieve 8 fire rate: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1olJat0jMuKxqiUnsSuclmmK7tvCkmquVArjdo27Oinc/pubhtml#

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This is a hybrid spores oriented Saryn build focused on weapon buffing (with venom dose and toxic lash), AOE armor strip/nuking (with spores and miasma) and speedrunning (molt). If you are having trouble surviving in steel path, you could add a crowd control subsume such as Resonator, Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash or Breach Surge.

Pure Weapon Platform Saryn: https://overframe.gg/build/226696/
Persistence Tanking Gloom Saryn build : https://overframe.gg/build/211170/ 
ESO nuke : https://overframe.gg/build/244100/

**UPDATE AUGUST 2026**
Arcane Sculptor allows you to run 45% efficiency with no [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/) while spamming Molt to lock at 175% efficiency. This allows you to shield gate easily without worrying about energy.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**
With armor changes, a single Tauforged Emerald shard is sufficient to allow up to 98% armor strip. Reaching 100% armor strip with two emerald shards is in comparison only a 14% DPS increase on armor capped enemies. In comparison, a single Tauforged +toxin status damage shard gives 18% or more DPS increase to toxic lash STATUS when running 2-3 Tauforged Toxin shards already, meaning the ideal shard configuration is 1 Tauforged +corrosive stack shard, 3 to 4 Tauforged +toxin status shard and 1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard (Optional).

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Hold 1 to activate [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) and press 3 to activate toxic lash to superbuff your weapon
2. Tap 1 on an enemy to create spores, shoot that enemy while toxic lash is active to spread spores
3. Use 4 occasionally when spore count is low to spread spores more, quick nuke enemies and create viral procs
4. If shields break, tap 2 for instant shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/), status cleanse and aggro [\[Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/836/redirection/) 
5. Also tap 2 Molt to get speed boost for speed running missions.

**Survivability**
In Steel Path you will want to stay out of gunfire completely when possible, by employing cover (stay behind walls and let spores kill in the distance) and a combination of molt and miasma to crowd control enemies if you need to be mobile. Molt draws enemy fire away from you and clears status effects, while miasma creates a brief 2 second radial stun. **Crowd Control** subsumes also makes surviving much much easier, e.g. resonator, shooting gallery (with [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/))

You will additionally employ Shield Gating while using Catalyzing Shields. When your shields break, you will gain up 1.33s of invulnerability frames (i-frames) aka the 'shield gate'. Within this short time, simply tap 2 to regenerate 75 shields, which fully resets max shield capacity (74 with catalyzing shields) giving you another 1.33s i-frames the next time shields break.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration** 
Duration allows easier upkeep of [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) and toxic lash, and prolongs molt's speed buff. Duration is otherwise not particularly requred for spores or miasma. This is flexible depending on preference, either keep it at neutral at 100% or positive at 155% with [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/). [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is a fine alternative, especially if you can't even get [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/), just note that it only applies corrosive status from molt and spores already caps corrosive status at 10 constantly.

**Efficiency**
Efficiency can be negative or near neutral as abilities do not need to be cast too often. Spores only needs to be cast once at the begginning or ocassionally if it wears off. You also occasionally cast molt for survivability and miasma to spread spores when the count is low, or for crowd control/viral procs. Toxic lash/[\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) only needs to be cast about once a minute.

[\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) does however have a very high base energy meaning [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) gives a huge energy pool. You can add [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) over [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) if you prefer.

**Range**
High range greatly benefits spore spreading and miasma radius. 

**Strength**
High strength greatly benefits buffs from [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) and toxic lash, spore growth and decay and miasma damage.
You can add more strength by swapping [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) for Blind Rage, or using both together.

**Arcanes**
Molt Augmented gives a bonus +60% str after 250 kills, easy to get with spores/weapons
Molt Efficiency gives some free duration to help toxic lash uptime
Arcane Aegis helps with passive survivability/shield gating

**Flexible Options**
- [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) and [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/): These are both flexible slots. Can add primed flow for more energy, more strength, augur reach for more range or another augment depending on helminth.

**Aura**
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/): Best for shield gating using Molt without augur mods. Having a single augur mod on a pistol or burst laser prime would allow you to drop Brief Respite.
- [\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/): Great for tracking enemies, but will need multiple augur mods in place of [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/), [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/) or [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) as well as augur mods on your secondary in order to reset shield gate (3 augur mods are needed for full reset at 75% efficiency, 4 augur mods at 100% efficiency). 
- Corrosive Projection: globally reduces armor 

**Exilus** 
- Primed sure footed is best in slot but is locked behind login. Handspring is next best alternative for knockdowns.
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Parkour velocity mods eg [\[Toxic Flight\]](/items/arsenal/851/toxic-flight/)

**Helminth**
Subsume over molt OR miasma (molt is more useful in endurance for shield gating, miasma is more useful in low level nuking):

- **Shooting Gallery** with augment gives amazing crowd control through walls, but requires an augment (put muzzle flash over augur reach). Blinded enemies also take bonus melee stealth dmg (+700% crit damage)

- **Resonator** provides wide area crowd control and doesnt use a mod slot, but doesnt work on acolytes or overguard.

- **Roar** to triple dip on Toxic Lash toxin proc damage and increase spore damage for even more DPS. At 200% strength and using primed faction mod, Toxic Lash status procs therefore gains 8.6x multiiplier. 

- **Nourish** over 4 provides bonus viral damage, boosts toxic lash procs indirectly and magnifies energy gained, and also provides viral AOE proc when you take damage

- **Spectrorage** with spectrosiphon augment produces tons of energy to fuel miasma spam, and also CCs enemies including acolytes: https://overframe.gg/build/283280/saryn-prime/spectrosiphon-spores-saryn/

- **Pillage** is a viable alternative without green shards since it allows full armor stripping and provides shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) for survivability and status cleanse. If you use pillage, don't run brief respite since pillage provides shields already. Can use another aura like enemy radar e.t.c.

- **Terrify** gives crowd control AND full armor strip at only 167% strength, if not using green shards (137% strength needed with corrosive projection)

- **Breach surge** synergizes with the build stats due to building for high range and strength, as well as spores stripping armor so surge sparks do a little more damage. Breach surge also provides line of sight crowd control for slightly cheaper cost than miasma and is spammable for shield gating. 

**Archon Shards**
Very flexible depending on preference:
- 1 Tauforged Amber Cast speed shard is optional but nice quality of life, making Miasma cast much faster and any other helminth abilities.
- 1 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+max corrosive stacks) - allows 13 corrosive status effects on a regular enemy, which strips armor by 98%.  
- 3 (or 4) Tauforged Emerald Shards (+toxin damage) - applies multiplicative increase to toxic lash procs (i.e. 2.35x with 2 tauforged shards).

## ARSENAL

**ACID SHELLS / SOBEK**
- Kuva Sobek (one-shot thrax variant for cascade): https://overframe.gg/build/731864/
- Kuva Sobek Nuke (maximum trash clear damage): https://overframe.gg/build/668084/

[\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) on [\[Sobek\]](/items/arsenal/1237/sobek/) is a mod that allows Toxic Lash to spread across a map via a chain reaction while scaling off %HP. This is because kills made via Toxic Lash can trigger [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) which explodes in a 15m radius and deals 45% HP (currently bugged to not account for steel path modifier meaning its much weaker than it should be), and enemies caught in the 15m radius take a Toxic Lash damage instance which scales off the %HP as 'base damage' which subsequently kills them. They then explode again in a 15m radius and triggers Lash on all enemies in range, chaining forever as long as there are enemies standing within 15m of each other (requires line of sight).

**VULCAN BLITZ / JAT KITTAG**
Jat Kittag (Slam): https://overframe.gg/build/692355/

If you want to slam, [\[Jat Kittag\]](/items/arsenal/974/jat-kittag/) with [\[Vulcan Blitz\]](/items/arsenal/342/vulcan-blitz/) has the same chaining mechanic but a MUCH lower radius of 6m, which means it basically cannot chain very far.

**THERMAGNETIC SHELLS / TENET DETRON**
- Tenet Detron (Thermagnetic Shells): https://overframe.gg/build/692365/

This is basically the secondary version of [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) but with MUCH lower range pf 6m instead of 15m meaning enemies must be extremely close together (within 6m of each other) in order for the effect to chain.


**NIGHTWATCH NAPALM / KUVA OGRIS**
- Kuva Ogris: https://overframe.gg/build/235322/

[\[Kuva Ogris\]](/items/arsenal/2846/kuva-ogris/) is a very weak weapon by itself, but the augment [\[Nightwatch Napalm\]](/items/arsenal/600/nightwatch-napalm/) creates lingering AOE fields of heat damage over 6s, which can trigger Toxic Lash on all enemies that walk into the field and thus continue killing enemies throughout the map. This makes it the highest trash clear KPM possible in the game when paired with [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) since it can be dispersed throughout a tile continuously to kill new spawns almost the moment they spawn in.

**SENTIENT SURGE / OCUCOR**
- Ocucor: https://overframe.gg/build/705641/

Ocucor is the most 'lazy/comfortable' Saryn weapon because it creates seeking tendrils that effectively auto-aims for you and has an augment called Sentient Surge that makes it auto-reload on kill while also boosting critical chance and status chance. [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/) by itself is also very weak but with [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) level buffs it can be made to kill up to levelcap enemies without trouble. The arcane Secondary Fortifier also steals overguard meaning you can just hold down the fire button running around the map while Ocucor auto aims, auto reloads and auto regenerates overguard without worrying about survivability.

*COMBUSTION BEAM / VERMISPLICER**
- Primary Vermisplicer:  https://overframe.gg/build/624759/

Primary Vermisplicer is a kitgun that has an auto-aiming beam that chains when it hits enemies and also has access to the mod [\[Combustion Beam\]](/items/arsenal/621/combustion-beam/). [\[Combustion Beam\]](/items/arsenal/621/combustion-beam/) is like an extremely weak version of [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) in that it can trigger an explosion on death with 600 base damage in a huge 18 m radius (vs [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) which is 450 + %45HP in 15m radius), which can then trigger toxic lash in 18m but scaling off the 600 base dmg only. Therefore in order to make it usable, the strongest possible buffs/debuff are required e.g. exactly what [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) + roar can offer. This would be made more viable alongside AOE armor strip (e.g. spores or corrosive procs) and viral status (e.g. from panzer/hound). Other beams can utilise [\[Combustion Beam\]](/items/arsenal/621/combustion-beam/) too e.g. [\[Tenet Glaxion\]](/items/arsenal/6552/tenet-glaxion/) but [\[Vermisplicer\]](/items/arsenal/5303/vermisplicer/) feels the best since you don't have to aim, can use Pax Charge for passive reload and fits thematically as a 'toxic' weapon.

**SPINNEREX**
- https://overframe.gg/build/858980/

[\[Spinnerex\]](/items/arsenal/7411/spinnerex/) is like a weaker melee version of [\[Combustion Beam\]](/items/arsenal/621/combustion-beam/), where enemies killed after being hit by [\[Spinnerex\]](/items/arsenal/7411/spinnerex/) explode for 450 toxin damage in a 10m radius, which can trigger further Toxic Lash scaling off the 450 dmg, allowing this to chain in 10m intervals. AOE viral and armor strip are required.

**DUAL ICHOR INCARNON**
- Dual Ichor: https://overframe.gg/build/580783/

[\[Dual Ichor\]](/items/arsenal/1104/dual-ichor/) Incarnon passive causes kills from [\[Dual Ichor\]](/items/arsenal/1104/dual-ichor/) to create a cloud or field that persists for 7s that deal 350 toxin damage per second in a 4m radius. The fields have a 50% status chance that cannot be changed by any mods or evolution. The damage of the cloud scales from +damage (e.g. [\[Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/377/pressure-point/), [\[Spoiled Strike\]](/items/arsenal/332/spoiled-strike/), Incarnon bonus, Arcane [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/)), +element (e.g. [\[Primed Fever Strike\]](/items/arsenal/353/primed-fever-strike/), [\[North Wind\]](/items/arsenal/367/north-wind/) etc) and has 0% crit chance with 1x crit multiplier. The damage instances of the cloud will then proc toxic lash which scales off 350 x damage x element which is a decent amount of damage. Enemies killed by the subsequent toxic lash create a further 7s cloud, effectively 'refreshing' the clouds. This allows clouds to self propagate but this does not really 'chain' across a map effectively due to the small 4m range unless enemies are very closely packed together.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a general use and endurance viable Steel Path [\[Dante\]](/items/arsenal/6507/dante/) build using all base abilities including [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/), with helminth options described below. You can focus on using [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) as the primary damage dealer, spamming Dark Verse and Tragedy to deal ability DPS,  use Pageflight to boost status based weapon DPS and Wordwarden for passive priming while using Triumph to stay immortal.

**UPDATE JAN 2026**
Arcane concentration essentially gives 60% duration to all final verse abilities which makes gameplay feel alot better when you need to recast buffs less.

**UPDATE FEB 2025**
Arcane Truculence allows you to proc 10 viral in 30m every time you generate a multiple of 3000 overguard, which occurs very frequently on [\[Dante\]](/items/arsenal/6507/dante/) due to Light Verse and Triumph. 10 Viral boosts all damage to health by 4.25x, thereby consistently boosting Tragedy damage. Swap Molt Efficiency for this is you prefer to maximise Tragedy DPS.

Secondary Encumber on [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) can allow Wordwarden or [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) itself to proc Arcane Impetus to maximum stacks (13) for a +39% efficiency boost and +78% strength boost. This could effectively replace Arcane Steadfast if you feel energy economy is still fine.

Quick video guide and demonstration:

[[ youtube id="s6T86fbbyHc?si=29Q6U5V6OVY2XEh_" ]]

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Keep Triumph buff active at all times (cast Light Verse twice followed by Final Verse: 2, 2, 4) to grant Overguard as well as Overguard with kills.
2. Keep Wordwarden buff active (cast Light Verse, followed by Dark Verse then Final Verse: 2, 3, 4) to summon a [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) companion which helps deal passive DPS or priming.
3. Keep Pageflight buff active (cast Dark Verse followed by Light Verse, then Final Verse: 3, 2, 4) to summon three Paragrimm companions which draw aggro, deal slash status and boost status DPS.
4. Activate Noctua (press 1) and either use it to deal DPS or as a primer/utility depending on your preference. If you are focusing on Tragedy for AOE nuking, use Noctua as a viral primer/ability buffer. 
5. Use Tragedy to nuke enemies in approximately 40m cone range (cast two Dark Verse followed by Final Verse: 3, 3, 4). This will force a total of four slash statuses before compressing approx 4-6s of remaining slash status into one instance, then multiplying it.

# VARIANTS:
- Roar Dante (non-noctua weapon platform + maximum tragedy DPS): https://overframe.gg/build/817819/
- Pure Noctua DPS (Heat based eg for ETA, grineer, disruption): https://overframe.gg/build/817813/
- Pure Noctua DPS (Electric Based e.g. for EDA/murmur): https://overframe.gg/build/711322/
- Pure Melee Influence Weapon Platform: https://overframe.gg/build/647575/

# SURVIVABILITY
You will gain 0.5s i-frames upon losing Overguard and approximately 1s i-frames on losing 240 shield. With Triumph active you can constantly gain Overguard with each kill/kill assist, and Light Verse gives more on-demand Overguard. Additionally constantly casting Tragedy will allow you to constantly regain shields via Augur mods which refreshes your shield gate in case your overguard is down and you are not actively regenerating it.

# BUILD SPECIFICS 
**Duration**
Higher duration gives longer uptime for all buffs (specifically Triumph, Wordwarden, Pageflight) so you don't need to refresh as often, lasting approximately 1 min. Note that [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) can equip [\[Ris Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6365/ris-invocation/) giving a free 60% duration. Archon Shards and Molt Efficiency are additional sources to improve quality of life.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
[\[Dante\]](/items/arsenal/6507/dante/) is a very cast heavy frame and each rotation of Final Verse costs 100 energy to enact at base. Triumph, Wordwarden and Pageflight each last about 1 minute meaning you need to spend 300 energy each minute to keep them active, while Tragedy costs 100 energy to nuke each time. The final efficiency is up to personal preference but you could sit beween 100% to 160% efficiency for a cast heavy Tragedy spam playstyle (without Arcane Steadfast), or 45% (with Equilibrium +/- Arcane Impetus +/- Arcane Steadfast/Mystic Bond +/- [\[Netra\]](/items/arsenal/2831/netra/) Invocation) on a more weapon focused playstyle. To restore energy, use a combination of Equilibrium and Xata Invocation (10 energy/s). [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) gives a high energy pool to cast Tragedy frequently. Arcane Steadfast is a great option that gives free casts. [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) also allows you to equip [\[Netra Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6364/netra-invocation/) which gives a free 60% efficiency and even procs [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion for another free 30% efficiency. As a final bonus [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is OPTIONAL but can be triggered via either [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) OR Wordwarden when it is modded for Viral Electric. [\[Mystic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6276/mystic-bond/) is also optional on your companion.

**Range**
Some range is needed for nuke range although both Dark Verse and Tragedy are line of sight, meaning you cannot damage enemies beyond the size of a normal room. ARCHON STRETCH is OPTIONAL but gives some free passive energy generation if noctua/wordwarden is modded for electric.

**Strength**
High strength affects the damage of Noctua, damage of Dark Verse, overguard from Light Verse/Triumph, multiplier of Tragedy and the damage/status boost of Pageflight, making this the most important stat. Running Molt Augmented  and [\[Vome Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6366/vome-invocation/) effectively gives +120% bonus strength to over 300% final strength. 

**[\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) vs [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/)**
Note [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) is flexible with [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/). While [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) boosts Triumph, Wordwarden and Pageflight to maximum possible values, it does NOT affect either Noctua damage or Dark Verse damage/slash procs. If you tend to use a combination of [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) + Dark Verse + Tragedy to deal DPS, you will be better off using Umbral Intensify since it affects all these abilities equally. If you tend to use your own weapons and rely on Triumph/Pageflight/Wordwarden more to support gameplay or use Tragedy without relying so much on Dark Verse procs, you are better off running [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/). If you also subsume Roar over 1, use [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) instead of [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/).

**Flexible slots**
Blind Rage: If you don't feel comfortable with negative efficiency and are not running some combination of Netra Invocation/Xata Invocation/[\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) or Arcane Steadfast, swap this for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) and consider even adding [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/).
[\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/): This just gives bit of extra duration and shield gating for times when you are spamming dark verse but have overguard down. This can be swapped for [\[Constitution\]](/items/arsenal/789/constitution/) at the cost of more forma, or even more strength e,g [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) at the cost of duration and forma.

**Aura**
Corrosive Projection reduces armor (effectively 1.8x dmg boost against fully armored enemies, especially for Noctua, although Tragedy/Final Verse ignores armor)
[\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) gives more strength.
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is optional for backup shield gating in addition to overguard gating.

**Exilus**
Since overguard provides knockdown resistance, Primed Sure Footed is not needed unless you subsume over 2, which is not recommended.
Flexible options:
- Preparation - starts you with enough energy on missions start to activate all buffs
- Power Drift - more strength
- Cunning Drift - more range

**Arcanes**
Very flexible depending on preference and accessibility:
- Arcane Impetus - when combined with encumber on noctua can provide up to 39% efficiency and 78% strength bonus
- Arcane Concentration - free 60% duration for 3s after cast. This works very well since you need to cast two abilities immediately before activating final verse.
- Arcane Truculence - gives max viral procs in 30m range when gaining overguard.
- Arcane Steadfast or Energize - for better energy economy
- Arcane Camisado - gives 60% str for next cast after Pageflight stacks it
- Molt Augmented - gives free 60% str after 250 kills
- Molt Efficiency - gives up to 36% duration with shield active
- Arcane Velocity - boosts Noctua fire rate
- Arcane Hotshot - boosts crit by modded 300% if modding heat on noctua/wordwarden
- Arcane Avenger - boosts crit by flat 45% but need to take damage (works on overguard still)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
General use Steel path [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) build using his full kit to provide shield regen for shield gating, high range of crowd control, energy regen for the team, reload/fire rate buffs and long duration covenant for both invulnerability window (i-frames) and crit buff. 

Update 34: [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) has indirectly been buffed by shield gating changes, since Condemn allows you to gain overshields basically every cast, meaning you can gain more shield gate i-frames than previously allowed. Currently Overshields count meaning hitting 1150 overshield with Condemn gives 2.5s shield gate, even WITHOUT [\[Primed Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/6441/primed-redirection/). Once this is fixed, [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) will instead get 2s of gate unless you slot [\[Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/836/redirection/). Having Augur mods allows you to generate small amounts of shields for a tiny gate (about 0.5s) even if enemies are out of range of Condemn, for extra backup gating.

**Build Alternatives**
Evade Lasting Covenant PERMANENT INVIS + CRIT variant: https://overframe.gg/build/258768/
Pillage FULL-STRIP variant: https://overframe.gg/build/374713/
Thermal Sunder NUKE Harrow: https://overframe.gg/build/274897/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Channel Thurible when you have enough starting enough pool to hit higher energy regen per kill. You want to hit at least 30-40 energy/kill (e. .about 3 seconds), so each headshot kill gives you about 100 energy, but leave enough leftover energy to cast Condemn at least once for safety. When you need to refresh Thurible in the middle of battle, simply use i-frames from either [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) (3s) or Covenant and channel while invincible. You can also press 3 and 4 at the same time, so you are immortal while channeling Thurible, and you can fit two full rotations of covenant (33s) into roughly one thurible time (64s+3s channel). 
2. Spam Condemn whenever possible for crowd control and overshield generation, which also makes getting headshots much easier.
3. Use Penance when at high overshields while invulnerable (with [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) or covenant) then immediately regenerate shields with Condemn OR cast Condemn first and immediately cast penance, which will use up your overshields while condemn refills your shields simultaneously so you never drop down to zero shield.
4. Use Covenant when near enemies and absorb damage to convert into crit chance buff. You only need to prevent approximately 2000 damage to hit maximum buff. 
5. Land headshots whenever possible to regenerate more energy and see red crits.

Here is a short video guide on how to play Harrow: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Escs1Cz1800

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration benefits all abilities meaning less energy is spent overall, less time spent micromanaging ability casts to refresh buffs and longer i-frames from covenant. 

**Efficiency**
Minimum efficiency paired with [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is fine for [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) since Thurible will give us a consistent source of energy regeneration and most abilities will have a long duration.

**Range**
High range is useful for crowd control from Condemn and the aura of Thurible so your team can benefit from energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/). This is the most flexible stat based on your preference. You can add [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) over [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) if you prefer much longer duration in low level missions where crowd control is not as necessary.

**Strength**
High strength benefits all of [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/)'s abilities but there are no strength breakpoints required to make each ability function well. Having higher strength makes it slightly easier to cap overshields with 1, give a higher penance buff, give slightly more energy from thurible and makes it easier to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) critical cap of 50% on Covenant. 

**Flexible Slots** 
*Natural Talent* is now flexible if you can slot 2 or more Amber Archon shards for cast speed. 
*Augur Message / Augur Reach* are both flexible slots

Flexible slots can be swapped for:
- Umbral Intensify - will need additional forma. [\[Archon Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/5923/archon-intensify/) also works but requires active healing from Penance and therefore loss of health, which can be difficult unless you run combat discipline.
- Streamline- if you have issues with energy economy despite Thurible
- Lasting Covenant augment - gain potentially infinite duration of crit bonus but lose the i-frames from covenant. Good for non-endurance speedruns where you want to do alot damage consistently and don't need i-frames.
- Narrow Minded - significant increase duration so less reactivation of abilities is required. if you use narrow minded, need to add overextended to counterbalance range drop and maybe umbral intensify to counterbalance strength drop.
- Tribunal augment - use this if you also want to play a support role for your team by sharing the buffs of penance and thurible.

*Rolling Guard* - preferred in high level/SP missions for status cleanse and more i-frames in addition to covenant. If you don't like this or need it, can swap for:
- Adaptation - ok to use in lower level missions to shield tank
- Narrow minded - counterbalance with overextended 

*Aura* 
- Enemy radar is ideal as it allows you to track enemy density before activating covenant and thurible. 
- Corrosive Projection gives small amount of additive armor strip
- Combat Discipline can be used to proc Arcane Avenger for even more crits. Health lost on kill is healed by penance.

*Exilus*
- Primed Sure Footed is ideal to prevent all knockdown. Handspring is next best alternative
- Ice Spring for mobility

**Focus**
- Vazarin is the ideal school as protective dash gives even more i-frames in between casts of Covenant and cooldown of rolling guard, giving you a near constant amount of i-frames. Vazarin's passive also increases affinity range which scales both the bonuses of penance and covenant.
- Madurai gives amp damage boosts and +40% bonus strength

**Arcanes**
Completely flexible and up to you. Arcanes that proc off headshots synergize well since [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) is all about getting headshots.

Warframe arcanes:
Molt Efficiency gives free extra duration with shields active, which is easy to maintain with Condemn. 
Molt Vigor/Molt Augmented gives free extra strength to boost penance/thurible.
Arcane Pistoleer gives ammo efficiency on headshots with your secondary
Arcane Consequence gives lots of parkour velocity on headshots
Arcane Rage/Precision

**Archon Shards**
Totally up to personal preference, but adding 2 or more Amber shards allows you to drop [\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/) for one of the other flexible options.

## HELMINTH
[\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/)'s kit is generally full and synergistic so helminth is usually unnecessary. Here are some interesting options to try nevertheless: 

**NUKE HARROW**
- Thermal Sunder - replace 1 or 2, allows Harrow to nuke lower level/unarmored/non SP enemies with thermal sunder spam, which is sustainable due to thurible. Great choice for relic speedruns and even sanctuary onslaught. Add Overextended and Umbral Intensify over rolling guard/consitutition and augur reach. e.g. https://overframe.gg/build/274897/

**LOOT HARROW**
- Petrify with Ore Gaze - subsume over 1 or 2 and replace constitution with Ore Gaze (brief respite is optional).

**VOID HARROW**
- Xata's Whisper over 2 - the void damage of [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper double dips headshot multipliers and can create a bullet attractor field that draws further projectiles to the head if the first bullet was a headshot. This has excellent synergy with Harrow who specializes in headshots.

Other mentions:
- Pillage can be used to replace Condemn IF you are okay with giving up your only crowd control option, in favour of slightly easier shield regen and armor/shield strip. This is only recommended in lower levels where crowd control is not as crucial to survival. You can drop range if you subsume away condemn for pillage.
- Ensnare can be used over 1 or 2 for great crowd control and grouping that allows you to line up headshots in rapid succession
- Silence - universally useful crowd control that stuns enemies for 2s, which can be refreshed on rentering range, giving you breathing room before casting condemn. Also disables special abilities of enemies, including acolyte abilities (even violence).
- Gloom - doesn't actually synergize well with [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/)'s kit since you cannot regenerate energy from Thurible while gloom is draining, and slowed enemies shoot you less for covenant. You can however turn gloom off when you need to regenerate energy on demand and use [\[Lasting Covenant\]](/items/arsenal/167/lasting-covenant/) to keep the crit buff activate at all times.
	
## ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION

General Use [\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/) build for buffing yourself, your team, crowd control with shock motes and breach surge, staying alive with Shield Gating and i-frames from Wil-O-Wisp (which scales better in endurance) and nice DPS/KPM boosts from using Breach surge and Haste mote. This can be used in general starchart, base steelpath or endurance steel path/arbitrations.

Nourish, Eclipse or Roar are the best general DPS helminth options to use. Nourish in particular applies bonus Viral damage to both weapons AND breach surge sparks while also also giving energy multiplier to sustain a shield gating playstyle while at 45% effficiency. 

**UPDATE JAN 2025**
[\[Worthy Comradery\]](/items/arsenal/7187/worthy-comradery/) in Aura is now a nice choice because it applies to Breach Surge sparks giving it 175% cc on headshots, allowing it to orange crit.
Arcane Crepuscular applies during both passive jump invisibility (with melees) and invisibility from 2. The critical damage buff even applies to breach surge sparks!
I have added lots more duration so you get longer invisibility from Wil o Wisp if you prefer to shoot guns (since shooting doesnt break invis from 2). If you are using melees like contagion/glaives, you could opt to not run as much duration.

VEILBREAKER UPDATE: 
use [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) for a little bonus energy from Shock Motes and [\[Archon Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/5923/archon-intensify/) to get 60% strength after healing with motes. Use Archon Shards with 2 cast speed to replace Natural Talent.

**VARIANTS:**
Sole Gate Nuke (Roar): https://overframe.gg/build/550522/
Red Crit Weapon Platform (Energized Munitions): https://overframe.gg/build/599184/
Pure Mote Support Buff variant (Roar): https://overframe.gg/build/511107/


**Alternate tanking playstyle**
If you prefer NOT to shield gate or be invisible and prefer passive tankiness, simply put Arcane [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) for armor and [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) over Catalyzing Shield. [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) mote provides health for eHP.

# PLAYSTYLE

[[ youtube id="d_H3bWByR0I" ]]

1. Cycle Reservoirs by tapping 1 (unless running [\[Fused Reservoir\]](/items/arsenal/5462/fused-reservoir/)) and plant one of each by holding 1. Haste motes and Shock motes will be your most important ones to use. Haste motes buff your movespeed, melee speed and weapon fire rate. Shock motes are your major source of crowd control. [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) mote is less important in Steel Path and endurance with shield gating but the healing and health buff can be useful when required, or for team setups. Remember Reservoirs have *infinite* duration so on a static map or with camping you simply lay down up to 6 reservoirs and never cast them again, just run through to pick up motes as needed.

2. Stay invisible by either jumping or tapping 2 whenever you can. Whenever your shields break, tap Wil-o-[\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/) (2) once to go invisible, create a decoy and fully reset shield gate. If you are afflicted by a damaging status (e.g. toxin, heat, slash) or are surrounded by enemies and damaging AOE effects (e.g napalm), double tap 2 to gain 3s of i-frames. You may need to repeat this to wait out the status procs (default duration 6s). This is basically [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) but without status cleanse or cooldown. With THREE augur mods on frame and TWO augur mods mod on a secondary or sentinel secondary, a single cast of Wil-o-[\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/) generates 108 shield at 45% efficiency, which gives 0.8s shield gate without [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/), while Breach Surge gives 0.92s iframes. If you add [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) over [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) or Secrets, you can gain 1.33s now from pressing either 2 or 3, without needing a pistol. This is optional. [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is also optional if you prefer to clear statuses instantly.

3. Cast Breach Surge to blind enemies (requires line of sight). Shoot blinded enemies (doesn't have to be in the glowing spot) to generate breach surge sparks (10% on hit and 100% on death). Each spark will take the weapon damage that caused the spark, multiply it by around 5-6x and deal that in radiation damage (with potential to headshot). Nourish will apply Viral damage to breach surge sparks. You can also teleport to motes by casting 3 on them, which will double the radius of breach surge. Casting Breach Surge while 2 is active will also duplicate breach surge at the clone location.

4. If you replace Sol Gate with Nourish/Eclipse, then simply keep Nourish/Eclipse active.

5. Take advantage of [\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/)'s passive by jumping repeatedly in the air to stay invisible.


# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Keep duration high (at least 150% or more) so you can stay invisible for longer. Adding molt efficiency is optional but increases final Duration to 187%. This helps with uptime of Mote buffs, invisibility duration of Wil-o-Wisp and Nourish/Eclipse which are most important. The duration for Breach Surge stun is less important due to its very long base duraiton.

**Efficiency**
All of Wisp's abilities apart form Sol Gate have a relatively low cost so you can get away with negative efficiency (45-75%). [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) or [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) are both optional and up to preference. If you run Nourish, Arcane Energize or [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/), you will be able to fill [\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/)'s large base energy pool easily allowing you to have many more casts. You can also alternatively just run Streamline or even neither energy mods depending on your preference.

**Range**
Range can be positive to very high (145-235%) so Breach Surge has a high stun radius (especially on open maps like Circuit), shock motes have a high stun radius and Nourish retaliation covers a wider area. Adjust this to your preference. If you prefer maximium duration for wil-o-wisp you could put narrow minded over augur secrets.

**Strength**
Strength is the main stat to build high (250-350%) for high Haste mote buff, health mote buff, Breach Surge multiplier and helminth ability multiplier.

**Flexible Options**
- Catalyzing Shields - forces 1.33s shield gate upon any shield gained currently (e.g. gaining a bit of shield via augur mods).
- Vigorous Swap - boosts Breach Surge damage by 2.65x and also multiplicative to Glaives and Exodia Contagion
- Natural Talent - very useful for mote and breach surge cast speed, but flexible if you run Madurai and use operator alot or spend two archon shards. 
- Primed Flow - flexible if you prefer a large energy pool
- Rolling Guard - optional for status cleanse and more i-frames independent of casting 2
- Critical Surge - this has been buffed to now give up to 250% cc to all primary weapons based on distance traveled when teleporting via Breach Surge

**Aura**
Completely flexible:
- [\[Worthy Comradery\]](/items/arsenal/7187/worthy-comradery/): multiplies breach surge crit chance, meaning you can make it hit 175% cc and orange crit on headshots (not consistent).
- Corrosive Projection: multiplies damage against armored enemies by about 1.8x
- [\[Combat Discipline\]](/items/arsenal/2727/combat-discipline/): This helps with three possible things, take measured self damage so you can proc arcane avenger consistently, proc nourish AOE with forced viral status and brief stun (if subsumed) and proc Archon Intensify since it requires actual healing of lost health by health mote.
- Brief Respite : only use this if you don't want to run any Augur mods but still want to shield gate.
- Growing Power: for more strength

**Exilus**
Completely optional/flexible:
- Ice Spring gives parkour and aim-glide duration
- Power Drift for slightly more strength
- Primed Sure Footed or Handspring for knockdown (or run Unairu Poise)
- Boreal's Anguish gives aim glide duration and reduced gravity

**Arcanes**
Completely flexible options:
- Arcane Crepuscular: gives 30% strength and 3x flat crit dmg, requires you to keep 2 invisibility active or jump and use melees
- Arcane Arachne: boosts breach surge sparks by 2.5x and double dips exodia contagion/glaives
- Arcane Concentration: 60% duration after cast
- Molt Augmented: 60% strength after 250 kills. Good in longer missions or endurance for even bigger buffs and breach surge/eclipse multipliers.
- Arcane Avenger: flat crit +45%, can be self triggered by combat discipline
- Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/): Bonus 45% strength but only on one ability cast after going into operator and using an operator ability. Can be useful to lock higher Reservoir buffs and Eclipse buff since you don't need to cast these very often.
- Molt Efficiency: Bonus 36% duration 
- Arcane Energize: If you don't run Nourish and need energy.

**Archon Shards**
Amber Shards: 1 tauforged cast speed shard speeds up casts of all abilities
Rest are preference and flexible:
- Crimson Shards: As many strength or duration shards as you like 
- Amber Shards: Parkour velocity for mobility
Personally I run 2 parkour and 2 duration shards

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
- Nourish: Has multiple benefits
1. Gives around raw viral damage boost to you and your teammates, which is additive to other elemental mods on your weapons. This means you can drop viral mods on many of your weapons.
2. Gives around raw viral damage boost to Breach Surge (semi double dipping it) and Breach Surge sparks now deal viral damage which further receive a 1.5x multiplier against corrupted enemies
3. Getting hit or causing self damage via [\[Combat Discipline\]](/items/arsenal/2727/combat-discipline/) activates an AOE forced viral status with brief stagger (for mild crowd control) with a 2s cooldown with approximate radius of 14 to 28m.
4. Gives an energy multiplier from all sources which allows Archon Stretch to generate more energy passively. 

- Eclipse: Eclipse gives only 30% buff at base helminth strength, however, Eclipse still boosts Breach Surge sparks and also double dips melees like Glaives and Contagion meaning if you want to specifically buff a [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) setup like [\[Xoris\]](/items/arsenal/4660/xoris/), [\[Falcor\]](/items/arsenal/1434/falcor/), [\[Glaive Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1127/glaive-prime/), you could still use Eclipse. At 300% strength, Eclipse double dips Contagion and Glaives for a 3.61x final damage multiplier and therefore multiplies final breach surge sparks created by Contagion by 6.85x. Use Eclipse for Exodia Contagion while using Melee Duplicate.

- Roar: More consistent multiplier that double dips DoT effects AND applies buff to your allies, but with lower maximum raw damage potential. At 300% str, Roar only has a 2x multiplier, meaning Breach Surge receives only a 4x multiplier. Roar also does not double dip Exodia Contagion or Glaives, but does triple dip melee influence procs, so use this when using Falcor/Xoris.

- Wrathful Advance: boosts melee crit chance if you choose to use contagion/glaives, but does not affect breach surge.

- Pillage: Strips Armor/Shields, Cleanses status effects and restores shields. You either need 400% strength to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) one cast full strip armor strip OR just 328% strength with Corrosive Projection (reachable by just adding a few strength shards or power drift in exilus).

- Brightbonnet: You can bounce on it and stay invisible indefinitely while also boosting strength for motes and giving energy to the team

# ARSENAL
**WEAPONS***
[\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/)'s passive of invisibility while airborne is broken by shooting primary and secondary weapons, but not broken by melee attacks. This includes ranged melee attacks that work well while jumping, including Glaives and Exodia Contagion. Note if using Contagion, you will want to subsume Eclipse for maximum damage.

**EXODIA CONTAGION ZAW**
Exodia Contagion is an arcane that can be attached on a modular melee weapon called a Zaw. A single RANK 0 copy of Exodia Contagion is all you actually need in day to day use, as increasing the rank of contagion does not really provide noticeable benefit since it only affects how much damage you do AFTER it travels 30m (which is a HUGE distance). To use contagion, you need to double jump or bullet jump into the air then aim glide then attack. This will launch a projectile that direct hits for 2x damage and also explodes on impact dealing 5x damage in 8m. The direct hit component has 'multiplicative [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/)' meaning [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) multiplies with [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) and priming a single enemy before launching contagion will result in HUGE damage, and can also headshot and headcrit. The AOE component has NO benefit from [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) and cannot headshot either. It is up to you whether you want to run [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) for huge numbers on single targets or no [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) for pure AOE.

RAW DAMAGE CONTAGION:
