**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION

[[ youtube id="B5oTQ9o1-Yo?si=t4HZwwmYldZo_kJQ" ]]

While the classic hall of mirrors build uses the *[\[Hall Of Malevolence\]](/items/arsenal/117/hall-of-malevolence/)* augment to increase the damage of [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/)'s holograms, the often overlooked *[\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/)* augment actually does work on holograms and provides a much more substantial boost to hologram damage provided the lighting conditions are bright. In fact, with high enough power strength while in maximum lighting, [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/)'s holograms under the effect of [\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/) outdamage the player under the effect of eclipse. This is further magnified by using both augments in the same build since their effects are multiplicative. At maximum lighting and maximum stacks, each hologram does approximately 9 times more damage. Since each hologram does approx 60% of weapon damage at 300% str, the total of four clones is 240% weapon damage, which is redistrbuted over 2 holograms when using primary/secondary weapons so each hologram actually does does 120% weapon damage. Boosting this by 9x means each hologram does a maximum possible of 1080% weapon damage!

**Update March 2025** - Due to the armor/health changes, armor strip from Pillage is no longer really necessary and a more passive and easy method of survivability over Pillage is passive shield recharge. This combined with staying mobile, killing fast and innate dodge from hall of mirrors helps you survive without actively casting abilities to gate. The subsume helminth is very flexible and you can tailor to your preference e.g. Nourish gives free viral for weapons and boosts energy, Wrathful Advance buffs melees, Omamori makes the passive survivability even more chill.

**Update April 2024** - Eclipse is no longer dependent on environmental lighting and gives the FULL damage buff or damage reduction based on whether you tap or hold 3. Make sure you go into control settings and INVERT the tap/hold setting for [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/), so tap becomes casting the light damage buff.

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 3 to activate damage buff of Eclipse (make sure to invert tap hold settings as default is hold for light), and keep active at all times
2. Tap 1 to activate Hall of Mirrors, and get kills to build up [\[Hall Of Malevolence\]](/items/arsenal/117/hall-of-malevolence/). Mirror clones help draw aggro to so enemies sometimes miss when they shoot you.
3. Optional: Tap 2 to near certain objects to booby trap them e.g. convert laser barriers to friendly, lockers into bombs that deal true damage of remaining HP, turrets into friendly turrets,  In addition, tapping 2 while 1 is active places five total jewels that can explode or blind enemies giving minor crowd control (although in a very small radius at 34 range).

# SURVIVABILITY
**PASSIVE SHIELD GATING/RECHARGE**
Currently [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) causes any amount of shield gained to give the full 1.33s shield gate (likely bug). This means gaining even 1 shield before taking damage again should give another 1.33s gate. If you run [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) with [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/), you can reduce the shield recharge delay to 1s. If you take any damage during the 1.33s shield gate, it will reset the delay timer back to 1s, meaning once you come out of a shield gate you have approximately anywhere between 0s to 1s before shields start regenerating again depending on when you last got "hit". If you can avoid being hit at during that 0 to 1s time frame, you can be effectively immortal to non-toxin damage. Hall of Mirrors causes enemies to miss which significantly reduces the change of you being hit in that time frame. Additional layers of optional protection include Arcane Aegis (when this procs you get 12 full seconds of effective immortality), Omamori which has a 50% chance to block damage and restore shields to overshield, [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) on a sentinel which regenerates shields on break with a cooldown and Secondary Fortifier on a pistol. Rolling Guard finally also gives you more i-frames to bridge that gap but with a cooldown. 

# VARIANT BUILDS
Prism Nuke: https://overframe.gg/build/234415/
ESO Legerdemain Nuke: https://overframe.gg/build/204158/

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Strength**
Strength boosts Eclipse, [\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/) and the damage, critical chance and status chance of Hall of Mirrors. We want to hit at least 250% strength so Hall of Mirrors clones have equivalent damage and crit/status stats to your equipped weapon.

**Duration**
Decent duration achieved with [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) + archon shards allows an upkeep on both Hall of Mirrors and Eclipse of almost one minute which is very comfortable.

**Range**
[\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) reduces the range to 34%, which reduces the range of Total Eclipse to 5m, enough to encompass the holograms but not enough to be helpful in co-op situations. If you want to provide a little more support in co-op play, you can increase the range with [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) or [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/).

**Efficiency**
While 45% efficiency seems low, keep in mind you only need to cast 1 and 3 roughly once every minute and recast Nourish if needed, while Nourish also boosts all energy gained so you should always have enough to recast your abilities.

**Augments**
Both [\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/) and [\[Hall Of Malevolence\]](/items/arsenal/117/hall-of-malevolence/) are optional depending on the type of weapon you are focusing on. If you use AOE weapons that do benefit from holograms you can keep both augments. If you use single target weapons you may not require the augments. If you use melee slam, glaive explosions or exodia contagion, holograms do NOT benefit and you should swap both augments out for other mods e.g.
- Primed Continuity for more duration
- Umbral Intensify/Transient Fortitude for more strength
- Equilibrium for more energy economy
- Nira's Hatred for Slam
- Vigorous Swap for Contagion/Glaives

**Aura**
This is flexible (don't need to add an Aura forma).
- Corrosive Projection: reduces armor to 82% which is effectively a 1.7x damage multiplier on armored enemies
- Growing Power: more strength
- Brief respite: allows manual shield gating, which shouldn't be necessary on this build

**Exilus**
Totally flexible: 
- Power drift for more strength
- Primed sure footed if you own it prevents knockdowns
- Nira's Anguish if using slam
- Parkour Velocity e.g. ice spring/[\[Mobilize\]](/items/arsenal/847/mobilize/), [\[Endurance Drift\]](/items/arsenal/66/endurance-drift/), [\[Amar's Anguish\]](/items/arsenal/5622/amars-anguish/)

**Subsumed Ability**
You can subsume over either 2 or 4. I have subsumed Nourish over 2 here because you can share a Nourish subsume with a Prism build.

- *Nourish* is a great choice that solves any energy issues while also providing free viral damage to your weapons (meaning you can drop viral mods if running viral HM or viral heat builds).
- *Omamori* offers an additional layer of lazy survivability that makes [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/) even harder to kill for little effort. If you run Omamori, you can drop [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for Primed Continuity. This is because Omamori can refill shields on negating damage to overshields, which can give up to 2.5s i-frame instead of the locked 1.33s gate from catalyzing shields.
- *Pillage* (from [\[Hildryn\]](/items/arsenal/2388/hildryn/)) is an amazing ability for high strength glass cannon Mirage since it provides a form of shield recovery for shield gating and FULL armor/shield strip in one cast.
- *Wrathful Advance* lets your melee red crit, e.g. espeecially when using Glaives or Contagion
- *Energized Munitions* is amazing when you want to spam something for non-stop damage, but doesn't apply to incarnon modes
- *Evade* is another survivability option but requires consistent headshot upkeep. If you run this you can drop all the shield recharge mods and catalyzing shields and pump more duration and strength (primed continuity, augur message, umbral intensify)
- *Breach Surge* gives a line of sight blind for decent crowd control and relases sparks on death that is a multiple of damage done. Eclipse double dips this spark potentially creating insane amounts of damage. If you use this, you can run a much more balanced build as follows:  https://overframe.gg/build/496882/mirage-prime/breach-surge-mirage-triple-augment/
- *Spellbind* gives status and knockdown immunity, particularly useful if you don't own primed sure footed but want to use AOE weapons
- *Molt* gives speed boost and draws enemy fire. Good for speedrunning.
- *Null Star* can combine with health/[\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) for lazy tanking but needs even more duration (drop [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/)). Not really recommended since you waste lots of mod slots and need augment to refresh stars if you lose them. You can swap strength for duration ([\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) for [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/)) in order to hit the 90% DR cap, which can multiply with the 90% DR from eclipse to give 99% DR to health. Add [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and guardian if you like for even more DR, exceeding 99.95%.

**Arcanes**
Reasonably flexible depending on your playstyle. 
- Arcane Aegis : additional layer of survivability but dependent on RNG
- Augmented : bonus strength
- Can use any DPS boosting arcane depending on weapon  e.g.  Precision, Velocity, for pistols
- Pistoleer for pistols and ammo efficiency
- Arcane Fury for melee
- Arcane Arachne for Glaives/Contagion 

**Archon Shards**
TWO Amber Cast Speed Shards (helps with recasting abilities and also if you want to use Prism build in other configs)
THREE Crimson Duration Shards (helps with uptime of 1 and 3 and also for Prism build)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION

General Use Steel Path and Endurance viable Hybrid weapon platform + sunder [\[Gauss\]](/items/arsenal/2716/gauss/) build for utilising all base abilities with a focus on using weapons to deal damage, cold sunder to crowd control enemies + build redline and heat sunder to strip and deal AOE damage. Mach Rush provides fast map traversal, battery charge and light CC + AOE damage. Kinetic Plating gives complete knockdown/stagger immunity, near complete status immunity and up to 100% damage reduction to impact, puncture, slash, cold, heat and blast damage at max battery, as well as energy generation on taking damage. Thermal Sunder is an amazing ability that allows you to hard crowd control enemies with freeze (at full redline) or soft CC with cold procs/heat procs, do scaling nuking with heat sunder spam or at full redline perform full armor strip in AOE by combining one heat and one cold sunder into blast (any order). Redline gives multiple buffs to fire rate, melee speed, reload speed and holster speed in addition to several bonus synergies for the other abilities such as half cost of mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/), melee damage bonus and stagger bonus to kinetic plating.

**Variant Builds**
Pure Thermal Sunder spam for nuking up to levelcap: https://overframe.gg/build/591349/
Pure Weapon spam (energized munitions): https://overframe.gg/build/591358/
Max speed meme (molt) or high damage weapon platform (roar): https://overframe.gg/build/327555/gauss/gauss-molt-speed-meme/

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
The new Arcane [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) can give +40% strength and duration and can be easily triggered by casts of Cold sunder, and even triggers when Cold Sunder combines with Heat sunder to make Blast, as long as the enemy doesn't die straight away. 

**ARCHON VITALITY/VEILBREAKER UPDATE**
Archon Vitality now doubles heat procs which significantly increases the output/scaling of Thermal Sunder (since the fused blast damage increases with the number of heat procs). If you are using shield gating, you can use a rank 0 [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) to save mod capacity. If you are using health tanking, you can use a max rank [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/).

# PLAYSTYLE

[[ youtube id="e0eIyjPa-BY?si=TJFAm8VMdQpqJQ0G" ]]

You can invert the default settings for thermal sunder so tap becomes heat sunder if you prefer.

1. Activate 2 and 4 as soon as possible and keep refreshed at all times. You can cancel and reactivate when they are close to expiring in a safe location rather than letting them run out in the middle of enemies.

2. Build up battery charge as quickly as possible by using 1 and cold 3 (tap 3 default for cold sunder) to generate +10% battery per cast until you hit 100% with Redline active (i.e. simply casting cold sunder 5 times and mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) 5 times maxes the battery). This will give you 100% damage reduction to IPS,cold,heat,blast on Kinetic Plating as well as allow for 100% armor strip on Thermal Sunder. **IMPORTANT NOTE:** Battery level is the blue bar in the right lower corner and does NOT have a numerical indicator. The Redline level is an entirely SEPARATE numerical number given by the percentage to the left of the battery bar. Your goal is to simply keep your battery ABOVE the horizontal red line (marks 80% battery) or ideally at 100% battery which will cause your 'Redline' % to steadily grow to 100%, with fastest growth at 100% battery. Note this rate of growth is limited by your duration (takes 1/3 of you duration minimum to hit 100%), and is not really affected by how often you spam 1 or 3 once you are already at 100% battery. Once you hit 100% redline, your battery will no longer drain at all.

3. Absorb damage to generate energy while Kinetic Plating is active, although note you will lose battery when this happens before you hit 100% redline.

4. Spam 1 and run into enemies into walls to knock enemies around for light CC and to generate battery. Melee attack to generate battery or shoot enemies to kill them.

5. When BELOW MAX REDLINE: Tap 1 to mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) and  ap 3 (default cold) to create zones of cold that can crowd control enemies (tap once for cold proc to slow, tap twice for full freeze or full freeze with one tap at 100% redline) and generate battery. Once you are at 100% battery, but below max redline, you can alternate casts of ONE HEAT SUNDER (-10% battery), followed by quick tapping ONE MACH [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) (+10% to bring back to 100%), followed by ONE COLD SUNDER to full strip and group enemies. The amount of armor stripped depends on the proportion of the last 20% of battery unlocked during Redline (i.e. 80% battery is 0 out of 20% meaning 0% armor strip, 90% battery is 50% strip and 100% battery is 100% strip). Since you are constantly losing battery, dropping 1% below 100%  battery before max redline means you may only be stripping 95% armor on combining cold after using heat and mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/). Using [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) actually reduces the required battery level for full strip to be 82% of the last 20% of battery i.e. 96.4% of total battery, basically guaranteeing a single cast full strip everytime you perform the HEAT, MACH [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/), COLD combo. Performing this combo basically maintains near 100% battery to allow redline to continue to grow, while also offering max buffs, armor strip and grouping even before max redline.

6. Once you hit MAX REDLINE, you can no longer lose battery meanig you can now spam as many heat sunders in a row as you like. Hold (or tap if inverted) 3 multiple times to create heat procs (eg 2-3 times), followed by tapping 3 to combine heat + cold to full strip enemies, suck them towards you and convert the heat procs into blast to nuke the full-stripped enemies. Thermal Sunder has exponential scaling so that each heat sunder cast doubles all current heat procs. 

**Heat Inherit**
'Heat inherit' is a mechanic where using a heat primer to apply an initial heat proc followed up by heat sunders allows thermal sunder's heat procs to inherit the +heat and +faction mods from the primer. For example you could use an AOE heat primer like [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/), shoot ONCE, then spam a few heat sunders before detonating with cold sunder. This will significantly boost the damage of both the heat procs and blast damage by an order of 5 to 10x depending on the build. Note, this is NOT practical in general thermal sunder spam gameplay since it is hard to ensure the very first heat proc originated from the primer instead of thermal sunder itself.

**Blast Expedite**
Stacking heat procs from a heat DPS weapon then using cold sunder compresses all the heat proc damage into a single blast instance and applies it after stripping armor. You can easily hit 100k - 1 million or even damage cap if the enemy doesn't die first. For example, you could use a heat DPS beam like [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) incarnon, [\[Miter\]](/items/arsenal/958/miter/) incarnon, [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/), [\[Phage\]](/items/arsenal/1005/phage/), [\[Phantasma\]](/items/arsenal/1440/phantasma/) to stack 500 heat procs then 'detonate' it with a cold sunder. You can even combine this with a heat inherit primer to maximise damage. This is a meme way to kill strong targets like demolysts and thrax units.


# SURVIVABILITY
OPTION 1: Shield Gating for a hyperactive playstyle
This is recommended for steel path endurance. You will rely on a combination of 100% damage reduction to certain damage types while at 100% battery as well as shield gating with shield generation from brief respite/augur mods achieved by spamming mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) and thermal sunder, crowd control from cold sunder and finally increased passive shield recharge from redline. With [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/), TWO augur mods on frame and up to TWO additional augur mods on a pistol, each cast of Thermal Sunder can generate up to 108 shields, which gives approximately 1.2s shield gate i-frames with Catalyzing Shields on (or about 0.6s iframes without). Without Brief Respite, we can generate about 56 shields which equates to about 0.8-1s shield gate (note, it is likely you will generate sufficient shields before taking damage while spamming 1 and 3). Catalyzing Shields is an entirely flexible addition to gain more i-frames per cast. Rolling Guard is also a flexible option for i-frames, although i prefer to use Vazarin Protective Sling for i-frames instead. 

OPTION 2: Quick Thinking Tanking
This is a meme option for lazy tanking base steel path/non-endurance. [\[Quick Thinking\]](/items/arsenal/833/quick-thinking/) uses energy as health pool once you hit 2hp. Kinetic Plating converts damage into energy. This allows you to to stay practically immortal while Kinetic Plating is active since you constantly create the energy you lose. You will eventually get one-shot by an instance of damage that surpasses the total ehp pool, which can be increased with [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and armor. Swap [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) for [\[Quick Thinking\]](/items/arsenal/833/quick-thinking/) and Arcane Energize for Arcane [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/).

OPTION 3: [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) + Arcane Aegis (probably a bug)
Exceeding the recharge delay reduction through [\[Gauss\]](/items/arsenal/2716/gauss/)'s passive and [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) then triggering Arcane Aegis once allows an "aegis" effect to persistently trigger subsequently, making you immortal to all non-toxin damage without hitting 100% battery. This is probably a bug and could be patched at an unknown time. If you want to use this simply drop [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) for [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) and one of the Arcanes for Aegis.

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration is the most important stat since it determines how long Kinetic Plating and Redline stay active as well as all redline buffs. Duration also affects the drain of Mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) and the heat proc duration of Thermal Sunder, which directly translates into overall sunder damage. [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/), [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/), [\[Constitution\]](/items/arsenal/789/constitution/) and Molt Efficiency gives a duration of 243%. Adding optional 4 to 5 tauforged duration shards can give up to 318% duration total.

**Efficiency**
We can keep efficiency neutral at 100% or add [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) to get 130%, because you only need to recast 2 and 4 once every 1.5 minutes roughly and Mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) is extremely cheap to cast. Thermal Sunder spam is the only ability that has significant impact to energy economy, but [\[Gauss\]](/items/arsenal/2716/gauss/) also has innate energy regeneration from absorbing damage via kinetic plating. This combined with Arcane Energize means it is very easy to go back to max energy quickly. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion can also give a consistent source of free efficiency. [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) is then flexible for more duration (eg [\[Nira's Hatred\]](/items/arsenal/5630/niras-hatred/)) or [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/).

Backup sources of energy include [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) with [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/), [\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Energy Generator\]](/items/arsenal/1388/energy-generator/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) with [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Invocation, [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/), Zenurik Wellspring.

**Range**
Range is used mainly to boost Thermal Sunders range so you can have high area crowd control as well as high area AOE armor strip + nuke. High range also slightly benefits Mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) impact radius which can deal minor damage but also cause knockback and light CC. Anywhere between 145 to 235+ range is reasonable depending on the tileset. If you prefer more range, simply swap [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) or [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) out for [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/), and use Molt Augmented. [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) is also optional over [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/).

**Strength**
We need to keep strength at or above 100% so Kinetic Plating maintains 100% damage reduction at max redline. Strength does directly affect Thermal Sunder but we don't need to go overboard since Thermal Sunder is so strong with exponential scaling and in built armor strip, it kills sufficiently fast at only 100% strength. Strength otherwise is not extremely important as it only provides minor boosts to the damage of mach [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) and redline projectiles. If you run overextended, you just need to use Molt Augmented to bring it back to 100% or the Grimoire Strength mod.

**Aura**
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/): Additively strips 18% armor, meaning you need to be at 82% of the last 20% battery i.e. above 96.4% to full strip in one cast. What this means is you don't need to be at exactly 100% battery while not at max redline to allow heat sunder to one cast strip after a cold sunder or for cold sunder to one cast strip after a heat proc, giving more consistent single cast strips at all times.
- Brief Respite: Optional for generating more shields for shield gating
- Sprint Boost : stacks with rush to mach rush even faster
- Enemy Radar : for tracking enemy spawns, stacks with primed animal instinct and passive radar

**Exilius**
- Rush : sprint speed affects mach rush speed
- Vigilante pursuit : alternative to enemy radar
- Cunning Drift: for more range

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Concentration: 60% duration after casting abilities
- Molt Efficiency : adds +36% extra duration
- Arcane Ice Storm: adds 40% duration and 40% strength, can trigger with cold sunder use and even when you detonate heat with cold
- Arcane Hotshot: up to 300% crit chance for weapons can be activated by thermal sunder heat
- Arcane Pistoleer: for ammo efficiency when using with secondary weapons

**Flexible Options**
[\[Thermal Transfer\]](/items/arsenal/5751/thermal-transfer/) buffs weapons, particularly adding blast status to weapons after using heat and cold sunder.

**Archon Shards**
5 tauforged duration shards which boosts all of [\[Gauss\]](/items/arsenal/2716/gauss/)'s abilities.

1 cast speed shard is OPTIONAL to increase speed of recasting redline and make up for low cast speed bonus in initial low battery levels. Once battery is near max redline will give up to 100% cast speed bonus.

# HELMINTH

**UPDATE APRIL 2025**
[\[Balefire Charger\]](/items/arsenal/2408/balefire-charger/) with [\[Aegis Gale\]](/items/arsenal/6687/aegis-gale/) is simply one of the strongest exalted weapons now. # BUILD VARIANTS

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Enter Aegis Gale and spam alt-fire everywhere to nuke enemies
2. Spam Pillage whenever enemies are around to regain shields, cleanse status and strip armor


[[ youtube id="UcZm_sqLyrw" ]]

.

# SURVIVABILITY
The two main options for surviving depend on what type of content you want to play. 

1. CASUAL STEEL PATH
For base steel path and below, casual tanking should be sufficient for you. Using [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) will increase your effective shield HP to over 50,000 at max. Note armor does NOT affect damage reduction on shields, so there is no need to add any armor mods or shards. Arcane Aegis and/or Arcane Barrier can improve this even further allowing you to often regenerate shields faster than you take damage even without spamming Pillage.

2. ENDURANCE STEEL PATH
For endurance runs (e.g. level 500-1000 and higher), enemies can easily deplete all your shields in seconds or in one hit despite adaptation and max shields. Luckily Hildryn has a special passive where she gains 3s of i-frames when shields break. Shield recharge delay is only 1s and she can regenerate shields at approximately 300 shield/s, meaning you will be able to cast Pillage again by the third second before i-frames end. Pillage lasts either 2.6s or you can end it early. If you use Rolling Guard near the end of your 3s i-frames you will get another 3s of i-frames which should give you enough buffer time to safely cast Pillage and regain all shields to reset your shield gate. You can also stack Vazarin protective dash on top of this for 5s of i-frames on demand with NO cooldown. Running [\[Raksa Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2231/raksa-kubrow/) should also passively restore shields consistently. Also consider swapping Arcane Expertise for Arcane Aegis.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration helps scale the spread distance of Pillage giving a final effective range of approximately 60m. 

**Efficiency**
You will want to run neutral to positive efficiency as Aegis Storm has significant drain. If you don't mind the level of drain then feel free to swap [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) for [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/). [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) applies while Aegis Storm is active giving you a free 30% efficiency and [\[Mystic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6276/mystic-bond/) gives free casts of Pillage, which all help energy economy. Raksa Hubrow restores shields passively which is very useful too.

**Range**
Range is required for scaling the radius of Balefire/[\[Aegis Gale\]](/items/arsenal/6687/aegis-gale/), initial cast radius of Pillage, radius of Haven and radius of Aegis Storms crowd control area. You can run anything between 145 to 280% range depending on preference.

**Strength**
Strength is required for the damage of Balefire, the strip amount of Pillage, the damage and bonus shield capacity of Haven. Note that you don't necessarily want to full strip armor in one cast because then subsequent casts of Pillage will not return shields from full-stripped enemies (which is essentially energy for Hildryn).

**Aura**
- Corrosive projection reduces armor to 82% meaning you could strip in two casts at 183% strength.
- Enemy Radar is nice quality of life to have so you can see enemies on radar very far away
- Growing power for more strength

**Exilus**
Completely flexible. 

**Flexible Slots**
- Blazing Pillage is optional for enemies with no armor or shields e.g. infested
- Streamline for more efficiency
- [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) if you prefer to have passive tankiness for casual SP missions. Having up to 90% DR on your shields can increase your shield eHP to over 50,000.
- Rolling Guard for extra i-frames

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Velocity - boosts balefire/aegis gale fire rate
- Arcane Expertise - turns strength to more shield which adds to Aegis Gale damage
- Augmented - gives free strength but needs 250 kills
- Aegis - when this procs, your rate of shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) could surpass the damage you take. If this procs during your shield gate duration you will effectively be immortal as you will constantly be refreshing your shield gate (at least to the 0.33s iframe window)
- Barrier -  consistently procs during hildryns 3s shield gate which returns her to instantly full shields, very useful but falls off in endurance

**Archon Shards**
- 1 Amber Cast Speed
- 4 Crimson Strength Shards

Vazarin also has the [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) Break ability which increases shield regeneration rate when [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) Shell breaks. 

Madurai is excellent for giving bonus cast speed and 40% strength.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
General use build for regular starchart or steel path endurance focusing on using discharge primarily for crowd control but also for trash mob nuking, [\[Capacitance\]](/items/arsenal/192/capacitance/) augment so discharge fills shields to reset shieldgate, while also using [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) to boost weapons with electric (particularly for melee influence), 2 for speed buff and 3 for protection and crit multiplier buff. 

Shock or Discharge could both be subsume slots, depending on whether you'd rather focus on nuking low levels with Discharge or buffing your weapons further. 

[[ youtube id="zwcTgLhVP0Y?si=2G22v3lEtc1bZbeJ" ]]

**UPDATE NOV 2025**
[\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) now no longer combines with modded elementals but still acts like a modded +electric % damage bonus, being additive to other electric mods and the bonus from shield. 

**BUILD VARIANTS**
Pure Weapon Platform (roar/nourish): https://overframe.gg/build/221002/
Pure Nuke (terrify):  https://overframe.gg/build/272289/
Pure Speed meme (Molt): https://overframe.gg/build/243697/
Low level fissure Shocking Speed: https://overframe.gg/build/521540/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Keep Shock trooper active (hold 1), depending on the weapon
2. Keep Speed active (tap 2) on cooldown for mobility/reload buff/melee attack speed buff
3. Keep Shield active (tap 3) at all times and pick it up for protection, electricity bonus and crit multiplier boost. If stationary, you can stack 6 shields together for a +300% electricity damage bonus (additive and separate damage instance like [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/)). 
4. Cast 4 to regenerate shields and crowd control whenever it runs out. Try to always have a Discharge active and affecting at least one enemy at all times to constantly regenerate shields and crowd control non-eximus enemies, which effectively makes you immortal since shields give between 0.33s to 2.5s i-frames on break depending on how much shield you had before breaking. 

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration is required for the uptime of all abilities so you can adjust this to be higher if you prefer to recast things less. For example, you can swap [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) for [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) and add duration shards.

**Efficiency**
Energy economy can be maintained at neutral efficiency by the use of [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) + [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) (with [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/)). [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is optional and can be swapped for more range or duration. If you need even more energy economy, you can consider adding Arcane Steadfast or running additional energy production methods like primary exhilarate, [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), [\[Tenet Glaxion\]](/items/arsenal/6552/tenet-glaxion/), [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/).

**Range**
This is mainly only needed for Discharge, which has a high base radius of 20m. 145% range gives 29m range which is enough to lockdown most areas in the game without affecting other areas, which improves influx of enemies. You can adjust this based on the map e.g. if you want to affect a large map such as circuit, you can add [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) over [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/). [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) can trigger off either 1 or 4 and gives a free bit of energy regeneration. If you decide to subsume over 4, you should just drop range for [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/).

**Strength** 
Strength boosts the [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) buff and Speed buff and affects the damage of Discharge,  but does not affect Shield. In higher levels the damage of Discharge falls off quite a bit so strength is primarily needed for your weapon buffs. 

**Flexible Slots**
- Aura : growing power gives more strength
- Exilus : primed sure footed is ideal to prevent knockdownms, handspring is next best alternative
- Rolling Guard : if you don't mind just casting 4 whenever you need to shield gate, can swap this for more range or strength
- Natural talent : flexible if you cant run some cast speed archon shards.

**Arcanes**
This is totally up to personal preference:
- Molt Efficiency: free 36% duration as long as shields are active, which is easy with Capacitance
- Molt Augmented: free 60% strength after 250 kills, good for longer missions
- Arcane Steadfast: improves energy economy 
- Arcane Energize: improves energy economy, but is harder to acquire
- Arcane Aegis: backup survivability

**Archon Shards**
- One to two amber cast speed: for improving cast speed animation of discharge and other abilities
- FLEXIBLE SHARD OPTIONS:
- Two parkour shards for extra mobility
- Crimson Strength shards help boost 1, 2 and 4 further and any helminth abilities
- Crimson Duration shards to increase uptime of 1, 2, 3 and 4
- Violet melee crit shards if focusing on a melee
- Violet primary elec damage shards if focusing on primary weapons

**Focus School**
Madurai for cascade and boosting strength + cast speed further'
Vazarin for i-frames in endurance Steel Path
Zenurik for better energy economy, particularly if you don't own energize
Unairu for shield and armor strip that works on acolytes and demolysts

## HELMINTH OPTIONS
Subsume over 1 if you prefer to keep discharge for nuking/CC and replace Shock Trooper
Subsume over 4 if you prefer to keep shock trooper for electric weapon DPS
- Nourish - adds viral damage and multiplies energy gained
- Roar - useful for general weapon DPS boost (double dip on DoTs) and also boosts discharge
- Pillage - strips armor and gives shield and also clear status
- Ensnare - you can use this for grouping to improve kill times and enable certain combos (e.g. weapon-based electric DoT chaining and headshots)
- Coil Horizon - alternative grouping with electric theme

**UPDATE 2025**
Bladestorm has now been completely reworked into an 'exalted' and requires mods on the [\[Shadow Clones\]](/items/arsenal/7350/shadow-clones/) weapon, and now scales with a number of melee mods and Smoke Screens duration has been buffed. **Empty arcane slot is for Arcane Crepuscular**

## **INTRODUCTION**
This is a general use/endurance levelcap build focusing on using both Bladestorm and melee weapons. Wrathful Advance gives flat critical chance boost to Bladestorm and Melee Weapons. For example at 388% final strength this gives a 388% flat cc boost to Bladestorm which sets its final critical chance to 399%, nearly guaranteed tier 4 red crits. This allows Bladestorm to deal between 20 to 30 million damage per initial hit WITHOUT any priming which means you can ONE-SHOT every single non-boss attenuated enemy in the game up to levelcap. The strongest enemies in the game are Drekar Manic Bombard which has a health of 30 million while levelcap Thrax have 25.5 million EHP. For day to day use in base steel path up to EDA/ETA, where the maximum HP reaches only about 10 million this is obviously overkill so you can reduce the strength a bit.

**BUILD VARIANT 1 GENERAL**
The first build as shown above is the general day to day build where at max combo and wrathful active you will be dealing approximately 10 million true damage without much build-up which is enough to one-shot pretty much every enemy encountered below level 500 without priming. I opt to run the new reworked teleport augment [\[Teleport Rush\]](/items/arsenal/157/teleport-rush/) to mix up gameplay a bit, get some finishers and [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) invisibility and also gain 30% parkour buff, but this is completely optional and you could run Rolling Guard, Augur Message or Augur Secrets instead.

**BUILD VARIANT 2 ONE-SHOT LEVELCAP**
This variant is an extreme overkill Endurance variant that has been min-maxed with strength to allow Bladestorm to ONE-SHOT levelcap enemies WITHOUT priming (including Thrax), and also with maximum priming on an unarmored enemy will allow you to hit over 800 million final damage ,which means you should be able to one-shot a demolyst too with priming. 

Note: [\[Proton Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/2520/proton-pulse/) has been patched so now just use [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/), [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) or [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/).

![](https://ik.imagekit.io/ninjase/AshBladestorm.PNG)

**BLADESTORM BUILD**
This is the highest possible dps for general use across all factions and will be able to one-shot every faction to levelcap including Thrax without priming. To maximise DPS against armored grineer, swap [\[Primed Fever Strike\]](/items/arsenal/353/primed-fever-strike/) for [\[Primed Smite Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/2883/primed-smite-grineer/) since elementals are affected by armor. To simply achieve the highest number possible without caring about speed, swap Fury for Primed Smite, Crescendo for Melee Exposure and use an encumber primer + armor strip.

## **PLAYSTYLE**
- Tap 1 to activate Wrathful Advance and keep active. Can also use this for mobility if you prefer.
- Cast 2 to go invisible and recast as necessary
- Cast 3 if augment is equipped to finisher enemies and refresh invisibility duration without it running out. If you cast 3 while Bladestorm is active you will join in and make it finish faster.
- OPTIONAL: Prime enemies with multiple statuses and viral status to maximise bladestorm damage (can be manually or via companion e.g. Dirgia, Hound, Panzer)
- Tap 4, move your cursor around to select enemies (they will glow), then tap 4 again to initiate bladestorm which will send clones to stab them. 
- Help kills with melee or guns


## **BUILD SPECIFICS**

**Duration**
High duration helps the uptime of smokescreen and wrathful advance so you don't have to recast as often. You can add more duration in if you prefer (e.g. [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/), Archon Shards).

**Efficiency**
Negative efficiency can be sustainable now because Smokescreen now lasts much longer and can even be renewed by casting 3 (which costs 39 energy at 45% efficiency), while Bladestorm costs 9.3 energy per mark while invisible and is a guaranteed one-shot. With 500 energy you could mark approximately 53 enemies before running draining the whole energy bar which is more enemies than can usually spawn in a room. 

You will want to have some source of energy production to help with sustain: 
1. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/): This converts health orbs (50 health) into energy (55 energy per orb). Every Eximius kill guarantees 2 health orb drops which equates to 110 energy. Diriga/Hound/Panzer with [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) can passively prime enemies and make 25% of kills drop health orbs. This means if you mark 20 companion primed enemies and spend 192 energy total to kill them, you will get on average 5 health orbs back which equates to 275 energy. If two of those 20 enemies contains an eximus you will refund a total of 495 energy which is over double what you spent.
2. Grimoire with Xata Invocation: Can give passive energy regen up to 10 energy / second
3. [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/): for missions with sparse enemies or long periods of downtime in between engaging enemies, you could consider running Energy Nexus instead of or in addition to Equilibrium for passive 3 energy/second. 
4. Archon Stretch: Diriga with Arc Coil or Hounds with electric modded can proc this for free passive 2 energy/second
5. Zenurik: Wellspring can give 5 energy/second [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) 

**Range**
Bladestorm has a very high base range of 50m which is enough to cover a very large room. You will most likely not need over 70 to 100 range in most tilesets. If you want to Bladestorm in openworld then you may want to increase range to over 200% by adding [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) and dropping [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) for [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/).

**Strength**
Strength is needed for Bladestorm damage and the crit chance boost from Wrathful advance

**Flexible Options**
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is optional over Steel Charge, helps with more shield gating to help with break through damage. Use your shuriken for on demand shield regen.
- [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is completely optional for most content considering you will spend nearly 100% of your time invisible, however it is still very good to get rid of sudden random cold, toxin, electric or slash procs from AOE or the environment. This becomes more important in high level endurance, although can be replaced entirely by just using Vazarin Protectice Sling.
- Seeking Shuriken is optional to bring to boss fights, sister fights, cascade and disruption mode for the armor strip. 
- Primed Sure footed is optional. Can use handspring, vigilante pursuit, power drift, particularly if you run Unairu Poise.

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Crepuscular: while invisible adds 30% strength and flat +3 CD which boosts all weapons and is a huge buff to Bladestorm (which has a low base crit dmg)
- Molt Augmented : boosts strength by 60% after 250 kills, which increases bladestorm damage further and boosts wrathful advance
- Arcane Trickery:  While it has a low chance of 15% and only activates on kill (and not bleed DoT), at the rate at which this build one-shots enemies, you'll find that Trickery is consistently activating every 10-20 kills, or roughly every 5-10 seconds. This provides pretty much permanent invisibility which can NOT be dispelled by nullifiers or acolytes, unlike smoke screen. If for some reason you don't have trickery active, use smokescreen as a buffer. If you want to go this route you could drop duration a bit e.g. change Narrow Minded and Stretch for Primed Continuity + Streamline
- Arcane [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/) and Blade Charger both significantly increase bladestorm damage. Use Fury on a melee focused ash loadout and Arcane Blade Charger if you plan on using your primary weapon more.
- Molt Efficiency gives more duration 
- Arcane Energize is great for energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) since silence costs nearly 100 energy and spamming bladestorm can wear out energy quite fast. [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/) may be able to replace this depending on what happens with it.

**Focus**
Madurai gives free 40% ability strength and 50% cast speed, and is meta for Cascade
Naramon can be useful for maintaining bladestorm combo without Melee Crescendo
Zenurik would be the go to more energy economy and slow blast (for disruption)
Unairu gives free knockdown resistance and full shield/armor strip.
Vazarin is best for endurance runs where you might need more consistent i-frames (e.g. energy drain conduit and enemy toxin weapons disruption).

**Archon Shards**
- Azure Energy Max : At least ONE TAUFORGED shard is needed to hit 500 energy max for doulbing Violet Melee Crit damage bonus. You can add more if you prefer more max energy.
- Violet Melee Crit Damage shard: Boosts both Bladestorm and your melee weapon further, you could add between 2 to 4 of these up to preference ( I prefer 2)
- Flexibe e.g. Crimson Duration : Put the remainder of free shard slots into duration as this improves uptime of both Wrathful Advance and Smokescreen, up to preference (I prefer 2), or into strength, parkour velocity etc

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This is a general use [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) build for boosting critical chance (particularly on primary weapons), high range larva for grouping, high range link so you can be somewhat mobile and parasitic link for status immunity. Virulence spam is used for stack gain, energy gain, crit chance boost and even low level DPS. This build is best used in more stationary situations with high enemy density (e.g. Solo survival) since you need to gain stacks and constantly link enemies. 

Maximum strength Roar Variant : https://overframe.gg/build/232438/

[[ youtube id="7oPF7M-wxHs?si=-iJec74MdRcc0pmD" ]]

**UPDATE JUN 2026**
[\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) got a massive quality of life and health buff. You can now link moving companions and the link persists even if thefy are downed meaning you are not at risk of losing health. He can now get 500 mutation stacks with [\[Abundant Mutation\]](/items/arsenal/4613/abundant-mutation/) (optional for funny health memes) which paired with [\[Parasitic Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/6488/parasitic-vitality/) gives around 35,000 health which lasts for 70s with arcane persistence. Casting Ravenous heals you and now scales with range so covers a huge area, while the optional [\[Insatiable\]](/items/arsenal/121/insatiable/) lets you quickly stack even up to 500 mutation stacks in a short time. [\[Larva Burst\]](/items/arsenal/122/larva-burst/) has been buffed and can kill enemies quite well.

**UPDATE DEC 2025**
The new arcane, Arcane persistence now limits damage taken to 500 per second if your armor is above 700. [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) has a high base armor of 525 and can hit 700 with a single Tauforged Azure archon shard (gives +225 armor) or a single armor mod. With [\[Parasitic Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/6488/parasitic-vitality/) and [\[Abundant Mutation\]](/items/arsenal/4613/abundant-mutation/) you can hit close to 20,000 health at 300 mutation stacks, meaning you could potential stand still for over 30s before healing. Arcane Grace scales healing off max health meaning you can simply outheal any damage you take if your max health exceeds 8334.

**UPDATE APRIL 2024**
The new augment [\[Parasitic Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/6488/parasitic-vitality/) now replaces [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/), giving an equivalent amount of health after approximately 13 stacks of mutation. At rank 30, 100 stacks and 200 strength, you gain approximately +800% health giving 5850 health. If you slot [\[Abundant Mutation\]](/items/arsenal/4613/abundant-mutation/) for a meme only (since it is usually very hard to achieve 300 stacks outside of solo survival), you can hit +2400% health giving 16,250 health.

## PLAYSTYLE

1. Cast 2 to group enemies, making sure you catch at least 5 enemies at the minimum
2. Cast 1 into the ball of enemies to kill and build stacks, as well as generate energy
3. Once you have a single stack hold 3 to link to your companion or tap 3 on an ally. This will give you a strength boost to you and the linked ally while also boost weapon damage (multiplicative like eclipse). 
4. Cast 4 when enough stacks for passive crowd control, healing and some AOE damage
5. Repeat 2 + 1 combo, until you hit max stacks
6. Recast 3 and 4 on expiry
7. Once at max stacks, cast 1 every 10-15s to refresh [\[Teeming Virulence\]](/items/arsenal/2468/teeming-virulence/) and and regain any lost stacks

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration is primarily for Link uptime so you don't need to recast it as often, and secondarily for Ravenous. Not useful for 1 or 2.

**Efficiency**
Lowest efficiency is fine for [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) since 1 costs 62, 2 and 3 costs 39 and 4 costs no energy and 1 even refunds energy, gaining tons energy when efficiency is low and you hit many enemies. [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) is OPTIONAL for easy energy regen in case you miss virulence or somehow run out of energy and desperately need to cast larva/virulence. However, you can always maintain your energy with careful management of the 2 +1 combo, only casting virulence when there are at least 5 enemies within the larva (Each enemy refunds 15.5 energy, so hitting 5 enemies refunds 78 energy. You only need to hit 12 enemies to fill the total capacity of your energy pool from 0 energy without [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/). If you run [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/), you need to hit approximately 33 enemies to refill the whole pool from zero). 

**Range**
Range is essential for larva to pull as many enemies as possible from across the map. Range also helps maggot explosions and maximising the link distance on mobile missions. High range is slightly detrimental to virulence since you need to wait for it to end before casting again, but you can aim into walls if possible to shorten this and spam virulence. Once you hit max stacks, you only need to use virulence every 10s or so to refresh [\[Teeming Virulence\]](/items/arsenal/2468/teeming-virulence/) and any lost stacks.

**Strength**
Strength scales the damage of 1, damage of [\[Larva Burst\]](/items/arsenal/122/larva-burst/), parasitic vitality health bonus, strength bonus and damage boost and the crit chance boost of Teeming Virulence. 

**Flexible Options**
- Rage/Hunter adrenaline  - can be useful if you have energy issues, but 1 can consistently return you to full energy and energy orbs spawn quickly enough. More useful in short missions where enemies are sparse.

- Primed Flow - can also be useful if you have energy issues as an alternative to hunter adrenaline, or even together with it

Augment slot (very flexible as no one augment is mandatory):
- Parasitic Vitality - gives a huge amount of health only after linking enemies or allies, but if you prefer non-conditional health, use vitality or umbral vitality.
- Teeming virulence - boosts crit chance of primary only. don't use this if you don't want to use your primary or your primary has incredibly low base crit chance. If you don't want to use [\[Teeming Virulence\]](/items/arsenal/2468/teeming-virulence/), you can reduce the overall power strength to simply exceed the 90%DR threshold of 180% (e.g. remove transient fortitude).
- Insatiable augment - faster stack gain while standing on ravenous (useful if you want to hit 500 stacks asap).
- Larva Burst - allows for decent ability DPS
- Abundant Mutation - Optional for health maxing. Increases stacks to increase 1 damage and scale 3, but gives undying a cooldown, which is no longer a huge issue with arcane persistence. Allows you to maximise health gained from parasitic vitality to over 50k.

Stretch (- slot): If you don't care about such high range,
- Swap for Archon Intensify for even more power strength, which is activated by Ravenous

Exilus slot is completely flexible:
- Toxic Flight/Ice Spring - parkour mobility 
- Cunning Drift - for extra range
- Primed sure footed if you don't want to rely on link for knockdown resist
- Power drift - for extra strength

Aura slot is completely flexible and up to what you own:
- Corrosive projection reduces armor by 18% which increases overall damage to armored enemies by 1.8x
- Growing Power for strength
- Steel charge for capacity 
- [\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/)

**Helminth**
[\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) has a reasonably synergistic kit so is best run without helminth.
If you really want to subsume something, you will subsume over 4

Options that synergize well with high strength/ or high range (although you may need more duration to sustain):
- Roar - universally good to boost virulence damage, larva burst (double dips toxin DoT), weapon damage and ally damage
- Nourish - gives viral dmg boost, viral status on damage and energy boost
- Gloom - CC and healing - Rely on Virulence to sustain energy for Gloom.
- Tharros Strike - full shield and armor strip a 200% str, very good into larva since it strips in a cone which hits the entire Larva easily
- Breach Surge - minor crowd control and damaging sparks

Here is a fun meme option using Reave to oneshot/nuke enemies within larva : https://overframe.gg/build/221813/nidus-prime/viral-reaver-nidus-one-shot-reave-steel-path/

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Persistence - limits health loss to 500hp/s
- Arcane Bellicose - 72% strength

**Archon Shards**
1 Amber Cast Speed
1 Tauforged Azure Armor Shard to hit 700 armor for arcane persistence
Rest is flexible
- 2 Parkour velocity for mobility + 1 strength
- 3 Violet primary electric damage shard for primary platform
- 3 Emerald +toxin status damage for [\[Larva Burst\]](/items/arsenal/122/larva-burst/)

This is a hybrid caster/platform [\[Uriel\]](/items/arsenal/7511/uriel/) build for using both guns and Brimstone to nuke occasionally.

Gameplay Showcase in Simulacrum and Levelcap Casacade

[[ youtube id="7Z3VIDgwVSg?si=RWEOrlJtaP-mixjC" ]]

# ALTERNATIVE BUILDS:
- PURE WEAPON PLATFORM (Thermal Transfer): https://overframe.gg/build/935576/

# PLAYSTYLE
**PASSIVE ABILITIES**
[\[Uriel\]](/items/arsenal/7511/uriel/)'s three passives are three demons Catenach (stays on your left), Gulphagor (middle) and Vythelas (stays on your right) which are constantly active provided they are alive, even if you helminth over their respective abilities. You will want to frequently cast 2 to revive and heal demons.
1. Catenach: when 6m away from enemies, casts chains on 5 enemies making them slow up to 95% at 190% strength and causing damage dealt to spread to all chained enemies (similar to [\[Kullervo\]](/items/arsenal/6201/kullervo/)). You don't really need to pay much attention to this demon, just passively kill slowed enemies and you will see all other slowed enemies die simultaneously. Killing chained enemies generates Brimstone charge.
2. Gulphagor: the flying demon latches onto enemies in 12m every 4 seconds and puts a huge red mark on their head. Killing this enemy will drop 6 health orbs and 2 energy orbs at 200 str, which equates to 430 energy with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) on. This means every 4s you potentially generate your entire energy bar from 0, provided you are consistently killing anymarked targets. You probably don't need to pay much attenuation to the mark unless you are desperately low on energy. Killing marked enemies generates Brimstone charge.
3. Vythelas: every 12s this demon will convert a corpse into a floating rune (star inside a circle), which is marked on the minimap as a cross inside a circle. You should aim to pick up these runes as they buff your fire rate and provide a heat damage buff that is equivalent coding wise to Cyte's Heat resupply. Note that currently, it seems the heat buff effects appears to last indefinitely and can even apply to incarnon mode, while the fire rate buff lasts for 10s at base x duration. Picking up runes generates Brimstone charge. To apply heat buff to incarnon modes, you need to interrupt the incarnon transformation by rolling or swapping weapons, then exiting and rentering incarnon form a few times. Once it sticks, its basically permanent (possibly a bug to be both permanent and apply to incarnon modes).

**ACTIVE ABILITIES**
1. Keep 1 active at all times, jump and dodge to fly around very fast. The speed of this scales with parkour velocity and dodge speed (amalgam barrel diffusion).
2. Tap 2 whenever you lose shields or need to turn immortal , and also tap 2 frequently to heal/revive demons. This makes you immortal for the duration of the cast and restores shields and health, scaling with the formula of 50% x max health x strength. In order to restore at least 1150 shield from 0 shield in order to gain the full 2.5s shield gate (not that currently, overshields count for shield gate regardless of max shield capacity), we just need to have [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) giving 1332 health and at least 173% strength OR 350% strength with no [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/).
3. Tap 3 constantly to apply an AOE damage vulnerability to increase damage against enemies while also charging Brimstone the fastest of all other sources.
4. Tap 4 to cast Brimstone which covers a huge area with persisting damage effect with guaranteed heat status. This damage increases over time to 10 x 1500 x strength

# MOD BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Duration helps the uptime of Infernalis, Brimstone and Demonium's Fire rate buff, as well as the chain time of Catenach, latch time of Gulphagor and rune duration of Vythelas, meaning you want decent duration at least155% or ideally over 200% which can be achieved with Duration Shards and Arcane Concentraiton/Efficiency. Duration has no effect on Remedium.

**Efficiency**
[\[Uriel\]](/items/arsenal/7511/uriel/) can handle negative efficiency due to Gulphagor priming enemies to drop 6 health and 2 energy orbs every 4s which is equivalent to 430 energy with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), refilling the entire energy bar. This means you can essentially spam demonium and remedium with no care provided you kill a [\[Marked Target\]](/items/arsenal/1453/marked-target/) every 4s.

**Range**
Range affects Catenachs initial chain range, Demonium's orb explosion radius and most importantly for Brimstone build, the range of Brimstone. If you are instead subsuming over Brimstone, you can effectively run negative range as Demonium orb travel is not affected by range, only the end explosion meaning you will have lower coverage of vulnerability and more single target focus.

**Strength**
Probably the most important stat as it affects the heat and fire rate buffs of Vythelas runes, damage of Brimstone, damage vulnerability of Demonium, shield restore of Remedium, health orb/energy orb drop rate of Gulphagor, slow of Catenach. [\[Archon Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/5923/archon-intensify/) works on healing demons which occurs constantly since 3 drains their health and 2 heals health.

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) is best in slot as it reduces armor before heat can partially strip.
Growing Power is a good alternative and fits default polarity.

**Exilus**
Totally flexible. 
- Power drift for more strength
- Cunning drift for more range
- Nira's anguish for parkour and slam
- Firewalker for more parkour velocity and infernalis speed
- Primed sure footed for knockdowns

# ARCANES
- Camisado: demons quickly stack 60% strength for next ability cast (also boosts strength for passive), nice for quicker missions or where you don't want to wait for molt augmented to stack.
- Molt Augmented: also stacks to 60% strength after 250 kills but works on all ability casts without waiting for demons to stack
- Concentration: 60% duration for 3s on ability cast, use this over hot shot for a pure Brimstone focused build
- Hot Shot: stacked by Uriel's abilities, gives 300% cc to weapons, good for weapon platforming
- Molt Efficiency: extra duration but less than concentration

# ARCHON SHARDS
At least TWO cast speed shards to speed up 2, 3 and 4
The last three are flexible. Personally I currently run 2 duration 1 parkour
- Parkour shards make him fly much faster
- Duration shards help with 1, Vythelas and 4 uptime
- Strength boosts many abilities
- Violet [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) Shards may help you replace [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) but depends on how much you spam abilities and how quickly you kill enemies. I found that [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) shards weren't enough at levelcap but one or two should be fine in general content.

# HELMINTH
What you subsume will be largely determined by what you wish to focus more on:
**BRIMSTONE FOCUS**
Helminth over 1 for a camping pure Brimstone focused build.
- Bright Bonnet: gives energy which helps fuel the high cost playstyle of spamming 3 to charge 4 and also boosts strength for both vulnerability and brimstone damage
- Sickening Pulse: doubles all heat statuses on cast in huge aoe (line of sight)

**WEAPON FOCUS**
Helminth over 4 for a high mobility pure Weapon platform build.
- Thermal Sunder with Thermal Transfer: can add +heat damage if you use heat sunder, which double dips into Vythelas buff (heat mods double dip heat dot).
- Nourish: adds free viral damage and raw damage which feeds into buff, and also gives even more energy

# ARSENAL
Since Vythelas's heat buff is identical to Cyte's resupply (and a cousin of Saryn/[\[Oraxia\]](/items/arsenal/7400/oraxia/)), we can run similar weapons used with those frames.
Note that HEAT MODS are mandatory as they double dip the heat DoT and FACTION MODS are ideal too as they TRIPLE DIP the heat DoT.
Vythelas Heat DoT = 0.5 x 30% x stregnth x base damage x (1 + HEAT MOD + other elements) x (1+ HEAT MOD) x (1+FACTION)^3

Just note, Vythelas is a pretty inconsistent buff since you need to go hunting for it and if it runs out, any weak weapons will suddenly go back to being very weak. For consistency you may want to just stick to strong weapons including incarnons even though they aren't affected by Vythelas, just so you can always kill enemies easily.

AERIAL BOMBING

MAIN HYBRID

# INTRODUCTION
This is a general use non-helminth [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) build utilising all base abilities with augments, focused around a combination of [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) use and splinter storm use. [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) with melee influence allows you to nuke maps by just spamming 1. Splinter storm can be stacked infinitely to create a passive zone of damage that moves with you, allowing you to even kill nearby enemies without casting. Spectrorage provides some crowd control while [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) augment helps generate tons of energy orbs to top up energy for yourself and your squad. [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) can be replaced with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) if utilising [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) and you can also just subsume over Spectrorage. Mass Vitrify can [\[Protect\]](/items/arsenal/221/protect/) objectives and also be smashed to build up splinter storm and deal AOE damage too.

ALTERNATIVE GARA BUILDS:
Pure shattered lash spam: https://overframe.gg/build/194448/
Pure splinter storm focused: https://overframe.gg/build/193196/

**UPDATE JUNE 2026**
Arcane Sculptor now makes efficiency 175% for 12s after casting either Spectrorage or Mass Vitrify which allows you to run [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) without penalty and have excellent energy economy now.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
[\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) no longer uses statsticks on a regular melee and is now an exalted that can be modded and use arcanes. The stats have been buffed to be both crit and status viable, making it very good with electric influence. If you don't like faction mods, swap Primed Smite for [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) (just note faction mods do TRIPLE DIP melee influence procs meaning they boost influence by a 1.55^3 = 3.72x multiplier.

![](https://imgur.com/YTh70Qu.png)

# **PLAYSTYLE**
**Make sure to INVERT tap/hold controls for Gara so tap is the Sweeping Slash Shattered Lash version**
- Cast 2 on yourself, your companion, your allies and the defense object
- Cast 3 in front of you/nearby to CC enemies and prime them to drop energy orbs when they die. Note if you cast it around an acolyte, their AI often turns off. Spectrorage can also inconsistently crowd control eximus/overguardeed units. If this is subsumed off, use helminth ability as necessary.
- Cast 4 and press 4 again immediately to end expansion (you want enemies to be outside the wall)
- Cast 1 at the wall to break the wall, nuke the map and build splinter storm stacks
- Spam 1 at enemies to nuke them with melee influence
- Kill heavier targets (e.g. thrax, acolytes) by stacking damage into splinter storm and just standing near them. 
- Use active or passive status priming to improve DPS (viral boosts damage by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks, corrosive boosts damage by up to 6x on armored enemies at 10 stacks and unique statuses boost condition overload on Shattered Lash (80% dmg per status))

https://youtu.be/w763Edm4Rks

[[ youtube id="w763Edm4Rks?si=j05OjFWV3anKPmJM" ]]


# SURVIVABILITY 
**Shield Gating**
When you lose shields to 0, you gain a short duration of invulnerability known as the "shield gate" which scales off the highest value of shields you had before breaking. [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) and Augur mods allow you to generate shields on demand by casting abilities. With [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) on warframe and two augur mods on a pistol statstick, casting 1 costs 25 energy at 100% efficiency which generates 57.5 shields. Breaking 57.5 shields to 0 gives 0.64s of i-frames. Adding [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) locks this value to 1.33s regardless of how much shield you had before breaking. If you can get out of danger, crowd control enemies or simply kill everything on screen during this next 1.33s before casting 1 again you should be able to stay alive. Other useful additional survivability options include [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/), Arcane Aegis, Arcane Circumvent and Vazarin Protective Sling. Vazarin Protective Sling is probably the ultimate survivability tool as it gives 5s of uninterruptable immortality with 0 energy cost and 0 cooldowns.

**Tanking**
Splinter Storm gives 90% damage reduction at 134% strength, allowing you to shrug off a fair amount of damage in non-endurance scenarios. Can swap Catalyzing Shield to [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/). You can maximise EHP by adding in Arcane [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) or [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) for armor, Arcane Blessing or [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) for health, or simply relying on shield tanking by using Pillage to gain overshields (since shields have a natural 50% DR).

# MOD BREAKDOWN

**Duration**
More duration is beneficial for splinter storm giving you more leeway between casts of 4 so you don't lose all your current stacks of splinter storm. You can add more duration over range/efficiency if desired (e.g. put [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) when you want splinter storm to last much longer so you don't need to recast 4 as much).

**Efficiency**
Since you will be spamming mass vitrify and breaking it with 1, you need to maintain some efficiency for energy economy. With Arcane Sculptor we can completely ditch efficiency to 45% since we are locked to 175% efficiency and won't even need [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) or [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). You could consider dropping [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) if you feel like energy is good.

Without Arcane Sculptor, 100 to 130% is good since we are running [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/). [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) augment generates tons of energy orbs for you and the whole squad. If you subsume over 3, run [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) instead. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on your pet further helps give free 30% efficiency since it procs while you are expanding 4. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) procs from electric modded on [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/). 

**Range**
Range is the most important stat for [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) range and Mass Vitrify Range, allowing the mass vitrify explosion radius to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 37.5m and [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 25m. You can increase this even more by adding [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/).

**Strength**
Strength boosts the damage of [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) which feeds into Mass Vitrify and Splinter Storm, and also boosts the damage vulnerabilities from glassed enemies from Mass Vitrify as well as damage vulnerability from Shattered Storm.

**Aura (flexible)**
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) boosts damage against armor by about 1.8x but you will need an external augur mod on pistol or burst laser prime for shield gating
- Brief respite is for shield gating without external augur mods
- Steel charge provides the most mod capacity if you are short on forma and adds a minor amount to shattered lash/splinter storm damage

**Exilus (flexible)** 
- Cunning Drift for range
- Primed sure footed if you own it, handspring as an alternative
- Power Drift for more strength
- [\[Ice Spring\]](/items/arsenal/845/ice-spring/) for parkour velocity

**Flexible mod options**
Can add more duration (e.g. [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/)), strength ([\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/)) or range ([\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/)) if you prefer and have free slots,

[\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/): optional quality of life for high levels to remove harmful statuses

[\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/): optional addition (e.g. over [\[Shattered Storm\]](/items/arsenal/6057/shattered-storm/)) that will give you much higher duration at the cost of range. This is useful in situtations where you may not want to nuke and just keep splinter storm on for damage reduction and splinter storm damage etc.

Shattered Storm - optional augment that spreads splinter storm onto enemies hit by 4, which creates a 35% damage vulnerability at base (basically acting like a universal 1.35x damage multiplier at base strength up to 1.7x at 200 strength)

Spectrosiphon - optional augment that generates energy orbs for the squad but is mainly for use in stationary situations since it cannot move on its own and needs to be recast constantly

Mending Splinters - support oriented augment for healing defense operative, pets and teammates. 

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Sculptor - locks efficiency to 175% for 12s after casting 3 or 4, solving all energy issues while at 45% efficiency
- Molt Efficiency - free 36% duration to improve splinter storm duration
- Molt Augmented - free 60% strength to further boost shattered lash damage, useful in longer missions where you expect to get 250 kills
- Arcane Fury - similar to blade charger but doesn't require a primary, is easier to proc but provides slightly less stack
- Arcane Blade Charger - if you have a good primary weapon, AOE primary or high DPS sentinel weapon (e.g verglas), you can easily get this buff, which will boost the damage of mass vitrify explosion
- Arcane Circumvent - rolling strips armor, shield and overguard and steals them for you, quite nice for splinter storm
- Arcane Aegis - If you have problems with surviving

**Helminth**
Subsume over Spectrorage, and drop Spectrosiphon for Equilibrium
- Roar: Boosts raw damage of Shattered Lash for Splinter Storm, double dips status damage from Shattered Lash and triple dips melee influence procs.
- Nourish: Gives additive viral dmg boost to [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/), widespread viral procs via influence (giving 4.25x multiplier to health dmg) and gives energy multiplier which helps greatly with energy sustain which is not quite as necessary now due to Arcane Sculptor
- Pillage strips armor/shields and provides shields to you, useful for both shield tanking and shield gating

**Archon Shards**
- Amber Cast Speed - 1 to 2 tauforged cast speed shard to improve Shattered Lash speed and Mass Vitrify casting speeds
- Crimson Duration - 3 to 4  Tauforged Duration shards to increase splinter storm duration and buff duration
OR
- Violet Melee Critical damage shards

Other options:
- Amber Parkour Velocity optional for quality of life
- Violet Melee Crit Damage shard: boosts shattered lash damage but does not affect mass vitrify for splinter storm stacking

# ARSENAL/OTHER TIPS
**Sentinels**
Use a sentinel as a companion rather than a moving pet. You can cast splinter storm on your sentinel and give it 90% damage reduction as well as creating a second damage source that gains the same stacks as [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/). Since the sentinel moves with you and overlaps your splinter storm radius, you effectively do twice the damage per tick compared to when splinter storm is on [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) alone. To cast on your sentinel, point your cursor directly up and press the reverse camera key (check key bindings) then spam 2 as the crosshairs pass over the sentinel. Furthermore, since the sentinel never runs away like other pets, you can keep 100% uptime on its splinter storm whenever you cast mass vitrify. You should also equip Seismic Bond which will trigger while Mass Vitrify is expanding, giving free 30% efficiency for 12s.

Recommended sentinels:
- Diriga with Arc Coil - most consistent close range priming for splinter storm DPS and synth deconstruct health orb generation: https://overframe.gg/build/541464
- Helios Prime with Vicious Bond and Deconstructor - allows you to passive armor strip enemies recently damaged by abilities, which is exactly what Gara specializes in: https://overframe.gg/build/542050/
- Nautilus with Cordon and Manifold bond - allows you to passively group enemies so you can kill them quicker with splinter storm. https://overframe.gg/build/540870/
- Wrym prime with negate - prevents status procs including knockdown, very useful if you don't own primed sure footed and want to block knockdown. https://overframe.gg/build/545608/
- Dethcube prime with energy generator - makes energy orbs every couple of kills, very useful for energy economy: https://overframe.gg/build/224301/

**Weapons**
No specific weapon synergies exist apart from having a good primary to proc arcane blade charger quickly if you are running that (e.g. [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/) which can be both primer and DPS) and a utility secondary such as Grimoire that can help with energy regen (Xata Invocation)/status boosting and survivability ([\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/)).

**Archgun Statstick**
Currently, primary and secondary dexterity arcanes placed on the archgun will increase your combo duration passively without even summoning the archgun in a mission. This means with 4 dexterity arcanes you can get 30s of combo duration and never run out of combo even without Naramon.
