**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# **INTRODUCTION**
This is a build dedicated to getting the absolute most out of Iron Skin, enough to tank early to mid Steel Path content without worrying about recasting, while also offering a usable Roar. The helminth rank 11 ability Parasitic Armor is subsumed over [\[Rhino\]](/items/arsenal/49/rhino/)'s 4th ability stomp and is the basis of this build. [\[Rhino\]](/items/arsenal/49/rhino/)'s Iron Skin scales off armor value which can be increased tremendously by stacking multiple sources including Parasitic Armor, [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/), [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) and optionally ([\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/), Arcane Tanker, Arcane [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/), Arcane Reaper, Melee Fortification, Arcane Ultimatum)

**UPDATE JAN 2026**
Arcane Expertise provides even more shield for Parasitic armor which translates into more armor for iron skin.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
Arcane Battery is a very cheap/easy to farm arcane that gives up to 1000 energy max when at 3333 armor (this build hits over 6000 armor with Parasitic armor active). This fluctuates with current armor rating, but gives a significantly higher amount than Primed Flow, allowing you to free up the primed flow mod slot.

This loadout shares polarities with my buff/roar Rhino build : https://overframe.gg/build/205669/rhino-prime/roaring-rhino-buff/
For the non-helminth iron skin tanking version : https://overframe.gg/build/207002/rhino-prime/iron-skin-rhino-non-helminth/
For endurance nourish non-tanking variant: https://overframe.gg/build/473949/

# **PLAYSTYLE**
1. When you begin in the mission, cast Parasitic armor followed by Iron Skin to get 30k iron skin for buffer and hit 1000 energy max from Arcane Battery
2. [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) your energy with energy generating methods eg zenurik, [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), [\[Tenet Glaxion\]](/items/arsenal/6552/tenet-glaxion/) [\[Photon Overcharge\]](/items/arsenal/6550/photon-overcharge/).
3. Perform any additional OPTIONAL armor buffings methods (collect health orbs for [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), melee kills for Melee Fortification and Arcane Reaper, Archgun for Arcane Tanker, Finisher for Arcane Ultimatum, Mecha marked kills for [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/))
4. Find a group of enemies and use a grouping skill ([\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/), exodia [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/), vazarin snare)
5. Cast Charge into the group of enemies (or out of the group of enemies if they are surrounding you for best results) to get [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) bonus (lasts 12s). This will set your total current armor value to it's highest possible value but only for 12 seconds.
6. Cast Iron skin twice, first to dispel it and again to recast it while the [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) bonus is active to *lock* in the current armor value into the Iron Skin value.
7. Keep Roar active as required

For even more meme bonus armor, use sources of increasing max shields such as [\[Shield Charger\]](/items/arsenal/224/shield-charger/), shield osprey specter and [\[Hildryn\]](/items/arsenal/2388/hildryn/)'s Haven (not sure if specter can cast this).

Here is a video demonstrating the sequence above:

[[ youtube id="ZInH4k6DwwM" ]]

# **BUILD SPECIFICS**

**Duration**
Decent duration allows easier upkeep of roar at almost 40s and high duration timers for [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) bonus and parasitic armor to make setup easier.

**Efficiency**
Using [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) allows us to tank efficiency, so about 200 energy is needed to pull off the combo. This means you will need zenurik, [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/) or energy pads when you start the mission to get sufficiency energy before using the combo. Once you have millions of iron skin, you only need to cast roar every half minute, meaning you won't be spending much energy. Every couple of minutes you may need to refresh iron skin.

**Range**
Range is untouched at 100%, giving a decent ironclade charge distance to hit multiple enemies, and decent roar radius.

**Strength**
Strength is the single most important stat in this build, since the formula for calculating iron skin uses power strength as a multiplicative factor three times (creating a cubic function). This is because Parasitic Armor scales with strength, providing 6185 armor at 398% strength, [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) scales with strength providing 199% increase on total armor per enemy hit and Iron skin itself scales with strength as a direct final multiplier. Finally it also affects the Roar buff.

Here are some example Iron Skin numbers based on 398% power strength in this build:
- Basic Iron skin (direct cast) : 7950
- After charging into 1 enemy : 14k
- After charging into 20 enemies : 131k
- After Parasitic Armor and no charge : 74k
- After Parasitic Armor and charging into 1 enemy : 217k
- After Parasitic Armor and charging into 20 enemies with Health Conversion: 3.18 million
- Parasitic Armor, [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) (20 enemies), [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) (20 enemies) and Melee Fortification (assume 5 kills): over 5 million

For reference, in base steel path (<5min in Grineer survival), 1 million iron skin will last approximately 5 minutes of getting shot while standing completely still and not defending.

**Augments**
[\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/): mandatory for scaling the armor to affect iron skin
[\[Iron Shrapnel\]](/items/arsenal/174/iron-shrapnel/): OPTIONAL for allowing you to cancel iron skin and recast at a time that suits you, i.e. before you completely run out. You can leave this unranked since we are only using it for the ability to cancel. If you don't care about cancelling, replace this with either more duration (e.g. [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) to help roar uptime), more strength ([\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/), niras hatred) or [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) for better energy economy.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Battery provides up to 1000 energy max (compared to only 427 energy max with [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) active) when at max possible armor ratings. Even without Parasitic armor or [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) active, just 3 stacks of [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) alone gives 492 energy as a baseline.

Arcane Expertise turns your strength into shield, so at 300% strength we get 200% shield which adds to the 180% from [\[Primed Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/6441/primed-redirection/)

Molt Augmented gives 60% strength after 250 kills. If you don't plan on getting this many kills in a mission,

Other alternatives
- Arcane Tanker: requires calling an archgun
- Arcane Ultimatum: requires performing a finisher, which you can initiate by using knockdowns, aero mods, bronco dizzying rounds or exodia hunt
- Arcane Reaper: requires melee kills which works well alongside Melee Fortification
- Arcane Guardian: requires taking damage

**Helminth**
- Parasitic Armor is the star of this build, providing 6185 armor when at full shields (1554 with [\[Primed Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/6441/primed-redirection/)) with just one press of a button. Compare this to other sources (1200 from arcanes, 1350 from [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), 378 from [\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/), 123 from [\[Gladiator Aegis\]](/items/arsenal/682/gladiator-aegis/)) and you will see how significant this is for Iron Skin. You could boost this even further with Primed Vigor but strength is more valuable to slot.

- Elemental ward (Cold) is the next best alternatives, providing approximately 1291 extra armor at 313% strength. Defy is the next providing 750 armor at max cap. Warcry is the worst alternative giving only 430 armor, but provides the best additional utility from slow and melee attack speed. Note that since you don't need [\[Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/836/redirection/) with these subsumes, you can slot health conversion so elemental ward + health conversion actually gives 2641 total armor.

- Empower can also be used, but you will need to cast before each ability use which makes it a little more clunky to use, and provides less total boost compared to Elemental ward. Empower does however also benefit roar.

- Ensnare or Larva are useful for grouping to help [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/), although there are non subume alternatives for grouping including Zenurik's void singularity, Arcane Magus Anomaly and Exodia Hunt.

**Alternatives/Flexibility**
- Aura - [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) is great when it procs to get another 25% strength, but any aura is fine (e.g. steel charge if you need mod capacity), enemy radar is nice quality of life, mecha empowered for full mecha memes

- **Mecha Pulse +/- Empowered** - a niche but slightly more annoying way to gain TONS more armor. Requires a direct kill of a [\[Marked Target\]](/items/arsenal/1453/marked-target/) (not slash status), has a cooldown for marking and requires you to run a Kubrow or Predasite. To try keep the kubrow alive in steel path, you'll need link armor and to constantly cast parasitic armor or [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) even while iron skin is active to boost the pet's armor (to get damage reduction over 90%). You can do this for fun if you want to mix things up a little. Replace primed continuity with mecha pulse and growing power with mecha empowered. Here is a mecha ensnare Rhino variant: https://overframe.gg/build/268102/rhino-prime/the-wild-hunt-rhino-ensnare-mecha-nuke-millions-iron-skin/ 

Run these builds for kubrow or predasite if you decide to use Mecha mods:

- Huras Kubrow: https://overframe.gg/build/268129/

**Why no umbral fiber/armor mods?**
[\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/) provides 130% extra armor (when paired with [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/)) scaling off base armor, which is only 290, giving a measly 377 armor as well as a measly 11% strength. This gives LESS final Iron Skin than both [\[Amar's Hatred\]](/items/arsenal/5624/amars-hatred/) or [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) while requiring you to spend one or even two Umbral forma.

**Archon Shards (updated for Veilbreaker)**
One or two amber cast speed shards to improve cast speed and quality of life
Put as many Crimson +Strength shards as want since strength TRIPLE DIPS Iron Skin.

**FOR INDEX**
Swap enemy radar into aura (or vigilante pursuit over umbral intensify): https://overframe.gg/build/268079/
Immediately cast parasitic armor followed by iron skin to get about 30k iron skin straight away.
Find an enemy or two and charge them before casting the combo to get between 80-100k iron skin which should last several rounds.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

General Use Sevagoth with either non-helminth base kit or helminth options. You can choose to either keep Shadow or subsume over shadow depending on your preference.

[[ youtube id="G2guSO9z-0k?si=n8jRy4GUL_ZsntW9" ]]

**REAP AND SOW MECHANICS - UPDATE JUNE 2024**
[\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/) is currently one of the strongest zero effort nuke frames that can nuke up to levelcap. Enemies affected by Sow who are then subsequently hit by Reap take true damage equal to 25% of their CURRENT health while also dealing 25%HP of current health as BLAST damage to surrounding enemies in a 4m radius (but not to themselves). This value is NOT affected by ability strength, but is affected by Reap's vulnerability buff (50% at 100% strength), Viral (2x at 1 stack and 4.25x at 10 stacks) and Roar (30% at 100% strength).

In order to one-shot a single enemy, you need to be able to deal 100% of current health which can be achieved with some combination of using a Reap first to debuff, Viral to prime or Roar to buff. The final requirement drops when enemies are densely packed because of the radial blast damage. For example, if there are 4 armor capped enemies standing in a 4m radius of each other and you deal 80% current HP,  each enemy will be dealt 80% HP true damage from the direct reap and then 8% HP from the radial blast component (attenuated by 90% DR of armor) from each of the other three enemies, receiving a total of 80 + 3*8 = 104% damage.

Shadow Haze produces multiple shadows at once while Dark Propagation allows Sow to self-propagate and thus allows the nuke to spread itself across a map. Note, [\[Dark Propagation\]](/items/arsenal/6559/dark-propagation/) also allows Shadow's 3 to create Sow, and [\[Shadow Haze\]](/items/arsenal/6224/shadow-haze/) allows new shadows to be produced on kills, meaning you can perform this same nuke while in Shadow form too, although it is limited by the lack of access to on demand Reap casts.

WITH ROAR (over 3 or 4): You need at least 255% strength with both Reap vulnerability and Roar active on an enemy to allow the next Sow+Reap combo to trigger a 100% current health loss to one-shot an enemy, without needing viral status. Without Reap vulnerability, you can use at least 3 viral status with Roar at 255% strengh to one-shot with Sow+Reap. This means to save energy casting 1 twice, you can just prime 3 viral status and cast Sow then Reap.

Use this build for an Endurance focused Sevagoth pure nuke build with Roar and maximum archon shard investment:  https://overframe.gg/build/717065/

WITHOUT ROAR: You will need at least 200% strength on Reap vulnerability with exactly 1 viral status on an enemy to oneshot on the next Reap without Roar. This can be achieved with AOE primers (e.g. [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/), [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/), [\[Bubonico\]](/items/arsenal/5293/bubonico/)), Panzer or Hounds.

# SHADOW
Using Shadow has its pros and cons and is mostly up to personal preference in the end. 

PROS:
- Interesting mechanic that basically gives you a "second" frame with 3 more abilities to try
- While you are using Shadow, you are technically "immortal" since [\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/) cannot be damaged and dying as Shadow just knocks you back into Sevagoth who should have full shields for a shield gate and you can just return to Shadow almost immediately.
- Shadow Claws are a very strong melee weapon that can now make use of Melee Influence to clear large groups of enemies easily
- You can still somewhat use the Reap + Sow mechanic to nuke because Death's Harvest can spawn Reap Shadows via [\[Shadow Haze\]](/items/arsenal/6224/shadow-haze/) augment but this requires you to manually get a kill with [\[Shadow Claws\]](/items/arsenal/5442/shadow-claws/) after tagging with Death's Harvest. Shadows spawned by kills also apply Sow due to the Dark Propagation augment meaning you will get the spreading effects of Reap + Sow while in Shadow too.

CONS:
- Interrupts flow of the simple Reap + Sow combo 
- Embrace is a bit slow and frustrating to use as it makes them ragdoll slowly towards you and only affects enemies in a cone
- Consume feels mostly useless
- Many helminth abilities become useless in Shadow, or do not directly affect shadow (e.g. roar, nourish, warcry)
- Takes another 5+ extra forma to maximise due to being a whole frame + melee you need to consider.

If you want to use shadow:
Shadow: https://overframe.gg/build/456961/
Heavy Spam Claws: https://overframe.gg/build/718154/

If you DON'T want to use Shadow, use this Shadow build dedicated for reviving only during the passive:
https://overframe.gg/build/457771/

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Gloom (can use either Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) + Zenurik to boost strength before casting for higher slow, or build up kills with Augmented then recast Gloom once max)
2. Cast Sow to mark enemies 
3. Cast Reap to kill enemies marked by Sow (through dealing true damage and causing blast explosions) and mark them with damage vulnerability and flat crit chance buff from Shadow Haze.
4. Using Reap and/or Sow and killing enemies will build up your Death Well. Once full, you can enter Shadow at any time.
5. Optional: Enter Shadow mode and press 1 to group enemies as well as 3 to give damage vulnerability. You can either use light attack melee spam or heavy attack spam to kill groups of enemies.
6. If Shadow dies, simply use Sow + Reap again to recharge Death Well and re-enter Shadow mode.
7. If you die, aim toward enemies and press 2 to consume. You have 5s of initial invulnerability and 20s of total time to consume 5 enemies to revive. Rolling Guard can give an additional 3s i-frames.

To one-shot with Reap and Roar active, you can either press 1 2 1 or 2 1 1. 
To one-shot a single target with only Roar active, you can use a primer to prime 3 viral then press 2 followed by a single 1.
To one-shot a single target without Roar, use a primer to prime 1 viral then press 1 2 1 to 2 1 1.

# SURVIVABILITY
**Shield gating**
[\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/) has 335 base shields so [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) will reduce that to 67 shield. Reap costs 25 energy and Brief respite alone generates 37.5 shield, which is equal to approximately 0.7s i-frame while Sow costs 50 energy generating 75 energy fully resetting 1.33s shield gate. Adding augur mods onto your pistol can give you additional i-frames per cast. Simply spamming Reap and Sow constantly will keep you alive without much thought.

**Secondary Fortifier**
Using a secondary primer or DPS with Secondary Fortifier arcane allows you to steal overguard from eximus and thrax. Overguard makes you immune to status, clears any existing status upon gaining overguard and gives an additional 0.5s i-frame gate on breaking. This is excellent quality of life and can make you even harder to kill.

**Crowd Control**
Gloom is one of the best crowd control abilities in the game, particularly as it gets close to slow cap as it basically prevents enemies from shooting. This affects demolysts and acolytes, but does NOT affect eximus/thrax who have Overguard active. Gloom will prolong any stuns created by other abilities (such as silence) or status effects (such as cold/heat/electric) which will further prevent enemies from shooting. This allows you sufficient breathing room to shield gate once every while or roll out of harms way.

Additional sources of crowd control include a sentinel such as Diriga with Duplex Bond and modded with radiation status, specters and on-call crew.

**Shadow**
Shadow sort of presents a get out of jail card when you have exhauted options eg you have run out of energy to shield gate and Gloom has deactivated, entering Shadow will give you an additional layer of shield gate/health with a crowd control ability. Shadow does not cost any energy to enter and also spawns with full energy due to [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/). You can mix Shadow into your playstyle since its basically free to cast, gives some grouping, AOE damage vulnerability and can DPS with claws.

**Passive**
If you take fatal damage as [\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/), you will activate your passive where Shadow pops out and you need to collect 5 souls as quickly as possible before shadow dies or the timer runs out. Basically spam 2 and target enemies as quickly as possible. You should be able to consume 2-3 souls within the initial i-frames and shield gate if-frames. Once you are vulnerable, use rolling guard and try to consume the remaining 2-3 souls within the i-frames of [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/). If arcane aegis procs, you're basically immortal for that duration so you can consume souls at leisure.

**Tanking Alternative**
If you strongly dislike shield gating playstyles and never plan on playing endurance (i.e. >level 500), you can swap [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), run Arcane Blessing instead of Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) and swap [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) for [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/). Gloom will constantly heal you as you take damage but enemies in higher levels deal more eHP per shot than you have resulting in a one-shot.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Duration affects both Reap and Sow but is not that important since [\[Dark Propagation\]](/items/arsenal/6559/dark-propagation/) allows Sow to self propagate and Reap has a decent base duration (6s flight time, 10s debuff)

Duration also affects the drain of Gloom (to a lesser extent than efficiency), and is particularly important when efficiency is not 175% or higher. Duration does not affect Shadow but could be useful for helminth abilities with durations such as Silence, Nourish etc. You would want to keep this around 80 to 130%.

**Efficiency**
At least some efficiency is useful for reducing the drain of Gloom, although [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + decent kill rate and Synth Decontruct on a companion can deal with the drain of Gloom, meaning we can just sit 100% efficiency. Other methods to boost energy economy include Arcane Energize, [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) with [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) and [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/), [\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Energy Generator\]](/items/arsenal/1388/energy-generator/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) with Xata Invocation, Tenet Glaxion with Photon Overcharge, Primary Exhilirate, Emergence Dissipate

**Range**
About 145-175% range is the sweet spot for Gloom. Any higher and you run the risk of potentially getting enemies stuck beyond your visible range (i.e. in adjacent rooms) so they end up draining your energy unnecessarily while also reducing over kill rates. A bit of range is also needed for the radius of Death harvest debuff from Reap and Sow radius.

The true damage component only affects enemies hit DIRECTLY by shadows. The radial component is blast damage and doesn't scale with range either. Range does affect Sow but since [\[Dark Propagation\]](/items/arsenal/6559/dark-propagation/) allows it to self propagate, you don't need much range to get this going. Range is needed for Gloom so keep range at least 145, can go up to 175 if you prefer.

**Strength**
Strength is needed for the damage vulnerability from Reap, flat CC buff from [\[Shadow Haze\]](/items/arsenal/6224/shadow-haze/) and the slow from Gloom. The slow cap of 95% is reached at 272% strength, which can be hit with several different combinations. Strength does NOT affect the % health from Reap however will affect Reap's damage vulnerability and roar if you subsume this, which both in turn affect % health damage. You need a minimum of 255% strength to one-shot 100% of the enemies health after an initial reap contact.

For Roar builds, to hit one-shot you can use the following options:
- FULL shards NO kills to buildup: [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) (55%) + FOUR Tauforged Strength (60%) + Madurai (40%). This is the best option for quick missions where you don't want to build up Molt Augmented before achieve one shot
- FULL shards, needs kills to buildup: Molt Augmented (60%) + FOUR Tauforged Strength (60%) + Madurai (40%). This is the best option for endurance where you will get 250 kills easily, and can free up the Transient Fortitude slot for additional quality of life like Rolling Guard.
- NO shards, needs kills: [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) (55%) + Molt Augmented (60%) + Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) to snapshot Roar (45%) + Zenurik (20%) (cast from within Wellspring zone) OR Madurai (40%) 

**Aura**
Completely flexible but [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is required for shield gating using Reap.
Other good options include [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) (to hit Gloom slow cap), [\[Steel Charge\]](/items/arsenal/312/steel-charge/) (for capacity).

**Exilus**
Completely flexible but [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) prevents knockdowns, [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) helps hit gloom cap, [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) for slightly more range.

**Flexible Slots**
[\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) is flexible for [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) in solo endurance against Grineer, up to personal preference, as long as you have four Tauforged Strength shards.

**Arcanes**
Molt Augmented gives 60% strength after 250 kills, greatly boosting strength without taking up mod slots but needing 250 kills to build up.
Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) gives another 45% strength which can be snapshot by Gloom and Roar. Optional in case you don't own any shards yet.
Arcane Energize helps significantly with energy economy since it basically provides an additional 600 energy/min (note Gloom drains 240 energy/min at maximum at these stats).

**Archon Shards**
1 tauforged cast speed shard - speeds up animations to make frame feel more fluid
4 tauforged crimson power strength shards - gives 60% strength allowing you to hit both Gloom threshold (272%) and one-shot Reap/Sow threshold (255%) with roar, while freeing up a mod slot (Transient Fortitude) or arcane slot (Molt Vigor).

# HELMINTH
If you DON'T use Shadow, subsume any of the following over 4:
- Roar: boosts Reap %HP, allowing one-shots without viral at 255% strength after an initial Reap
- Silence: Silence creates a 2s stun which can be prolonged by Gloom up to a ridiculous 40s giving insane crowd control. Silence also blocks annoying eximus abilities (like arson fireblast and leech), annoying acolyte abilities (like violence/malice) and annoying enemy abilities (like disruptor ancient hooks). 
- Nourish : boosts energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) to sustain gloom, taking damage releases brief stun which is prolonged by gloom and applies viral status to amplify damage

If you want to specifically use Shadow with a helminth, you are basically forced to subsume over 3 since Dark Propagation and Shadow Haze with Reap/Sow nuke is too good to give up:
You would want to pick an ability that provides some sort of boost TO shadow. This significantly limits the available options because you cannot cast buffs like Roar or Nourish while Shadow is separated from Sevagoth, so only passive aura type abilities work:

- Silence with [\[Savage Silence\]](/items/arsenal/79/savage-silence/) augment: Adding the [\[Savage Silence\]](/items/arsenal/79/savage-silence/) augment forces a 700% stealth melee multiplier (additive to final crit multiplier) which affects Shadow's Claws as long as silence is active and you remain in range of Sevagoth's main body. Replace Catalyzing Shields or Primed Continuity with Savage Silence.

- Eclipse with [\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/) augment: Normally eclipse will only buff the caster. The augment buffs applies an aura so Shadow also receives the buff as long as it is active on [\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/) and Shadow remains in range. 

# ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a basic non-helminth shield gating [\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/) build for general use in starchart, steel path and endurance with many possible helminth options and build variations.

**UPDATE OCT 2025**
The new augment Untime Rift is OPTIONAL over Augur Reach

# BUILD VARIATIONS:
Nourish/Quiver Xaku: Same as this but subsumed over 1
More comfortable energy/survivability 100 efficiency version: https://overframe.gg/build/594750/
Pillage Xaku: https://overframe.gg/build/761400/

**UPDATE
# PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 4 (Vast Untime) first to freeze all timers BEFORE you cast other abilities to maximise their respective timers. Every time you recast 4, each ability ticks down a tiny bit. Vast Untime slows enemies in radius and also applies a 50% vulnerability to void damage (i.e. affects [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s and [\[Lohk\]](/items/arsenal/2830/lohk/)).
2. Activate 1 ([\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper) to buff your weapons with void damage which good against Thrax (1.5x bonus) as well as Overguard (a further 1.5x bonus). Void status also creates void bubbles that attract projectiles into the bubble.
3. Activate 2 (Grasp of [\[Lohk\]](/items/arsenal/2830/lohk/)) when there are enemies around to 'steal' guns'. This will summon a number turrets that auto target enemies and SCALE with enemy level. Strength affects the damage of each gun and range affects the number of guns. At maximum range you will have 16 guns. Each turret deals 50 x strength x enemy level. This means at 200% strength and at level 9999, each turret deals approximately 1 million damage per shot at a rate of 1 shot per second. At 15 guns, this equates to 15 million damage per second which enough to kill most enemies at levelcap very quickly, even when divided among several enemies, especially with armor strip from Gaze or viral priming.
4. Make sure to INVERT Tap/Hold controls. Hold 3 to cycle to Accuse, then tap 3 to convert a whole bunch of enemies into allies (minimap will be filled with blue dots).
5. Hold 3 to cycle to Gaze and Tap 3 ideally on up to TWO accused enemies about 15-20m apart. This will create a passive zone of armor strip in 22m. Note: Casting [\[Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/2565/gaze/) on an Accused enemy is ideal so other accused enemies dont waste time trying to attack the Gazed enemy.
6. If you take damage and lose shields, tap 1 to gain a little shield for gate OR tap 4 gain a bigger gate as well as apply radial slow (approx 50%) and void damage vulnerability.

# SURVIVABILITY
[\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/) has an innate 75% dodge passive while Vast Untime is active, which combined with active Shield Gating and Crowd Control, will allow you to survive reasonably easily at any level.
1. Active Shield Gating: When shields break you will gain a certain amount of i-frames prevent all damage to health depending on the maximum amount of shields reached prior to breaking. Casting abilities with [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) and Augur mods present will regenerate shields allowing you to reset your shield gate on demand. Catalyzing Shields is OPTIONAL and simply improves the efficiency of i-frames so each cast of Xata's Whisper gives 1.33s i-frame with only a single [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) mod. Alternatively, at 45% efficiency with [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) + THREE augur mods (one on frame and two on Burst Laser Prime), casting Xata's Whisper costs 39 energy which generates 104 shield which equates to about 0.8s i-frames. Casting Vast Untime generates 418 shield which equates to 1.45s i-frames. I would generally recommend casting [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper for active gating since it is MUCH cheaper and faster to cast than Vast Untime. Rolling Guard gives additional 3s i-frame and status cleanse which is quite useful as backup but is also OPTIONAL and dependant on your preference.
2. Passive Shiled Gating: If you prefer a much lazier approach not reliant on casting abilities on shield break, you can combine the passive dodge from vast untime with shield regeneration delay reduction mods like [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) and [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/). Adding Omamori subsume makes this even more foolproof and nealy impossible to die. Swap catalyzing shield and [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) 
3. Crowd Control: Accuse (from The Lost) is a vastly underrated ability which converts around 15 and more enemies into allies which draw aggro from other enemies, meaning you will even more rarely take damage. Vast Untime also slows enemies (up to 100% freeze at 400% strength, which is NOT really required).

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Vast Untime freezes ability timers which means you effectively only need to recast 4 once every 30s - 40s. Having more duration helps reduce the frequency you need to recast 4.

**Efficiency**
Adjust your efficiency between 45% and 100% depending on how you play and how often you want to cast abilities. If you are running [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) for invisbility or Vazarin Protective Sling, you may not need to shield gate much and find 45% efficiency fine. If you have poor enemy density and need to shield gate frequently you may want to keep neutral efficiency.

 [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) gives you higher energy capacity and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) allows you to convert health orbs into energy. Each eximus kill guarantees 2 health orbs which is equivalent to 110 energy and Synth Deconstruct on a companion such as Diriga/Panzer/Hound contributes to more health orb production. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is an optional addition that can be activated by certain companions ([\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) with [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/), any sentinel with [\[Coolant Leak\]](/items/arsenal/230/coolant-leak/) and electric modded weapon + [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/), beast with [\[Shock Collar\]](/items/arsenal/1412/shock-collar/) and Hounds with [\[Synergized Prospectus\]](/items/arsenal/5504/synergized-prospectus/)) giving free passive energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/). Additional energy sources if you find energy difficulties include the following: Arcane Energize, [\[Tenet Glaxion\]](/items/arsenal/6552/tenet-glaxion/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) with [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/), Zenurik Wellspring, Primary Exhilarate.

**Range**
Range is [\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/)'s most important stat because it scales the number of guns stolen by Grasp of [\[Lohk\]](/items/arsenal/2830/lohk/), the radius of [\[Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/2565/gaze/), Accuse and Deny and the radius of Vast Untime. Because Grasp of Lohk scales with base 6 guns x range, and rounds down, the cut-offs of range required for guns are 250% range for 15 guns and 267% range for 16 guns. [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) is optional.

**Strength**
Strength is required primarily for the armor strip from [\[Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/2565/gaze/), which reaches 100% at 200% strength OR 164% strength when Corrosive Projection is equipped, as well as the damage of Grasp of Lohk and enemy limit for Accuse if you want to use it. 

**Aura**
- Corrosive Projection helps reduce the strength for full armor strip to 164%. 
- Brief Respite helps with shield gating if NOT using Catalyzing Shield.

**Exilus**
Completely flexible 
- Cunning Drift gives one more lohk gun and more range for Gaze/Accuse
- Primed Sure Footed if you prefer to always avoid knockdowns or power drift to help hit strength thresholds. 

**Arcanes**
Molt Efficiency - gives even more duration 
Molt Augmented - can build up 60% strength after 250 kills
Energize - optional if you own for more energy economy
Arcane Aegis - gives extra passive survivability

**Flexible Options**
Blind rage - if you have energy issues, consider dropping Blind Rage for Transient Fortitude
Catalyzing Shields - optional addition to gain slightly more i-frames per cast, interchangeable or can combine with rolling guard, or can swap out for passive regen mods
Natural Talent - very useful if you don't have one or two amber cast speed shards equipped

**Archon Shards**
2 Amber Cast speed - reduce cast speed of The Vast Untime to reduce time loss of 2 as well as cast speed of quiver
3 Crimson Strength Shards - strength boosts the amount of enemies you can accuse, the damage of Lohk, the buff of Xata's Whisper

# HELMINTH

**Quiver Arrow**
Subsume over1. Quiver Arrow can be used for a lazy afk camping playstyle. Cloak Arrow creates a 6+m radius bubble at the point of contact that makes everything inside invisible so you never get shot at, even by acolytes and eximus (note, the invisibility affects humanoid defense targets but does NOT affect defense pod or excavation cryopods). This is the extreme lazy approach to AFK [\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/), similar to how [\[Octavia\]](/items/arsenal/10/octavia/) is played, but possibly even lazier since you don't need to spam crouch.

The ultimate lazy survivability option for [\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/), combine with passive shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) mods ([\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) and [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/)) and vast untimes dodge and you will basically be unkillable without needing to active shield gate or use invisbility.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This build focuses on Avalanche to achieve 100% armor strip and [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) augment to boost weapon damage further, as well as allowing Breach Surge sparks to red crit.  Survivability mostly relies on shield gating and amazing crowd control from avalanche, which also gives Overguard via Icy Avalanche. Globe offers an additional layer of defense/survivability, or even a way to one-shot enemies with viral status.  

**UPDATE 2026**
Arcane Sculptor is activated by snow globe and locks you to 175% efficiency for 12s. This allows you to run [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) to hit the full strip threshold of 137% with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) without needing shards or arcanes while solving all energy issues, provided you are frequently casting snow globe which you usually should be to throw enemies away and block projectiles.

**UPDATE FEB 2025**
Arcane Truculence procs 10 viral in 30m when gaining overguard which boosts all damage to health by 4.25x. This can replace one of the arcane slots if you prefer.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**
Arcane [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) gives +40% strength and +40% duration for 15s when enemies are frozen, which occurs constantly on [\[Frost\]](/items/arsenal/22/frost/). This means you can rely on just [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) and Arcane [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) to hit full strip from 40% strength (40+90+40 = 170% strength). 

Another interesting interaction is armor. If you want to, you can put [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) over [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) to boost armor to 1665. This increases Snow Globes base health but now with Arcane Battery we can increase Energy Max to 650 (compared to just 427 via Primed/[\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/)), in addition to the bonus armor from his new passive (50 armor every enemy affected by cold status in 15m). Furthermore, [\[Icy Avalanche\]](/items/arsenal/113/icy-avalanche/) was recently changed to give more overguard scaling with Armor (20% of 1665 = 333 overguard, on top of the 60 per enemy).

**UPDATE APRIL 2024**
Breach Surge and Ice Wave Impedance now both no longer work on Eximus/Thrax through Overguard, but [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) still allows Breach Surge to achieve red crits. Note Avalanche can apply 4 cold procs onto eximus which still slow them by 65%.

[\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) with [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) and [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) now gives Avalanche exactly 169% strength after [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/), without needing to get kills to build up Molt Augmented, allowing you to full strip from the beginning of a mission.

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast Breach Surge to stun non-overguarded enemies in line of sight and prime them for spark production.
2. Cast Avalanche (4) to freeze and strip enemies and debuff them for [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) crit boosts. Breach Surge sparks also red crit (300% cc) when they hit frozen enemies due to [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) adding +200%cc onto the base 100% cc of breach surge. Additionally, [\[Icy Avalanche\]](/items/arsenal/113/icy-avalanche/) gives overguard which blocks status effects and has 0.5s iframes on breaking.
3. Use Snow Globe to push all enemies away and block all enemy fire (remember it is invulnerable for 4 seconds). Use 1 to break globes that are in the way.
4. Shoot frozen enemies with weapons to kill enemies and generate surge sparks that red crit on frozen enemies.
5. Optionally, if you prime enemies with viral and use snow globe to push them into walls, this can deal true damage and oneshot. Optionally, you can cast Freeze at the floor to create small patches of ice that slow enemies (not eximus).

Video demonstrating the general playstyle of [\[Frost\]](/items/arsenal/22/frost/) at circuit levelcap and red crit breach surge. Note that Circuit Decrees make these breach surge sparks deal billions of damage from Avalanche alone which will NOT occur as regular Steel Path. You will need a strong single shot weapon to hit these numbers.

# BUILD SPECIFICS:

**Duration**
Duration is not an important stat as Breach Surge and Avalanche both have long base durations where enemies should die before they expire, but you should go too negative. Snow globe does not scale off duration. If you run any helminth buffs or freeze force you may want to add Primed Continuity.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
Avalanche is a very costly ability so you will need some forms of energy regeneration/economy. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is used here as the main source, since it converts health orbs to energy. Every Eximus kill drops a guaranteed 2 health orbs which equated to 110 energy. Adding a companion with [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) means you will generate even more health orbs reasonably consistently. Finally Arcane Sculptor locks you to 175% efficiency after using 3 so if you are consistently using globe you will never run out of energy. 

**Range**
Higher range is ideal so avalanche and breach surge cover a wider area. I am running [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) here just for a bit more extra shield gain for shield gating.

**Strength**
Avalanche only needs 167% ability strength for permanent full strip or 137% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/). The remainder of Frosts abilities general don't need strength in an endurance setting since Snow Globe breaks instantly anyway and is only needed for the 3s invulnerability.  Breach Surge's multiplier helps low damage weapons [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 5 million damage sparks but once you hit the 5 million cap the multiplier doesn't do anything, particularly on stronger single hit weapons (see below in Arsenal section). 

**Aura**
Completely flexible:
- Corrosive Projection lowers the strength threshold for strip to 137%.
- Brief respite can be used for restoring shields for backup shield gate i-frames.

**Exilus**
Completely flexible:
- Ice Spring for parkour velocity to improve mobility
- Power drift to hit any strength thresholds
- Cunning drift for a little more range
- [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) for absolute safety in very high levels if overguard is getting oneshot constantly

**Flexible optional**
Rolling Guard - optional for extra iframes in case you are nullified or out of energy, and cleanses existing statuses (when overguard is not on as gaining overguard does not cleanse existing status). 

Catalyzing Shield - maximum safety so each time you press 3 or 4 you get 1.33s shield gate back 

[\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) is flexible for [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/). Both give the same amount of energy but [\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) has the slight bonus that random kills via cold abilities like avalanche or freeze generates a special large energy orb.

Augments - each of the augments are flexible depending on personal preference. 
- Biting Frost is good for buffing crit based weapons, but if you're using phenmor/laetum/felarx, you should drop this
- [\[Icy Avalanche\]](/items/arsenal/113/icy-avalanche/) is great for givng you and your team overguard, which blocks statuses including knockdown and gives extra 0.5s i frames upon breaking.
- Freeze Force is optional and can be used to provide extra raw damage, but does not combine with any elements to make viral/blast so you do not save mod slots on weapons. Note, this does NOT apply cold damage to Breach Surge.

Natural Talent - important to slot if you don't have 2+ Cast speed shards or Madurai Power Transfer active.

**Archon Shards**
At least TWO normal or ideally Tauforged Amber Cast Speed Shards
TWO to THREE strength shards lets you replace [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) or [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) for a flexble option.
Rest of shards could be Azure Energy Max shards

**Arcanes**
Truculence for free viral status on AOE
Molt Augmented for strength
[\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) for duration and strength
Arachne boosts Breach Surge sparks by 2.5x (bypassing the cap) and also double dips on Glaives/Contagion

# SURVIVABILITY

# HELMINTH
1. BREACH SURGE: Generates sparks from damage (10% chance) or kills (100% chance) and [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) can boost the damage of sparks significantly. Breach Surge has a 100% base crit chance and a 1.5x base crit multi. [\[Biting Frost\]](/items/arsenal/5750/biting-frost/) boosts this to 300% crit chance and 4.5x crit multi. The final multiplier provided by Biting Frost is therefore 1 + 3 x (4.5-1) = 11.5x meaning if a Surge Spark capped at 5 million damage is created, the final damage is actually about 57 million damage. Breach Surge sparks can also headshot and benefit from 'headcrit' where crit damage is multiplied by 2, giving 3 x (1 + 3x(2x4.5-1))= 75x multiplier, dealing a final damage of 375 million damage on headshot. With 10 viral status from arcane truculence this potentially deals 1.6 billion damage. Adding in [\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/), Arcane Arachne or Naramon Lethal Levitation makes this over 4 billion damage (which exceeds the damage cap)

3. NOURISH: Provides viral damage bonus to weapons without modding viral and therefore apply viral status too, boosts all energy gained by a multiplier. See Nourish Variant: https://overframe.gg/build/456819/

3. ENSNARE: Allows you to pull frozen enemies together

4. OTHER ENERGY OPTIONS: If you have energy issues, a helminth that can supply energy is very useful:

## INTRODUCTION

This is a high range [\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/) build that focuses on staying in [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) and using [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) for damage, zipping around with Ripline, grouping with Ripline, boosting attack speed with warcry, slowing and applying damage vulnerability with paralysis.

# SURVIVABILITY
Due to the recent changes with [\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/)'s [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) no longer providing permanent invincibility, you have two main choices for survivability.
1. Invulnerability frame abuse
[\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/) now has a passive based on her [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) meter. While you are above 150% [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/), taking fatal damage will prevent death and give 5s invulnerability (similar to [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/)) but drain all your [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/). Technically if you are able to quickly kill a couple of enemies within that 5s and regain at least 150% range you should be able to stay completely immortal anyway. Arcane Persistence can be used as extra backup invulnerability window to recharge death gate passive in case the 5s window is over and you have not yet killed, persistence prevents you from losing more than 500hp/s while over 700 armor. [\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/) by default has 1000 armor and warcry almost doubles that so you will be safe even if affected by heat status which strips armor by 50%. At over 1500 health this means you it will take at least 2s before you die and you instantly heal health back with [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) due to lifesteal.

2. EHP Tanking
[\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/)'s health and armor stats have been buffed even more and clearly DE intends for us to utilise this for survivability too. If you prefer a more comfortable time particularly in non-endurance missions, just slap on [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and consider adding [\[Umbral Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/693/umbral-vitality/) over [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) (will need more forma). Arcane Blessing or Arcane Reaper are nice considerations over Molt Augmented too. You should be able to comfortably tank even up to level 1000 or higher with Valkyr.

**UPDATE JUNE 2025**
Ripline now groups enemies making [\[Prolonged Paralysis\]](/items/arsenal/86/prolonged-paralysis/) grouping redundant, and also auto melee attacks on cast. Ripline can also be used to quickly traverse the map. [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) no longer makes you invulnerable but instead you get a death gate (5s invulnerability) when above 150% [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) and you take fatal damage. Paralysis now gives a 50% damage vulnerability (Scaling with strength). Valkyrs base armor has been buffed and now we can drop [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and rely just on Arcane Battery for energy (even hits over 500 base for Violet Shard boost). Warcry is also recastable and has a increased base duration meaning Eternal War is now optional for quality of life.

**UPDATE 2025**
Exalted mods can now run acolyte mods/galvanized mods and arcanes meaning [\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/) is even stronger than before and has more options available. Gladiator statsticks have also been removed.

**Update Aug 2024**
With the armor cap, armor strip is no longer as mandatory for [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) to oneshot and in fact, you can even use a passive companion primer to partially strip armor (e.g. via corrosive or heat status procs). Nourish can give both a boost to raw [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) damage and boost energy gained from all sources, including the major source via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/). Arcane Battery is optional but is able to give a ton of extra energy capacity. [\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) is slotted for the option of corrosive cold [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) and also conditional armor from warcry does not allow violet melee crit damage shard to work.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) and use any combination of slide attacks, neutral block combo or just ripline attacks. Slide attacks have very high damage multipliers and hit all grouped enemies multiple times (6 x 300% multiplier or 2250% per second). The neutral block combo now also has a high average multiplier (1063% per second). If running Archon Intensify, you can activate it with hysteria then exit and re-enter [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) within 10s to snapshot the extra 30% strength.
2. Tap 2 to cast Warcry and keep active as required. This is now recastable and has a decent base duration so you don't need to run [\[Eternal War\]](/items/arsenal/83/eternal-war/) if you don't want to.
3. Tap 3 to cast paralysis to apply both slow and damage vulnerability on enemies
4. Tap 1 on enemies to cast Ripline to group enemies and initiate and automatic attack, or tap 1 on a surface to swing quickly to it to traverse maps

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Maintain neutral to positive duration to reduce drain of [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) and give uptime to Warcry

**Efficiency**
You can adjust this to your playstyle and mission type. If there is high enemy density, team mates with energy generation or you are not casting much, you can run 45% efficiency and be fine while at 1000+ energy with arcane battery. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a pet can give you a free 30% efficiency while [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) is active. If you like to cast alot or are having issues with energy, keep efficiency above 100% (i.e. swap [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/)).

**Range**
Maximum range maximises the grouping range of Ripline and the range of Paralysis.

**Strength**
More strength boosts Warcry speed boost (and armor which indirectly gives more energy via Arcane Battery) and Hysteria damage.

**Aura**
- Corrosive Projection in a vacuum reduces armor by 18% which is equivalent to a 1.8x damage multiplier
- Steel charge is good for saving mod capacity/forma and provides a small boost to talons damage.
- Swift momentum is great for maintaining combo duration
- Growing power also slightly boosts talons damage and warcry speed boost 
- Enemy radar to improve positioning by knowing where enemies are on minimap further away

**Exilus**
Completely flexible:
- Cunning Drift gives a bit more range
- Preparation is good for speedrunning missions so you start of at maximum energy
- Hysterical Assault lets you leap onto enemies and gain a short boost to parkour and sprint

**Arcanes**
Arcane Battery - synergizes with warcry and hysteria (gives armor) to give even more energy pool.
Persistence - prevents health loss to 500hp per second when armor is > 700
Fury - boosts melee damage but will be additive to dmg mods on talons e.g. condition overload/primed pressure point
Augmented - more strength
Strike - boosts attack speed
Energize - helps maintain energy to stay in hysteria but expensive

**Archon Shards**
One Cast speed shard optional to speed up casting of Ripline/Paralysis.
Rest into Tauforged Violet Melee Crit damage shards
Parkour shards optional

# HELMINTH OPTONS
Helminth over 3 since 1 has grouping without augment and great mobility.

**Roar**
Roar boosts damage and double dips status effects, also trip dips electric influence and gas afflictions variants.

**Nourish**
Nourish is an excellent subsume that provides bonus raw Viral damage to claws and significantly increases energy gain to sustain [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/).

**Lycath's [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/)**
Gives the most consistent energy generation via health orbs, which convert to energy via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), if you feel energy is an issue.

**Silence**
Against infested, you will want to use **Silence** to block ancient disruptors since they will take all your energy while you are in [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/). 

**Armor strip**
Armor strip gives an effective 10x boost against armored enemies (or 5.5x boost with corrosive projection on)
- Tharros Strike: works well along side [\[Prolonged Paralysis\]](/items/arsenal/86/prolonged-paralysis/) since you can group them first then strip. A single cast full strips both shields and armor in one cast with low strength threshold (200 str at default, 164 str with corro projection), works on acolytes and demolysts and is cheap to cast
- Pillage: radial but line of sight with huge range, requires alot of strength to full strip (400% without [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) and 328% with), or multiple casts otherwise to strip. This also cleanses status and provides shields, both of which are kind of useless in [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) but does have some meme benefit to Paralysis which converts shields to damage. Also means you could run Melee Retaliation in arcane slot.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This is a steel path general use and endurance survival looting focused build using [\[Pilfering Swarm\]](/items/arsenal/164/pilfering-swarm/) to generate additional loot and oxygen, Tempest Barrage to deal AOE DPS, [\[Viral Tempest\]](/items/arsenal/163/viral-tempest/) augment to apply AOE viral procs, Tidal Surge to become invulnerable clear statuses and travel around the map and finally Plunder which applies a corrosive damage boost to both Breach Surge and Tempest Barrage. Breach surge is an optional subsume to deal additional ability DPS and blind enemies 

If you don't want any extra loot, simply swap [\[Pilfering Swarm\]](/items/arsenal/164/pilfering-swarm/) out for [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/). 

Survivability Options:
1. Casual Tanking: This is viable for non SP and early base SP eg first few hundred levels or 1 hour survival etc. Simply swap [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and the Arcanes for [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/)+Blessing.

2. Shield Gating: With [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) and [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) (or any Augur mod) a single cast of Tempest Barrage or Tidal Surge will reset shield gate to 1.33s currently due to a bug where any amount of shield gained gives the full 1.33s gate. Just make sure to constantly be spamming tempest barrage. If this is ever fixed you will need to run multiple other augur mods on your secondary slot or [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/) on a sentinel. Tidal Surge also makes you invulnerable, and [\[Tidal Impunity\]](/items/arsenal/166/tidal-impunity/) even makes you immune to status effects while also reducing energy cost to be almost negligible. Combine active gating with passive crowd control e.g. from Tentacles.

**Alternate Builds**
Weapon Platform (Roar/Nourish): https://overframe.gg/build/541107/
AFK Looting (Quiver):  https://overframe.gg/build/311460/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Find an area to camp in and cast tentacle swarm, ideally having one or two chokepoints.
2. Cast 3 when there are a decent number of enemies nearby, eg trapped in your tentacles
3. Spam 1 on a chokepoint to deal ability DPS, strip armor and apply viral procs in a fixed 10m AOE. You can infinitely stack 1 in the same area.
4. Cast 2 reset shield gate, turn immortal and traverse maps

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
A little bit of duration is needed for Tempest Barrage, Plunder and Tentacle Swarm. 

**Efficiency**
Should keep neutral or positive for Tempest Barrage spam mainly. [\[Pilfering Swarm\]](/items/arsenal/164/pilfering-swarm/) improves energy orb drops. If you find energy is an issue, consider adding other tools like Zenurik, [\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Energy Generator\]](/items/arsenal/1388/energy-generator/), [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/)

**Range**
Higher range is technically preferred for Tempest Barrage although note that Tempest barrages initial radius is FIXED at 10m, while only the impact AOE scales with range. This means range is not AS important for tempest barrage as it seems, particularly if enemies are bunched into tentacles so AOE damage overlaps already. Plunder has a decent base range so it doesnt need a huge range boost. In fact, high range is actively detrimental for tentacle swarm due to its high base radius and enemy capture limit. With 200+ range, you may find tentacles grabbing and trapping enemies outside of your current area which then prevents additional tentacles spawning on new enemies actively coming into your area. For this reason, i'd keep range between 100 to 175 depending on the map and whether you actually want to loot or not. If you want to just KILL and CROWD CONTROL enemies (eg circuit), you can make your range 175+. If you want to actually loot efficiently, keep you range around 100-130.

**Strength**
Strength is used to boost the damage of Tempest Barrage and raw damage boost of Plunder.  The boosts from Plunder are a bit less important, since armor isn't important for a shield gate build, and corrosive bonus damage can be actively detrimental to status weighting on certain weapons (e.g. beams like [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/), [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) etc), since it lowers their heat weighting which is what deals the majority of status DPS. 

**Aura**
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is mandatory for the shield gating setup unless you can offload to external augur mods
If not shield gating, swap for anything else eg [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/), [\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/).
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) is NOT useful, as it is multiplicative with corrosive status and does NOT reduce the number of corrosive procs required to full strip.

**Exilus**
Power Drift - boosts strength
Primed Sure Footed - blocks knockdown

**Flexible Slots**
[\[Viral Tempest\]](/items/arsenal/163/viral-tempest/): Optional since it only provides viral procs which u can simply apply manually if using guns like [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/). Can swap this out for Stretch, Augur Message.

Catalyzing Shields: Can swap this out if you are okay with generating less i-frames per ability cast (115 shield = about 0.7s)

[\[Rousing Plunder\]](/items/arsenal/165/rousing-plunder/): Optional augment that only boosts armor and corrosive dmg bonus from 3, which is already in the base ability, and adds some healing. Could be okay to use in a tank build, but not useful for endurance.

# ARCHON SHARDS
- TWO cast speed shards
- THREE +ability damage on corrosive status - boosts tempest barrage and breach surge if you use it

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Either subsume over 2 (for relatively stationary missions) or over 4 (on more mobile missions where you won't be looting in one spot). 
I generally use a separate speedrun build subsuming over 4 for mobile missions.
1. Breach Surge -receives a corrosive dmg bonus from Plunder (which double dips as Plunder also applies to your weapon and tempest barrage) and is particularly effective as ability DPS on enemies stripped by Hydroid's passive, but no longer blinds enemies
2. Nourish - mainly useful for energy to fuel tempest barrage spam, without taking extra mod slots, but also applies viral damage to your weapons. This means Plunder + Nourish applies both Corrosive and Viral to you weapons and you can drop all elements on your weapon builds for extra crit/dmg mods.
3. Roar - boosts the damage of viral tempest and your weapons.

# SURVIVABILITY
Method 1: Active Shield Gating and Crowd Control
Muzzle Flash is the major source of survivability creating an approximately 20m non-line of sight radial blind every couple of kills
Catalyzing Shields reduces Mesa's max shields to 56 (and currently is bugged to allow ANY amount of shield gained to give 1.33s i-frame on breaking). The act of going in and out of 4 should keep shield gate constantly refreshed. Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL and gives additional i-frames for shield gating. A single Augur Mod (e.g. [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/), [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) or message or Augur on a pistol) is sufficient for full gating. **YOU MUST HAVE AN AUGUR MOD ATTACHED TO A PISTOL OR [\[Burst Laser\]](/items/arsenal/2248/burst-laser/) TO HELP SURVIVE**
In lower levels, having Shatter Shield active also gives 95% damage reduction so keep this active.
If you run Secondary Fortifier on your pistol, Shatter Shield's reflected damage appears to steal overguard (bug) from eximus.

Method 2: EHP Tanking
You can utilize Shatter Shields 95% damage reduction to projectiles and swap [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) for another 90% damage reduction. 

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Some duration is needed to help maintain the uptime of nourish, shooting gallery and shatter shield. Duration also effects the drain of peacemakers.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
Efficiency is required for the drain and activation of peacemakers. You can get free 30% efficiency from [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on your pet. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) + [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + Nourish helps sustain energy.

**Range**
Range is mainly needed for [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) radius which stuns enemies, but also helps with nourish viral retaliation range. Range does NOT affect how far [\[Regulators\]](/items/arsenal/2399/regulators/) can shoot, but does affect the final reticle size after 20 bursts. 

**Strength**
Strength affects [\[Regulators\]](/items/arsenal/2399/regulators/) damage with the following formula:
1 + 1.5 x (1 + 1.5 x STRENGTH + PEACEMAKER DAMAGE MODS + SHOOTING GALLERY BUFF x STRENGTH)

You can see this means strength is additive to damage mods (e.g. [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) and [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)), but also that if you run [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) which provides up to 600% damage at 5 statuses, this is equivalent to running 400% strength already. Each strength mod slot taken up on [\[Mesa\]](/items/arsenal/14/mesa/) therefore does not add that much relative boost to final DPS. [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) is a good option as it is the biggest boost to 4 dps without affecting other stats too much, especially efficiency. [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) also boosts Nourish though which helps viral status consistency and energy gain.

You can use this link to calculate Regulator DPS and try different combinations of arcanes/strength values etc: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-m2RKQTHGD7klGEBxBZr0h9mSP77wmL1xTE0iQvqB50/edit?usp=sharing

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/): gives an effective 1.6x dps boost against armored enemies without any corrosive status on board
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/): use this for shield gating IF the catalyzing shield bug is fixed (where any amount of shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) gives 1.33s gate)
[\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/): conditional strength has a very little DPS boost about 8%
[\[Pistol Amp\]](/items/arsenal/314/pistol-amp/): only 2% DPS boost as it is additive to strength and damage mods, this would be a very last resort

**Exilus**
Flexible:
[\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) for more range
[\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/) to start with max energy
[\[Mesa's Waltz\]](/items/arsenal/93/mesas-waltz/) is up to personal preference
[\[Ice Spring\]](/items/arsenal/845/ice-spring/) for parkour velocity

**Arcanes**
Arcane Velocity is a huge DPS boost (45% to 75%) depending on amalgam [\[Furax\]](/items/arsenal/1120/furax/) or [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/)
Arcane Hotshot at max stacks max rank gives 300% crit chance
Arcane Avenger is a decent DPS boost (19% to 50%) depending on archon shards or secondary outburst
Molt Augmented is only a 10% DPS boost
Molt Efficiency optional for more duration
Arcane Energize optional for more energy economy

# ARCHON SHARDS
3 to 5 Tauforged Topaz Secondary Crit Chance shards gives the highest possible DPS boost, even after considering Secondary Outburst and Arcane Avenger
1 to 2 Parkour Velocity shards to jump higher and move around faster

# OPERATOR
I would use Vazarin for protective sling for on demand 5s immortality, allowing you to spend up to 5s standing still in regulators shooting without worrying about dying. 

On Tektolyst arcanes, make sure to use Zid-An Uskos, the one that gives up to +250% heat damage to secondary weapon (applies to [\[Regulators\]](/items/arsenal/2399/regulators/)), permanently until you die.

# HELMINTH
Subsume over 1 if you are just playing casual missions up to level 1000ish where Shatter Shield is very comfortable allowing you to tank multiple hits to shield before shield breaks.
Subsume over 3 if you are playing levelcap where the damage reduction from Shatter Shield is meaningless, and casting 1 while in peacemakers allows you to shield gate without exiting.
- Nourish: Gives energy multiplier and viral damage to regulators
- Roar/Eclipse: Both give a similar damage bonus to regulators 
- Xata's Whisper: gives slightly less damage than roar/eclipse but has bonus against overguard and also procs void bubble on enemies which attracts enemy bullets back into themselves
- Pillage: full armor strip boosts damage against armored enemies (10x) without needing corrosive procs, gives shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) for 2.5s shield gate and cleanses status

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This is a shield gate oriented [\[Nekros\]](/items/arsenal/38/nekros/) with active playstyle for general steel path looting and endurance.

If you prefer a traditional tanking style Nekros, you can use this variant:  https://overframe.gg/build/219927/

This build shares polarities with the Tomb Raider Petrify Nekros build:  https://overframe.gg/build/212485/

**UPDATE 2025**
I have removed Gloom and [\[Despoil\]](/items/arsenal/145/despoil/) as these are no longer really needed. Gloom doesn't affect eximus enemies and [\[Creeping Terrify\]](/items/arsenal/148/creeping-terrify/) slows enemies too. Since we are able to pick up health orbs now at full health while [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is equipped, without [\[Despoil\]](/items/arsenal/145/despoil/), and eximus now have gauranteed health orb drop, [\[Despoil\]](/items/arsenal/145/despoil/) is no longer mandatory although you could still use it if you prefer having a separate energy pool to make sure desecrate never turns off.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 3 to activate Desecrate and keep active at all times. Kill enemies with this active to generate health orbs which are converted to energy by [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/).
3. Cast 2 when surrounded by groups of enemies to crowd control them, fully strip armor and reset shield gate as needed
4. Cast 1 on heavy units when low on health (<25%) to instant kill them + spawn a shadow. Usually I tend to spam 1 while shooting heavy enemies since it is onehanded and has a quick cast animation. Killing an enemy within 3s AFTER you soul punch will also spawn a shadow. Once you [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 7 shadows, casting 1 and killing with then heal all current shadows to full health instead.
4. Cast 4 to summon 7 shadows simultaneously, or heal all 7 shadows if they are low on health.


## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration mainly affects the rate of health decay of shadows. The base duration of Terrify is so long that you shouldn't really need to invest much duration for this. Duration has no effect on Soul Punch or Desecrate.

**Efficiency**
Energy economy relies mainly on desecrate producing health orbs (which have been buffed to 50) and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) which converts each orb to give 55 energy. You should adjust the efficiency to your playstyle, with 45% efficiency being fine if you are not casting as often and just using AOE clearing weapons and up to 130% being necessary if you have a cast heavy playstyle. If you drop [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) you will need to add more strength to ensure you hit the strip threshold on terrify (167%).

**Range**
This is flexible and down to preference and tileset. Having too large a range on a map with small rooms may mean you slow enemies in other rooms or scare them away from you before you even see them. Having too small a range on large open tilesets may mean you won't be affecting the distant enemies at all. You can adjust between 145% to 235%. 

**Strength**
Terrify only needs 167% strength to full strip and shadows damage/health are affected by strength. Otherwise soul punch and desecrate are not affected by strength.

**Aura**
- Brief respite - helps shield gating as generating more shields from casting 2 gives more i-frames on break
- Summoner's Wrath - boosts shadows if you wanted to focus on shadow DPS

**Arcanes**
- Molt Augmented/Camisado - increases strength to help hit full strip breakpoint. You could add strength shards for this instead.
- Arcane aegis - filler arcane that helps refill shields passively making you periodically immortal (particularly to eximus attacks)
- Eruption - energy orbs produced by desecrate can knockdown enemies in 30m range
- Arcane Consequence - boosts parkour velocity

**Flexible slots**
Exilus:
If you don't own [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/), other exilus options are [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/), [\[Handspring\]](/items/arsenal/825/handspring/), [\[Vigilante Pursuit\]](/items/arsenal/700/vigilante-pursuit/) e.t.c, depending on your preference

[\[Creeping Terrify\]](/items/arsenal/148/creeping-terrify/): This makes terrified enemies 80% slow so they don't run away from you as fast, making them easier to hit. Can swap out for more strength

Rolling Guard: Optional, helps status cleanse and provides i-frames

**Archon Shards**
ONE to TWO Amber cast speed shards - amazing for improving the cast of terrify and shadows
TWO Tauforged crimson strength shards - allows you to hit 167% terrify full strip threshold without conditional boosts like molt augmented
ONE to TWO Parkour Velocity shards for mobility

# HELMINTH
You can subsume over either 1 or 4 depending on if you [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) the animation of 4 or spamming of 1 more, as both are capable of producing shadows.
1. Nourish : Nourish boosts energy generation further, applies viral damage bonus to both your weapons and your shadows and creates radial viral procs on taking damage
2. Pull : Pull with [\[Greedy Pull\]](/items/arsenal/135/greedy-pull/) augment is a great way to group enemies and simultaneously increase looting speed since it pulls loot straight to you so you dont even need to go pick it up 

# ARSENAL
For maximum looting with desecrate, we want to use weapons that divide enemy bodies into 2 on kill. This allows you to have two chances per enemy to generate loot.

There are TWO main ways to achieve this:

1. Non-DOT raw or physical damage on a weapon with >50% innate slash bias. This just means the weapon has >50% proportion of its physical IPS damage components as slash, which can be modified by +slash mods but is NOT affected by elemental mods. You can then mod raw damage on like viral, corrosive, radiation etc depending on the enemy you face. Since [\[Nekros\]](/items/arsenal/38/nekros/) has armor strip, raw viral damage modded weapons are typically the way to go. Note, kills via SLASH PROCS (aka BLEED PROCS) will NOT split enemies, so be careful not to use high slash status weapons like weeping wounds modded nikana prime etc. 

Examples of good raw damage moddable weapons with >50% slash bias include: 
- Phenmor
- Miter Incarnon
- Dread Incarnon 
- Tenet Flux Rifle
- Soma Incarnon
- Boltor Incarnon
- Braton Incarnon
- Kuva Kohm
- Pyrana Prime
- Vasto Incarnon
- Dual Toxocyst (requires +slash mod)
- Nearly all good slash melees (just mod for raw viral) eg [\[Nikana Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1177/nikana-prime/), [\[Kronen Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1191/kronen-prime/), [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) incarnon, [\[Gunsen Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6258/gunsen-prime/), [\[Praedos\]](/items/arsenal/5839/praedos/). ([\[Dual Ichor\]](/items/arsenal/1104/dual-ichor/) requires a +slash mod).

2. [\[Amalgam Ripkas True Steel\]](/items/arsenal/2508/amalgam-ripkas-true-steel/) forces enemies to be 'gored' on death, meaning they will be split from kills from ANY source including bleed procs, AOE damage, raw damage and even ability kills eg thermal sunder. Note, sometimes if your final hit is on the head or a limb, the split body part may NOT be desecrated. Overall this is the most flexible method allowing you to use very strong high KPM primary and secondary weapons to bisect enemies, eg [\[Torid\]](/items/arsenal/907/torid/) Incarnon, [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/). Amalgam Ripkas also has bonus to increasing shotgun reload speed, so you can pair it with a strong shotgun for maximum synergy:
- Strun Incarnon
- Boar Incarnon
- Phantasma
- Felarx
- Tenet Arca Plasmor
- Cedo
- [\[Phage\]](/items/arsenal/1005/phage/)
