# INTRODUCTION
[\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) focused [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/) build utilising all base abilities with [\[Elusive Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6491/elusive-retribution/) and [\[Reactive Storm\]](/items/arsenal/4243/reactive-storm/) augments. [\[Reactive Storm\]](/items/arsenal/4243/reactive-storm/) adds tons of status chance to [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) allowing it to apply statuses such as viral + heat or electric quickly, as well as converting the small impact component into an additional element to match enemy weakness. [\[Elusive Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6491/elusive-retribution/) gives bonus attack speed and critical damage upon dodging attacks.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025** 
Exalted Weapon rework has mega buffed [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/), allowing you to run acolyte mods such as weeping wounds and blood rush as well as arcanes e.g. Melee Influence.

**UPDATE JULY 2024 - Armor Strip from Pillage is no longer as necessary as it is capped at 2700 (or 90% damage reduction). Partial strip with Corrosive Heat is much more valuable than before, as 90% strip now drops armor to 270 for 28% DR (i.e. 100 damage is reduced to 72). Full strip is equivalent to a 10x damage multiplier while partial strip via Corrosive Heat is equivalent to a 7.2x multiplier, and there is only approx 40% difference between them now. For this reason, I have removed Pillage and show a base non-helminth build with suggested helminth abilities below.**

Nourish Elusive Retribution variant: https://overframe.gg/build/672521/
Pull Baruuk build: https://overframe.gg/build/402139/. 
Panzer build (Swap Tandem Bond over Hunter Recovery): https://overframe.gg/build/220091/

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Elude and Desolate Hands (3), always keeping Desolate hands above 9 daggers for max damage reduction.
2. Stand still and don't attack for brief periods to build up [\[Elusive Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6491/elusive-retribution/). You should be able to naturally sustain this buff in between attacks.
4. Periodically use Lull (2) on Enemies to erode Restraint and crowd control enemies allowing your Panzer to attack and build combo
6. Keep [\[Serene Storm\]](/items/arsenal/7444/serene-storm/) (4) active and spam light melee to kill enemies. Can use a combination of slide attacks and grouping tools to build combo direct on [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/).
7. If shield gating, cast Lull or Desolate hands to reset shields actively, or simply stop attacking to allow shields to restore while in Elude.

[[ youtube id="8LIEUzXgar8" ]]

# SURVIVABILITY
In non-endurance content, [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/) has multiple layers of damage reduction that multiply together making him innately extremely tanky. You can swap Transient Fortitude for Adaptation.

**Damage Reduction Calculations**
At minimum restraint - 50% damage reduction
At 9 or more Desolate Hands daggers - 90% damage reduction
With Serene Storm active - 40% damage reduction

Max total damage reduction WITHOUT [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) = 97% damage reduction
Max total damage reduction WITH [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) = 99.7% damage reduction
Accounting for adaptation AND base armor = 99.8% damage reduction to health

In endurance content we can rely on many factors:
- Elude allows you to completely negate damage while NOT attacking
- Crowd Control from Lull and Disarm from 3 and 4 allows you to prevent attacks WHILE you attack
- Rolling Guard for i-frames and status cleanse (OPTIONAL)
- Pillage or Brief Respite to reset shield gate (OPTIONAL)
- Vazarin Protective Sling for more i-frames (OPTIONAL)
- [\[Dante\]](/items/arsenal/6507/dante/) Specter casts Triumph and allows you to constantly gain overguard (OPTIONAL)

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration does not affect Desolate Hands or [\[Serene Storm\]](/items/arsenal/7444/serene-storm/) and lower duration allows Lull to be recast quicker. We only need enough duration to help reduce the drain of Elude, or for a helminth ability. 

**Efficiency/Energy**
[\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) drain and use is not affected by efficiency. You should be casting Lull and Dagger sparingly and we can offset the drain of Elude with a bit of duration as well as [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) from your companion. Energy restoration relies mostly on the combination [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on your companion and high KPM as well as eximus kills (each eximus drops a guaranteed 2 health orbs for 110 energy converted from health). [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is needed for sustaining energy economy and allowing Violet Shards to give maximum melee crit damage boost (requires energy max > 500).

**Range**
Elude requires exactly 200% range to hit a 360 degree dodge radius, meaning you are completely immune to all damage while not attacking. We can hit this with [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) + at least rank 3 [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/). If you prefer to run [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) in exilus, you will either need to add [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) to hit 200 range to just deal with having 190 range which still gives you near complete dodge. Range also allows Lull to affect a wider range, but makes you lose daggers more quickly. 

**Strength**
High strength boosts damage of [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) and [\[Elusive Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6491/elusive-retribution/) buffs, as well as any helminth abilities you may plan on using.

**Aura**
Aura is always flexible depending on preference:
Brief Respite - allows for active shield gating.
Growing Power - more strength

**Flexible Slots**
[\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/) flexible for [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/), [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) or [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/)

[\[Endless Lullaby\]](/items/arsenal/4244/endless-lullaby/) is a nice quality of life to recast lull without you actually casting, giving crowd control and eroding restraint
[\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) is a flexible option that doubles the heat status procs from [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/). This results approximately 18% final DPS boost on a viral heat build. If you do a pure heat inherit setup with a primer, then Archon Vitality would give approximately 50% DPS boost.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Fury -  boosts damage for Desert Wind, additive to primed pressure point
Molt Augmented - boosts Desert Wind base damage and Elusive Retribution buffs
Arcane Strike - gives attack speed, but less impactful than Fury due to Elusive Retribution and Berserker fury both giving bigger values
Energize - optional for energy economy

**Archon Shards**
These are flexible:

Violet Shard: 3 to 4 Tauforged for over +225% melee crit damage

# HELMINTH

### **INTRODUCTION**
This is a more active steel path viable build focused around [\[Wukong\]](/items/arsenal/37/wukong/)'s Celestial Twin and giving it both increased damage and crowd control utility. Buffs such as Nourish, Eclipse with [\[Total Eclipse\]](/items/arsenal/118/total-eclipse/) or Roar can apply damage buffs to both you and the Celestial Twin. [\[Enveloping Cloud\]](/items/arsenal/1385/enveloping-cloud/) is used to make Celestial Twin invisible, which allows it to survive very high levels. [\[Celestial Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/142/celestial-stomp/) gives very wide range crowd control. Survivability comes from crowd control, shield gating, invulnerability from cloudwalker/defy and wukong's passive rather than the normal health/armor tanking route. Defy is an infinite scaling nuke that scales with enemy level since it reflects current enemy damage.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
[\[Wukong\]](/items/arsenal/37/wukong/) [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) has been mega buffed due to now being able to use Acolyte mods ([\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/) and [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/)) as well as Arcanes (Melee Influence). Since [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) has a good base damage, very high range (3.5m base + 5.5m at max combo bonus + 3m from [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/) = 12m range) and 1 [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/), [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) is now one of the strongest 'standard melee' influence weapons in the game. This build below forgoes attack speed due to Arcane Strike on the frame. If you do NOT have Arcane Strike, you should add an attack speed mod (e.g. [\[Quickening\]](/items/arsenal/327/quickening/), [\[Berserker Fury\]](/items/arsenal/359/berserker-fury/) or [\[Primed Fury\]](/items/arsenal/349/primed-fury/)) over either Smite or Galv Elementalist slots.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This Zephyr build is geared towards General use on steel path missions, particularly defense/mobile defense/excavation as well as endurance steel path survival/disruption, offering high range crowd control and grouping from airburst, AOE nuking and crowd control from tornadoes and easy survivability/defense from high range turbulence. Tailwind also gives quick map traversal and floating with tailwind gives passive crit chance bonus as well as good positioning away from melee units.

If you are new / beginner and just got Zephyr from the dojo, use this super budget ZERO forma non-prime variant with no primed mods : https://overframe.gg/build/294975/ 

Alternate Jet Stream Based speedrun/open world build: https://overframe.gg/build/212547/

**UPDATE JAN 2026**
Changed arcanes to Concentration and Circumvent and added [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) for energy instead of energize. Also added [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) to maximise duration even more for comfort and make tailwind even faster.

Arcane Concentration gives +60% duration if you cast something 3s after another ability e.g. if you cast airburst everytime before using 3 or 4, you can get an extra 60% duration on both those abilities meaning much less recasting required.

Arcane Circumvent allows you to strip armor, shield and overguard while stealing it for yourself. This works excellently with grouping via either airburst or tornado as you can strip multiple enemies in a single dodge.



**VEILBREAKER UPDATE 2023**
[\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is a new optional addition. Tornado inherits elements shot into it and most weapons you'll use with [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) should be electric. This means tornado's can proc [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) for some free energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/).

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
Electric and Gas are back and no longer break tornado, and now Blast is one of the best statuses for Tornado. 
These three elements (Electric, Gas and Blast) work well with grouping and tornadoes. Electric is technically the strongest because Electric DoT scales from electric mods and has no status cap, while Gas and Blast are slightly weaker since they do not scale from elemental mods and have a status cap of 10. Gas however has the largest possible AOE and lingers for the whole 6s even without enemies, continuing to hit tornadoes and spread damage to create a "kill zone". Blast on the other hand has the fastest kills rates on weapons with decent status chance but requires more mods than electric and does not linger like gas. 

The general rules for elements are:
Electric: If a weapon has no innate elements, use an electric mod to make pure electric.
Gas: If a weapon has innate heat or toxin with strong slow attacks, use a single toxin or heat mod to make gas
Blast: If a weapon has innate heat or cold with fast fire rate and good status, use a single cold or heat mod to make blast
Corrosive Blast: If a weapon has innate heat,cold,toxin or electric and you are able to offload mods like fire rate, damage etc, you may be able to fit three element mods to make Corrosive Blast to allow self-stripping

[\[Trumna\]](/items/arsenal/5125/trumna/) Alt fire completely recharges again from DoT kills whiile in Tornado, giving you infinite nukes! 

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate turbulence and keep activated on cooldown (watch your timer). Use turbulence to [\[Protect\]](/items/arsenal/221/protect/) defense objects.
2. Hold 4 to cast three stationary tornadoes, or tap 4 to cast three homing tornados. Aim down sight to guide the closest homing tornado.
3. Jump into the air and hold 1 to hover. This gives you a +150% crit chance boost (additive) and keeps melee units away. Tap 1 to traverse map quickly.
4. Tap 2 to create airburst vortex that sucks enemies into tornadoes. Aim near the edge of tornado pull radius to get more enemies into tornado quicker.
5. Shoot any tornado with your electric or gas weapon and watch them die.

Video demonstrating levelcap circuit gameplay with silence subsumed:

.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
We want duration mainly for maximum comfortable turbulence uptime and as a bonus it affects tailwind travel speed and hover channelling cost. Tornado has a very long base duration already and airburst is not affected by duration at all. 

**Efficiency**
[\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) and [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on a priming companion will help upkeep energy e.g. panzer, [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/), hound.
[\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) gives minor passive energy regeneration and works with electric weapons applying to tornado.

**Range**
Note that range does NOT affect the actual pull and damage radius of tornado, which is locked at 10m per tornado. Casting three stationary tornadoes creates a triangle of semi-overlapping 10m radius circles, meaning the effective pull radius of a triple tornado is actually closer to 20 m radius. Having high range however increases airburst to nearly 20m pull radius, meaning if you aim an airburst at the outside of a tornado, you can effectively pull enemies from over 40m away into the centre of a tornado complex. High range is also extremely beneficial for Turbulence, allowing you to cover defense objects by standing next to them, and deflecting AOE projectiles further away so you don't take damage from AOE effects.

**Strength**
This does not affect the build in a meaningful way as strength only affects the damage of tailwind, airburst and passive tornado damage. It dos not affect the damage distribution from weapons, which is what does the bulk of damage.

**Aura/Exilus**
Aura 
- Enemy radar helps plan enemy pathing for optimal tornado placement and airburst use
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) is an optional addition as backup survival against breakthrough damage (melee, explosions) or if turbulence is down for some reason (e.g. disrupted by Violence/Demolyst)
- Corrosive Projection maximises damage against armored enemies

Exilus
- Cunning Drift for even more range
- [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) or [\[Handspring\]](/items/arsenal/825/handspring/) to prevent knockdowns which makes Zephyr vulnerable to melee attacks and reduces DPS (but this can now be replaced somewhat by Unairu Poise)
- Aero vantage is an option that allows you to basically hover without tailwind, particularly if you choose to replace 1
- Vigilante pursuit if you don't run enemy radar

**Flexible Slots**
Natural talent - essential quality of life mod but is now replaced with archon shards. Speeds up the animation of turbulence cast so recasts are faster meaning less downtime in vulnerable state and drastically speeds up slow cast time of tornado.

Rolling guard - optional useful mod for endurance runs. Even though turbulence blocks all projectiles, [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) will still need to recast every 30s and becomes completely vulnerable in between. Furthermore, AOE damage and environmental status effects still go through turbulence so the status cleanse and invulnerability from rolling guard is very useful for survival.

**Augments**
Funnel Clouds - Optional augment for use with AOE/ high spread weapons, put this over [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/). This makes tornadoes smaller but increases their total number from 3 to a total of 11 tornadoes. While they cannot innately pick up enemies with the augment, casting airburst or afflicting enemies with a ragdoll state causes them to be sucked into tornadoes exactly like without the augment. Because each tornado is smaller with a 5m radius they tend to overlap less. However, if you use an AOE/high spread weapon that can hit multiple tornados at once, then an enemy caught in a single tornado can potentially receive up to 11 damage instances of that one AOE shot, rather than the default of 3. Therefore you want to reserve Funnel Clouds when using weapons that can hit multiple tornados in one shot e.g. AOE weapons (trumna, bubonico alt-fire) and weapons with high spread ([\[Stropha\]](/items/arsenal/4646/stropha/), tenet arca plasmor). Single target weapons like fulmin and most bows work better without the augment.

Target Fixation - meme option that makes Tailwind do ridiculous scaling damage, however you will not be using weapons any more and will basically be spamming an ability rotation of jumping, airburst to group, then slamming down into the group, then jumping back up into the air immediately. 

Jet Stream - you want strength to use this augment, so won't work well at 40% strength, consider adding molt augmented over circumvent or concentration if you want, or see alternate build:  https://overframe.gg/build/212547/

Airburst rounds - also scales with strength so needs extra strength investment. See alternative build :  https://overframe.gg/build/212547/

**Helminth**
Generally you will replace tailwind or airburst depending on if you really want the mobility of tailwind or not.

- Silence - great option for preventing violence from dispelling turbulence/tornado and preventing eximus abilities from damaging you through turbulence.

- Tempest Barrage - can deal damage in AOE and proc corrosive status (for partial armor strip) and viral status (with augment), creating a semi-afk zone of death since tornadoes can multiply Tempest Barrage damage by up to 10x without funnel clouds and aproximately up to 34x with funnel clouds.

- Nourish - low strength nourish adds viral to weapons without overweighting the status distrbution meaning you can still use electric/gas/blast status weapons well while still benefiting from viral status without external priming. You also get a minor energy boost.

- Spectrorage - [\[Spectrosiphon\]](/items/arsenal/2296/spectrosiphon/) is great to generate tons of energy orbs for you and your squad, since [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) does not need more crowd control or damage and spamming tornado and airbust can cost a lot of energy. This is also good for newer players who do not own a rank 5 arcane energize. Simply subsume spectrorage over 1 (so you can still airbust to suck enemies in, particularly with [\[Funnel Clouds\]](/items/arsenal/184/funnel-clouds/)) or 2 (if you enjoy floating, but you can't use funnel clouds), and put the spectrosiphon augment over streamline or augur message/flex slot.

- Breach surge - sparks produced from tornado damage can feed back into tornados and make stronger sparks. Synergy seems good on paper but it is inconsistent in practice and tornados can already do so much damage you probably won't notice it. You may also want to build positive strength to help the breach surge multiplier.

- Spellbind +/-spellbound harvest - decent option for the status immunity and knockdown resist if you don't own primed sure footed. Spellbound harvest augment returns energy whenever cast on 4 or more enemies.

- Sickening Pulse - if you want enemies to die even faster than what Tornado alllows, use this to double-triple the gas/electric proc damage.

**Archon Shards**
Crimson Shard : Ability Duration (Use 3 or more)
Amber Shard: Cast Speed (Use 2), allows you to drop [\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/) for a flexible option (e.g. augment, [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/))
Amber Parkour Velocity optional

## ARSENAL
**Weapons**
AOE and spread weapons are able to deal the most damage because they can hit the group of enemies floating in the tornado, as well as all tornadoes at once (either 3x at base or 11x with [\[Funnel Clouds\]](/items/arsenal/184/funnel-clouds/)). If an AOE weapon achieves a critical hit on all three tornadoes and the enemy, while the enemy is within the radius of all three tornadoes simultaneously, they would receive approximately 1 + 3 x 3 x 2 = 19x damage multiplier, allowing for a bit of AOE fall off. If you use 11x funnel clouds, enemies are typically only in the range of 2-3 of these tornadoes simultaneously, meaning you get approximately 1 + 11 x 3 x 2 = 67x damage multiplier.

Note that since tornados are counted as objects and cannot hold a status, galvanized savvy/aptitude/shot and [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) that rely on status do NOT give bonus damage. As such, make sure you swap these mods out for +dmg mods instead if applicable.

# COMPANION
Citrine has a strong focus on free moving companions, especially now with the Prismatic Companion Augment. **KUBROW**
Note [\[Summoner's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7186/summoners-wrath/) is actually stronger and more consistent than the full Mecha set, because it double dips DoTs for every attack rather than boosting dmg on one enemy every 15s, and causes [\[Contagious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6277/contagious-bond/) to loop on every single kill rather than once every 15s. Kubrow's require a 'statstick' which boosts their crit chance and status chance. Prismatic Gem affects the statsticks status chance and in turn, the final status chance of the kubrow. With [\[Paris Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1075/paris-prime/) Incarnon statstick, a max status riven and Prismatic Gem active we can hit approximately 450% final kubrow status chance meaning at least 4 guaranteed status effects applied by the kubrow per hit.

# SURVIVABILITY 
OPTION 1 : EHP Tanking
At max Arcane Blessing, you get 1605 total health without wasting a slot for [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/).
At max [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) stacks, you get 1600 total armor which contirbutes 84.2% damage reduction (to health only)
At max [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) stacks you get 90% damage reduction to a specific damage type.
At max Preserving Shell you receive another 90% damage reduction.

Multiplying all sources gives a potential maximum of 99.84% damage reduction which then translates into a total of 1,003,100 effective HP. This should allow you to tank damage in Steel Path to the level of around 500-1000, but might NOT allow you to survive much higher or closer to levelcap as enemies start doing more than 1 million damage per shot.

OPTION 2 : Shield Gating + Invisibility
Swap Adaptation for Catalyzing Shield and equip augur mods on you pistol so every cast of 1 generates shields which gives you 1.33s i-frames on shield break. If you constantly spam 1 everywhere , you will effectively be unkillable from non-toxin damage. Energy sustain is easy since 1 makes so many orbs to fuel [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/).

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Positive duration is required for uptime of Preserving Shell as well as for 3 and 4. Primed Continuity/[\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is sufficient, but feel free to increase it further by swapping [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) for [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/).

**Efficiency**
Efficiency can be sacrificed due to the energy generating capabilities of 1 + equilibrium.

**Range**
Range is required for the range of Fractured Blast, Prismatic Gem and Crystallize. Around 145-175% is sufficient, which you can achieve with Stretch +/- Augur Reach +/- [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/). [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is optional over normal [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) since electic procs give some minor almost negligible energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/), at the cost of more forma. 

**Strength**
A threshold of 200% strength gives Fractured Blast a 100% chance to drop health orb and any bonus strength above 200% gives a chance to drop a second health orb, as well as a 40% chance to drop energy orbs. This ultimately translates to increased energy generation for yourself and allies. Strength also affects the starting damage reduction and build-up rate of Preserving Shell but does NOT affect the 90% cap. It also has an effect on the damage of 3 and 4, which is mostly negligible, but does boost the status chance/duration bonus provided by 3.

**Archon mods**
These are all flexible for their normal primed/non-primed variants. 

[\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is optional as it provides minor passive energy regen and is activated by 3. Archon Continuity is optional as it provides bonus corrosive procs for condition overload/galvanized CO and minor armor striip, and is activated by 3. [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) is optional but is largely replaced by Arcane Blessing. [\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) is also optional but you will most likely not be activating it by 3, so you should only use this is you don't own Primed Flow. Don't use any Archon mods if you subsume over 3.

**Aura**
Completely flexible. 
- Summoner's Wrath : boosts companion damage by +75%, but since this acts like ROAR/FACTION MOD, this double dips status damage for a 3.06x multiplier. When combined with contagious bond this can create a feedback loop at hits damage cap.
- Corrosive Projection slightly reduces armor
- Enemy Radar helps with tracking enemy movements so you capitalize on casts of 1 and 4 to catch the most enemies.
- [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) : for use specifically with a KUBROW running the mecha set, allowing you to spread status procs created by 1,3 or your weapon for occasional map nuking. Replace [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) with [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) if you try this and pair it with this a kubrow build:

**Exilus**
Handspring interchangeable with Power Drift or Primed Sure footed if you own it.

**Flexible Options**
- Recrystalize - OPTIONAL if you are using weapons and want to get red crits, but do NOT care about hitting headshots
- Augur Reach - more range
- Natural Talent - This is extremely recommended if you do not use Amber Cast speed shards as both 3 and 4 have ridiculously long cast times. Could slot over Augur Reach or Primed Flow.
- Augur message/Constitution - add more duration for uptime of 2
- Archon Vitality - Flexible addition over Health Conversion or Augur Reach if you don't own Arcane Blessing, which also boosts heat procs from 3
- Mecha Pulse - only if you use the mecha set with Kubrow

**Arcanes**
Totally flexible
Arcane Impetus - gives efficiency and strength
Arcane Blessing - adds 1500 health after picking up health orbs which is very easy with fractured blast
Arcane Guardian - adds 900 armor flat to increase damage reduction to health
Molt Augmented - gives bonus strength with kills

# ARCHON SHARDS
Armber Shards - 2 Cast speeds shards is basically mandatory to make Crystallize cast speed bearable, and even then you might want natural talent or madurai power transfer to make it feel better. 
Other shards are flexible:
- 2 Violet Equilibrium shards allow you to offload Equilibrium for another mod
- 2 Parkour velocity shards give you more mobility
- Emerald shard - 1 TAU +corrosive stack allows [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) to hit 13 corrosive which is 98% strip, but this does take a while and may not be worth it if enemies just die way before you hit 13 stacks.

# HELMINTH
Crystallize is the main subsume slot because it is slow and clunky to use, can be difficult to actually hit the crystals (can't hit with AOE), and doesnt actually boost the damage of good crit weapons that much since you are often forced to aim away from the head.

Options include:
- Roar: Boosts team damage, slash procs of 1 and DoT damage of 3. Roar even allows spamming Fractured Blast to kill SP enemies easily.
- Expedite Suffering: Compresses accumulated slash procs from 1 (or your weapon) and accumulated toxin+heat procs from 3 to rapidly kill enemies.
- Pillage: Full strip, shields and status cleanse
- Terrify + Creeping Terrify: Crowd control, slow and armor strip
- Ensnare: Groups enemies so you can hit many enemies easier with 1, 3 and 4
- Nourish: Bonus viral damage and boosts energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) from 1

# PLAYSTYLE
NOTE: Invert tap/hold controls 
1. Hold 3 until you select Ortholysts and tap 3 to summon and keep active as needed for summon DPS. Otherwise you can select Summulysts to boost passive shield regeneration.
2. Cast 1 (Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)) frequently or whenever shields break to restore shields, gain energy and group enemies and trigger [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/). 
3. Cast Fusion Strike to create a 20+m zone that strips enemies as they enter the zone (or keep Nourish active if subsumed)
4. Use Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) frequently to crowd control enemies and apply a damage vulnerability as well as Tau status.

# SURVIVABILITY
1. SHIELD TANKING (CASUAL PLAY AND BASE STEEL PATH)
Shields have an innate 50% damage reduction and [\[Caliban\]](/items/arsenal/5617/caliban/) can restore shields with both 1 and summulysts. [\[Caliban\]](/items/arsenal/5617/caliban/)'s passive also has damage adapation that gives up to 50% damage reduction to a specific damage type. [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) is optional over [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) or [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) for even more passive tankiness (but note that [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) simply overrides his passive), allowing shields to have 95% damage reduction. This is probably fine for most missions up to base steel path (i.e. < level 500) especially if you want to have a more laid back time.

2. SHIELD GATING (ENDURANCE STEEL PATH)
Once enemies deal enough damage to oneshot all your shields, you will need to rely on the shield gate mechanic which is where you gain a certain duration of i-frames (invulnerability) depending on the highest level of shield reached before breaking. For example if you [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 1150 shields or higher, breaking this will give 2.5s of immortality. Currently Overshields generated by either 1 or 3 count to giving this 2.5s shield gate (likely unintended but has been present for almost 2 years since inception in September 2023), meaning pressing 1 and generating over 1150 shields resets your shield gate for 2.5s gate each time. If you are constantly spinning around in 1 or at least within 2.5s of breaking shields, you will effectively be unkillable. You MUST combine this with crowd control i.e. from Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) to reduce the frequency of taking damage so you don't actually lose shields constantly. Rolling Guard is optional but highly useful to gain additional backup i-frames AND clear annoying statuses that can kill you (e.g. slash, electric, heat). 

**IMPORTANT NOTE ON AUGUR MODS**: Try to AVOID using any augur mods on both [\[Caliban\]](/items/arsenal/5617/caliban/) and secondary on both you and your sentinel. This is because Augur mods cause you to gain a tiny amount of shields on ability cast and can OVERRIDE the 2.5s gate with a tiny 0.5s gate if you cast an ability like Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) after reaching 1150 shields.

**ORTHOLYST SURVIVABILITY**
Ortholysts appear to have the same sentient health gates as the enemy sentients in addition to damage [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), meaning it takes at least 5 shots to kill no matter how much damage enemies can deal. They also appear to dodge many enemy attacks while in mortar mode for whatever reason, meaning they are actually quite hard to kill even at level cap.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration is mainly suggested for the uptime of Lethal Progeny (around 1 minute) so you don't need to recast as often as well as the uptime of Razor Mortar. Sentient Wrath and Fusion Strike have long enough base durations (sitting around 10-20s)

**Efficiency**
This is a flexible stat that you should tailor to your preferences and access arcanes and can be either negative at 45% (due to [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/)) or neutral at 100% (drop [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/)). Negative efficiency allows Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) to generate more overall energy which effectively offsets the increased cast costs. For example at 45% efficiency, Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) costs 39 energy and refunds 9.75 energy per enemy hit, meaning you will have a net energy gain of 156 energy after hitting 20 enemies (equivalent to another four casts of Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)). At 100% efficiency, Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) costs 25 energy and refunds 6.25 energy per enemy hit, meaning a net energy gain of 100 after hitting 20 enemies (also equivalent to four casts of Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)). Arcane Steadfast triggers frequently with spamming of 1, which then allows free casts of Fusion Strike and improves energy economy significantly. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is **optional** for maximum backup energy restore. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is also optional for further passive energy generation with [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/).

**Range**
Range is a useful stat as it affects all his abilities, particularly the range of Razor Gyre and therefore how many enemies you can hit per spin for shield/energy restoration as well as grouping radius from [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/), the range of Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/), the shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) range of Lethal Progeny and the lingering strip zone of Fusion Strike. You can keep this between 145% to 235%+ depending on tile set and preference. Note to activate [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/) mode on Ortholysts, you only need to hit a single enemy with ragdoll grouping and they will still shoot other non grouped enemies with no real range limitation meaning the grouping itself is actually not that important. If you prefer high range, swap [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) or [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) for [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/).

**Strength**
Strength is [\[Caliban\]](/items/arsenal/5617/caliban/)'s most important stat as it affects the amount of shield restored by 1 and summulysts, the damage vulnerability from Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) and the strip of Fusion Strike, although you only need to hit 200% strength for full strip (or 164% with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/)). 

Finally, the total DPS of Ortholysts in fact is dipped multiple times by strength:
1. Multiplies their damage directly by 2.5 x strength
2. Increases their level scaling which boosts damage exponentially by the enemy damage multiplier formula 1 + 0.015 x (current level - base level)^1.55. Since current level is given by 30 x strength and base level is 1, substituting this in gives 1+0.015 x (30 x strength - 1)^1.55
3. [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/) augment boosts electric damage by 1 + 0.7x strength which is a final multiplier to damage as it is applied like an element mod
4. [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/) augment boosts fire rate by 1 + 0.7 x strength which is another final multiplier to DPS
5. Boosts other potential damage multipliers e.g. sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) (1 + 0.35 x strength) and nourish (1+ 0.45 x strength) although nourish would be additive to [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/) electric boost.

Multiplying all of these together (with Nourish) we get approximately:
2.5 x strength x (1+0.015 x (30 x strength - 1)^1.55 x (1+0.7 x strength + 0.45 x strength) x (1+0.7 x strength) x (1+0.35 x strength)

See Desmos graph for calculating relative DPS boost: https://www.desmos.com/calculator/iepqomk69w

For example going from 100% strength to 200% strength multiplies damage by 14x rather than 2x, and going to 400% strength actually multiplies damage by 282x rather than the expected 4x.

With conditionals you can hit over 400% with Camisado + Augmented active, while adding archon shards and madurai in can let you even hit 500% which is actually about 800x damage. This is sufficient multiplier to essentially kill enemies up to levelcap within seconds, and can be further boosted by nourish and priming/armor strip.

If you want to calculate final effective DPS you can plug in all damage instances from mortar, [\[Summoner's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7186/summoners-wrath/) and base fire rate. In mortar mode, each of the THREE Ortholysts fires TWO mortars at a rate of 0.417 which explode for 200 direct/50 aoe damage, but each mortar also split into THREE further shells that each explode for another 200 direct/50 aoe each, for a total of 3 x 2 x (1+3) = 24 detonations of 250 damage. Each hit also has a 300% status chance to proc electric status. Summoners [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) multiplies the raw hits by 1.75x then double dips the electric status for a second 1.75x dip.

Assuming all three ortholysts fire simultaneously on a single enemy (to avoid calculations based on density, overlapping and electric status chaining).

Final DPS = 250 x 3 x 2 x 4 x 0.417 x 1.75 x (1 + 3 x 0.5 x 1.75) x damage multiplier

Desmos calculator for final DPS : https://www.desmos.com/calculator/awyjqqsd88

The damage of a single mortar direct hit is expected to be in the order of 5 million damage before viral status. At 500% strength we are dealing approximately 1 billion theoretical DPS on a single target, without even accounting for tau status, viral status or group density effects. Once you add in grouping from [\[Razor Mortar\]](/items/arsenal/7398/razor-mortar/), viral and tau status as well as the chaining effect of electric status the overall DPS on a group of enemies probably reaches in the order of a few billion damage per second.

# HELMINTH
The subsume slot can be quite flexible depending on preference and usecase:
1. Razor [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/): Since this gives energy and shields, you could replace this with Nourish which provides more energy and just shield gate with brief respite/augur mods instead
2. Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) Sentient [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/) would slow down missions like Defense and Survival especially with a group and you may consider dropping this for grouping (e.g. airburst/coil horizon/pull/larva or Rest and [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) (for rage) in those situations. 
3. Lethal Progeny is very good for aggro draw, shield recharge and passive tau status priming/dps but they do not scale much in level and start getting instantly oneshot by levelcap. You could consider dropping this if you don't want to constantly recast them in long endurance runs.
4. Fusion Strike is quite a high cost ability to strip enemies and armor is not as important these days since the armor cap, given that status effects such as corrosive and heat already partially strip armor. Applying 10 corrosive status via a weapon strips 80% armor which is effectively a 6x damage multiplier. Fusion Strike full strip is therefore only 1.6x damage increase on top of this and you could consider swapping this out. 

HELMINTH OPTIONS
1. Nourish: gives viral damage buff to weapons and Lethal Progeny, allowing your summons to apply viral status on attacks and on getting attacked, multiplies energy gained to help sustain energy at 45% efficiency even better. I would suggest subsuming this over 4 as not all enemies even have armor and the armored enemies have an armor cap now, meaning just a few corrosive or heat procs added via a companion or primer is sufficient to strip. Since high strength Nourish makes other statuses difficult to proc, this would work best if using raw damage weapons e.g. slam [\[Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1138/magistar/), [\[Dual Toxocyst\]](/items/arsenal/1015/dual-toxocyst/), [\[Laetum\]](/items/arsenal/5841/laetum/), [\[Burston\]](/items/arsenal/1226/burston/) incarnon,

2. Roar: boosts Lethal Progeny and weapons, double dipping DoTs specifically e.g. the electric statuses, but is additive to [\[Summoner's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7186/summoners-wrath/) meaning [\[Summoner's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7186/summoners-wrath/) is already a 75% roar (i.e. equivalent to 250% roar) so the benefit to summons is actually low. This is still a nice option for when you want to boost the damage of status weapons in addition to summons, and is probably your best option for a hybrid weapon platform/summoner when using status weapons e.g. [\[Strun\]](/items/arsenal/1241/strun/) incarnon, [\[Torid\]](/items/arsenal/907/torid/) incarnon, [\[Boar\]](/items/arsenal/1238/boar/) incarnon etc.

3. Brightbonnet: boosts strength even more for Ortholyst DPS and should be the highest possible damage from Ortholysts if you have both viral and corrosive priming e.g. [\[Bubonico\]](/items/arsenal/5293/bubonico/), [\[Kompressa\]](/items/arsenal/5582/kompressa/).

4. Shock with [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) augment: Adds electric damage at 100% x str to Ortholysts ONLY while they are not in mortar mode. Since this applies electric that does not combine to your weapons, it is a good option for a hybrid melee influence platform/summoner when using influence melees such as [\[Syam\]](/items/arsenal/6176/syam/), [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) incarnon.

# INTRODUCTION

[[ youtube id="xZsowiD9YY4" ]]

**UPDATE JUNE 2026**
Arcane Sculptor triggers off multiple abilities and sets efficiency to 175% allowing you to spam abilities despite 45% efficiency.

**UPDATE 2026**
[\[Vauban\]](/items/arsenal/56/vauban/) has been reworked slightly with minor changes across the board. Tesla Nervos has better targetting and spread, Minelayers are compressed into 2 forms and no longer need to be cycled, Photon Strike has slightly increased AOE (5m to 7m base) and forces a blast proc which further increases AOE clearing potential and  deals double damage against overguard, and Bastille no longer has an enemy cap and also works on ragdolled enemies in Vortex.

This build is a hybrid ability DPS build using both [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) Orb and Photon Strike for scaling ability DPS, with Vortex used for grouping and applying magnetic status (and even viral if adding nourish), Bastille used for stripping armor, Overdriver for boosting damage. Tesla Nervos stuns enemies passively and applies [\[Vauban\]](/items/arsenal/56/vauban/)'s passive +25% dmg buff without needing to recast 4, but this is an optional ability.

**FLECHETTE ORB**
Flechette Orbs from minelayer are used to do DPS that *scales* with enemy level (multiplied by 1+enemy level/10), at a faster rate than enemy HP scales. In addition, ability strength (2.83x), Vaubans passive (1.25x), overdriver (1.46x), vigorous swap (2.65x)/arcane arachne (2.5x), naramon lethal levitation (3x), roar/nourish, hotshot/avenger, crepuscular/[\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) are all optional multiplicative damage buffs for [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) orb. This means at level 101, each [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) nail deals an average damage of around 200,000 damage while at level 9999, each nail does an average of 15 million damage, which increases to 90 million after 10 stacks of viral status (created by nourish). Keep in mind a fully armored corrupted heavy gunner at lvl 9999 has 18.7 million EHP (and 7.5 million HP), meaning flechette almost one-shots with zero viral status.

Flechette has a base CC of 50% and base CD of 2 which can be boosted with the following sources:

The CC can be boosted by :
- Arcane Hotshot (needs a heat ability such as pyrotechnics or diriga applying heat), adds +300% making final CC 200%,
- Arcane Avenger (needs combat discipline to proc consistently) adds flat 45% crit i.e. 95% without hotshot or 245% with hotshot too. 
- Mutalist Quanta 

The CD can be boosted by:
- Arcane Crepuscular (needs invisibility e.g. Evade, Quiver or Huras/Shade)
- Tenacious Bond (needs companion e.g. sentinel with burst laser prime, panzer/huras)
- [\[Mutalist Quanta\]](/items/arsenal/1002/mutalist-quanta/)  

To absolutely maximise [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) damage you will therefore want to focus hard of critical hits (arcane hotshot + crepuscular) and combine this with Naramon Lethal levitation (300% dmg for 60s after hitting 4 levitated enemies with an amp e.g. Phahd)

You can check your theoretical damage with this calculator spreadsheet (please select "file -> make a copy", do NOT ask for permission to edit): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1l_5Z-Pr0-PiMl4xvkbOmZqFtTiclXjMOV286p646WZI/edit?usp=sharing

# PLAYSTYLE

1. OPTIONAL if not subsumed over and using [\[Tesla Bank\]](/items/arsenal/188/tesla-bank/):  Hold 1 to charge 4 tesla nervos. These will attach to enemies and when enemies die they will discharge the unarmored hp value at time of attaching in a big AOE, further adding more scaling AOE damage in addition to Flechette/Photon Strike (which may be somewhat redundant).

2. HOLD 2 to cast a Vector-Overdriver and step on it to gain a global damage buff and speed boost

3. TAP 2 to lay up to four Flechette-Tether orbs in a fixed area you want to lockdown and passively kill enemies. Try to plant them near head height on a wall so they can headshot.

4. TAP 4 to lay up to four Bastilles throughout the area which lift enemies and strip their armor

5. OPTIONAL HOLD 4 to collapse existing Bastilles into a grouping vortex OR cast a vortex first  then cast Bastilles to have both active

5. Spam TAP 3 to cast Photon Strikes (either into a vortex) or just freely while you are moving around to kill enemies on demand

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Keep positive for uptime of minelayer, vortex/bastille and any buff you run. Not needed for photon strike. Helps with charges of tesla nervos.

**Efficiency**
Keep neutral if you play a cast heavy playstyle e.g. spamming photon strike - consider swapping [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/). Use [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on a pet to generate healths orbs and convert into energy. You can feel free to supplement with other sources of energy such as Arcane Energize, [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), Emergence dissipate, Dethcube energy generator, Zenurik, Tenet Glaxion with Photon Overcharge

**Range**
Important for Bastille/Vortex range, tether coil grab range and photon strike radius (and tesla nervos if you use it).

**Strength**
Important for flechette damage, photon strike damage, overdriver boost and roar/nourish boost and status chance for vortex/bastille. 

**Aura**
- Brief Respite for shield gating. If you have catalyzing shields and a free pistol/sentinel weapon slot, you can swap this for Corrosive Projection and make sure to run at least ONE augur mod on your loadout.
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/): improves damage against armored enemies even before bastille full strips, and shortens the time required for Bastille to full strip

**Exilus** 
- [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is best in slot to avoid knockdowns but Ice Spring shares the same polarity and gives more mobility for quality of life.
- Flexible for handspring, cunning drift, power drift.

**Flexible Alternatives**
Augur Reach is a flexible option for:
- Rolling Guard: gives i-frames and status cleanse on roll with cooldown
- [\[Photon Repeater\]](/items/arsenal/187/photon-repeater/): improves photon strike spam energy economy and overall DPS but up to you how much you plan on spamming photon strike, note you will not be able to consistently shield gate using 3 and will need to mix it up with casting 2 and 4 for shield gating since some casts will be free
- Enduring Bastille: Lets you have a lazier time when locking down stationary gamemodes as killing enemies in Bastille prolongs it now.
- [\[Tesla Bank\]](/items/arsenal/188/tesla-bank/): When Tesla Nervos latches onto an enemy, it will take the amount of current unarmored hp at the time of latch (e.g. 90% HP) and then explode that in an 18.8m radius (at 235 range) on death. Since you have four nervos you could have four explosions at any time going off contributing to AOE damage which technically scales off enemy HP (although if [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) damages them to low health and then nervos latches you will only get explosions that scale off low values). With viral priming  + armor strip via bastille this can scale quite well and contribute to DPS. 
- [\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/): This applies a +165% damage boost to [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) but is additive to Arcane Arachne and Naramon's Lethal Levitation, AND requires you to constantly swap between weapons since it only lasts for 3s. This does not snapshot a cast of [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) so you need to be constantly swapping every 3s.

**Arcanes**
Very flexible depending on preference and loadout:
Augmented: +60% damage after 250 kills.
Concentration: optional extra 60% duration for 3s allows you to snapshot duration of vortex or minelayer if you cast right after a photon strike
Arcane Circumvent: strips armor, shield, overguard on rolling through enemy. Vortex allows you to roll through tons of enemies at once.
Crepuscular : applies +30% strength and flat +3 cd buff to [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) but requires you to be invisible e.g. from Huras or [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/)
Arachne : applies a +150% damage boost to [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) orbs after wall latch
Avenger : flat +45% crit chance to the base 50% crit chance of [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) orbs, would be helpful to run rank 0 [\[Combat Discipline\]](/items/arsenal/2727/combat-discipline/) to maximise uptime
Hotshot: adds 300% modded CC to base 50% cc for final 200% cc, which is gauranteed orange crits. Needs pyrotechnics or companion to proc (e.g. [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/)).

**Archon Shards**
2 cast speed shards
2 strength shards
1 flexible shard e.g. parkour shard

# PLAYSTYLE
1. OPTIONAL: Cast several Stinkbrains (tap 1) up to 4 around the map to spread viral status and sleep. If you subsume over this, then just keep you subsume active.
2. Always cast a Brightbonnet (tap 2) right next to you/under you, and jump on it to pulse energy and boost ability strength
3. Cast Sporespring (tap 4) three times in rapid succession directly at the Brightbonnet. This doubles the ability strength boost, with boost each subsequent sporesprings damage, and forces a pulse of energy which partially recovers some of the energy spent (each bounce restores about 43 energy while each cast costs 116 energy).
4. Enter Reroot to be completely immortal and "invisible" and wait for all three Sporesprings to complete the 10 bounces, then pop out and shoot another three Sporesprings at Brightbonnet and re-enter Reroot mode.

# INVISIBILITY WITH HURAS OR [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/)
Reroot counts as Invisibility for arcane crepuscular (currently bugged in UI to not display). Invisibility allows Sporespring to take advantage of Arcane Crepuscular which gives a flat +3 crit multi on top of base 2x crit multi for final 5x crit multiplier on yellow crit, 9x on orange and 13x on red crit, which is on average a final 3x multiplier to total damage. 

1. Shade Prime/Prisma with [\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/) and equipped with Tazicor can create up to three immortal clones that consistently prime viral and magnetic status in a wide area.
- Shade build: https://overframe.gg/build/441583/
- Tazicor (viral magnetic): https://overframe.gg/build/890595/

2. [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) with Mecha Set allows you to be invisible well as giving the Mecha Set effect which periodically magnifies the nuking by Sporespring's toxin statuses. 
- Huras build: https://overframe.gg/build/268129/

# SPORESPRING DAMAGE CALCS
**WHAT FACTORS AFFECTS SPORESPRING DAMAGE**
This will be a running list as more things are discovered or tested:
- Roar: YES
- Arcane Crepuscular: YES (+30% strength doesn't work if using Reroot, but Reroot gives +3 crit multi even though it doesn't show icon)
- Emerald Archon Shard (+ability damage on corrosive status): YES
- Emerald Archon Shard (+toxin status damage): YES
- Damage Blessing: YES (addiive to Roar)
- Tenacious Bond/Cold Procs: NO
- Arcane Hotshot/Avenger/Puncture Procs: NO
- Arcane Arachne/Madurai: NO
- Nourish: NO
- Arcane Camisado: NO

**DAMAGE**
You can use this spreadsheet to calculate damage numbers for yourself with different shard combinations (make a copy, DO NOT ask for access): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10TeRiiG8ahP8-5-NWobRf3p4zQaQ0YiOTUtC2DxN3Bw/edit?usp=sharing

Sporespring deals a base of 2500 toxin damage with a forced toxin status that deals a further 1250 toxin dmg per second. 
This is multiplied by strength and bright bonnet gives additional strength of 30% x strength, which is further doubled if you throw a Sporespring into it first. 
With all mods, conditions and madurai active we can get 368% strength before Brightbonnet.
The next sporespring after brightbonnet boost therefore deals 2500 x (strength + 30% x strength x 2), or 2500 x (3.68 + 30% x 3.68 x 2) = 14720 damage

Each bounce multiplies the damage by +50% (1.5x) and adds 25% critical chance to the base 75% critical chance with base critical multiplier of 2x.
While invisible Arcane Crepuscular adds flat 3x multi to give a final multi of 5x. 
By the 10th bounce we hit 300% critical chance for guaranteed tier 3 red crit of 1+3x4 = 13x and a 1.5^9 = 38.4x multiplier.

We are therefore dealing 14,720 x 1.5^9 x 13 = 7,356,521 damage on each direct explosion in an 8.6m radius. 
Once you add Roar to this we get 16,688,745 damage on the direct explosion AND 17,535,520 per second as forced toxin status damage as it double dips Roar.
If you then finally add three Tauforged Emeraled +toxin status damage shards the toxin procs are buffed to 41,208,472 damage per second on the final bounce!

If you add ALL the damage dealt over all ten bounces and all 6 seconds worth of toxin status procs, the total average lifetime damage with ROAR +3 TOX SHARDS is approximately 677 MILLION DAMAGE. If you then multiply this by viral at 10 stacks, we get a final maximum of 2,875,927,716 or 2.9 BILLION LIFETIME DAMAGE, and this is from a SINGLE sporespring without any incidental weakpoint hits. Sporespring appears to target centre of mass and certain enemies such as Moas take 3x more damage on weakpoint hits. The total lifetime damage from all three simultaneous sporesprings would then be almost 10 billion damage.

# SURVIVABILITY
1. Invisibility + Reroot + Shield Gating + Passive Reviving
If you run [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) or [\[Shade Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6128/shade-prime/) OR subsume Evade or Quiver Arrow (Cloak), you can stay invisible while allowing Sporespring to benefit from Arcane Crepuscular. You can also immedaitely pop into reroot form and chill while completely immortal waiting for all 10 bounces from Sporespring to finish, then pop back out. Any breakthrough damage can be shield gated with shields (about 1.5s on full break from 400 shield), and you can restore shields with Augur Mods equipped on a secondary or [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/), or [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/), and casting abilities which [\[Nokko\]](/items/arsenal/7472/nokko/) does constantly if using Sporespring. If you still somehow die even through invisibility and shield gate, you can simply revive via the passive by touching one of your mushrooms from 1 and 2. This just means you should get into a habit of ALWAYS keeping at least one mushroom (usually brightbonnet) active and nearby. This usually isn't an issue if you are using the mushrooms as trampolines.

2. Health Tanking + Passive Reviving
If you are not running invisibility or are planning on using weapons consistently, you will either need to actively shield gate or just use health tanking. Health tanking falls off rather quickly but is fine in lower levels of steel path e.g. up to level 500. This will require you to slot some health ([\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/), arcane blessing), armor (fiber, arcane guardian) and adaptation. Reroot will also heal you and make you immortal.

# STAT/MOD BREAKDOWN
**DURATION**
Positive duration helps uptime of his 1 and 2 mushrooms as well as reroot duration, with no effect on Sporespring. 
[\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is used because Sporespring applies toxin statuses in an AOE which therefore apply corrosive statuses that strip armor.

**EFFICIENCY/ECONOMY**
Negative efficiency is maintainable due to Brightbonnet giving pulses of energy everytime you jump on them or receive a bounce from Sporespring. This energy scales with strength meaning at very high strength levels e.g. around 300%, we are getting approximately 45 energy per bounce. Hitting Brightbonnets with Sporespring reduces pulse rates to every 1.5s AND doubles the strength gained, and the new strength value actually affects the energy gain but not the strength boost of the next Brightbonnet. This means effectively you could be pulsing 60 energy on cast, then 60 energy every 1.5s and everytime you touch it with sporespring. This stacks quite quickly to [\[Recover\]](/items/arsenal/509/recover/) most of any energy spent eve though Sporespring costs 114 energy per cast at 45%.

**RANGE**
Range is the most important stat to maximise as it allows Sporespring explosions (which have zero falloff) to hit the maximum amount of enemies each bounce, will also allowing Stinkbrain to apply viral to maximum amount of enemies and Brightbonnet to give energy/strength to allies in highest range.

**STRENGTH**
Strength is the second most important stat to maximise as it affects the damage of Sporespring as well as the strength boost and energy gain from Brightbonnet. If you subsume Roar then strength will also boost this. Use [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) rather than [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) if also subsuming ROAR, because global strength affects three abilities and helps your squad via Brightbonnet more. Use Precision Intensify if you are not subsuming Roar.

**AURA**
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/): reduces armor by 18% which effectively increases damage against armored enemies by about 1.6x, particularly on the first few bounces of Sporespring, although once the corrosive statuses start building up this effect becomes a bit less significant
- Growing Power: more strength but needs weapons to apply status
- Mecha Empowed: use this if running a Kubrow e.g. [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) wkth the mecha set

# ARCHON SHARDS
**Cast Speed**
TWO Amber Cast Speed shards to speed up animations, especially allowing you to spam three sporesprings quickly.

**Toxin Status**
THREE Emerald +toxin status damage to boost forced toxin status from sporespring which maximises the actual total damage over the lifetime of all spores. 

**Corrosive Ability Damage**
If all your care about is how "BIG" your red crit damage number is, then you could use the Emerald +Ability Damage on Corrosive status instead.

**Corrosive Stacks**
I would NOT recommend using +corrosive stacks since each bounce only adds 1 corrosive status meaning you need about 10 total bounces across three spores, or about 3 to 4s from the very first spore to even hit 10 corrosive status in the first place, by which time everything is already likely dead or getting oneshot. 

**Strength**
This is the weakest shard since Brightbonnet already gives a huge amount of bonus modded strength in addition to all the strength mods.

# HELMINTH
You can subsume over either 1 or 3. I would suggest subsuming over 3 for stationary missions like survival, and over 1 for highly mobile missions or endurance situations such as Cascade, particularly since weapons and companions can apply viral at a much faster rate than 1 viral every 3s. You can also still die even while invisible from shade/huras from AOE type damage, eximus enemies or AOE effects so Reroot is a very nice safety net in endurance.

1. ROAR: Boosts Sporespring damage and double dip toxin status.
2. BREACH SURGE:  Sporesprings damage and toxin statuses will generate breach surge sparks that home in on enemies and deal many additional damage instances, and are also affected by arcane crepuscular meaning they are essentially double dipped. 

# ARSENAL
[\[Nokko\]](/items/arsenal/7472/nokko/) has no specific synergy with weapons but if you want to be somewhat thematic, there are "spore" themed weapons that can help spread viral status, such as:
- Coda Sporothrix: https://overframe.gg/build/816640/
- Sporelacer (Secondary): https://overframe.gg/build/267804/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
General Use and Endurance [\[Nezha\]](/items/arsenal/40/nezha/) build focusing on using a status weapon and combining it with [\[Divine Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6490/divine-retribution/) to "nuke" in a large range. Pillage is ideal but you can run a similar build with no helminth if you prefer, and use Firewalker as a source of 'active gating'.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast Warding Halo to get 3s-iframe, knockdown/status immunity and 90% damage reduction, and recast when it breaks
2. Cast Divine Spears when a large group of enemies are nearby to crowd control them and allow Chakram to multiply/spread rapidly. Shoot them to allow DoTs to spread and kill all speared enemies.
3. Cast Chakram to debuff all the enemies with a damage vulnerability (basically a universal damage multiplier) and kill affected enemies to generate health and energy orbs which quickly fills up your energy to max. Make sure to spear first then aim chakram at a speared enemy so it multiplies.
5. Spam Pillage frequently to shield gate and strip armor

## SURVIVABILITY
**Shield Gating**
For endurance steel path (up to level 9999), we need to rely on a combination of Pillage to shield gate (2.5 i-frames after 1100 shield breaking), Divine Spears to crowd control, i-frames from Warding Halo (3s i-frame on activation and 2s i-frame on breaking) and OPTIONAL i-frames + status cleanse from Rolling Guard (3s with cooldown). You can also add in overguard from pistols running Secondary Fortifier which gives a further 0.5s i-frame from overguard breaking. Arcane Aegis is a final optional [\[Failsafe\]](/items/arsenal/2823/failsafe/) that has a small random chance at making you effectively immortal for 12s.

NOTE: Currently, OVERSHIELDS counts to shield gate meaning if Pillage restores over 1100 in Overshield you will get the full 2.5s gate. If this gets FIXED, you will only be able to get the gate from [\[Nezha\]](/items/arsenal/40/nezha/)'s maximum shield which is only 185, giving about 0.7s iframe only. In such a scenario, you will want to run a few Tauforged Azure Shield capacity shards (1 tau shard gives 1.4s gate, 2 tau shard gives about 1.8s gate, 3 tau shard gives 2.1s gate). [\[Primed Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/6441/primed-redirection/) only gives a total of 518 shield which results in 1.6s gate, which is less than two tau azure shards.

One more optional addition is Catalyzing Shield for a more comfortable experience in endurance. This actually limits the maximum shield gate from 2.5s down to 1.33s, but allows you to regain 1.33s shield gate on the very first cast of Pillage as well as any other ability and then you get another 1.33s gate when Pillage returns in case shields break in between.
 
**Shield Tanking**
For base steel path (up to level 500ish), you can very easily shield tank by using Pillage to frequently restore shields and having multiple layers of damage reduction to reduce the rate at which shields are lost. Shields have an innate damage reduction of 50%, warding halo gives another 90% and [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) can be added optionally for a further 90% damage reduction for a final possible 99.5% damage reduction to shields.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Negative duration actually benefits [\[Nezha\]](/items/arsenal/40/nezha/) as it allows Divine Spears to end earlier byitself which expedites all status damage and allows you to recast on a new group of enemies sooner. Duration doesn't affect Warding Halo and Chakram debuff has a high base duration, meaning at negative duration it is still approximately 5-10s long. Negative duration is also beneficial for Pillage since it causes the shield restore to occur quicker (after approx 1.5s at 70% duration), i.e. before 2.5s shield gate finishes.

**Efficiency**
We can either dump efficiency completely ([\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/)) OR run near neutral efficiency ([\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) + [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/)) due to the synergy between Chakram and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). Killing an enemy affected by Blazing Chakram has a 100% chance to drop a health orb and a 35% chance to drop an energy orb. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) will convert the health orb into 55 energy, meaning every enemy you kill who has been debuffed by chakram guarantees 55 energy. If you can kill just 10 affected enemies, you generate 550 energy. depending on your playstyle. If you prefer a very active frequent cast playstyle, you want to maintain a neutral to positive efficiency with [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/). If you don't cast as much and feel you could sustain with 45% efficiency, simply swap [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/) for either [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) or [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/). Running Arcane Steadfast and [\[Mystic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6276/mystic-bond/) on companion can also be very helpful to further improve energy economy. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a sentinel also procs while Divine Spears is active giving a bonus 30% efficiency.

**Range**
High range allows Divine Retritbution to spread statuses in a large AOE (approximately 35m at 250% range).

**Strength**
Strength boosts the strip from Pillage, the vulnerability from Chakram and the end expedite multiplier on Divine Retribution.

**Aura**
Very flexible
- Corrosive Projection reduces strength required to full strip
- Growing Power boosts more strength
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) for shield gating, but DON'T use this if running Pillage since you could interrupt your 2.5s shield gate if you cast 2 during the gate time

**Exilus**
- Cunning Drift for maximising range 
- Controlled slide is purely preference if you don't enjoy the passive sliding. 

**Flexible slots**
- Reaping Chakram - more health orbs for equilibrium and allows Chakram to deal DPS

**Arcanes**
Highly flexible based on preference:
- Arcane Steadfast - works well for negative efficiency builds with a frequently cast high cost ability (eg divine spears)
- Arcane Aegis - when this procs you basically become immortal passively to non-toxin damage for the duration of the effect which is 12s, a very good but OPTIONAL backup survivability tool
- Molt Augmented - free +60% strength but only after 250 kills. 
- Arcane Avenger - procs on self damage from combat discipline and gives flat +45% crit chance.
- Arcane Precision/Velocity - if running pistol
- Arcane Fury - if running melee

**Archon Shards**
Very flexible:
2 Amber Cast Speed Shards
3 Crimson Strength Shards for extra strength 
OR 
2 Parkour Velocity for mobility


# HELMINTH OPTIONS
- Pillage: Strips armor and shield, cleanses status and also restores shields. Full stripping armor is still an effective 10x damage multiplier while shield restore allows you to effectively shield gate. Also works well with negative duration.
- Nourish: boosts energy generation further, adds free viral to weapons, will need to add some more duration back in
- Breach Surge: Chakram debuff allows breach surge damage to 'double dip', by magnifying the initial weapon damage that produces the spark, then magnifying the spark damage on hit, as long as all enemies taking the damage have been hit by chakram. This means you could potentially get sparks that do upwards of 30x or higher of original weapon damage. Breach surge also gives provides crowd control. Same mods can be used.
- Grouping e.g. Pull, Airburst, Ensnare, Coil Horizon : works well with high range and negative duration.
- Reave: Chakram debuff allows Reave to oneshot most enemies even up to level cap: https://overframe.gg/build/228690/
-  Roar: for more passive damage buff to multiply further with Chakram

Positive duration helps mind control, psychic bolts and chaos, although all abilities have decent base duration

**Efficiency**
You need a certain mix of duration and efficiency to minimise the drain cost of Assimilate. 
- Between 40% to 100% duration, you need 190% efficiency (you can hit this despite the UI being limited to 175%), using rank 5 streamline and rank 5 fleeting expertise
- Between 100 to 162% duration, you need 175% efficiency, which can be hit with rank 4 streamline (or Seismic Bond) and rank 4 fleeting expertise, which saves mod capacity and duration
- Between 162% to 280% duration, you need 160% efficiency, which can be hit with a single rank 5 [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/) or rank 5 streamline + seismic bond. Primed Continuity with Molt Efficiency or some Duration Shards can hit above 162%.
- Over 280% duration, you need 130% efficiency, hit with a single rank 5 [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/)

**Range**
Range is only really needed for Chaos. If you decide to subsume over Chaos you can drop range for something else e.g. strength.
Note, range isn't even really needed for Absorb/[\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) nuke radius because it also scales with damage absorbed: 
With Assimilate, the equation is 7.5m x range% + ( SQRT (5m x damage absorbed) / 50 ) and is capped at 50m. This means at 34% range, absorbing around 1.1 million damage will make you hit the 50m cap. At lower levels however, since enemies deal such low damage it may take much longer to hit the 1.1 million damage cap so you may want to keep some range so the base range (7.5m x range) is reasonable.

**Strength**
Without helminth, strength is only required for hitting the full strip threshold on Psychic Bolts (125% default, 103% with corrosive projection) and Mind Freaks movement/attack speed bonus. With a helminth, feel free to increase this higher as required. 

**Aura**
- [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) gives 25 strength which hits the 125% str threshold for strip, although you need to activate this constantly with status from weapons
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) allows psychic bolts to full strip at only 103% strength, or if you don't invest into any strength a cast of 2 will only leave 2% armor.
- Ready Steel helps Ruvox maintain 6x combo while only slamming so you can keep incarnon mode active at all times

**Exilus**

- Power drift lets you hit strength threshold to full strip 
- Amar's Anguish gives parkour velocity and allows you to teleport on heavy melee
- Nira's Anguish boosts slam damage

- Arcane Agility - parkour velocity so you can roll around faster while in Assimilate

[[ youtube id="N6txmFmLQZw?si=K7hd0APNMhtSPZ1W" ]]

# WHY [\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/)?
[\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/) augment is the focus of this build because it allows you to have normal frame mobility while benefiting from damage reduction and status immunity (but not complete knockdown immunity). [\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/) also has a unique effect where Merulina follows you around like a companion and automatically casts unique instances of Sea Snares. The important factor is that Sea Snares cast manually by 1 and cast automatically by [\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/) **stack multiplicatively**. For example at 200% strength, Sea Snares has a 300% damage vulnerability which equates to a 3x damage multiplier to all damage on affected enemies. A single enemy affected by BOTH instances of Sea Snares therefore takes a 3 x 3 = 9x damage multiplier, which is equivalent to Eclipse on a [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/) running 400% strength. 

In essence, [\[Yareli\]](/items/arsenal/5532/yareli/) has one of the strongest damage buffs in the games when double stacked while also providing a passive bonus 200% critical chance to pistols while moving (which is additive to mods like [\[Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/423/pistol-gambit/)). 

# SURVIVABILITY
**Immortality for Endurance: Merulina Gating + Shield Gating**
[\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/) allows you to gain 4s of invulnerability EVERY TIME you double tap 2. Normally if you double tap while on the board without the augment, you only have about 1s of i-frame. If you double tap while Loyal Merulina is active, you will deactivate and reactivate instantly giving the full 4s i-frame. If you [\[Double Tap\]](/items/arsenal/507/double-tap/) while Loyal Merulina is not active, the activation animation will prevent you from cancelling immediately and you will gain the full 4s i-frame too. Note, having a very high cast speed can sometimes cause the activation animation to speed up so fast that double tapping 2 can cancel your iframes compeltely.

This means you can basically survive to level cap by just consistently double tapping 2.  You can reduce the frequency of needing to do this by adding additional survivability factors such as passive shield gating. For example, slotting [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) allows you to start regenerating shields after 2.2s rather than 4s, meaning if shields break and you immediately double tap 2, you will start regenerating shields again during the i-frames. Once you are vulnerable again, you will therefore have a reasonable amount of shields equating to another 1 to 2s of shield gate as a safety net, rather than potentially coming out with 0 or only a tiny amount of shield e.g. 0.33s gate. Adding Boreal's Hatred is optional and increases the max possible shield gate from 1.7s to almost 2.5s adding another 0.8s potential i-frame to your safety nets. 

Furthermore, Sea Snares provide passive crowd control by lifting and disabling enemies which reduces the frequency you taking damage.

**Tanking for Casual/Base Steel Path**
Having Merulina active gives 90% damage reduction. You can add [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) to make this 99% damage reduction and even add more shields, health or armor to further improve EHP. This is a very valid playstyle if you prefer less overall button pressing and just staying in Merulina forever.
