# STAT BREAKDOWN

**DURATION**
At least neutral to positive duration is useful for letting Sea Snares bubbles linger a bit, Aquablades (if you use it) and if you have a helminth ability (e.g. Nourish, [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper, Roar e.t.c). Duration has no effect on Merulina and no real effect on Riptide since it doesn't really group new enemies after the initial 2s grouping duration.

**EFFICIENCY**
Maximum efficiency is required to maximise the frequency that [\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/) casts it's own Sea Snares. At 175% efficiency it will cast Sea Snares once every 0.5s, while at 100% efficiency it will cast every 2s. Having high efficiency also means all abilities are very cheap to cast (Sea Snares and Merulina only cost 6.25 energy), and [\[Yareli\]](/items/arsenal/5532/yareli/) has a very high base energy pool meaning you don't even need [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/). Gaining a single energy orb will provide enough energy for 4 casts of Sea Snares or Merulina.

175% efficiency can be hit in a number of ways:
Rank 4 Fleeting Expertise (50%) + Rank 4 Streamline (25%) - this saves you 10% duration penalty
Rank 4 Fleeting Expertise (50%) + Seismic Bond (30%) - this saves you 10% duration penalty and a mod slot on frame, but relies on your companion being alive dealing damage while you are on Merulina
Rank 5 Fleeting Expertise (60%) + Boreal's Hatred (15%) - this has max duration penalty but also gives extra shield which increases max shield gate from 1.7s to 2.2s, also extra damage reduction while jumping (stacks with merulina to give 92% DR).
Rank 5 Streamline (30%) + Boreal's Hatred (15%) + Seismic Bond (30%) - this has no duration penalty but even more heavily relies on your companion being alive

Small sources of energy regeneration that are usually pretty negligible have a much higher impact on Yareli's economy if running max efficiency. For example, energy Nexus generates 3 energy/s,  Archon Stretch generates 2 energy/s (can be activated via companions) and Primary Exhilarate gives 3.6 energy/s. If every 10s you can generate 50 energy, this is enough for 8 casts of Sea Snares/Merulina. You can play around with how much energy source you require depending on how often you cast Riptide too. If you use Riptide sparingly you might be able to sustain [\[Yareli\]](/items/arsenal/5532/yareli/) by just picking up energy orbs from getting kills (or boost it via Dethcube). If you cast very frequently you might want to slot Energy Nexus +/- [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/).

**RANGE**
Range is only required for the grouping radius of Riptide which starts at a pretty large starting radius of 15m, so having 145 to 175 is decent enough giving 22m to 26m. Compare this to other grouping abilities like Coil Horizon which only has a base radius of 12m and requires 200 range to hit 24m grouping. If you don't care much for Riptide's grouping you can just run neutral range. Sea Snares already has an extremely high base range of 30m and range has no effect on Merulina or Aquablades so you really don't need to invest much into range. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is **OPTIONAL** since it can be activated by a companion running electric damage (e.g. [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/), [\[Synergized Prospectus\]](/items/arsenal/5504/synergized-prospectus/) Hound, [\[Coolant Leak\]](/items/arsenal/230/coolant-leak/) Sentinel)

**STRENGTH**
Strength affects Sea Snare's damage vulnerability but is only additive to the base 200% by the formula (200% + current strength% over 100%). This means the overall effect of strength on a single Sea Snares instance is not as large as other buff abilities. For example 200% strength increases a single Sea Snares multiplier from 200% to 300% which is a 1.5x increase, while 300% strength increases it by 2x. However, if you consider Sea Snare stacking from [\[Loyal Merulina\]](/items/arsenal/6493/loyal-merulina/), then the effect of strength does become MUCH more magnified. For example at 200% strength, we go from 4x total multiplier to 9x total multiplier (which is a 2.25x increase), while at 300% strength we go from 4x multiplier to 16x (which is a 4x increase). 

**AURA**
Very flexible depending on preference.
- Growing Power fits the default polarity and gives more strength upon dealing status with a weapon
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) requires changing the polarity or using Omni forma, but gives the highest technical DPS boost against armored enemies

**EXILUS**
Very flexible depending on preference.
- Power drift for more strength
- Proton pulse for more mobility
- [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) to prevent knockdowns in between casts or downtime of Merulina. Note that Merulina doesn't completely block all knockdowns in the game.

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**
- [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/): gives passive energy regen but is flexible if you have Archon Stretch, Dethcube, Primary Exhilarate, equilibrium shard or other options
- [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/): allows you to start regenerating shields before the merulina gate time is up which effectively extends the total available i-frames upon double tapping 2. Could even add Vigilante Vigor to this if you like
- More Strength: more sea snares damage buff
- More Duration: better upkeep of a helminth or aquablades

**ARCANES**
Flexible depending on weapon and preference
- Molt Augmented: gives up to 60% str after 250 kills
- Arcane Camisado: can be activated by loyal merulina but pretty inconsistent and is used up after every cast of sea snares
- Arcane Precision: big damage boost to pistols after headshot
- Arcane Pistoleer: adds ammo efficiency to pistols after headshot
- Arcane Velocity: gives more fire rate

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION
This is a build focused on [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) which makes you immortal for over 30s at a time with a short cooldown in between (about 5s in practice), apply Doom with all abilities and weapons, apply viral with Wyrd Scythes and strip armor/damage with Rakhali.

If you prefer not using the augment Spectral Spirit, use this non augment variant where you cast abilities alot more often to shield gate rather than stay immortal: https://overframe.gg/build/719147/

**UPDATE 2025**
The wrathful advance infinite stack bug has been nerfed. The build in the video below still works but you will just not get overflow crit anymore and it is more ideal to subsume over 4.

[[ youtube id="rSA1-1iE8IY?si=TRBsxdfp4LtzeO3W" ]]

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**
The new augment [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) which allows you to forcefully enter Spectral Form, allowing you to become invulnerable, gives 100% health orb drop chance on kill (meaning 55 energy per kill via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/)) and force applies Doom via weapons or abilities. Finally, the augment allows you to reduce the 25s cooldown by 1s per kill, meaning you can reset Spectral Form completely every 25 kills, which can be achieved in under 5 seconds with just Rakhali's Cavalry or shooting weapons.

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Grave Spirit (tap 3) at the beginning of the mission and whenever it is off cooldown to stay invulnerable.

2. Cast Wyrd Scythe (tap 1) to throw out 7 sickles that auto target enemies within 40 m after a 1s delay. Enemies hit get slowed and receive a forced viral status

3. Cast Doom (tap 2) within the 1s delay of Wyrd Scythe on nearby enemies in front of you (only need to tag at least one enemy). Doomed enemies hit by Wyrd Scythe will spread the Doom effect to nearby enemies, basically propagating the effect through the map. Damaging Doomed enemies triggers "Phantom [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/)" which appears as a sickle above their head, storing all damage dealt in the next 2s then dealing that damage again as true damage (bypassing armor). Think of this as a "total damage multiplier" with a base effect of 1.35x.

4. Cast Rakhali's Cavalry (tap 4) to strip and nuke enemies marked by Phantom [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/), in front of you over a fixed distance. 

The general ability rotation will be to spam 1 + 2 followed by 4 in that order to constantly kill enemies, while keeping 3 active at all times as possible.

# SURVIVABILITY
**Invulnerability + Shield gating + Crowd Control **
[\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) gives you about 30s of invulnerability at 300% duration whenever you activate Grave Spirit, and getting kills reduces the 25s cooldown by 1s per kill meaning you only need to stay alive with regular shield gating during a short window while getting 25 kills to reset Spectral Spirit. With the Catalyzing Shields mod on, whenever your shields break from maximum you will have 1.33s of i-frames to basically recast 2 or 4 to fully reset your shield gate. [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) sets [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/)'s max shields to only 50, meaning a single cast of either 2 or 4  gives the max gate time with Brief Respite and an Augur mod. Casting 4 is preferred because it has inbuilt i-frames and tends to kill or knockback enemies. Note in general play, just the ability rotation of constantly pressing 2,1 and 4 will naturally allow you to shield gate without needing to actually keep track of your shields.  Finally, most enemies should either be SLOWED by Wyrd Scythes that gets spread throughout the map everytime you use 2,1 combo, or DEAD from 4 so you shouldn’t even be getting damaged that frequently.

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration has been maximised for maximum [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) uptime. At 300% duration we get at least 30s of invulnerability. With Arcane Concentration or Molt Efficiency and Duration Archon Shards or even [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) duration mod, we can increase this even further over 40s. Duration also sets Scythe and Doom duration to excessive levels and even Rakhali to almost 10s which increases the total amount of damage.

**Efficiency**
We can now completely drop efficiency because [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/) has TWO methods of improving energy generation. With [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/), you now have a 100% chance to generate health orb on kill, while [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) converts each health orb into 55 energy. This means you are guaranteed 550 energy every 10 kills while [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) is active, which is simply insane. In addition, [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/) has the Abundant Abyss passive that has a 35% chance of QUADRUPLING orb effectiveness, i.e. increasing energy orb effect from 25 to 100. That means for every 10 energy orbs dropped, instead of getting 250 energy, [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/) on average gains 537 energy (nearly double energy). Note Equilibrium does NOT appear to allow the health orb boosts to translate into energy gain i.e. health orbs do not give 200 health/220 energy when [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is equipped. It is uncertain if this is intentional or not. 

**Range**
Range is actually NOT as important as you would initially think. This is because hitting a single doomed enemy with Wyrd Scythe causes the effect to spread to surrounding enemies within a base range of 15m (approximately 5m at min range). This means as long as enemies are standing within a short distance (about 5m) of each other, you should be able to spread the effect throughout a crowd regardless of range. In most maps, enemies do not stand that far apart so 100% range is sufficient. What range really affects then is simply how close you need to be to affect the first enemy with Doom, although this is also no longer important with the augment [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) since it allows weapons and Rakhali itself to self apply doom and therefore strip from any range. 

**Strength**
Strength affects the slow of 1, the stored damage on 2, the crit dmg buff of 3 and the armor strip and damage of 4. A strength of 272% is required to hit the 95% slow cap on 1 while a strength of 286% is required to hit both the 100% damage storage of 2 as well as the 100% armor strip per horse. Note that a single horse can actually hit multiple times so the threshold of 286% is not crucial to hit, in fact even just running around 140% str allows consistent full strip.

**Aura**
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) matches her innate polarity and allows her to shield gate effectively in between [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/) cooldown. 
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) would be best in slot if you apply forma and run an augur mod in addition to catalyzing shield to shield gate (you get 1.33s gate regardless of shield value on break).

**Exilus**
Completely flexible. Use [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) if you own it, otherwise just use [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) or [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/).

**Flexible Options**
[\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/): at least ONE source of Casting Speed is MANDATORY for casting 4 since it has such as slow cast time. This can be either from Natural Talent, Madurai power transfer or Amber Archon Shards.

Catalyzing Shields/[\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/): Either or both are OPTIONAL if you have issues with surviving in between cooldowns of Spectral Spirit. This is especially useful if using weapons to kill rather than Rakhali to kill, since Rakhali normally has inbuilt i-frames. If you don't have issues are using vazarin protecting sling you can swap this for Augur Message/Nira's Hatred for even more duration.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Concentration and/or Molt Efficiency for even more duration
Molt Augmented for more strength
Arcane Icestorm, use with a cold status weapon like epitaph for 40% str and duration

# HELMINTH
Helminth on [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/) is extremely flexible and can go over either 1 or 4 depending on the focus. 
For pure weapon platform, subsume roar, eclipse, xata's whisper, wrathful advance or energized munitions over 4. 
If pure Rakhali or Hybrid ability/weapon focused, subsume roar over 1 and use a companion or weapon to apply viral status instead
Note you should NOT subsume over doom, as while you will still be able to apply doom due to [\[Spectral Spirit\]](/items/arsenal/6557/spectral-spirit/), you lose the strength scaling meaning it will be fixed at 35% bonus.

**Ability Nuke**
For a 4 nuke and ability spam based build:
- Roar: Boosts Rakhali damage and weapon damage
- Breach Surge: Crit damage buff from Grave Spirit applies to Breach Surge spark separately, thereby semi "double dipping" when created by a weapon. Breach surge also applies the melee stealth multiplier (7x additive to crit multi). If you want some range for Breach Surge, swap Narrow Minded for Stretch or Nira's Hatred

**Weapon Platform**
For a weapon platform based build:
- Wrathful Advance: Flat crit chance buff to melee weapons
- Roar: double dips DoTs
- Eclipse: for raw damage
- Energized Munitions: for spamming guns 
- Xata's Whisper: for raw damage especially if headshotting or using blast status
- Nourish: free weapon viral and energy boost
- Warcry: for melee attack speed
- Molt/Infested mobility: for speed boost

**Reave DPS**
For an alternative Reave nuke build, subsume Reave over 4. Reave normally requires 295% strength with 10 viral status to oneshot any non-boss enemy. With [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/), since Doom stores the damage of Reave and deals it again, you can effectively reduce the total strength required to oneshot. In addition, Wyrd Scythes spreads viral status. With Doom and 10 viral, you only need 181% str to one shot. With Doom and 1 viral, you need 304% strength to one shot.

Similar to Breach Surge variant, swap [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) for [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) or [\[Nira's Hatred\]](/items/arsenal/5630/niras-hatred/).

**UPDATE DEC 2025**
Arcane Circumvent is a nice new addition that lets you steal enemy defenses by 50% upon rolling through them and Melee Careen can be attached to a melee to freeze enemies on rolling. [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)'s cool custom fluxing animation adds additional flair, meaning you can constantly dodge through the map while stripping armor/shields/overguard, freezing enemies for CC and flat crit damage and simultaneously gain shields for shield gate and even overguard from eximus/thrax.

# INTRODUCTION
General Use steel path build allowing [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) to fry enemies with a combination of weapons and abilities. Coil Horizon can be used to group enemies which greatly boosts the effectiveness of electric status since they chain to another 5 enemies within a short range of 3m. Coil Horizon also deals electric damage + status innately AND triggers Rotorswell discharges for more damage. Cathode Grace gives some slow energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) (approximately 180 energy per minute) but also boosts crit chance of both weapons and abilities. The augment [\[Cathode Current\]](/items/arsenal/6058/cathode-current/) is used to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the duration of Rotorswell indefinitely and provide an additional discharge for more damage.

Rotorswell is a source of passive AOE damage, dealing damage passively in approximately 9m aura (requires line of sight) and also chaining electricity to enemies damage by a critical hit dealt by either your weapons OR abilities such as Coil Horizon (also requires line of sight). Note this damage falls off quite quickly in steel path so you should primarily be relying on weapons to deal damage, particularly to stronger enemies.

[\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) + Cathode Grace turns [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) into a formidable weapon platform. Cathode Grace provides a little extra modded crit chance while [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) gives 75% base modded electric damage (additive to electric mods for raw damage, but additive to elementalist for status), when you shoot through the orb, with a FORCED electric status.

Good helminth options include Nourish, which multiplies energy gain from both Cathode Grace and [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) and gives free viral on weapon, Omamori for even better lazy survivability and Roar which boosts status damage of both weapons and abilities.

# HOW TO PLAY
1. Press 3 to activate Cathode Grace at the beginning of the mission. You will have approximately 10s to start getting kills to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the duration of 3, which caps at 60 seconds after approximately 13 kills, so don’t activate this when there are zero enemies around to kill otherwise you will enter a long cooldown. As long as you get kills you will not need to recast 3 (unless you get nullified or silenced by Violence). This combined with Archon Stretch will keep you constantly regenerating energy at approximately 5 energy/s or 300 energy / min. 
2. Press 4 to activate Rotorswell once you have eneough energy. As long as you get kills with Cathode Grace active, Rotorswell will also [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) its duration indefinitely and you not need to recast 4. 
3. Press 2 to throw orb and tap 2 again to initiate grouping whenever there are lots of enemies nearby. This will exponentially magnify the damage from electric status due to the chaining mechanics. This is usually the subsume slot in my opinion due to how annoying the bouncing mechanic is and the need to [\[Double Tap\]](/items/arsenal/507/double-tap/) 2.
4. Press 1 to manually shield gate (optional) and shoot through the orb to apply [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) buff (forced electric procs and added electric damage). You probably want to spam this constantly to cover the map

# SURVIVABILITY
**SHIELD GATING**
Since [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) doesn’t have much health, armor or damage resistance at base, she relies heavily on crowd control and either passive shield gating or active shield gating in order to survive up to levelcap.

- OPTION 1 PASSIVE SHIELD GATING: 
[\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) + [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) reduces the shield recharge delay to 1s meaning if you avoid getting shot for 1s, shields will automatically start recharging giving you another 1.33s iframe on next frame after only 1 shield regenerated. When Arcane Aegis procs which is RNG, you get 12s of effective immortality to non-toxin damage. This gives you a less active method of surviving but requires Rotorswell to be active to stun enemies to help bridge the 1s delay time. 

- OPTION 2 ACTIVE SHIELD GATING:
https://overframe.gg/build/1041757/

Whenever your shields break, you can immediately tap 1 to reset your shields manually. Currently [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) gives the FULL 1.33s shield gate regardless of how much shield you hit before breaking. If you prefer full manual gating make sure to run at least single Augur mod on your pistol OR sentinel [\[Burst Laser\]](/items/arsenal/2248/burst-laser/) rifle, and you can drop Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor for any combination of Rolling Guard, Primed Flow, Equilibrium/Energy Nexus, Umbral Intensify.

OTHER
- Arcane Circumvent: Arcane Circumvent is a neat optional addition that steals overguard, shield and armor on rolling, which also simultaneously strips armor, shield, overguard by 50% which helps with DPS too. This basically means you get full shield gate when you dodge through corpus enemies too.
- Crowd Control: Coil Horizon and Rotorswell both provide soft CC which doesnt affect eximus/overguarded enemies. Coil Horizon drags enemies into a ball preventing them from shooting while Rotorswell is able to passively stun enemies briefly due to electric procs. This should reduce the frequency of you getting shot. 
- Invulnerability: As final backup, you could run Vazarin protective sling for 5s iframe with no cooldown. [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is also optional for 3s iframes and status cleanse over either shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) mods or [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/).

**DAMAGE REDUCTION**
For base steel path levels (e.g. 100 to 500ish) you can stack [\[Reverse Rotorswell\]](/items/arsenal/7502/reverse-rotorswell/), [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and innate shield DR and also add overguard from secondary fortifier (since [\[Reverse Rotorswell\]](/items/arsenal/7502/reverse-rotorswell/)) to simply tank lower levels of damage. Swap Fast Deflection, Vigilante Vigor and Catalyzing Shields for Reverse Rotorswell, Adaptation and Primed Flow/Equilibrium for more energy.

**GLOOM PERSISTENCE**
https://overframe.gg/build/936164/
Arcane Persistence can limit health loss to 500hp/s but requires lots of armor shards to hit 700 armor threshold. Gloom allows all damage from abilities to heal including rotorswell and reverse rotorswell. Rever Rotorswell reflects damage back on getting shot and will therefore always heal more than the 500hp damage/s that you take.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Roughly neutral duration is all you need to give Cathode Grace about 8 to 10s initial duration. Once you get kills within that time frame, duration doesn’t matter at all since you can [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) both 3 and 4 indefinitely as long as you continue getting kills. Coil Horizon does not scale with duration and most of the helminth options do not need much duration either, but you can add Primed Continuity for Roar/Nourish if you like.

**Efficiency**
[\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) can generate approximately 300 energy per minute with Cathode Grace + [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/), and once 3 and 4 are up they never need to be cast again. You will only need to occasionally cast 1 and 2. You can add more passive energy regeneration if you want, i.e. via  Zenurik, [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/), [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), Primary Exhilarate or [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/).

**Range**
Range is an important stat since it affects the range of Arcsphere, range of Coil Horizon's grouping and range of passive Rotorswell aura to about 9m and range on on crit rotorswell discharge to over 20m. We can use Overextended + Archon Stretch to hit this. Archon Stretch is also nice because it triggers from electric damage and gives 200 energy/min on top of cathode grace. If you need mod slots you could consider dropping [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/).

**Strength**
Strength is another important stat since it affects the damage of her electric dicharges from Rotorswell, damage of Coil Horizon as well as energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) and crit chance boost from Cathode Grace and boost of [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/).

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) reduces armor by 18% which is effectively a 1.8 x damage multiplier on armored enemies.
Brief respite is required for active shield gate (unless you have augur mods on secondary/burst laser prime)

**Exilus**
Completely flexible and up to preference:
- Lightning Dash for mobility and thematic fit
- Power Drift for more strength, Cunning Drift for more rante
- [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is best for preventing knockdown

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Either Arcsphere or Coil Horizon could be subsumed over, depending on if you like to use [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) or not. I usually prefer to remove Coil Horizon due to how annoying it is to actually use, as it often bounces to the wrong place and requires a second key tap to actually group, but would consider using Roar over 1 for a pure ability DPS setup.

**Nourish**
Subsume over 2 for a weapon platform focus. Gives free viral to your weapons and also multiplies all energy gained via Cathode Grace and [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/). The base energy gain is approximately 5 energy per second at 200 str. WIth Nourish this increases to approximately 13 energy per second or about 800 energy per minute.

**Omamori**
Subsume over 2 for a weapon platform focus. Makes survivability really easy with passive shield regeneration.

**Roar**
Subsume over 1 for pure ability DPS or over 2 for hybrid ability/weapon platform. Roar applies faction bonus which double dips DoTs like electric created by both [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) and rotorswell.

**Shock**
[\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) applies +electric damage which multiplies with the buff from [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/), and adds with other modded electric% on the weapon. This does require you to use another mod slot which is already tight.

**Armor Strip** 
This allows the electric procs to scale best against steel path armored grineer and corrupted as armor reduces damage by up to 10x. Note that due to armor changes, the effect of partial strip is often good enough so it isn't mandatory to full strip now. In fact, there are even other external sources of armor strip such as Grimoire + Jahu Canticle, Latron Incarnon, Amalgam Argonak + Innodem/Contagion that mean you don't need to waste a helminth purely on armor strip. Eventhe new Arcane Circumvent gives you on demand partial strip (50% on dodging through enemies).
- Tharros Strike: My preferred option because it is cheap to cast, full strips both armor and shields at only 200% strength and works on Acolytes and Demolysts. Tharros Strike's main issue is the lower range and non-radial area of effect, requiring you to aim towards enemies and missing any enemies behind you. This is somewhat overcome by grouping abilities such as [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)'s Coil Horizon, which groups enemies radially so you can strip all enemies in one cast. Tharros Strike also heals you.

- Pillage: Another great option, but requires 328% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) to full strip armor, which means you need either Blind Rage or external strength boosts such as Madurai, Archon Shards etc. Pillage also provides shields/overshields back to [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) allowing you to shield gate without [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) + augur mods, as well as cleansing status. Pillage cannot strip both shields and armor simultaneously, so when facing an acolyte, you must remove shields first (takes 2 casts of pillage, or just shoot with a weapon), then cast pillage. https://overframe.gg/build/490498/

- Terrify: Terrify has the best radial non-line of sight armor strip for regular enemies and only requires 167% strength for full strip, but is NOT permanent and does NOT affect Acolytes or Demolysts. It also does provide crowd control but makes enemies run away from you which can sometimes be more frustrating than helpful, depending on the mission.

**Sickening Pulse**
This creates an expanding pulse with line of sight that effectively multiplies the total electric status damage currently on an enemy by 10x. This works very well when cast into a group of enemies all affected by electric status from rotorswell.

# ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[[ youtube id="jQ18Ix_VCQ8?si=ANvEqFEuCvyQRBN5" ]]

**UPDATE OCT 2025 - NEW SMITE MECHANICS**
[\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/) rework now allows Smite to deal up to 75% current HP of the targetted enemy as radiation damage on the single target (while simultaneously stripping armor and overguard on that one enemy) as well as up to 30% current HP as radiation damage in an AOE with 6m at base and 16.8m at maximum range. Smite will auto-target the strongest enemy if there are multiple enemies close together (e.g. the eximus) but since this is now RADIATION damage, it has a 50% effect on Orokin enemies (e.g. found in conjunction, fissures, circuit) meaning you will need alot more viral priming to overcome the penalty. 

If you want to oneshot a single target before they are affected by radiation status, viral status etc - you just need exactly 185% strength with Roar.

If you boost the AOE to 100% we can potentially nuke enemies in up to 16.8m. The base value of the AOE damage is 10% CURRENT HP and is affected by strength but caps at a maximum of 30% at 300% strength. In order to make this useful, we need to get it 100% HP or higher as well as strip armor (which Reckoning does for you now in a single cast).

The things that can boost the Smite on [\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/) include: 
1. ROAR: Subsumed Roar gives +30% ability damage scaling with strength
2. TOPAZ ARCHON SHARDS: Each Tau Topaz Shard gives +15% ability damage for up to +75% with five tau shards
3. VIRAL STATUS: A single viral status doubles all damage done to health and 10 viral statuses increases all damage by 4.25x

Different combinations of the above three factors give arise to varying strength breakpoints for 100% HP in AOE, for example:
WITH ROAR ACTIVE:
FIVE TOPAZ SHARDS + NO VIRAL: 302% strength (very hard to hit this threshold while maintaining range and uses up all shard slots)
FOUR TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 197% strength 
THREE TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 212% strength
TWO TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 229% strength 
**ONE TOPAZ SHARD + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 249% strength** (this is what I run in this iteration)
NO TOPAZ SHARDS +  ONE VIRAL STATUS: 275% strength
NO SHARDS + NO VIRAL: 778% strength

WITHOUT ROAR ACTIVE:
NO SHARDS +  10 VIRAL : 276% strength (very hard to consistently and quickly get 10 viral status exactly where you need)
ONE SHARDS + 7 VIRAL: 249% strength 

In practice, it is extremely easy to have a companion or manually prime viral status and you usually apply much more than one viral stack, so you probably don't actually need much strength at all. However, for consistency sake we should assume we are only able to apply a single viral status due to RNG e.g. from [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/), [\[Bubonico\]](/items/arsenal/5293/bubonico/), [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/) and try to hit the breakpoint for that.

If you want to check breakpoints for your own setup, use this neat desmos calculator made by the player mineturtleofdeath: https://www.desmos.com/calculator/hl5vibupsr

**UPDATE APR 2025**
Arcane Universal Fallout gives amazing energy economy when you kill enemies affected by radiation status, which alot of [\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/)'s abilities can apply.

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast 2 whenever necessary to cover the entire map with Hallowed Ground. This will give you and allies status + knockdown immunity while confusing enemies with radiation status, which also feeds into universal fallout and armor from reckoning.
2. Cast 4 to full strip enemies, slam them to the ground for crowd control, apply radiation damage and status.
3. Spam 1 everywhere to kill enemies by dealing current %HP damage everywhere
4. Keep Roar active if subsumed (OPTIONAL).

# SURVIVABILITY
OPTION 1: Righteous Negation, Shield Gating and Crowd Control
[\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/)'s new passive Righteous Negation provides up to three protective charges on picking up health orbs or universal orbs. Reckoning makes a 50% chance to drop health orb on kill while Universal Fallout creates up to 60% chance to drop universal orb on kill (at 10 radiation), meaning by combining these two you will be spewing orbs all over the place provided you upkeep kills. Each charge negates damage and gives 0.25s i-frame, with 0.5s i-frame on the final charge, meaning a total of 1s effective i-frame when you have 3 charges. This is effectively passive immortality as long as you get kills and pick up orbs. If you cannot get sufficient kills to drop orbs in a timely manner, you also have Shield Gating as backup, where breaking 370 shields to zero gives about 1.37s of i-frames. Casting Reckoning with [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) + [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) costs 155 energy which is converted into 294 shield on cast, which is equivalent to 1.23s iframe on shield break. This means even if you run out of Negation charges, just spamming abilities like Reckoning will give you backup survivability. Simultaneously, radiation procs from Hallowed Ground and slamming from Reckoning gives crowd control which reduces the frequency of even taking damage in the first place.

OPTION 2: Health Tanking and Renewal Healing
If you prefer not to think too hard, cast too often or rely on orb pickups, or just want to utilize his whole kid including Renewal, you could always do the old fashioned method of health tanking and healing via Renewal. [\[Phoenix Renewal\]](/items/arsenal/160/phoenix-renewal/) even adds an additional layer of protection. Oberon is very good at it due to high base armor, free flat armor bonuses from Renewal/Reckoning and the innate healing from Renewal. You can help increase EHP by adding health e.g. [\[Umbral Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/693/umbral-vitality/) + Arcane Blessing. You should not need to slot armor due to all the innate bonuses. 

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Positive duration mostly helps uptime of roar and hallowed ground so you don't have to recast as often.

**Efficiency and Energy Economy**
At 45% efficiency, [\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/) will consume ALOT of energy per ability rotation e.g. casting 4 and 1 costs a whopping 194 energy while refreshing 2 and 3 occasionally also costs about 194 energy. 

Thankfully he has multiple means of recovering energy and improving energy economy, allowing you to spam all abilities with zero care in the world:
- Arcane Universal Fallout: enemies affected by radiation status (created by abilities) have a chance of dropping a universal orb (60% at 10 radiation). Both Smite and Reckoning forces one radiation status on cast while Hallowed Ground forces 1 radiation status every 0.5s, meaning it would take about 4s + reckoning + smite to hit 10 radiation status. On average you will probably be killing enemies afflicted by about 4 to 5 radiation status meaning at least 30% chance to drop orbs all over the map. Each universal orb restores 50 energy meaning if you kill about 20 enemies you could be getting on average 300 energy back. If you also have equilibrium, the universal orbs also restore 55 energy (from health), meaning a total of 630 energy.
-  Enemies simply damaged once by Reckoning also have a 50% chance to produce health orbs on death, which can be converted into energy by [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) so each orb makes 55 energy. If you kill those same 20 enemies on average 10 of them will drop orbs and produce 550 energy. All up, you can spend about 200 energy killing 20 enemies and receive about 1180 energy back. This is absolutely overkill but also means you can spam both 4 and 1 with zero reservation. 
- [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and high base energy: With [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) [\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/) hits 755 energy max. You could potentially replace this with just Arcane Battery to save a mod slot, or run only Primed flow to save arcane slot, OR even run BOTH simultaneously for extreme energy reserves.
- Arcane Battery (OPTIONAL): This increases maximum energy with armor rating BUT is highly fluctuatant. Oberons base armor makes Battery give 135 energy. Reckoning provides up to 1000 flat armor bonus based on enemies hit and how many radiation procs are on them (you need to hit 18 enemies with 10 radiation status each to cap this), which results in approximately +435 max energy (to total of 700). Using both Arcane Battery AND [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) can result in 1190 energy max. Adding [\[Hallowed Reckoning\]](/items/arsenal/158/hallowed-reckoning/) provides even more armor bonus for a total of 1335 max energy. If you decided to keep Renewal you finally get a whopping 1755 energy! Keep in mind however, casting Reckoning each time REWRITES the armor gained from the previous buff. This means if you were sitting at 700 energy from a 1000 armor buff, then cast Reckoning and only hit one enemy for a tiny armor buff, you will effectively LOSE almost 300 energy. 

**Range**
High range sets Smite's AOE component to 15 to 16.8m allowing you to maximise kills per cast. Max range also gives both hallowed ground and reckoning a huge 40+m range allowing you to affect a very large number of enemies per cast. Keep in mind however, Reckoning now has a line of sight requirement so you cannot affect enemies behind walls, and sometimes misses enemies on different levels.

**Strength**
Reckoning only needs 167% strength to full strip, but there are certain strength thresholds required for Smite to deal 100% current HP to single targets and AOE.

Use this calculator made by mineturtleofdeath to check individual breakpoints with specific build variations: https://www.desmos.com/calculator/hl5vibupsr

For this current build iteration, i have chosen two breakpoints, 185% strength for killing single targets with smite + roar with NO viral or radiation which you hit before building up any Molt Augmented stacks and 249% strength for killing enemies in the AOE with smite + roar + reckoning + ONE viral + ONE topaz shard, which you hit after getting about 200 kills for molt augmented. What this means is at the start of the mission you can oneshot all single enemies without using any priming but to oneshot in the AOE, you may need to shoot you primer (e.g. [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/)) more than once to apply at least FIVE viral statuses. Once you get 250 kills and max out molt augmented, you now only need to apply a SINGLE viral status i.e. one shot of [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/).

The more topaz shards you add, the less reliant on viral status you are, but alternatively you can also still nuke effectively with no shard investment in case you don't own any shards, but simply improving the consistency of viral application. This can be done by using a combination of AOE companion primers (tazicor, hound, panzer) and an AOE weapon primer (cedo, epitaph).

**Aura**
Optional:
- Brief Respite gives backup shield gating in addition to Oberon's passive immortality. 
- Growing power gives extra 25% strength when you apply status via a weapon

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Universal Fallout : killing enemies affected by radiation status applied by abilities give a chance to drop a LARGE universal orb. This orb gives 50 energy, 50 health (converts to 55 energy by equilibrium) and counts for Oberon's passive.
- Molt Augmented: Free strength after 250 kills, helps you hit oneshot thresholds with even less viral statuses
- Arcane Battery: gives energy max based on current armor rating. Reckoning gives up to 1000 flat armor based on how many enemies you hit and how many radiation procs they had, but overwrites it each time you recast reckoning meaning you cost potentially lose 300 energy if you first hit 20 enemies then hit only 1 enemy on a next cast. If you add Hallowed Reckoning or Renewal, you get even more armor for more energy max.

**Flexible Mods**
- Hallowed Reckoning - OPTIONAL augment to take advantage of grouping and passive damage zones that can actually deal some DPS when enemies are full-stripped, and helps kill stragglers with very little HP left after a smite nuke. Also gives additional armor bonus that feeds into Arcane Battery energy.

- Smite Infusion - OPTIONAL augment that gives bonus radiation elemental damage for improving raw weapon damage.

- Natural Talent - If you don't own Amber Archon shards, good quality of life to make the long casting animation of Reckoning much more bearable. Can offload with Amber Archon Shards and Madurai school. 

**Archon Shards**
- ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed shard to speed up cast of smite and reckoning, which you will be spamming alot, as well recasting of Roar and Hallowed Ground
- ONE to FOUR Tauforged Topaz +ability damage on radiation status to boost smite and reckoning damage, lowering strength and viral requirements for AOE oneshots. You would want to tailor this to your needs and specific build. Personally I am running ONE Tauforged Shard along with a 249% strength breakpoint, in order to free up shard slots for other useful shards
FLEX SHARDS:
- Parkour Velocity for mobility
- Equilibrium shards free up equilibrium in mod slots, e.g. for hallowed reckoning or smite infusion

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
- Roar: boosts damage of smite and reckoning/hallowed reckoning and weapons
- Breach surge: blinds enemies, creates cascading damage sparks scaling from smite damage and hallowed reckoning damage, can apply radiation status
- Marked for Death
- Blood Altar
- Decoy

# ARSENAL
# PRIMER
For the most consistent 'nuking' with smite, you will want an AOE viral primer that roughly matches the radius of smite (which is about 16.8m at max) and can apply at least 1 to 2 viral statuses in one shot.
- Epitaph: quickshot has 14.4m radius with very high status chance :https://overframe.gg/build/912227/ , can run fortifier for extra overguard and amalgam barrel diffusion for faster rolling. This range nearly matches smite's AOE radius so is the perfect fit.

[\[Rakta Dark Dagger\]](/items/arsenal/1039/rakta-dark-dagger/) is a melee that regenerates shields on hit when used against enemies affected by a radiation proc. This synergizes somewhat with Oberon since three of his abilities cause radiation procs: https://overframe.gg/build/264292/

Companions that can AOE prime viral are ideal to help boost the AOE of smite. Companions are much less consistent than manual priming but offer a viable 'hands-off' alternative if you prefer:

2. Tap 3 for Collective Curse to curse a large group of enemies in a 65 degree cone over an huge range. Attacking any of these cursed enemies with his 4 or a x12 heavy attack i.e. either manually or using 1, will transfer 100% of the damage to all other cursed enemies (only the instance of initial hit and resulting bleed damage but not the slash status itself).

4. If not subsumed over, Tap 4 for Storm of Ukko to create a wide zone of slash damage and slash procs which can deal slash damage + status to enemies, stun enemies and generate combo to maintain you at x12.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This is a general use [\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/) build for steel path and endurance steel path with high range for full strip with Tharros Strike and Final Stand explosions. Survivability in endurance is from a combination of overguard generated by the augment Intrepid stand (which gives extra 0.5s i-frame gate from depleting overguard) and shield gating (another 1.3s gate) which is complemented by the shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) from Rally Point. Axios Javelin has questionable targetting and can be replaced with Nourish to boost energy gain, raw weapon damage, final stand raw damage and allows final stand to have a small chance of creating viral status.

[\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/)'s passive is not specifically worth building excessive amounts of shield for since it is only additive to mods. Even with 2-3 shield mods, the maximum shield + overshield you can reach is about 4000, which equates to 100% additive crit chance or only half of a single Critical Delay, and 2/3rds of what [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) can [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) by simply jumping without having to maintain shields. 

**UPDATE FEB 2025**
Since the health and armor changes, [\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/) 4 is even worse than before for DPS. Arcane Truculence is a nice choice to help maximise DPS since 10 viral status in 30m can boost damage up to 4.25x more consistently than Panzer priming.

**UPDATE JULY 2023**
The new augment [\[Intrepid Stand\]](/items/arsenal/6221/intrepid-stand/) allows Final Stand to generate overguard on each enemy hit, which scales with strength. Since overguard now has 0.5s gate, [\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/) is effectively immortal as long as you are hitting enemies in 4. 

[[ youtube id="tyGw2KPKiMg" ]]

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Rally Point and Nourish at the beginning to start passively generating energy.
2. Cast Tharros Strike to full strip armor
3. Cast Final Stand and aim at groups of enemies to kill them while simultaneously generating shields and overguard.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration is important for easier upkeep of Rally Point as well as the duration and therefore total damage output of Final Stand. 
On the other hand Axios Javelin's implosion is fixed at 2s and the duration of pinning a single target is not worth worrying about, while Tharros strike is not affected by duration at all.

**Efficiency**
Nourish allows you to run negative efficiency, either at 45% or 75% depending on preference, even without Energize, since we can boost Rally Points energy restore to about 20 energy/s and triple energy gain from all sources like orbs. Without Nourish, you can keep this neutral or adjust to preference as Styanax can regenerate energy around 6 energy/s with rally point. Finally, [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is a huge source of energy since it converts health orbs into energy meaning each health orb is 55 energy. Every eximus kill guarantees 2 health orbs or 110 energy while [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) on Panzer causes lots of more health orbs to drop. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is used to help energy economy. 

**Range**
Extreme high range is needed for the pull range of Axios Javelin, range of Tharros Strike and Explosion range of Final Stand.

**Strength**
Strength is important for Tharros Strikes armor/shield strip, which requires either 200% strength to full strip in one cast or just 164% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) in aura. Strength also boosts Rally Points shield on kill and energy regen, as well as overall damage of all his abilities. 

**Flexible Options**
Natural Talent - speeds up cast animations, particularly of Final Stand. Use this if you don't have Amber cast speed shards.
Rolling Guard - grants i-frames and status cleanse.
Vigorous Swap - affects the damage of Final Stand, acting as a 2.65x damage multiplier, but requires you to swap weapons to activate, before pressing 4. This is additive to Arcane Arachne.

**Aura**
Corrosive Projection - reduces armor from 100% to 82%, meaning you only need to strip the remaining 82% armor with Tharros strike which is hit at 164% strength. This means you can full strip immediately without getting kills first.
Growing Power - boosts all abilities but needs additional aura forma.

**Exilus**
Totally flexible for [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/), [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) etc. [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is optional since you are knockdown immune with overguard active, but are still susceptible whenever it breaks.

**Arcanes**
Molt Augmented - gives +60% strength after 250 kills, boosting all abilities. Better used in longer missions.
Arcane Arachne - after wall latch, boosts Final Stand damage by 2.5x for 30s (+150% additive to Vigorous Swap and Naramon's Void Levitation). For weapons, the +150% dmg is additive to Serration etc.
Molt efficiency - more duration with shields active (easy with styanax since 3 gives shields)
Truculence - 10 viral in aoe
Arcane Avenger - adds +45% flat crit chance to weapons, often stronger than Styanax's passive. 

**ARCHON SHARDS**
- TWO AMBER Cast Speed: Mandatory for speeding up final stand animation time
- THREE CRIMSON Strength or Duration: up to personal preference.

## HELMINTH OPTIONS
Nourish - Subsume over 1 for a final stand focused build. Nourish actually applies the viral damage bonus to Final Stand since it is coded like a weapon (increasing its damage by almost 2x) and even creates the occasional viral status proc and finally multiplies the energy gained by Rally Point to approximately 18 energy/s and all energy gained from equilibrium.

Roar - Subsume over 1or 2 for a Final Stand spam focused build, Roar double dips on the forced slash procs but the raw damage boost to initlal hits is lower than Nourish. Consider adding Streamline over Transient Fortitude. Note you become very vulnerable while in last stand so this works best in non-steel path. Consider Adaptation over Rolling Guard.

# FOCUS SCHOOL
Naramon - Lethal Levitation can replace or ADD to Arcane Arachne as it adds 200% damage in the same layer as the 150% from arachne, meaning a 3x multiplier alone (or a 1.8x multiplier with arachne on). This is easy to proc with phahd amp as you just need to press 1 and then alt fire to hit 4 levitated enemies.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This is a DPS [\[Limbo\]](/items/arsenal/36/limbo/) build focused on buffing weapon damage with the [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) augment and combining this with Breach Surge to create 'double dipped' surge sparks which can do damage in the billions or even negative billions (due to integer overflow). This is possible because Breach Surge spark damage scale off your weapon damage which is multiplied by the [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) bonus, but each spark itself is also counted as a weapon, so it is multiplied by the [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) bonus a second time when it hits. In addition, [\[Limbo\]](/items/arsenal/36/limbo/)'s stasis and cataclysm abilities allow you to get easy headshots in the absolute safety of the rift. If up against acolytes however, since stasis doesn't freeze them, you will have to use cataclysm + stasis to freeze other enemies allowing you to focus on the acolyte, [\[Magus Lockdown\]](/items/arsenal/2294/magus-lockdown/) to shut them down and rely on [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) to get the insane damage bonus to kill them quickly.  

**Update 2023**
Breach Surge has been nerfed to be capped at 5 million damage BEFORE multipliers such as [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/), Eclipse etc. This means you can still [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) hundreds of millions of damage, but will NOT hit damage cap any more as easily.

**OLD Damage Calculations** 
For example, if you rift surge 50 enemies you can hit a [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) bonus of approximately 3000%, which is additive to your other +dmg sources like [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/) and merciless arcanes (but multiplicative with galvanized overload mods on certain weapons like [\[Bubonico\]](/items/arsenal/5293/bubonico/), [\[Quellor\]](/items/arsenal/2886/quellor/)), and equates to approximately 30x more damage. Applied twice means each breach surge spark actually receives a multiplier of 900x damage. Adding the breach surge multiplier of 4x makes this about 3600 x weapon damage. Theoretically, if you can make a weapon do 1 million damage by itself, then each spark potentially does 3.6 billion, which exceeds the games damage cap of 2.14 billion and can even become negative. Furthermore, surge sparks can headshot and are affected by headshot multipliers.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate stasis (and keep active at all times)
2. Cast cataclysm over a large group of enemies
3. Cast rift surge to gain [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) bonus. As the bubble shrinks, enemies near the edge that exit the bubble banish enemies around them, allowing to you damage enemies beyond the range of the bubble.
4. Cast breach surge and shoot an enemy in the glowing head
5. Let sparks fly and watch the damage happen

[[ youtube id="rGKdIBTkFwU" ]]

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration is required so stasis, rift surge and cataclysm don't need to be recast so often.

**Efficiency**
Efficiency can be negative since we don't need to spam abilities, and [\[Limbo\]](/items/arsenal/36/limbo/)'s passive also returns 10 energy for every enemy killed in the rift, meaning killing a room of 30 enemies returns 300 energy. This combined with arcane energize means you can sustain your energy as long as you get lots of kills, which is the whole point of the build. If you feel energy becomes an issue, you can drop [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) for [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/).

**Range**
High range is needed so rift surge and cataclysm covers a large amount of enemies and to give you the maximum bonus on [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/). Range is also beneficial for breach surge range.

**Strength**
Strength is the most important stat since it scales both the Breach Surge damage multiplier and [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) multiplier, the latter of which scales again into breach surge sparks, meaning strength essentially 'double dips' breach surge. At about 200% str, we hit approximately 4x breach surge multiplier and 60% [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) bonus for each enemy affected by rift surge.

**Aura**
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) helps with shield gating.

**Exilus**
Power drift is optional to further boost power strength.
Other useful options are primed sure footed/handspring, cunnning drift for more range or speed drift for even more cast speed

**Flexible slots**
Rolling Guard - can drop for more range, strength  or efficiency

**Arcanes**
Energize for energy
Consequence to jump around fast after headshots which are very easy against frozen enemies
Molt Augmented for more strength
Molt Efficiency for duration

**Archon Shards**
2 or more amber cast speed shards let you drop Natural Talent for stretch/[\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/)
Place the remainder in duration.

## HELMINTH
We have built specifically for Breach Surge due to the interaction with [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/), but if you don't have this or don't need excessive amounts of damage, you can use something more useful like Ensnare, which can lock down acolytes (which are not affected by stasis) and will also draw enemies into the cataclysm and group them for quicker killing.

## ARSENAL
You want heavy hitting single damage instance weapons to get the biggest breach surge sparks. Keep in mind you can DROP base damage mods like serration/steel on these builds for something more useful like fire rate etc since [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/) is additive to bsae damage.

**COMPANIONS**

[\[Helios\]](/items/arsenal/2238/helios/) can use [\[Vicious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6270/vicious-bond/) to give passive AOE armor strip as enemies get damaged by abilities and can also use [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) which gives a free 30% efficiency with near continuous uptime, which for some reason currently activates while Limbo uses stasis OR cataclysm. **Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

Magnetize is Mag's most versatile and powerful ability and can be used to crowd control/group enemies, block enemy projectiles, shred a single target (bosses/acolytes) or grouped enemies, AOE nuke (line of sight) and finally disarm enemies (with the augment). Magnetize works by creating a bubble around an enemy and redirecting all projectiles/bullets into the centre. This will allow weapons with punch through to rapidly kill enemies in the centre by hitting them multiple times as they orbit around. 

Additionally, 25% of your weapon's damage will be absorbed into the bubble (counts multishot but not crits or DoT effects). This absorbed damage will then be dealt as magnetic damage over time (50% absorbed damage per 1/2 second tick) to every enemy in the field for the remaining duration of the bubble. Finally once the bubble destabilizes (either manually with augment or on expiration once the initial enemy is dead), all the absorbed damage will be multiplied by the total number of damage ticks experienced by each enemy (essentially 2 x duration in seconds x enemies in bubble) and released in a massive AOE explosion (requires LINE OF SIGHT). 

Using the augment [\[Magnetized Discharge\]](/items/arsenal/133/magnetized-discharge/) increases the radius of the magnetize bubble and resulting explosion range (additive 45% to range mods, effectively giving 280% range to magnetize) AND provides approx 40-50% chance to disarm enemies in explosion range (at low strength). 

Breach Surge synergizes with Magnetize because surge sparks are counted as weapon projectiles and are absorbed into the bubble damage as well doing a small amount of direct radiation damage to enemies. Damage over time from the bubble can release more surge sparks, in addition to any further damage from weapons, which are then absorbed back into the bubble to further boost bubble damage. This creates a positive feedback loop where the bubble will simply magnify damage without extra input, giving a final explosion damage of over 10 times the damage without breach surge (with 20 enemies in bubble). 

Breach Surge can be subsumed over either 1 or 3, and this is mostly up to personal preference. Pull is a very good ability since it's buff as it allows you to group enemies into a magnetize bubble with a longer range, while Polarize gives shield restore with quicker one handed casts and allows you to run [\[Counter Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/137/counter-pulse/) augment.

**VEILBREAKER UPDATE SEPT 2022**
[\[Fracturing Crush\]](/items/arsenal/134/fracturing-crush/) now full strips permanently at only 134% strength and provides +50% cast speed to crush. Amber Archon Shards can also provide additional cast speed, freeing up slots that used to be used on Natural Talent. 

Triple augment variant (requires archon shards): https://overframe.gg/build/369097/mag-prime/shards-of-power-triple-augment-mag-post-veilbreaker-with-archon-shards/

## PLAYSTYLE
Main ability rotation:
1. Use Breach Surge (1 or 3) to blind enemies for crowd control and prime them for spark production.
2. Cast Magnetize (2) on an enemy to draw enemies into the center - choose positions where the bubble will block incoming enemies or gunfire (e.g. corridors)
3. Cast Crush to full-strip enemies and immobilize enemies.
4. Shoot weapon slightly off to the side of centre to create an orbiting path
5. Enemies will either die instantly or produce surge sparks that then feed back into the bubble
6. Let the bubble expire or detonate bubble by casting 2 again near the bubble for big line of sight explosion
7. OPTIONAL (if not subsumed over): Cast Polarize constantly to restore shields and crowd control if running counter.
8. OPTIONAL (if not subsumed over): Cast Pull while standing inside a bubble to pull additional enemies quicker into magnetize.

Survivability:
If shields deplete, either cast polarize (3) or crush (4) combined with or without rolling guard. Polarize is one-handed and has a short animation, meaning you can reload and run/dodge while doing this, but does not offer any crowd control (without the augment). Crush is two handed and locks you into an animation, but does offer a short period of knockdown for breathing room, while also costing a little more energy. If possible, try to use polarize since it is quicker. When surrounded you can cast crush for more overshields and breathing room while you reposition.

Here is a video demonstrating breach surge interaction with magnetize and how to play, with SP levelcap circuit survival and defense.:

[[ youtube id="XVTgZqGPKO0" ]]

.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Keep duration as close to neutral since it will affect the blind duration of breach surge and the duration of magnetize (all of which have a decent base duration of about 15s). 

**Efficiency**
[\[Mag\]](/items/arsenal/33/mag/)'s playstyle requires constant casting of abilities. We can supplement this with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + synth deconstruct on companion to produce health orbs which are converted into energy, as well as a combination of arcane steadfast +/- [\[Mystic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6276/mystic-bond/) to give free ability casts. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) would be nice to slot, but you can also use the surplus of azure shards to supplement energy capacity.

**Range**
Range is the most important stat for magnetize. [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) and [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) hit a range of 235%. The augment [\[Magnetized Discharge\]](/items/arsenal/133/magnetized-discharge/) adds a further 45% to give 280% effective range to magnetize, giving a total radius of 11.2m and explosion radius of 42m. High range also affects the range of crush which gives more shields/overshields.

**Strength**
While we ideally want the strength to be high to scale the breach surge multiplier and pull speed of magnetize, strength is not that important as the magnetize 'damage multiplier' only applies to the single targeted enemy rather than all the enemies, and strength does NOT affect the absorption of weapon damage into the bubble. The strength multiplier also does not bypass the 5 million damage cap of breach surge meaning if you use strong single hit weapons that deal more than 5 million damage already (e.g. heavy [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/), exodia contagion), strength will have little effect on the final surge damage. [\[Fracturing Crush\]](/items/arsenal/134/fracturing-crush/) only requires 134% power strength for full strip in a single cast. We require either [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) + [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) for 4 to hit 134 str, or run [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) and Molt Augmented to offset the strength penalty from [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) and hit this benchmark. Other alternatives like [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) or [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) have too much drawback and [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) has too little boost. If you don't like or own molt augmented, consider dropping overextended for augur reach, or simply dont run fracturing crush

**Flexible slots**
Augments - flexible. [\[Fracturing Crush\]](/items/arsenal/134/fracturing-crush/) full strips at 134% strength, immobilizes melee enemies and adds +50% cast speed to Crush. [\[Magnetized Discharge\]](/items/arsenal/133/magnetized-discharge/) increases range of magnetize nuke, lets you detonate it and disarm enemies. [\[Counter Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/137/counter-pulse/) jams enemy guns and goes through walls which is great crowd control to improve survivability. Each of these can be swapped out for other options like more stats instead (e.g. streamline, strength, duration).

Rolling guard - optional addition. Nice for extra layer of survivability and status cleanse which is missing from [\[Mag\]](/items/arsenal/33/mag/)'s kit. If you are comfortable with camping behind bubbles and shield gating with 3 or 4 without [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/), feel free to switch this out for primed flow, augur secrets (to increase magnetize grouping speed and breach surge multiplier), streamline, duration (constitition/augur message) or even more range with augur reach.

Stretch - can swap for Primed flow

Natural talent - crucial if not using archon cast speed shards

Exilus - flexible
- Cunning Drift gives more range
- Power drift for a little more strength
- Primed sure footed is best in slot to prevent knockdowns but is not easily acquirable. Handspring is a useful alternative.

Aura - flexible
- Growing power gives 25% extra strength
- Worthy Comradery applies to breach surge and allows it to orange crit at 175% cc
- Corrosive Projection reduces strip strength threshold to 110%

Arcanes - flexible
- Steadfast - improves energy economy by giving free casts
- Energize - improves energy economy but very costly and hard to get
- Arachne - multiplies breach surge damage by 2.5x but requires frequent wall latching
- Augmented - gives free 60% strength after 250 kills
- Concentration - gives 60% duration after each cast for 3s

**Archon Shards**
2 Cast Speed - allows you to free up natural talent slot
Rest are flexible depending on preference:
- Parkour Velocity for mobility
- Strength shards to boost breach surge


## ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Utilise the power of the Mecha Set, Archon Mods and Heat + Gas Catalyze to nuke enemies as [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/), the Full Mecha Alchemist. [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s Catalyze is a strong through the wall nuke that applies elemental damage and a forced status effect, applying heat damage at base and a second element that you can 'infuse'. We infuse Gas into catalyze because Gas procs linger across the map dealing damage in a small AOE, lasting longer than usual due to [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)' passive, and works well with both grouping and optionally the Sickening Pulse helminth. 

**Update April 2026**
Swapped back to regular tank and shield recharge from persistence as it requires too much external healing to upkeep which locks you into specific weapons

**Update Dec 2025**
Swapped survivability to Persistence. Use a single armor shard to hit 700 armor or rely on [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/).

**Update May 2025**
[\[Valence Formation\]](/items/arsenal/6483/valence-formation/) is now additive to regular elemental mods on weapons rather than status damage, and is no longer double dipped by Sickening Pulse. Blast infusion can also no longer buff blast status. Gas infusion still buffs Gas Catalyze status at least so we can continue using Sickening pulse + Gas Catalyze (just with a final 30x multiplier rather than 90x)

**Update Feb 2025**
Since the armor changes (armor capped at 2700 for 90% damage reduction), we no longer really require full strip for good damage which means the focus on corrosive procs and emerald shards is now optional. 

Arcane Impetus is a new arcane that is great on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/), you just need to cast one of each of the 10 possible elements at least once in the mission then it will constantly refresh to get 10 stacks for 60% strength and 30% efficiency. Arcane [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) also gives both duration and strength both of which are useful on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/), but can be difficult to stack in certain missions.

**Update April 2024**
[\[Valence Formation\]](/items/arsenal/6483/valence-formation/) is a new augment that applies a +200% elemental bonus to weapons, BUT, seems to also apply to statuses created by abilities including Catalyze. This means infusing Gas into Catalyze will allow subsequent Gas procs to benefit from a 3x multiplier.

# PLAYSTYLE
NON-HELMINTH PLAYSTYLE
1. Try to group enemies with Magus Anomaly/Ensnare/Nautilus Cordon/Melee Vortex. 
2. Infuse Corrosive (hold 1 and 3) and cast Vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) (Tap 2) to charge through groups of enemies, dropping vials that rapidly stack corrosive status for full strip on enemies standing in the pools (14 procs in 3-4s).
3. Shoot your primer (e.g. Cedo altfire, Grimoire Alt-fire) to inflict more unique statuses, especially viral and heat, then hold 1 and 4 to infuse GAS, before immediately casting Catalyze (4).
4. Tap 3 immediately after to reduce the cooldown of 4, and ideally before enemies all die
5. Tap 1 ideally into the group of enemies. This will reduce cooldowns of both 3 and 4 further

**HELMINTH COMBOS**
**Sickening Sublimation (Gas and Sickening Pulse)**
- Subsume Sickening Pulse over 2
- Group enemies
- Hold 1 and 4 to infuse Gas
- Tap 4 to nuke with Gas + Heat
- Hold 1 and 3 to infuse Corrosive
- Tap 3 to reduce cooldown of 4
- Tap 2 to cast Sickening pulse which will add 10 corrosive procs (giving full strip with 2 emerald shards), multiply electric status damage by 10x (from Transmutation probe), multiply gas status damage by 10x and increase its AOE (from gas infused Catalyze), double heat status damage (from Catalyze) and double toxin status damage (from Ophidian Bite).
- Hold 1 and 3 to further infuse corrosive and Tap 1 to tag 1 Toxin and 4 corrosive and reduce cooldowns of 3 and 4
- Optional: Spam grouping to get new enemies into the existing Gas clouds
