.

**Primed Combustion (Heat Inherit Catalyze)**
- Use Roar over 2
- Use heat inherit primer with secondary encumber e.g. Kompressa, Catabolyst, Dex Furis or AOE heat primer (cedo, bubonico)
- Hold 4 to infuse Heat
- Tap 4 to nuke with Heat (3 heat procs total per enemy)
- Hold 1 and 3 to infuse Corrosive (optional)
- Tap 3 to reduce cooldown of 4 
- Tap 1 to reduce cooldown of 4 and 3 


# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration provides status duration to all of the statuses created by [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s abilities. At 155% duration, every proc is increased to approximately 9s increasing the overall damage potential of a status. We can add [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Ris Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6365/ris-invocation/) (up to 60%) and three tauforged duration shards to help boost this up to 260% final which makes statuses last 15s. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) can be used because Toxin procs created by Ophidian [\[Bite\]](/items/arsenal/656/bite/) can then proc corrosive which boosts Catalyze in two ways, due to both minor armor strip (up to 80% at 10 corrosive) and because Catalyze scales with number of elemental statuses (2^status). 

**Efficiency**
Efficiency does not affect [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) cooldowns directly however do affect how much cooldown reduction is generated by [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) and [\[Lingering Transmutation\]](/items/arsenal/7500/lingering-transmutation/). Arcane Impetus can hit 10 statuses which gives a bonus of 30% efficiency which is very easy to upkeep as you only need to cast a single ability once every 20s after you have performed every elemental combo at least once. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) also procs whenever your companion damages an enemy while you are casting Vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) meaning you could potentially have another free 30% efficiency, bringing you back to 105% final efficiency.

**Range**
Range is essential for all of [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s abilities as it increases the range at which Ophidian [\[Bite\]](/items/arsenal/656/bite/) can hit, the travel and explosion of Vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/), the radius of Transmutation Probe which affects how quickly you can reduce cooldowns and the range of Catalyze, including certain helminth options such as grouping abilities and Sickening Pulse. 

**Strength**
Strength is mainly is needed for the damage of Catalyze so we can benefit from [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) if you want. WIth [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/), Precision Intensify and Arcane Impetus ( or Molt Augmented) we could hit 289% final strength for Catalyze damage.

**Exilus**
Flexible:
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Power Drift for more strength
- [\[Coaction Drift\]](/items/arsenal/64/coaction-drift/) double dips on aura, giving [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) 198% status damage on marked enemies, which double dips for a final 8.9x multiplier.

**Arcanes**
These can be flexible based on preference.

Survivability:
- Arcane Aegis - when this procs (based on RNG) you could get 12s of relative immortality to non-toxin damage (see below for Fass Canticle bug to abuse this further)
- Arcane Persistence - limits health loss by 500 hp /s as long as armor is over 700 and you are not affected by magnetic, bleed, heat, corrosive.
- Arcane Blessing - gives up to 1200 more health which is an additional 2s of survivability with persistence
- Arcane Guardian - extra armor to help ehp

For Catalyze damage
- Arcane Impetus - up to 60% strength and 30% efficiency from [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) potential elements, just need to cast each combination at least once in the mission then you will be able to constantly refresh it by casting any element
- Molt Augmented - up to 60% strength after 250 kills
- Arcane Ice storm - 40% strength and duration, but can be difficult to keep maxed and highly dependent on density, so could sit around half stacks around 20% strength/20% duration

**MECHA SET**
The mecha set provides many benefits:
- [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) gives +150% damage (2.5x damage multiplier) to a marked enemy (marked every 12s), which doubles dips on status effects for a final 6.25x on heat/gas DoT
- [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) gives +60% armor for each enemy in 30m upon killing the marked enemy. In a dense map like survival you can easily get 1000-2000% armor bonus, which scales extremely well with [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)' high base armor, allowing you to hit between 3000 to 10,000 final armor. This is optional if you would like to health tank instead of shield gate.
- Mecha set bonus causes status effects to spread upon killing a marked enemy which basically applies whole additional set of boosted catalyze procs to 30m radius every 15s.

**ARCHON MODS**
Archon mods work well with Lavos, but are NOT compulsory (the regular versions work fine too):
- Archon Vitality adds an additional heat proc created by Catalyze, but only one extra proc even if you infuse heat into heat. 
- [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) adds corrosive status upon being hit by toxin procs via Ophidian Bite, which slightly helps with Emerald shard armor strip and any additional elemental statuses boost Catalyze.
- [\[Archon Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/5923/archon-intensify/) activates upon being healed by Ophidian [\[Bite\]](/items/arsenal/656/bite/), giving a total of +60% strength (compared to only 44% from [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/)). [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) is however straight up better since it gives 90% strength to 4.

[\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) and [\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) are NOT usable on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) since he has NO energy and does not benefit from energy orbs.

# ARCHON SHARDS
ONE regular Azure armor shard for Arcane Persistence OPTIONAL to hit 700 armor and free up aura slot
ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed Shard to speed up cast animations
TWO or THREE Crimson Duration Shards helps increase the duration of gas procs from catalyze and all other statuses
Other flexible shards include Parkour Velocity for mobility

# SURVIVABILITY
1. **Health Tanking (for lower levels <500)** 
Since Lavos does not spend energy, he is unable to reset shield gate with the normal methods using Brief Respite/Augur mods. For non-endurance content, you can commit to full eHP tanking using a combination of armor, health and adaptation and using Ophidian bite to heal. 

Lavos has a high base health so Archon Vitality/[\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) boosts health to 1480. Transmutation Probe converts all orbs into universal orbs which activate Arcane Blessing so you can gain an additional 1200 health very quickly for a total of 2680 health.

[\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) also has a high base armor of 675, meaning [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) after affecting just 10 enemies in a 30m radius gives a 600% armor boost for 3150 extra armor for 20s. Compare this to [\[Steel Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/808/steel-fiber/) which only gives +100% for another 675 armor. Since Mecha set has a cooldown of only 15s you should be able to upkeep a large armor buff permanently provided you kill dense crowds consistently. If you affect 20 enemies, you can get 1200% armor or 5850 armor for 95.6% DR. This multiplied with [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) gives 99.56% DR and applied to 2680 health gives an effective HP of 609,090. Additional useful sources of ehp include Arcane Reaper, Melee Fortification, Arcane [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/), [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), Arcane Doubleback.

2. **Arcane Persistence (for higher levels >500 but needs external healing)**
The new Arcane Persistence prevents taking more than 500 health damage per second (applying after damage reduction from armor or abilities) while armor is above 700, meaning if you have high health and/or can heal 500 health back quickly/consistently you can be survive without shield gating or classic health tanking all the way up to levelcap. [\[Lavos Prime\]](/items/arsenal/7246/lavos-prime/) has a very high base armor which almost meets the 700 armor threshold (675 at rank 30), meaning you could run a single normal azure armor shard to hit the threshold. You can then run [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) for health and don't require any additional armor or DR sources. All you need is consistent healing which you could source from a combination of Ophidian [\[Bite\]](/items/arsenal/656/bite/), [\[Life Strike\]](/items/arsenal/330/life-strike/) on a melee and other weapons with health steal ([\[Syam\]](/items/arsenal/6176/syam/) + [\[Daikyu\]](/items/arsenal/1072/daikyu/) Amalgam, [\[Coda Hirudo\]](/items/arsenal/7330/coda-hirudo/), [\[Sancti Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1033/sancti-magistar/)).

3. **Shield Gating (for higher levels > 500)**
3a. **Active Gating**
You can subsume a shield regenerating ability like Pillage or Condemn, and swap [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) for [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/). Pillage gives armor strip which is very beneficial to [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s damaging abilities, while Condemn gives crowd control which is very useful in Endurance and preventing you from getting hit in the first place. You will also want to run Vazarin protective sling for additional i-frames as well as [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) or [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) for invisibility.  [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) has the added bonus of having [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) + [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/) which allows it to constantly refill your shields passively whenever you get kills on enemies affected by multiple statuses, which is Lavos's specialty. An Endurance oriented variant using Pillage: https://overframe.gg/build/459333/lavos/pillage-lavos/

3b. **Passive Gating/Recharge**
Another niche method is to use multiple sources of shield recharge delay reduction mods like [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) and [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) to reduce the recharge delay to approximately 1s (4s down 75%). [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) is currently bugged to force a 1.33s gate on any amount of shield regenerated, which means if you DON'T GET HIT during the shield gate you will regenerate shields before the iframes end. However, if you get hit during the 1.33s gate the delay timer will be reset meaning after the end of i-frames you may have anywhere between 0s to 1s of delay before you start getting shields again. If you stay mobile and continue killing things, and try not to get hit during the gate time it is possible to passively maintain your shield gate indefinitely. You can add additional sources of invulnerability such as Vazarin Protective Sling, [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) or Omamori helminth if you prefer. When you combine this setup with Arcane Aegis and [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) you become completely immortal for 15s (see near the beggining for explanation)

3c. **[\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) Immortality Bug**
Currently, there is a special bug that occurs when you run a combination of [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) + [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) + Arcane Aegis and trigger [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) from the [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/). Whenever [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) is active (for 15s each time), you will have an arcane aegis like effect which renders you effectively immortal to all NON-TOXIN damage. In order to activate [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) however, you must be HOLDING [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) as your currently equipped weapon AND kill an enemy that is currently being damaged by [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/). However the source of damage that KILLS the enemy does not need to come from [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) it self and can be an ability or even from status from another weapon so long as you swap to [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) the moment they die. Luckily [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) specialises in killing enemies with abilities and can very easily and consistent proc Fass Canticle. So all you need to do is just spam Grimoire alt-fire everywhere once every 15s which also gives your choice of bonus 60% of duration, efficiency or strength (personally would set this to duration at default OR efficiency if you don't have arcane impetus).

![](https://imgur.com/R2mzAjB.png)

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
In most cases we subsume over Vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/), unless you really enjoy the mobility of vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/) or are doing weapon platform, you could subsume over 1 or 4 instead.

**Sickening Pulse**
This sends a spreading wave that basically doubles heat DoT, doubles toxin DoT, adds 10 stacks of corrosive (to help with full strip from 2 green archon shards) but multiplies gas and electic DoT by 10x. This is the best subsume for smaller maps with tight corridors or where you can force enemies to naturally group up as they come in, or if you have an alternate form of grouping like [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/), Vazarin Snare, [\[Telos Boltace\]](/items/arsenal/1026/telos-boltace/), [\[Nautilus\]](/items/arsenal/5415/nautilus/) [\[Cordon\]](/items/arsenal/5402/cordon/), Melee Vortex etc. This also double dips [\[Valence Formation\]](/items/arsenal/6483/valence-formation/) meaning you can multiply the single Gas proc created by catalyze effectively by 90x.

**Roar**
Boosts all DoT status effects and double dips the roar bonus. Less spammy and applies passively to all damage from both your weapons and abilities.

**Ensnare/Grouping**
Grouping is great on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) as it lets Gas procs from Gas infused Catalyze overlap and create exponential damage on groups of enemies, and also allows more enemies to get hit at once for both [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) and Transmutation Probe in order to reduce cooldowns more efficiently.  

Ensnare is a bit slower than the other grouping abilities but provides longer crowd control by keeping enemies locked in place for longer durations. This is ideal on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) as you often need to perform an ability rotation before you can nuke with catalyze, so you need to keep enemies in place for at least a few seconds. Coil Horizon is a good alternative as it provides electric status procs in case you didnt cast 3.

There are however alternative methods of grouping that don't use a subsume e.g. [\[Nautilus\]](/items/arsenal/5415/nautilus/) [\[Cordon\]](/items/arsenal/5402/cordon/), [\[Scyotid\]](/items/arsenal/7419/scyotid/) alt fire, [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/)

**Expedite Suffering**
Compresses the total duration of slash and toxin procs and deals it in one instance, then applies a multiplier. This is a great tool for disruption when paired with a good natural slash weapon such as [\[Flux Rifle\]](/items/arsenal/913/flux-rifle/), [\[Convectrix\]](/items/arsenal/928/convectrix/), Spectral Vandal or any decent slash Melee weapon (e.g. nikana prime, dual ether, kronen prime etc). 

For a specific Expedite build, use this:  https://overframe.gg/build/458639/lavos/endurance-disruption-lavos-expedite-suffering/

**Pillage**
Pillage lets [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) shield gate more effectively and also strips armor which allows status effects to scale more effectively against armor.

**Omamori**
Good option of lazy survivability and pairs well with passive gate because it gives a 50% chance to basically ignore damage and restore shields but has a cooldown.

**Evade**
Another good option for survivability since it makes you invisible but requires a headshot chaining weapon to upkeep ideally (e.g. [\[Dual Toxocyst\]](/items/arsenal/1015/dual-toxocyst/), [\[Vadarya Prime\]](/items/arsenal/7468/vadarya-prime/)). [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) can reduce the innate cooldown of Evade with transmutation probe in case you come out of invisibility early and reenter evade instantly after using 3.

# ARSENAL
**MECHA SET KUBROWS**

# GAS GROUPING CATALYZE CALCULATIONS
Using a [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/) Primer giving blast, viral, rad, tox, electric, cold with heat and gas from catalyze gives about 8 unique status effects. If you apply this to a mecha marked enemy with 10 viral statuses, the highest gas proc that can be spread is 

2000 x 1.45 x 0.5 x 2^8 x 4.25 x 6.25 = 9,860,000 gas damage per second

If you then apply this to 10 enemies ensnared together within 3m, each enemy will deal this amount of damage per second to each other enemy in a 3m radius, meaning each enemy actually takes about 99 million gas damage per second.

If you apply Sickening Pulse and use another form of grouping, we can max this to 10 gas procs which deals 99 million damage/s per enemy but in a 6m radius i.e. 990 million damage/s if 10 enemies grouped or about 2 billion damage/s at 20 enemies.

Without Mecha Empowered active, we deal about 1.6 million gas dmg/s per enemy, or 32 million gas dmg/s in 6m area if 20 enemies are ensnared.


# HEAT INHERIT CATALYZE CALCULATIONS
Heat Inherit is a special characteristics of heat procs that causes heat proc damage to inherit the +heat% mods and +faction% mods from the very first heat stack applied to an enemy. This means you can give Catalyze heat procs an additional 5x damage multiplier from weapon mods even though it is not a weapon but priming enemies with a heat primer first.

Catalyze has a base heat damage of 2000 per cast and creates a guaranted heat status proc.
Self infusion with heat basically creates an additional instance of heat damage and a second guaranteed heat status proc per cast.

After casting all abilities and priming with a viral rad heat inherit nukor - you could get magnetic, radiation, viral, heat, elec, tox and possibly cold statuses for a maximum of 7 non-physical status effects to a small group of enemies, which magnifies Catalyze damage by a special multiplier of 2^7 = 128x. If you could swap primers or use secondary encumber to apply all 10 non-physical statuses, then you will get a multiplier of 2^10 = 1024x.

The viral applied by the primer gives a multiplier of 4.25x

On an enemy affected by mecha set mark, the bonus damage of [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) (2.5x) actually applies twice to status effects for a final multiplier of 2.5x2.5 = 6.25x

Using a heat inherit primer, we can give allow catalyze to inherit the +heat% mods giving 1+1.65+0.6 ([\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) + [\[Scorch\]](/items/arsenal/401/scorch/) with no riven) = 3.25x as well as one faction mod of +55% giving a total of 3.25 x 1.55 = 5.03x

Finally Grineer enemies with cloned flesh and many Infested enemies take +25% increased damage to heat giving 1.25x multiplier.

Therefore, the final possible heat proc damage per second inflicted by one cast of Catalyze on a FULLY heat primed enemy (with 10 statuses and max viral) and affected by [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) is:

2000 (base dmg) x 1.45 (strength) x 0.5 (DoT modifier) x 3 ([\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) + self infused heat) x 2^7 (status modifier) x 4.25 (10 viral stacks) x 6.25 ([\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/)) x 5.03 (heat inherit) x 1.25 (cloned flesh bonus) = approximately 92 million damage per second. With 10 statuses, this becomes 740 million damage per second.

Assuming the enemy doesn't die INSTANTLY (which would probably only be possible against levelcap armored grineer/corrupted enemies - for example a level 9999 corrupted heavy gunner has about 3.2 billion EHP), each cast of sickening pulse would double this allowing it to hit damage cap 2.14 billion dmg/s procs after 3 casts (not really practical due to cooldown).

In comparison, a single cast of cold sunder would compress the 9 seconds of heat procs into a single 8 billion damage instance of blast damage.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/) is a frame that is slightly geared toward endurance as it takes a while to accumulate sufficient decrees via Omikuji before you feel like are getting a significant benefit to gameplay. If you want to run quick missions then you may not be bothered using Omikuji at all. [\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/)'s decrees are also slightly weighted toward a melee focus due to the number of melee decrees while her Kumihimo and Bunraku abilities produce lots of status effects that work well with [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) on melees and similar mods on guns (e.g. [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/)). Just note there are number of weapons that do NOT really benefit from such effects (e.g. Melee Slam, Glaives, AOE guns, several incarnons).

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
Arcane Impetus gives up to 39% efficiency and 78% strength due to all the status effects from Bunraku and Kumihimo.
New augment [\[Omikuji's Fortune\]](/items/arsenal/7266/omikujis-fortune/) reduces cooldown of Omikuji by killing with weapons affected by her rotating passive

[[ youtube id="MtjJlZu0jmc?si=pmgcNHsWwGQ-juwc" ]]

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Keep 3 (Omamori) active at all times as this has a 50% chance to block damage. If you roll a triple 6 you will have a 100% chance to [\[Negate\]](/items/arsenal/238/negate/) all damage which is effectively immortality until all current charms are consumed.
2. Press 2 and perform a challenge to unlock a decree. You will want to keep some utility weapons to help with certain decrees e.g. ([\[Scourge\]](/items/arsenal/1095/scourge/) for headshots, [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/) for elemental kills)
3. Constantly tap 1 to shield gate and apply status effects. This is the only ability that can consistently be spammed for shield gating.
4. Press 4 whenever on cooldown and enemies are present. This will lock down a group of enemies and apply many statuses.

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**DURATION**
Duration only affects her 1 and 4, and both have a decent base duration.

**EFFICIENCY**
Some efficiency lets you cast 1 and 4 on demand for shield gating and priming without needing significant energy investment, but energy economy only gets better once you get energy economy decrees e.g. Bounce Back, Morale Boost, Envious Economy. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is therefore optional but helps sustain economy before you roll the decrees.

**RANGE**
Range is needed for 1 and 4, both have extremely high base range but 200 range is required to cap the number of threads from 1.

**STRENGTH**
Boosts the passive status damage of 1 and 4, but is completely optional to invest in considering they don't deal that much damage and you can get strength back via arcane impetus as well as fortifier's will (up to 500%) and armor decrees.

**AURA**
Completely flexible
- Aerodynamic gives bonus wall latch and aim glide for decrees
- Mecha empowered if running Kubrow with mecha mods, allows status effects to spread and deal DPS
- Swift momentum gives extra wind up and combo duration
- Growing power fits the default polarity and gives strength
- Brief respite for shield gating
- Steel Charge for more capacity and minor melee damage

**ARCANES**
Completely flexible 
- Arcane Impetus gives up to 78% strength and 39% efficiency
- Arcane aegis is optional and gives additional passive survivability but based on RNG (which almost fits her theme). **NOTE** ANY Rank arcane aegis is fine e.g. Rank 0.
- Molt Augmented for strength
- Arcane strike/fury to boost melee
- Arcane Precision to boost pistols
- Arcane battery gives huge energy pool with armor decrees although this is largely unnecessary

**ARCHON SHARDS**
At least ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed shards would be recommended to make casting Bunraku feel nicer.
Rest are flex and can go into Azure Energy Max, Parkour Velocity or Violet Melee Crit Damage shards (will require [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/))

# SURVIVABILITY
**Shield Gating for Endurance (up to level 9999)**
Since many of [\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/)'s abilities do not really require stats we can invest many mod slots into "lazy" shield gate survivability which allows you to scale in endurance. One issue with standard active shield gating on [\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/) is the possibility of rolling the Envious Economy decree which causes certain ability casts to cost 0 energy, which means [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) and Augur Mod shield generation will not work consistent. As an alternative, [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) with [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) reduces the shield gate recharge delay to 1s. [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) currently gives max 1.33s shield gate after losing ANY amount of shield, despite not generating max shield capacity (likely unitended bug). For example regaining 3 shield via casting her 1 with Augur Reach or 1 shield via Fast Deflection/Vigilante Vigor (which occurs 1s after not taking damage) gives a full 1.33s i-frame upon breaking. Getting hit during the 1.33s i-frame resets the shield recharge delay so depending on when you take damage, you could have a 0 to 1s vulnerability window until you shield gate is fully reset. Omamori basically has a 50% chance to [\[Negate\]](/items/arsenal/238/negate/) damage which makes it harder for you to take damage during the vulnerability period. If you also stay mobile and utilise crowd control you should have no problems surviving up to levelcap without actively pressing buttons to shield gate.

Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL but clears harmful statuses and gives additional i-frames on demand, which can be life saving in the right circumstances.

As a final layer of gambling, Arcane Aegis is RNG but when it triggers it effectively gives you 12s of immortality to non-toxin damage. 

**Health Tanking (also endurance viable)**
[\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/) has about 4 decrees that can boost armor to ridiculous levels, a damage reduction decree and a decree that boost strength to further boost elemental ward subsume for even more armor/health. The amount of ehp gained is actually sufficient to tank up to levelcap provided you have a consistent form of healing e.g. from decree, from arcane reaper, [\[Healing Return\]](/items/arsenal/372/healing-return/), [\[Sancti Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1033/sancti-magistar/) e.t.c.

Since you have so many free slots you can also run multiple mods to health tank i.e. swap [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/), [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/), [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) and [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) (if running Kubrwo), [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), Archon Vitality and Primed Flow. You can swap arcanes for Arcane Reaper, Guardian or Blessing.

HEALTH TANK KOUMEI (COLD WARD): https://overframe.gg/build/891348/

# HELMINTH
Most subsumes will require a bit more strength investment so you may want to give up some survivability mods for more strength (i.e. swap Fast Deflection/Vigilante Vigor/Strike) for Umbral Intensify, Transient Fortitude, Augur Secrets, Molt Augmented.
1. Pillage - subsume over 1. Pillage gives armor strip which boosts damage against both shielded and armored enemies, cleanses statuses and allows you to consistently shield gate even if you roll Envious Economy.
2. Wrathful Advance - Gives flat melee crit chance boost giving your melee easy red crits
3. Eclipse - double dips specific melees like contagion and glaives if you want to use those specifically
4. Nourish - gives free viral and boosts energy multiplier
5. Grouping - airburst, pull, coil horizon can drag enemies through your Kumihimo wires and create multiple procs. You would need to subsume this over 4.
6. Sickening Pulse - multiplies all status effects, can be used to make 4 deal more DPS, subsume over 1
7. Breach Surge - benefits from certain decrees

# MELEE PLATFORM
[\[Koumei\]](/items/arsenal/7091/koumei/) can utilize any weapon but there is a larger proportion of decrees that can benefit melee overall. For example there are NINE melee-specific decrees and SEVEN general damage buffing decrees out of a total of 42 decrees, meaning you have a roughly 36% chance of rolling any single decree that will benefit melee, versus a 17% chance of rolling a decree that will buff guns.

Melee decrees (9)
	- Majestic Strike - duplicates melee hits but is affected by follow through
	- Sweeping Blow - heavy attacks create shockwaves similar to Exalted Blade that travel 35m
	- Venomous Touch - every third melee attack deals Toxin damage and status (makes separate status to modded elements)
	- Royal Wrath - each hit increases crit chance by up to 30% for 3s
	- Smoldering Strike - add heat damage and status chance (does not combine with modded elements)
	- Rising Agony - melee crits give critical damage for 7s (up to 150%)
	- Dueler's Outburst - on crit gain melee attack speed for 3s (up to 90%)
	- Killer's Confidence - on  melee kill gain overguard
	- Salted Wound - heavy attacks deal extra corrosive hit with status
	
General damage decrees that affect melee (7)
	- Shattering Frost - deal extra damage to enemies affected by cold status (similar to secondary shiver, additive to base dmg mods)
	- Deadly momentum - moving gives increased damage (additive to base dmg mods)
	- Twofold Torment - double status damage (is actually +100% status damage additve to melee elementalist so not as good as it really is)
	- Fearsome Bonanza - gain damage for every enemy affected by status in 20m (addtive to base dmg mods)
	- Critical Roll - after roll get critical damage for 4s (up to 120%)
	- Vicious Barb - double crit damage (actually +100% CD additive to mods and shards i.e. much worse than it should be)
	- Critical Frost - crits deal extra cold damage and status

# ARSENAL
Choose weapons that help you do decree challenges quickly. 
The challenges include:
- Headshot - hitscan guns (e.g. cedo prime, dual toxocyst), innodem
- While sliding - light attack melees  
- While wall latching - cedo prime, dual toxocyst
- Within 10 meters - light attack melees
- From 20 meters away - hitscan guns (e.g. cedo prime, dual toxocyst)
- While you are airborne - light attack melees (particularly innodem), contagion
- While they are affected by a status effect - cedo alt-fire + light attack melees

## INTRODUCTION

[[ youtube id="d7Nna7pAP8c?si=rm4cY_2xCz3kcl6u" ]]

General Use non-helminth [\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/) build which is steel path endurance viable and great to use in the open world. Use [\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/)'s airborne acrobatic abilities to leap across the map with [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror and Blood altar, nuke from the skies with [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Heart, heal with Blood Altar, regenerate energy on demand with Bloodletting and get shield gating, brief stun and insane scaling slash procs from Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/). 

Up to date with changes to [\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/)'s abilities (March 2022). Now that [\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/)'s passive has changed from being based on missing health to the number of kills, there is now no reason to run a traditional 2hp/quick thinking/tank build. The addition of invulnerability frames to both [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror and Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) makes shield gating much easier and in combination with status cleanse from Bloodletting means you can even drop rolling guard. 

Update June 2022 : Dread Mirror now gives full knockdown/stagger immunity! This means you can drop [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) and run an alternative like Kavat's Grace to prevent hard landings.

## PLAYSTYLE
**General Ability Rotation**
1. Cast Bloodletting (tap 3) twice at beginning of a mission to hit near max energy (240 energy per 50% health consumed), and recast whenever needed e.g. energy drops below 300
2. Cast up to three Blood Altars (aim at enemy and tap 2) and either spread out circles evenly throughout an area for maximum coverage or concentrate in one location for maximum heal rate.
3. Keep [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror (aim at enemy and tap 1) active at all times and face direction of enemies to block frontal damage, while absorbing damage into dread heart. Dread Mirror also prevents knockdown/stagger. Leap onto additional enemies (trying to target heaviest units) to build up more [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) heart damage.
4. Charge [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Heart (hold 1) and release to nuke, ideally keep at least 100 energy so you can still cast 4 on demand. If you built up sufficient damage via leaping and absorbing prior to charging, you can just charge for a very short time and release it immediately so you don't stay in a vulnerable charging state for too long.
5. Cast Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) ([\[Double Tap\]](/items/arsenal/507/double-tap/) 4 for narrow cone, tap 4 and allow it to expand for maximum cone) to cause slash procs and mark enemies to take slash procs from damage from any source, including [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Heart. If you're running [\[Blending Talons\]](/items/arsenal/5256/blending-talons/) augment, you can just simply tap 4 once for full shield gate.


**Survivability**
We rely on a combination of shield gating, crowd control and invulnerability frames (i-frames) to survive.
- Shield gating: Whenever you deplete shields you gain a certain number of i-frames based on how much shield you had. Brief Respite and two augur mods allows a single cast of seeking talons generate 230 shield, which is approximately 1s of i-frames (can equip more augur mods on pistol).
- Crowd control: Both [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror and Blood Altar create an 8m radial stagger on landing and Seeking Talons both knocks nearby melee enemies back and the slash procs create a brief stagger animation. 
- I-frames: Both dread mirror and seeking talons now have inbuilt i-frames, meaning Rolling Guard's i-frames are no longer necessary when you can simply cast seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) once to get full shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/), rather than rolling followed by either [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror or seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/). Status cleanse from bloodletting also lets you quickly get rid of damaging status procs or annoying cold procs.

**Combos and Aerial Combat**
[\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/)'s abilities can be linked together in certain 'combos'. [\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/)'s 3 and 4 abilities also launch her into the air particularly when cast while already airborne. The combination of the two can cause you to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) very high altitude without even bullet jumping. There are many benefits for aerial combat. You become a harder target to hit while airborne and moving, melee units cannot hit you, ground based damage sources cannot hit you e.g. mines, toxic sludge, grenades, you have a better overview of enemies allowing for easier targeting of dread mirror, dread heart and seeking talons. 

-  **Heart to Heart (Aerial Chain Nuke Combo)**: With [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror active, while in air, tap 4, aim glide, hold 1 to hover and release dread heart to nuke, aim glide, tap 1 on enemy before they die to refresh dread mirror for new dread heart.
- **Clean Energy (Status Cleanse)**: When you are afflicted with a damaging status, cast 4 and immediately start tapping 3 to fit a cast of Bloodletting within the last few i-frames of 4 to get a safe status cleanse as well as regenerate energy safely. You get 1.75s of i-frames from the beginning of casting 4 and become free to move/cast new abilities for the last 0.5s. Bloodletting takes 0.8s to finish casting.
- **The Ascension**: With [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror active, while aiming down sights, tap 3 to ascend into sky. This means you don't need to bullet jump to achieve air time and can keep dread mirror facing enemies the whole time
- **Honing Altar**: Attack a blood altar enemy with melee to build up melee combo to x12 without killing the enemy, great for x12 heavy attacks.

## HELMINTH
[\[Garuda\]](/items/arsenal/1377/garuda/) does still lack a good crowd control option which is where helminth can come into play. We always replace Blood Altar as it is the weakest component of her kit:

**Breach Surge**
Gives a wide range blind for crowd control and surge sparks have a positive feedback loop with Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/), creating self propagating sparks that deal infinitely increasing slash procs over time. Garuda's passive also double dips on Breach Surge sparks (i.e. 4x damage to spark). Max range variant for breach surge: https://overframe.gg/build/489274/

**Expedite Suffering**
Expedite suffering compresses all existing slash procs and their remaining duration and deal them in one instance of true damage. This new damage instance can also create a new big bleed proc on enemies afflicted by seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/). Casting expedite suffering again compresses the 6s of the new bleed proc into an even bigger instance of damage, which again can feedback into seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) creating an infinitelyscaling feedback loop. No change to build except maybe [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) in aura.

**Gloom**
Provides both passive healing (with infinite range) and insane crowd control with a radial slow field (up to 95%). Slightly different build with overextended swapped for stretch and augur message swapped for augur secrets or blending talons: https://overframe.gg/build/303690/

**Molt with [\[Regenerative Molt\]](/items/arsenal/181/regenerative-molt/) augment**
Gives speed boost, quick cast for shield gating, draws aggro, explodes with damage in wide radius (which can become slash with seeking talons) and the augment gives 50hp/s at base to 500hp total over 10s which is not dependant on the presence of enemies. Great choice for speedrunning, particularly when used in combination with Blood Forge. A dedicated molt build uses mostly duration and strength: https://overframe.gg/build/304728/

**Nourish (UPDATED Dec 2022)**
Nourish now gives double energy from all sources including Bloodletting, meaning you always gain full energy in a single cast AND infused viral damage/procs into both [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror explosion AND Seeking Talons. If you run Combat Discipline, you can also proc forced viral in an AOE every kill. See this build: https://overframe.gg/build/443145/garuda-prime/nourish-discpline-garuda/

**Reave**
Reave heals health to power bloodletting AND the true damage triggers bleed procs on enemies afflicted by seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/). You can also reduce enemy health by an exact %, which works well with [\[Dread Ward\]](/items/arsenal/2467/dread-ward/) augment.

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration helps maintain uptime of [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror, blood altar and seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) mark. Use a combination of [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/) and [\[Constitution\]](/items/arsenal/789/constitution/) or [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) to offset [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/).

**Efficiency**
Neutral efficiency is suggested because the amount of energy returned from bloodletting scales positively with efficiency, meaning you get 364 energy per 50% health at 100% efficiency (2.5 casts to refill whole energy bar from 0), compared to only 228 energy per cast at 45% efficiency (4 casts required to refill whole energy bar from 0). This means you need to spam bloodletting much less often (less vulnerable periods) and one cast provides enough energy to perform multiple combos of Seeking Talons and Dread Mirror/Blood Altar. Neutral efficiency also means you can channel [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Heart more efficiently and get more damage for less drain. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is essential to hold more energy for chaining combos. If you run Nourish then you could drop efficiency to 45%.

**Range**
High range is used to increase the pounce range of dread mirror/blood altar, the size of the [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Heart explosion, Blood Altar heal radius. Use [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) with either [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) or [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) to hit above 200% range. 

**Strength**
We only need to hit the 134% strength breakpoint to give Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) a 100% chance to cause slash procs. This can be achieved with Transient fortitude and Umbral intensify to offset overextended.

**Aura**
Brief Respite - Essential for good shield gating.
Swift Momentum - Good for melee/talons focused build for maintaining combo and heavy attacks
Combat Discipline - Only for activating arcane avenger

**Exilus**
Primed Sure Footed/Handspring - not needed for most weapons as Dread Mirror blocks knockdown, but still has inconsistent stagger resist for certain AOE weapons
Kavat's Grace - prevents hard landings which is very common when using Garuda, as all her abilities cause you to launch into the air
Vigilante Pursuit - if no enemy radar
Cunning Drift - maximum range

**Augments**
All augments are optional and can be placed over [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/) depending on preference (means you need to use [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) in aura or add one augur mod on pistol for shield gating) and there is really only room for one augment at a time:

Blending Talons - Tapping 4 gives a radial area of seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) and also helps build combo quicker. This is more a quality of life change and up to personal preference, as you can get a quick shield gate in one tap rather than [\[Double Tap\]](/items/arsenal/507/double-tap/) of 4, as well as being able to target enemies behind you with no animation lock. You can still hold to charge 4 to cover the original 60m range. 

Blood Forge - Allows you to reload your weapon by casting bloodletting. Great with certain weapons hampered by insanely long reloads e.g. [\[Strun\]](/items/arsenal/1241/strun/), [\[Kuva Zarr\]](/items/arsenal/5576/kuva-zarr/),  [\[Trumna\]](/items/arsenal/5125/trumna/), Sepulcrum, Tenet Envoy, Quellor, Gorgon, Komorex, Kuva Chakkhurr, Tenet Arca Plasmor, Akarius. Note: this does NOT work with Hata-Satya on Soma Prime as it counts as a proper reload.

Dread Ward - gives a long duration of invulnerability if you either kill directly with [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror (requires health < 40% threshold) or kill with a slash proc just as the [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror leap animation occurs even if they die before you land. Pairs well with Reave which harvests a set % of health per cast, but the micromanaging of the invulnerability period and enemy health values can become tiresome and is overall inconsistent compared to just shield gating. The other issue is if you run [\[Panzer Vulpaphyla\]](/items/arsenal/5018/panzer-vulpaphyla/), matryr symbiosis will trigger BEFORE [\[Dread Ward\]](/items/arsenal/2467/dread-ward/) prevents your death and your Panzer will [\[Sacrifice\]](/items/arsenal/242/sacrifice/) itself for no reason. In my opinion, it is safer and more fluid gameplay wise to rely purely on shield gating and crowd control.

**Other**
- Natural talent is MANDATORY on Garuda if you don't have any archon shards for cast speed
- Vigorous Swap - optional for a more controllable 2.65x multiplier to [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror damage, but requires you do swap weapons while charging her 1 and just before releasing at it only has a 3s duration on swap

**Arcanes**
- Molt Reconstruct - gives you healing on spending energy, particularly useful if you subsume something over blood altar that doesn't heal you e.g. breach surge and expedite suffering
- Arcane Arachne - gives 2.5x damage to Dread Mirror explosion, can be dropped if you run Vigorous Swap
- Arcane Eruption - good passive crowd control choice to help since Garuda doesn't have very good in built passive crowd control
- Molt Augmented - more strength
- Molt Efficiency - more duration

**Archon Shards**
Two or more amber cast speed shards allows you to drop [\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/) for a flexible option like an augment or [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/)
Can use Azure shardswith HP [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) as an alternative to running molt reconstruct.
Fill remaining slots with duration, strength or energy max based on preferece.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
Subsume Gloom over 4

This is a gloom [\[Banshee\]](/items/arsenal/8/banshee/) (or gloomshee) build that combines the extreme slow offered by gloom to lengthen the stun of silence while allowing you to carefully target sonar spots for extreme damage. Silence has an innate stun duration of 2s, which can be extended up to a maximum of 40 seconds at 95% slow. Sonar is a huge multiplier to damage as long as you can hit the spots, and up to two sonar spots can overlap to multiply together (e.g. at 200 strength, two sonar overlapping gives 100x damage multiplier). [\[Resonance\]](/items/arsenal/80/resonance/) augment is optional but nice quality of life allowing Sonar to self propagate as you get kills via sonar spots, meaning you don't need to recast Sonar very often. Sonic Boom is also optional but helps armor strip priority targets eg (acolytes, demolysts, thrax) for even faster kills.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate both gloom and silence (optional - get headshot to activate pax bolt for +30% str +/- [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) for +25% then activate gloom for higher slow values)
2. Keep silence active at all times for stun and preventing special enemy abilities
3. Whenever shields break, roll and cast sonar to regenerate shields completely to reset shield gate
4. Stack multiple casts of sonar when fighting an enemy with damage resistance e.g. lich/sister/acolyte

Here is a video demonstration of the playstyle:

[[ streamable id="43m29y" ]]

.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Positive duration gives decent sonar and silence durations and helps reduce gloom drain costs.

**Efficiency**
Maintain neutral efficiency for shield gating, so a single cast of Sonic Boom can restore 37.5 shield giving 0.7s i-frames while a single cast of Sonar can restore 75 shield giving 1.33s iframes (without augur mods)

**Range**
Positive range is nice to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the range of gloom, but too much range is actually detrimental for silence since the stun only lasts 2s outside of gloom and about 8s in gloom, and you need enemies to exit then re-enter silence range so they can be restunned. This is made easier by having a lower range. Since silence has a longer range than gloom, enemies will always be subjected to silence first before gloom meaning gloom has a slightly reduced effect on the stun, particularly if you travel slowly.

**Strength**
Strength affects both the sonar multiplier and gloom slow so we do want this as high as possible without losing too much functionality. Gloom 95% slow cap is achieved at 272% str and Full Strip from [\[Sonic Fracture\]](/items/arsenal/78/sonic-fracture/) is achieved at only 143% str. [\[Resonance\]](/items/arsenal/80/resonance/) augment allows self propagating Sonar to benefit from the strength of the inintial cast, meaning you can use Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) and conditional strength boosts to lock in strength values. 

**Flexible slots**
[\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) and Rolling Guard are flexible for each other. Catalyzing shields allows casts of Sonic Boom and Sonar to give more effective i-frames per cast, while [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) gives iframes and status cleanse with an 8s cooldown. Both are up to personal preference.

The augments [\[Resonance\]](/items/arsenal/80/resonance/) and Sonic Fracture are both flexible options that are interchangeable for Streamline or more strength eg Transient Fortitude/Augur Secrets.

**Exilus**
Preparation - best option for speedrunning exterminates/lich missions, can keep mod at rank 8 since your energy will start at max
Power drift - to get higher slow
Primed sure footed - best option for everything else, particularly if you plan on using explosives

**Aura**
Brief respite - to allow sonar to reset shield gate along with augur mods

**Arcanes**
Either Molt Vigor and/or Molt Augmented to provide strength to hit max gloom slow (need 272% str), and boost sonar

Since headshots become much easier with gloom, arcanes that trigger on headshot are good:
Consequence - faster parkour
Pistoleer - ammo efficiency
Precision - pistol damage
Rage - primary damage

**Archon Shards**
2 Amber Cast speed shards makes spamming of Sonar and recasting of Silence extremely quick.
3 Crimson Strength shards gives up to 45% strength with Tauforged, meaning you can drop Molt Vigor or Molt Augmented for something like Arcane Aegis/Energize

## ARSENAL
**Companion**
[\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with Energy Generator is the recommended companion so you are able to generate an energy orb roughly every 10 kills. Build: https://overframe.gg/build/224301/dethcube-prime/cube-of-deth-health-energy-orb-generation/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) build designed for general Steel Path endurance and even endurance with a focus on scaling ability DPS via Regurgitate. Feast is required to power his abilities. Nourish provides AOE viral procs and stun, applies free viral damage to both your guns and also provides energy multiplier to all energy sources so you should never have energy issues even at 45% efficiency and with no Arcane Energize. Pulverize strips armor and heals you passively. Regurgitate slows enemies by 80%, full strips armor and deals scaling damage.

[[ youtube id="CU3ENTXQp-U?si=mQF-HFOyB_Np8GdB" ]]

**UPDATE DEC 2025**
Arcane slot for arcane persistence which prevents you taking more than 500 damage per second while armor is higher than 700. [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) has high base health and armor as well as a passive that gives armor with each enemy swallowed. With the passive and umbral set you can pretty consistently exceed 1400 armor meaning even heat statuses wont make you lose arcane persistence.

With over 3500 health on you have about 7s of leeway time to heal back damage before you hit 0 health. Both Nourish and Pulverize can heal you to max. Nourish heals about 2000 health at 200 str on cast while Pulverize heals 500hp/s at 250% strength for only the first 5s. If you can somehow reach 500% strength Pulverize will hit 500 health/s permanently which exactly matches the rate of health loss from persistence. The only things that can stop Persistence are violence, nullifiers, magnetic status, corrosive/heat status (which reduce armor below 700). [\[Hearty Nourishment\]](/items/arsenal/5459/hearty-nourishment/) augment is optional and makes you status immune which removes the vulnerability from statuses at least.

**UPDATE OCT 2024**
Empty slot is for new Augment [\[Gastro\]](/items/arsenal/6669/gastro/) which lets Regurgitate bounce up to 4 times, effectively increasing ability DPS 4 times. I removed Breach Surge as the subsume and kept Pulverize since you can cast feast more seamlessly while in Pulverize.

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 1 to feast on enemies until you have 5 enemies ingested, always try to top this up whenever empty or low.
2. Tap 2 to activate Nourish, which will give you energy, viral damage and 10 viral status in an AOE with brief stun every 2s whenever you take damage. Keep this activated at all times. Can also use for emergency heal button.
3. Tap 4 to Regurgitate enemies to slow enemies, strip armor, deal scaling damage and produce breach surge sparks.
4. Optional: Hold 1 to expel all current feasted enemies to deal even more scaling damage and produce breach surge sparks.

[[ youtube id="N7Aq_vbGwf0?si=v5zYZGAzoH3Z4lys" ]]

# SCALING DAMAGE CALCULATIONS
**REGURGITATE/[\[Gastro\]](/items/arsenal/6669/gastro/)**
Regurgitate deals 2000 damage x strength + 10% of the launched enemies current health. For example, if you were to swallow a level 9999 SP Corrupted Heavy Gunner a with 10 million health and immediately regurgitate it, you would deal approximately 1 million raw gas damage in 6m base AOE (with [\[Gastro\]](/items/arsenal/6669/gastro/)), with two subsequent forced Gas procs dealing a total of 1 million gas damage per second in a small radius (starting at 3m and adding 0.3m for every additional proc), which deal their full damage amount since you full strip armor. With 10 viral (due to Nourish viral retaliation), this is multiplied by 4.25x so 4.25 million damage on raw hit which may kill enemies directly in one hit while also boosting gas clouds to deal  4.25 million damage per second for 6s. [\[Gastro\]](/items/arsenal/6669/gastro/) causes a second bounce dealing 25% of the initial hit, so another 250k raw gas damage and 250k gas proc damage in 3m range, and finally a third bounce dealing 6.25% so 62.5k damage, 62.5k gas status damage/s and finally one more 31k toxin proc. The grand total damage over a 7s period from a single enemy launched is therefore about 1,312,500 million initial raw damage then 7,875,000 dealt over 7s. Adding maximum viral this gives 5,578,125 raw dmg and 33,468,750 over a whole 7s. This is effectively enough to kill enemies at any level as long as you are spitting enemies of a similar HP, even without damage buffs. You can maximise this by swallowing 5 enemies and immediately regurgitating all five at once dealing a huge amount of overall damage and many times over the hp of enemies. The only issue is that this does not handle overguard well as overguard is often bigger in value than health.

**ROAR**
Roar multiplies the initial raw hit, then multiplies the subsequent Gas proc a second time so from the above example at say 100% roar, the initial hit deals 2 million while the two gas procs deal a total of 4 million/s (and therefore 17 million/s with 10 viral).

**BREACH SURGE**
An enemy affected by Breach Surge has a 10% chance per damage instance (and 100% chance on kill) to spawn a spark that deals the damage that caused it but multiplied by a multiplier and crit multiplier. If we assume the multiplier to be about 5x, a spark created by the initial 1 million damage becomes 5 million damage which is the cap. Breach Surge has special quirk in that it is coded as a 'weapon' and universal weapon boosting effects like Nourish and Arcane Arachne/Naramon Lethal Levitation/[\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/) actually applies their respective damage bonus to it and allows it to exceed the 5 million cap. For example a 200% nourish means a 5 million damage spark becomes 15 million damage, and adding arcane arachne multiplies this again by 150% (2.5x) to 37.5 million. Crit multipliers boost the further if the spark headshots which occurs randomly, meaning they get a headcrit bonus (2x CD), headshot bonus (3x total) and worth comradery (100% cc to 175% cc). A tier 2 headcrit is a further multiplier of 3 x (1+2 x (2 x 1.5 -1)) = 15x, so 37.5 million now becomes 562 million. Adding 10 viral to that we could potentially get theoretical 2.38 billion damage (limited by damage cap of 2.14 billion)

**Mecha Set Option**
Mecha Set with Huras or [\[Raksa Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2231/raksa-kubrow/) (wearing the cool Lunar new year skin) is a further option to massively increase the damage and AOE potential of Regurgitate. Mecha Empowered double dips status procs and multiply damage on marked enemies by 6.25x, so 95,000 toxin proc becomes 590,000/s. This can be spread to all enemies in 30m if they die. 

Huras as the additional bonus of making you invisible so you barely get hit, while Raksa passively provides shield gate for you as you take damage. If you want to use the Mecha Set, swap aura for [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) and [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/)

# SURVIVABILITY
**Option 1: Arcane Persistence**
Arcane persistence prevents you taking more than 500 damage per second while armor is higher than 700. [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) has high base health and armor as well as a passive that gives armor with each enemy swallowed. With [\[Stand United\]](/items/arsenal/302/stand-united/) in aura you hit 500 armor which means all you need is 200 more armor to activate arcane persistence. This can be achieved by either swallowing a single enemy (each enemy gives 250 armor), by slotting a tauforged Archon Shard (gives 225 armor) or running Unairu (gives 200 armor passively). Using the armor shard is maximum safety/consistency since you will still be safe even if you expel all enemies from the stomach and aren't running Unairu.

With [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) on you have about 5s of time to heal back damage before you hit 0 health. Both Nourish and Pulverize heal you. Nourish heals about 2000 health at 200 str on cast while Pulverize heals above 400 health per second over 5s at 200 str. If you can somehow reach 250 strength Pulverize will hit 500 health/s which exactly matches the rate of health loss from persistence. The only things that can stop Persistence are violence, nullifiers, magnetic status, corrosive/heat status (which reduce armor below 700). [\[Hearty Nourishment\]](/items/arsenal/5459/hearty-nourishment/) augment makes you status immune which removes the vulnerability from statuses at least.

**Option 2 : Shield Gating + Crowd Control**
For an active playstyle, utilize shield gating and crowd control to allow [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) to survive any level up to level 9999. Use [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) to drop max shields to 19, meaning a single cast of Nourish or  Regurgitate will reset shield gates with a single Brief Respite or Augur mod active, giving 1.33s iframes. This will allow you to survive any instance of non-toxin damage. Combine this with the stun from Nourish and slow from Regurgitate. Adding a form of invisibility from Huras Kubrow or Shade would also make surviving much simpler.

**Option 3: Casual ehp Tanking**
Casual Tank Grendel Build: https://overframe.gg/build/547930/grendel-prime/the-glutton-beginners-casual-tank-grendel-300k-ehp-0-forma/

For a more laid back playstyle, [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) can absolute passively tank base SP and about up to level 500ish easily. Swap [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), [\[Hearty Nourishment\]](/items/arsenal/5459/hearty-nourishment/) for [\[Gourmand\]](/items/arsenal/5749/gourmand/) and [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) over [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/). Arcane Avenger can swapped for Arcane Blessing and Molt Augmented can be swapped for [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) (both optional)

[\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) has a passive that provides 1250 flat armor after swallowing 5 enemies, or 2000 armor with [\[Gourmand\]](/items/arsenal/5749/gourmand/). Combine this with his high base health pool and [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) to get a decent eHP of approximately 300,000. For reference, a solo full tank [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) has a max of approximately 1 million ehp while [\[Trinity\]](/items/arsenal/58/trinity/) has approx 1.5 mil ehp, and the maximum possible ehp by [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/) is about 9 million.

# BUILDS SPECIFICS
**Duration**
You need positive duration for the uptime of Nourish so you don't have to recast as often. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is OPTIONAL but allows both Regurgitate and Feast to apply Corrosive procs which can be an extra status for Condition Overload and Galvanized Aptitude/Savvy/Shot on weapons. This is absolutely NOT necessary and you can simply use Primed Continuity if you own it.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
Negative efficiency is sustainable due to the energy multiplier from Nourish and [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) + [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) or [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). If you still feel like you have energy issues, you can add any of the following into your loadout: Arcane Energize, [\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Energy Generator\]](/items/arsenal/1388/energy-generator/), [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/), Primary Exhilarate

**Range**
Range benefits the viral retaliation from Nourish, strip range of pulverize and range of regurgitates aoe. 

**Strength**
Higher strength benefits the energy multiplier on Nourish but a negligible component of damage of Regurgitate, because regurgitate scales off enemy health. Regurgitate only needs 134% strength to full strip. Pulverize requires 250% strength to hit 500hp heal per second in the first 5s, and 500% strength if you stay in Pulverize after 5s. In order to hit 500% strength for permanent lazy immortality you will need lots of modded strength and conditional bonuses i.e. Triumbral + [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) + Arcane Bellicose + [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) + 5 tauforged strength shards gives 77% + 99% + 72% + 25% + 75% = 448% strength. If you [\[Snap Shot\]](/items/arsenal/520/snap-shot/) one more conditional like [\[Velox Conclusion\]](/items/arsenal/7663/velox-conclusion/) or [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) Invocation (60%) you can cast Pulverize and now be completely immortal. Combining multiple conditionals e.g. [\[Velox\]](/items/arsenal/4656/velox/) + Madurai (40%) would let you reduce the other strength requirements.

**Aura**
[\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) helps nuking when used alongside a Kubrow.
If not using Kubrow, just slot [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/)

**Flexible Options**
[\[Hearty Nourishment\]](/items/arsenal/5459/hearty-nourishment/) : optional but important augment that gives status immunity from each cast of Nourish with duration scaling with duration% and enemies in gut. This is excellent quality of life meaning you dont need [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) to prevent knockdown and dont get affected by heat procs from Arson eximus, magnetic procs or toxin procs. Can swap this for more range if you prefer.

[\[Catapult\]](/items/arsenal/4325/catapult/): allows you to speed around in Pulverize, lots of fun

**Arcanes**
Bellicose is ideal to give bonus strength of 72%
Arcane Persistence lets you have easy survivability
Molt Efficiency is an alternative to give bonus duration.
Arcane Avenger is option to boost your weapons crit chance if you like. This does not affect breach surge or regurgitate.
Arcane Arachne gives a 2.5x multiplier boost to Breach Surge sparks if you want to focus purely on ability damage, but requires you to occasionally perform a wall latch.
Arcane Energize for even more energy if you have energy issues.

# ARCHON SHARDS

1 Amber Cast Speed Shard optional
1 Tau armor shard optional helps you hit 1400 armor with [\[Stand United\]](/items/arsenal/302/stand-united/) and umbral mods so heat procs don't break arcane persistence
4 strength shards to help hit 500% strength
Note that Emerald +Toxin status damage doesnt affect [\[Gastro\]](/items/arsenal/6669/gastro/) DPS much since it produces gas procs with only one toxin proc at the end.

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Pulverize will be your helminth slot and you will need to heal with Nourish instead or external weapons.
1. Breach Surge - needs line of sight but blinds enemies, creates sparks that scale with damage that created it e.g. regurgitate
2. Roar - double dips forced tox DoT from regurgitate
3. Resonator - shuts off enemy AI in huge radius, doesnt affect acolytes/eximus
4. Grouping eg Pull, Airburst, Ensnare, Larva. - brings enemies into group to be hit by regurgitate

# ARSENAL
Since Nourish provides viral damage to you weapons, it is best to DROP viral mods on any weapons you equip and add more damage, crit, fire rate mods to increase total DPS.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION
[\[Chroma\]](/items/arsenal/15/chroma/) can now health tank to levelcap with Arcane persistence as long as you have a source of healing e.g. Gloom, Remedium or lifesteal from a weapon.
Keeping Vex Armor active gives enough armor to surpass the 700 needed for Arcane Persistence, but if you prefer an absolute safety net even if vex armor is not active you could put [\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/) or two archon armor shards. [\[Guardian Armor\]](/items/arsenal/6484/guardian-armor/) can provide innate healing as kills by your or your teammate heal 5% of your health over 3s scaling with strength. At around 300% strength and about 2500 hp you will be able to heal 375 hp over 3s per kill (non-stackable) which is equivalent to 125hp/s. 

# HELMINTH
Subsume over 1, make sure to set EMISSIVE COLOUR to red so elemental ward is HEAT.

1. GLOOM: Gloom allows you to run basically any weapon and setup and still heal consistently and easily even without meetign the kill criteria for Guardian Armor. If you have a specific setup that can heal you faster than 500hp/s e.g. high KPM AOE weapons, [\[Life Strike\]](/items/arsenal/330/life-strike/) heavy spam ([\[Falcor\]](/items/arsenal/1434/falcor/), [\[Xoris\]](/items/arsenal/4660/xoris/), [\[Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1138/magistar/)), [\[Sancti Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1033/sancti-magistar/), [\[Daikyu\]](/items/arsenal/1072/daikyu/) with [\[Syam\]](/items/arsenal/6176/syam/) (and amalgam [\[Daikyu\]](/items/arsenal/1072/daikyu/) mod), [\[Coda Hirudo\]](/items/arsenal/7330/coda-hirudo/), [\[Coda Hema\]](/items/arsenal/7324/coda-hema/) then you won't need gloom.

2. SPELLBIND: Gives you status immunity for a fixed duration, meaning you cannot be susceptible to the things that can normally break persistence e.g. magnetic, bleed (bypasses persistence), heat, corrosive. This also makes you immune to self knockdown from [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) and contagion explosions which is very good if you don't own [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/).

3. WRATHFUL ADVANCE: Even more damage to boost melee weapons.

4. NOURISH: Viral damage and energy multiplier

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate HEAT Elemental Ward (2) and recast whenever it ends
2. Activate VEX ARMOR (3) and get kills with melee and ranged weapons to build the armor and damage bonuses respectively.
3. Activate GLOOM (optional if subsumed) so every damage you deal with weapons heals you
4. Optional, Activate EFFIGY (4) for movement speed boost and credit bonuses if you get kills within range

# ELEMENT CHOICE
**Heat Ward**
- Gives extra health based on 370 x 55% x strength. In order to be useful for arcane persistence you really want to hit approximately 500 health bonus (about 221% strength needed)
- Heat ward deals damage only to enemies in a 5m radius, meaning for Gloom to heal passively you need enemies in close proximity, which makes this ideal for a melee oriented playstyle.
- Make sure to use a red coloured emissive before starting mission.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Needed for elemental ward uptime and initial vex armor uptime, but guardian armor prolongs vex armor indefinitely.

**Efficiency/Energy**
Don't really need energy as [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) keeps you completely topped up constantly, and you never need to recast Vex Armor due to [\[Guardian Armor\]](/items/arsenal/6484/guardian-armor/). You only need to recast Elemental Ward. Effigy does drain alot of energy. Gloom at minimum range barely has any drain. We do need to run [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/) to hit 500 energy for violet melee crit damage shards.

**Range**
No real effect on anything. Gloom heal range does not require range. Effigy credit drop range is fixed at 10m.  

**Strength**
Most important stat as it boosts vex armor and elemental ward health boost. You want approximately at least 221% strength for heat ward. This is because [\[Umbral Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/693/umbral-vitality/) + Arcane Blessing gets you to 2051 health, meaning to hit 2500 you just need another 449 health which is achieved at exactly 221% strength. 

**Exilus**
Ice Spring for parkour mobility
Primed Sure Footed blocks knockdown from AOE e.g. glaives/exodia contagion without using Spellbind

**Arcanes**
Arcane Persistence: mandatory here for survivability
Arcane Blessing: optional for extra health for persistence, effectively giving an extra second of i-frames before you die


# ARCHON SHARDS
1 cast speed optional
2 Parkour Velocity
2 to 3 Melee critical damage

# ARSENAL
Vex Armor damage buff is a additive buff to +dmg mods like serration, hornet strike and merciless/deadhead arcanes. For this reason, you can actually remove these base damage mods on any weapons you use. Additionally, there is a current strange interaction of Vex Armor buff where it 'double dips' (i.e. has a squared effect) on certain weapons including all Glaives ([\[Glaive Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1127/glaive-prime/), [\[Cerata\]](/items/arsenal/1007/cerata/), Xoris) and Exodia Contagion. **Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

HELMINTH is optional between Nourish (to help sustain energy economy but doesn't really help Prism damage) or Pillage (helps survivability and Prism damage)

Use prism, a disco ball of death, to shoot lasers to wipe out entire rooms rapidly. 

Each cast of 4 shoots 20 lasers which track enemies dealing 250 radiation damage tick twice a second, with each tick increasing damage of all lasers
 by 25% (or 50% with Solar Eclipse active). This means at around 200 strength and assuming a dense map where all 20 lasers constantly tick twice a second, after the first second each laser will deal 30,000 damage per tick. After 6s, each laser will deal 180,000 damage per tick. Across a 10s Prism lifespan, the total potential cumulative damage across a single laser is approximately 3 million damage and across all lasers is 63 million damage. 

Normally a single laser can only target one enemy at a time, but with an attractor bubble such as Scourge alt fire or Void status (Xata's whisper/Amp/[\[Astral Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6281/astral-bond/)), you can force the prism to rapidly pass THROUGH the enemy causing all 20 lasers to hit them simultaneously, meaning you could be rapidly building up damage on a single target up of up to 1 million damage per second after just one second. This allows you to instantly kill basically any enemy, even up to levelcap without armor strip.

[[ youtube id="gLDZZ76wG_w?si=ANpWjzCaqzQ5ZFWn" ]]

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast Hall of Mirrors (tap 1) and Solar Eclipse (make sure to invert controls and tap 3) and keep active at all times. Holograms help draw away enemy fire
2. Keep Nourish active (optional)
3. Use Scourge alt-fire to create attractor bubbles
2. Cast 4 and run headfirst into enemies so the prism is picked up by bubbles

**Archon Shards**
2-3 tauforged Cast Speed Shards are mandatory.
Put remainder of shards into duration.

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
High duration is required to increase the very short Prism Guard duration and reduce channelling drain. The longer Prism lasts, the more damage it can build up.

**Efficiency/Energy**
[\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) are for energy. Use [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on sentinel e.g. [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) to give free 30% efficiency.

**Range**
A little positive range helps increase the prism laser radius and prism blind radius.

**Strength**
Positive strength boosts prism damage.

**Other mods**
[\[Prism Guard\]](/items/arsenal/120/prism-guard/) augment is compulsory so you can actually guide the ball towards enemy density rather than rely on chance, and is also required for the attractor bubble interaction. If you plan on playing in very small rooms only, you might be able to drop the augment and pump up efficiency with [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/).

If no cast speed shards, [\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/) is absolutely compulsory to shorten the ridiculously long cast animation of prism.

Rolling Guard is optional and flexible for Umbral Intensify or Augur Secrets

**Arcanes**
Arcane Concentration - if you cast Prism immediately after Pillage you will get a bonus 60% duration onto Prism
Molt Augmented - more strength
Arcane Aegis - better lazy survivability optional

## ARSENAL
[\[Scourge\]](/items/arsenal/1095/scourge/) is the best weapon for Prism [\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/). [\[Scourge\]](/items/arsenal/1095/scourge/) can set up a headshot attracting bubble that can suck in the prism if you run through it, and rapidly accelerate the damage buildup due to a special interaction. You can use this to deal with single targets eg acolytes/Thrax/Demolysts. You can also use [\[Scourge\]](/items/arsenal/1095/scourge/) as a primer (since it has innate corrosive and you run viral, you can get viral,corrosive,magnetic,radiation,heat,impact. https://overframe.gg/build/708470/

Grimoire is optional to give more energy regen via Xata invocation as well as free Shield Recharge delay reduction/shield regen via Fass Canticle. https://overframe.gg/build/569013/

You can use an AOE primer like [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/), [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) or even [\[Kuva Ogris\]](/items/arsenal/2846/kuva-ogris/) to magnify the damage of your lasers. Viral magnifies all damage to health by up to 4.25x while magnetic magnifies all damage to shields by up to 4.25x. 

Epitaph primer: https://overframe.gg/build/235422/epitaph/epitaph-primer/
Kuva Nukor primer: https://overframe.gg/build/235421/kuva-nukor/kuva-nukor-primer/
Kuva Ogris primer: https://overframe.gg/build/235335/kuva-ogris/kuva-ogris-primer/

**Sentinel**
Can use Diriga/[\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) to increase channeling efficiency and provide healtenergy orbs
