**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**UPDATE Aug 2024**
Due to armor cap, Danse Macabre no longer requires full armor strip to perform and in fact can even nuke up to levelcap due to the damage absorption mechanic. Danse deals damage equal to enemy damage absorbed, but this decays rapidly over time unless you continue to take damage. Danse Macabre also has innate armor strip since it procs corrosive status on any armored enemies. By levelcap, enemies typically deal up to 1 million damage per shot, meaning each revolution of nine lasers deals 9 million damage after just one shot. If you absorb damage for a few seconds, you could absorb upwards of 10 to 50 million damage meaning each revolution deals 450 million damage total, enough to oneshot all enemies at levelcap without armor strip.

You can subsume roar or nourish over 1. Roar helps scaling Danse at lower levels while Nourish helps with energy economy.

Reave is kept not to actually use Reave to kill, but for mobility since it allows you to travel around the map very fast. Reave is currently bugged with Danse as spamming reave allows you to continuously build momentum and become even faster than [\[Titania\]](/items/arsenal/21/titania/). 

If you need to kill a specific enemy with Reave before Danse can ramp up e.g. a Thrax or enemies that do not attack you, you just need to use a primer with viral and magnetic e.g. [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/), [\[Coda Catabolyst\]](/items/arsenal/7333/coda-catabolyst/), [\[Kompressa Prime\]](/items/arsenal/7392/kompressa-prime/) then use Reave

[[ youtube id="_drks2HHF-I?si=SUuOhFbB1dAk5wCl" ]]

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Positive duration is required for Roar uptime, Reave duration (for moving around quickly) and to reduce energy drain of Danse Macabre. You need one of the following combinations of duration and efficnecy to minimise energy drain (see https://wiki.warframe.com/images/DurationEfficiencyTable.png?7c660)
- 166% duration and 160% efficiency
- 261% duration and 135% efficiency
- 280% duration and 130% efficiency - can hit this with Arcane Concentration + [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/)

**Efficiency**
Positive efficiency is required for energy drain of Danse Macabre and to allow Reave to be easily spammable. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) from a companion gives a free 30% efficiency which could free up [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/)

**Range**
Range does not affect the total sweep radius of Danse, only the beam thickness which doesn't really seem to impact it's effectiveness. Range is not necessary for roar or mesmer skin, and we are not using reave to kill so we dont need range for reave either.

**Strength**
Strength is required for Roar and Mesmer skin, and helps Danse in lower levels. In very high levels, absorbed damage adds a flat amount of damage on making strength basically useless for Danse.

**Flexible**
[\[Mesmer Shield\]](/items/arsenal/6059/mesmer-shield/) helps allies in affinity range gain mesmer skin.

**Archon Shards**
1 tau cast speed shard or 2 regular cast speed shards helps with mesmer skin/roar recasting and entering Danse animation.
1 tau corrosive stack shard lets Danse proc up to 13 corrosive procs for 98% armor strip, which is only about 15% difference to 100% strip with 2 corro shards.
The rest goes into strength shards

**Arcanes**
Molt Augmented provides more strength to Roar and Mesmer Skin, but is entirely optional and can be adjusted to your preference or situation.
Arcane Concentration gives more duration for Roar uptime and reduces drain of Danse

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This is an endurance SP survival build focused around using the [\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/) augment to turn Artemis Bow into a scaling room nuke using the combination of Internal Bleeding to create slash procs and Primed Firestorm/Range mods. 

Well of Life creates an invulerable floating target that you can spam headshots onto to trigger the explosion of [\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/), nuking a room repeatedly without having to find a new target to headshot. Once you release the target or the 12s duration is up, the target will die and create 4 health orbs due to the augment [\[Pool Of Life\]](/items/arsenal/191/pool-of-life/), which will be converted to 220 energy due to [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). If you need energy desparately, terminate well of life quickly after shooting the target to generate orbs. Well of Life also makes you immune to status effects and knockdown within range of the well of life target.

**NOTE ON CREPUSCULAR AND [\[Spectral Serration\]](/items/arsenal/7193/spectral-serration/)**
Currently, [\[Spectral Serration\]](/items/arsenal/7193/spectral-serration/) is bugged to not apply if you activate [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) while invisible. However normally if you activate Artemis outside of Prowl, [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) will not benefit from the +30% strength from Crepuscular. 

The workaround is to do the following:
1. Turn on [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) (tap 4) FIRST while visible and NOT in Prowl or Cloak Arrow 
2. Select CLOAK ARROW and cast arrow in front of you and walk inside bubble
3. Turn on Prowl (tap 3) which will now lock both crepuscular and [\[Spectral Serration\]](/items/arsenal/7193/spectral-serration/) buffs

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
[\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/) now has 20% base status chance which means you could now mod it for a status effect to deal damage. Electric is the best option due to the existence of Violet Shards which give free up to +600% electric damage to [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) and other primaries. Fire rate mods are also no longer inherited via a statstick.

**UPDATE JAN 2025**
Use Arcane Crepuscular gives flat cd boost
[\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) boosts [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) without negatively affecting other stats. This is optional over [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) but less damage since it doesn't boost prowl's headshot multiplier. Could also go over [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) if you prefer more damge over range.

**Why use [\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/) and not just a Bramma?**
[\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/) produces explosions with the highest AOE radius in the game, of up to over 20m (compared to 13.8m from [\[Kuva Bramma\]](/items/arsenal/4245/kuva-bramma/) + [\[Primed Firestorm\]](/items/arsenal/5331/primed-firestorm/)). It also is the only weapon that produces forced impact procs in an AOE meaning [\[Internal Bleeding\]](/items/arsenal/5405/internal-bleeding/) allows you to create slash procs on all enemies in range at a rate of 70% (compared to 30% from [\[Hunter Munitions\]](/items/arsenal/688/hunter-munitions/)). Furthermore, the explosion damage has NO drop off, is completely silent and does NOT stagger you. The main drawbacks are it unfortunately has half the base damage of Kuva Bramma, cannot run primary arcanes and cannot self-proc statuses like viral (due to 0% status). 

## PLAYSTYLE
1. OPTIONAL: Throw [\[Afentis\]](/items/arsenal/5945/afentis/) down and stand within bubble to get Ballistarii might buff (reload buffs greatly improves fire rate of bow).
2. Activate Prowl and Artemis Bow
3. OPTIONAL: Switch to sleep arrow (default is tap 1 to swap) and tap alt-fire while in [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) to shoot a sleep arrow to allow easy headshots or CC enemies, particularly if not using [\[Scourge\]](/items/arsenal/1095/scourge/) or Well of Life.
4. Cast Well of Life on an enemy. You can have up to three wells active, you can place one at each chokepoint on a tile and keep shooting them in a rotation.
5. Spam headshots onto well of life target with [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/) primary fire to nuke the room. Fully charging shots now apply a +25% critical chance bonus to the AOE which allows you to hit more orange crits.

Old build demonstration using Spectrorage instead of Well of Life:

[[ youtube id="fW4t4mAlSKU" ]]

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Not specifically needed in the build but keeping this neutral to positive helps with Well of Life uptime and Prowl Drain.

**Efficiency**
We can dump efficiency and run [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) since [\[Pool Of Life\]](/items/arsenal/191/pool-of-life/) generates 4 health orbs which is converted into 220 energy via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). 

**Range**
High range scales the explosion radius of [\[Concentrated Arrow\]](/items/arsenal/169/concentrated-arrow/) headshots (19.6m at max range, and 22.68m with [\[Primed Firestorm\]](/items/arsenal/5331/primed-firestorm/)) as well as the radius of sleep arrows, making this our most important stat.

**Strength**
High strength scales the headshot multiplier of prowl and the damage multiplier of artemis bow.

**Aura**
Corrosive Projection - effective 1.8x multiplier against armored enemies without other sources of armor strip
[\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) can be snapshot by prowl to gain additional headshot bonus, and also snapshot by artemis bow to get additional base damage multiplier.

**Arcanes**
Arcane Crepuscular - gives 30% strength and +3 flat CD
Arcane Rage - adds +180% dmg to [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/)

**Archon Shards**
1 to 2 Amber Parkour Shards optional to boost roll velocity OPTIONAL
3 to 5 Violet Primary Electric Damage shards to give artemis bow raw electric damage and the ability to proc electric status in AOE

**Helminth Options**
- Well of Life - makes a stationary target to spam headshots on, and pool of life generates tons of energy, makes you immune to status effects and saves you if you die with cooldown

- Roar - double dips status procs but would be additive to any bane mod run on [\[Artemis Bow\]](/items/arsenal/2276/artemis-bow/). Swap [\[Pool Of Life\]](/items/arsenal/191/pool-of-life/) for [\[Empowered Quiver\]](/items/arsenal/171/empowered-quiver/) and shoot enemies from dashwire if you prefer.

## ARSENAL
**ARTEMIS BOW BUILD**
Artemis Bow (Electric for General): https://overframe.gg/build/279335/

**COMPANION**
Ideally use a pet that can passively prime viral status AND use [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/) + [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) for you since Artemis Bow has low overall status chance:

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This is an all purpose Iron skin [\[Rhino\]](/items/arsenal/49/rhino/) build for maximising iron skin health, having a strong buff from roar and providing decent crowd control from stomp. [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) and [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) are key components that boost Iron Skin while [\[Reinforcing Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/177/reinforcing-stomp/) is a great way to maintain iron skin.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
Arcane Battery is able to give you much more energy max than [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) can give, fluctuating between +492 energy with just [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) and 1000 energy with [\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/) active). This allows you to run [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) instead of [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and drop reliance on arcane energize for energy generation. You can also afford to run 45% efficiency with Blind Rage.

This is the non-helminth version of: https://overframe.gg/build/198760/ ,  which is a meme build to get an even higher level of iron skin using parasitic armor helminth.

Endurance Nourish non tanking: https://overframe.gg/build/473949/
Empowered Roar Buff Rhino: https://overframe.gg/build/205669/

**VEILBREAKER UPDATE**
[\[Reinforcing Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/177/reinforcing-stomp/) is now a viable replacement over [\[Iron Shrapnel\]](/items/arsenal/174/iron-shrapnel/) since it now restores 4% of total iron skin per enemy stomped.
Add 2 amber cast speed shards to increase stomp speed
Remaning shards can go into strength for Iron Skin and Roar.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Augments**
The *[\[Ironclad Charge\]](/items/arsenal/176/ironclad-charge/)* augment is absolutely essential to the build, giving a **massive** boost to base armor after charging into enemies with 1. Once your base armor is boosted, you can 'lock' this value into iron skin by casting 2.  The *[\[Iron Shrapnel\]](/items/arsenal/174/iron-shrapnel/)* augment is less essential and has now been replaced with **[\[Reinforcing Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/177/reinforcing-stomp/)**, which lets you constantly refresh iron skin without needing to redo the iron skin again.

**Why [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) and no armor?**
Health conversion is better than traditional armor mods like Umbral Fiber, Steel Fiber, Armored agility or Gladiator/Carnis mods. This is because [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) at 3 stacks provides 1350 additional base armor, compared to a measly 378 from Umbral Fiber and 123 from Gladiator aegis/[\[Armored Agility\]](/items/arsenal/797/armored-agility/). This is because armor mods scale off [\[Rhino\]](/items/arsenal/49/rhino/)'s tiny base armor value of 290.

**Duration**
[\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/) is required to offset [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) and give decent duration so that iron clad charge lasts over 15s, giving a long window to setup, roar lasts almost 1 minute and stomp lasts over 10s.

**Efficiency**
Low efficiency can be maintained due to high energy from Arcane Battery, high energy regeneration from Equilbrium + [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) and energy generation methods. If you feel like you have energy issues with quick missions, simply swap [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/).

**Range**
Just a bit of range gives a huge stomp and roar radius of over 30m. You can either run 100, 145 or 175 range, up to preference.

**Strength**
Strength is the most important stat for iron skin since it scales This scales into iron skin twice due to boosting ironclad charge bonus and as a final multiplier on iron skin. 

Approximate iron skin values achieved with about 300 Strength:
- Base iron skin: 6000
- After charging into 1 enemy : 10k
- After charging into 20 enemies : 80k
- With max health conversion stacks : 15k
- With max health conversion and charging into 1 enemy: 40k
- With max health conversion and charging into 20 enemies :  480k

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Energize is optional for energy generation
- Arcane Battery gives up to 1000 extra energy max
- Molt Augmented gives +60% free strength after 250 kills. Molt Vigor can be an alternative.
- Arcane Guardian now builds on taking damage to iron skin, so a good option to increase iron skin values.
- Arcane Tanker / ultimatum increase your armor even further but are probably unnecessary and reasonably difficult to consistently activate
- Can use damage boosting arcanes depending on your weapon of preference

**Helminth**
Stomp will be the ability that is replaced most of the time on an iron skin focused build:

Options to increase base armor for maximising iron skin:
- Parasitic Armor can provide the biggest possible armor boost but doesn't do much else. With redirection you can gain 3747 armor, but you will need to drop health conversion
- Elemental ward (Cold) provides the next biggest armor boost at 1291 extra armor but also provides passive damage reflection and free cold status procs
- Defy is the next providing 750 armor at max cap and a bit of knockback/damage on cast
- Warcry is the worst giving only 430 armor, but provides melee attack speed boost and an initial slow wave. 

Options to increase both iron skin and roar:
- Empower can also be used, but you will need to cast before each ability use which makes it a little more clunky to use, and provides less total boost compared to Elemental ward. Empower does however also benefit roar.

Options for grouping (for ironclad charge) and crowd control
- Ensnare - can be spammed onto multiple targets but requires a target to cast, highest range but slowest pull
- Larva - can be cast without enemy to target, very fast pull
- Airburst - can also deal some damage, as well as both push and pull

If you want to keep stomp, highly recommend Nourish over 1.

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Kill some enemies to generate energy orbs to regain energy, and health orbs to activate [\[Synth Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/1422/synth-fiber/) and in turn [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), until you get to 3 stacks
2. Find a group of enemies and use a grouping tool such as [\[Proboscis Cernos\]](/items/arsenal/5315/proboscis-cernos/), [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/), Vazarin Void Snare
3. Cast Charge into the group of enemies (or out of the group of enemies if they are surrounding you for best results) to activate the [Ironclad Charge] bonus
4. Constantly Stomp enemies for crowd control and to keep iron skin value near max
5. Keep Roar active as required

## INTRODUCTION 

[[ youtube id="hHAp5uwVCYM?si=Hh8KHZ0ZDyeNimch" ]]


Extreme lazy tank Wukong for speedrunning and general use missions throughout normal starchart and base/early steel path, but now able to even scale to levelcap due to Arcane Persistence.

**UPDATE DEC 2025**
Arcane Persistence now allows [\[Wukong\]](/items/arsenal/37/wukong/) to take lazy tanking all the way to levelcap. Persistence stops you from losing more than 500hp per second if your armor is over 700. At 3000 health, this means you can stay alive without doing anything for at least 5s before dying. As long as you can heal back the damage you can stay alive pretty effortlessly compared to shield gating. Cloud Walker heals quite slowly and other methods are a little inconsistent but reasonable to use e.g. [\[Healing Return\]](/items/arsenal/372/healing-return/) or [\[Life Strike\]](/items/arsenal/330/life-strike/) on [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/), [\[Magus Elevate\]](/items/arsenal/2197/magus-elevate/), [\[Hunter Recovery\]](/items/arsenal/686/hunter-recovery/) on Panzer. The most consistent and fastest heal is Gloom. The only danger you can face is if heat and corrosive status reduces your armor, but having Defy active gives you over 2000 armor which is a nice buffer in case that happens. Magnetic status and Violence are the main two things that will prevent persistence from working so you need to be very careful there.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**
[\[Wukong\]](/items/arsenal/37/wukong/) [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) has been mega buffed due to now being able to use Acolyte mods ([\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/) and [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/)) as well as Arcanes (Melee Influence). Since [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) has a good base damage, very high range (3.5m base + 5.5m at max combo bonus + 3m from [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/) = 12m range) and 1 [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/), [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) is now one of the strongest 'standard melee' influence weapons in the game. This build below forgoes attack speed due to Arcane Strike on the frame. If you do NOT have Arcane Strike, you should add an attack speed mod (e.g. [\[Quickening\]](/items/arsenal/327/quickening/), [\[Berserker Fury\]](/items/arsenal/359/berserker-fury/) or [\[Primed Fury\]](/items/arsenal/349/primed-fury/)) over either Smite or Galv Elementalist slots.

![](https://imgur.com/M8zxzie.png)

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate clone (optional if not subsumed)
2. Press 3 to absorb damage to stack 1500 armor
3. Use 2 to traverse the map and heal when needed
4. Enter 4 and hold down light attack, use tennokai when necessary

## BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
This is mostly for cloud walker so you can travel further with each cast, as well as lenghtening buff durations

**Efficiency**
Efficiency helps with cloudwalker and [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) drain.

**Range**
Range is not really necessary for any abilities except defy's range.

**Strength**
Higher strength mainly scales Iron Staff damage unless you run a helminth.

**Flexible slots**
Aura - Corrosive Projection gives the highest dmg boost against armored enemies. Can also be growing power or steel charge.
Exilus - can be preparation, primed sure footed/[\[Handspring\]](/items/arsenal/825/handspring/), [\[Vigilante Pursuit\]](/items/arsenal/700/vigilante-pursuit/). Preparation is preferred, particularly so you can start off using cloud walker for speedrunning missions.
Nira's Hatred - gives a little extra health to push you over 3000 
Gladiator Resolve - gives a little extra health to push you over 3000 for another persistence layer and also gives +110% crit chance at 12x combo, just under what Primal Rage gives

**Arcanes**
Arcane Persistence: makes you effectively immortal as long as you can heal more than 500hp/s
Arcane Strike: for [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) attack speed
Arcane Blessing: helps you get an additional 2s of leeway between neding to heal and dying, which makes it feel much more comfortable in longer missions but this can be swapped if you dont feel you need it.

**Helminth**

- [\[Firewalker\]](/items/arsenal/843/firewalker/) gives you status immunity (esp to slash, heat, corrosive, magnetic which can make persistence fail and kill you), boosts movement speed for cloudwalker and looks cool. If you need healing without Gloom you may want to use magus elevate/repair, hunter recovery on panzer, life strike on iron staff
- Nourish for energy and viral procs

- Molt or infested mobility for cloud walker speed boost. Molt provides the highest speed boost at 105% (compared to only 25% for firewalker)

**Archon Shards**
Flexible:
5 Tauforged Violet melee crit damage shards if you want to fully commit to [\[Iron Staff\]](/items/arsenal/2407/iron-staff/) damage

[[ youtube id="G2guSO9z-0k?si=RlYGK-5qFlpwgPSo" ]]

Both augments are mandatory. [\[Shadow Haze\]](/items/arsenal/6224/shadow-haze/) is required to create 3 roaming shadows that can each trigger the true damage. [\[Dark Propagation\]](/items/arsenal/6559/dark-propagation/) allows enemies killed to self spread Sow, meaning it can spread across a wider area without recasting Sow.

Enemies affected by Sow who are then subsequently hit by Reap take true damage equal to 25% of their CURRENT health. This value is NOT affected by ability strength, but is affected by Viral (2x at 1 stack and 4.25x at 10 stacks) and Roar. You need exactly 255% strength on both Reap and Roar to one-shot enemies without viral status. You may be able to get away with using [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) if you have enough strength on reap to save forma.

Use this spreadsheet to calculate exactly what components you need to hit the one shot threshold (made by me, to use click file -> make a copy, do NOT ask for edit permissions please): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qXQBttYGe6qfG1xruv9YDpgb1YON4LitOhrUfifu2oU/edit?usp=sharing

Use this for Shadow to help reviving: https://overframe.gg/build/457771/

# HELMINTH
ROAR is MANDATORY for the one-shot threshold.

You can subsume over EITHER Gloom or Shadow depending on preference. If you would like to focus purely on nuking while in normal [\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/) or [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) using shadow, subsume over shadow. If you like to switch it up and occasionally switch into shadow, swap over Gloom. Gloom provides decent crowd control in certain situations but does not affect eximus, and also consumes alot of energy. 

# SURVIVABILITY
1. Shield Gating: Catalyzing shield reduces your shields by 5x, but currently having ANY amount of shield gives you a full 1.33s shield gate upon breaking. If you regenerate shield via [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) after casting 1 or 2, you can reset this gate to full. Since you constantly spam 1 and 2, you can stay in a constant cycle of refreshing your shield gate.
2. Vazarin Protective Sling: for absolute safety, I would recommend running the vazarin school protective sling which gives you on demand 5s invulnerability when you sling through your frame. Having [\[Magus Cloud\]](/items/arsenal/2201/magus-cloud/) on your operator is very helpful to make this even easier.

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Keep positive to maintain Roar uptime and reduce Gloom drain.

**Efficiency**
[\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is sufficient to maintain energy since you only need to cast 1 occasionally when new enemies spawn which only costs 25 energy.

**Range**
The true damage component only affects enemies hit DIRECTLY by shadows. The radial component is blast damage and doesn't scale with range either. Range does affect Sow but since [\[Dark Propagation\]](/items/arsenal/6559/dark-propagation/) allows it to self propagate, you don't need too much range to get this going. 

[\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) can be procced by [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) on [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) and is optional for free energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/). Note you CAN regenerate energy passively while Gloom is active as long as there are no enemies in range.

**Strength**
Strength does NOT affect Reap damage, but is needed for Reap debuff, Gloom slow, Roar buff and affects the Crit chance buff of Shadow Haze.

# ARCHON SHARDS
1 tau Amber Cast Speed
3-4 tau Crimson Strength gives 45% to 60% strength, MANDATORY to hit the threshold, but you can vary this if you have other strength sources e.g. [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/), Madurai, Zenurik. The fourth shard would allow you to drop Power Drift for primed sure footed.
1 optional flexible shard shard slot if you run power drift- duration to improve roar uptime, parkour velocity for mobility, energy orb effectiveness for more energy

**Arcanes**
Arcane Energize/Steadfast - if you need extra energy economy help (note : Steadfast prevents consistent shield gating).
Arcane Concentration - gives 60% duration to help longer roar
Molt Augmented - if you run this, you could do either free up shards OR mod slot for rolling guard, but you would need to stack with kills and lose energize/concentration

# ARSENAL
Weapons to help generate energy:
- Tenet Glaxion with Photon Overcharge: https://overframe.gg/build/668833/
- Miter Incarnon with Primary Exhilarate and for popping nullifiers in corpus/fissure: https://overframe.gg/build/219227/
- Grimoire with Xata Invocation: https://overframe.gg/build/569013/

Companions:
- Shade: https://overframe.gg/build/441583/. Keeps you invisible while you only cast abilities, giving a much easier time with survivability. Can use Coolant Leak to help generate health orbs for energy, but has low consistency
- Diriga: https://overframe.gg/build/541464/. Arc Coil gives highest consistency for priming enemies passively and generating health orbs for energy.
- Wyrm: https://overframe.gg/build/545608/. Negates status effects including knockdown, very good if you don't own [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) and to [\[Protect\]](/items/arsenal/221/protect/) against slash procs in grineer missions. Can also use [\[Coolant Leak\]](/items/arsenal/230/coolant-leak/) but has low consistency.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Temple is a mixed caster/weapon platform frame with a few weakish AOE damaging abilities (Pyrotechnics, Overdrive), a strong exalted flamethrower on 4 (Lizzie/Exalted Solo) and a few decent weapon buffs with Overdrive providing flat critical chance (scaling with strength) and Ripper's Wail providing up to 750% raw heat elemental damage boost. You will be casting 1 and 2 quite frequently trying to hit 'backbeat' which is the sweetspot on the pendulum. 

Hitting a backbeat on either 1 or 2 will improve energy cost of casting that ability, fuel ammo for the exalted [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/), [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the duration of Ripper's Wail, increase the heat bonus of Ripper's Wail, increase the Pillars from 1 and double the crit chance boost of 2, meaning it is absolutely crucial for you to hit backbeats pretty consistently.

[[ youtube id="9rh61hpksK4?si=bgvGKANu1q3Gl-AM" ]]

## BUILD VARIANTS
- Lazy Gating Exalted DPS Variant (Silence/Omamori/Nourish): https://overframe.gg/build/816839/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 1 and 2 on crowds of enemies in front of you making sure to hit backbeats as much as possible to charge fuel for [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/).
2. Tap 3 on a backbeat to become invulnerable for a short period and gain raw heat damage buff
3. Cast 4 making sure to time a backbeat so you consume no energy to summon the Exalted. The exalted runs on fuel rather than energy which is fueled by hitting backbeats on 1 and 2. Shoot enemies.

## SURVIVABILITY
**Option 1 : Shield Gating/Invulnerability**
This is a HIGH activity playstyle requiring frequent casting and high mobility, but is the best option if you want to take Temple into higher levels over 300 to 400 e.g. (EDA, ETA, endurance cascade/disruption). Tapping 3 on a backbeat will also give you approximately 7s of invulnerability and also restores shields to over 1100 shields which gives another 2.5s shield gate. Rolling Guard is also OPTIONAL for additional i-frames and status cleanse while spamming 1/2. Heat procs from 1 also add additional layer of crowd control, but you could swap this for better layers of survivability e.g. Omamori, Silence, Pillage etc. 

**Option 2: Health Tanking**
If shield gating just isn't your cup of tea or if you are only playing non SP or low level SP missions and don't feel like gating, feel free to swap Catalzying Shields and [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/), and use a fully ranked [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/).

## STAT BREAKDOWN
**DURATION**
Duration is not a particularly important stat because Ripper's Wail has a base duration of 30s and is extended by each backbeat cast of 1 or 2 and can be refreshed indefinitely. Additionally if you use Ripper's Wail for invulnerability at all, you may be frequently recasting Ripper's Wail manually anyway. Duration has no effect on Exalted Solo and Overdrive already has a long base duration of 20s, meaning after casting you just need to kill affected enemies before approximately 15s. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is used here specifically for combination with Blast Toxin modded on [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) to get corrosive status.

**EFFICIENCY AND ENERGY**
Efficiency is not required on [\[Temple\]](/items/arsenal/7285/temple/) as Exalted Solo does not continuously drain energy and instead spends fuel which requires backbeat casting of 1 and 2 to charge. Casting 4 on a backbeat also spends 0 energy. Backbeat casting 1 and 2 also grants a 50% efficiency bonus meaning it basically costs the base energy cost of 25 each cast. Ripper's Wail is infrequently cast and is also cheap. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion can easily activate while Exalted Solo is active giving a further free 30% efficiency. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is sufficient to sustain any energy requirements and [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is optional.

**RANGE**
[\[Temple\]](/items/arsenal/7285/temple/)'s 1 and 2 require range but both have a decent base range of 25m and 20m respectively. You will want to increase this dependent on the tileset but approximately 145 to 175 range is sufficient in most cases. Note that [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) has a maximum range of 26m with [\[Sinister Reach\]](/items/arsenal/620/sinister-reach/) and Overdrive at 145 range reaches exactly 29m which will cover the entire range of [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/). NOTE: [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is OPTIONAL of regular [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) if you are running a companion such as [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) or Hound that can proc it for you for some passive energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/).

**STRENGTH**
Strength is the most important stat as it scales the damage of 1, 2 and 4 and the critical chance bonus from 2. At 350% strength a backbeat cast of Overdrive can give a flat 175% crit chance bonus. Strength has no lasting effect on Ripper's Wail since it is capped at 750% maximum heat bonus regardless, with strength just speeding up the ramp up to get there. 

Strength acts like a +damage mod for [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/), with the formula: 1.25 x STRENGTH%. This means at base 100% strength, strength is equivalent to a +25% damage mod. At around 350% strength, this is equivalent to a 337% damage mod (i.e. almost matching Primary Merciless).  Other sources of +damage such as Arcane Rage, Serration, Galvanized Aptitude and Primary Merciless are all 'additive' to this strength component.

**ARCANES**
- Arcane Hot Shot - gives 300% critical chance to all weapons at r5
- Arcane Impetus - gives 54% strength and 27% efficiency (Lizzie primary can be modded for Heat, Blast, Tox. Lizzie Alt-fire can force impact, viral, magnetic, cold and corrosive. Magnetic applied to overguard can proc electric on breaking, giving up to 9 procs, or even 10 with radiated reload on Lizzie)
- Molt Augmented - gives up to 60% strength after 250 kills
- Arcane Acceleration - boosts Lizzie fire rate, highest boost in DPS for LIzzie compared to Augmented or Rage
- Arcane Rage - boosts Lizzie base damage on headshot but this is additive to strength and other mods so no that necessary
- Arcane Aegis - nice backup survivability

**AURA**
- Corrosive Projection: increases damage against armored enemies by about 1.8x before applying heat and corrosive procs
- Growing Power: gives another 25% strength

**EXILUS**
Completely flexible
- Firewalker for more parkour velocity in matching style
- Power Drift for more strength
- Cunning Drift for more energy
- Primed Sure Footed to avoid knockdown if you own it

**FLEXIBLE SLOTS**
- [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/): This works on [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) and gives an addition heat proc whenever heat status occurs, effectively doubling the heat status DPS. If you are shield gating you will not need this at maximum rank so to save capacity we can run this unranked. If you are NOT using Lizzie at all, you can swap this out.

- Rolling Guard: Useful for additional backup i-frames but particularly for the status cleanse. Flexible for catalyzing shields if you prefer to use 1 or 2 for active shield gating rather than rely on 3 for i-frames, or for more strength mods.

**ARCHON SLOTS**
ONE Amber Cast Speed Shard: This reduces the animation time of Ripper's Wail from 3s to approximately 2s making this slightly more bearable while also speeding up casting of 2 which you will use on basically every new enemy. Note : this also reduces the actual invulnerability from a non-back beat cast of 3, but does not reduce the invuln window of a backbeat cast.
To maximise [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) DPS: up to THREE Crimson Primary Status Chance shards: boosts status chance on [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) and other Primary Weapons and ONE Tauforged +Corrosive stack to improve damage against armored enemy
For General Use: The other shards are flexible and up to preference e.g. energy max shards allow you to remove [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/), parkour shards to improve mobility, 

## HELMINTH
You can either subsume over 1 for a Lizzie focused build, or subsume over 4 for a Pyrotechnics Ability focused build or non-[\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) Weapons Platform.

**EXALTED DPS**
For 4 DPS build, given how much you need to focus on pressing 2 to prime enemies for crit chance AND hit backbeats, I would prefer a PASSIVE ability over 1 that doesn't need casting simultaneously with 2. Temple's main weakness is a lack of crowd control and survivability:

- **Nourish**: gives passive viral status without needing to use any alt-fire and maximises energy economy, although neither of these are REALLY required, can be a very comfortable choice
- **Silence** : creates an aura around you that briefly stuns enemies for 2s while also preventing special eximus/acolyte/thrax abilities which can be a very nice passive source of crowd control and survivability: 
- **Omamori**: independent of duration and creates charms that have a 50% of blocking damage. This could be even better if you ran a full passive gating setup e.g. [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/)+vigilante vigor+catalyzing shield + arcane aegis. You could do this by swapping out Rolling Guard and Transient Fortitude.
- **Resonator**: gives passive area crowd control and has fits the musical theme, nice for non-mobile missions

If you are happy with more active abilities you can try grouping e.g. Pull, Airburst, Ensnare

**MECHA ROAR NUKE**
Roar is a special case because unfortunately you can only subsume Roar over Ripper's Wail, which is reasonable in a special Mecha setup with a specific focus on boosting heat status from Pyrotechnics, which Ripper's Wail doesn't do anyway.

General Use Steel Path/Endurance Qorvex build focusing on Crucible Blast to nuke the map. Crucible blast requires both grouping and armor strip for maximum DPS/KPM potential. Armor strip can be achieved via helminth (eg Pillage/Tharros Strike/Terrify) or [\[Helios\]](/items/arsenal/2238/helios/) ([\[Vicious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6270/vicious-bond/) with [\[Deconstructor\]](/items/arsenal/2257/deconstructor/)). Containment wall gives suboptimal grouping, with better grouping achievable via helminth (e.g. Airburst, Larva, Pull, Coil Horizon), [\[Nautilus\]](/items/arsenal/5415/nautilus/) ([\[Cordon\]](/items/arsenal/5402/cordon/) with [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/)) or [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/) spam. 

**UPDATE APRIL 2025**
[\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/) lets you walk around slowly beaming things but prevents casting of other abilities, makes you move very slowly but also completely invulnerable.
Arcane Universal Fallout gives tons of unviersal orbs to sustain even at low rank.
Ophanim Eyes optional over 3, can swap [\[Wrecking Wall\]](/items/arsenal/6556/wrecking-wall/) for [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/)

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**
The new augment for Containment Wall will now allow it to full strip at 200% strength while also refreshing Chyrinka Pillars. 

# PLAYSTYLE
1. For stationary missions (eg survival): Tap 1 to plant two Chyrinka Pillars and keep active whenever one wears off. You want the Pillars to occupy separate areas to cover the largest possible area, but be within line of sight so you can hit them both with your 4. 
2. Tap 3 to cast Disometric Guard for status immunity
3. Tap 2 to group enemies in a line and apply radiation procs with Containment Wall
4. Tap 4 and try to focus the beam groups or lines of enemies as well as simultaneously hitting a Chyrinka pillar (hitting a pillar empowers it for 5s, allowing it's pulses to inherit the chain reactions of Crucible Blast). Hitting the Pillar basically allows you to damage any enemies within the range of Pillar but without actually aiming at them with the beam. Try to hit both Pillars in each beam.

[[ youtube id="kWW1lgmr_oQ?si=Gj0xntXZv3BHjoTD" ]]

# SURVIVABILITY
**[\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/)**
[\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/) makes you completely invulnerable while 4 is active. Shield gating can save you while you are out of crucible and using parkour to get around e.g. equip augur mods on pistol and tap 2 to shield gate.

**Casual EHP Tanking**
Since [\[Qorvex\]](/items/arsenal/6383/qorvex/) has a very high base armor rating, he is able to casual tank Starchart and base SP (< level 300) somewhat. You will want to slot an armor mod (e.g. [\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/) or [\[Steel Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/808/steel-fiber/)). [\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/) adds 1137 additional armor (compared to say 900 from [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) or 1350 from [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) at max stacks), but will probably require an Umbral Forma to fit and you will need to drop [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/). You can also swap [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) out for [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) as well as Molt Efficiency out for Arcane Blessing. This will give final stats of 1900 health, 2012 armor and 90% damage reduction potentially, for a final EHP of 146,427. For reference, a full tank [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) has 800k EHP and a regular [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/) tank build has about 300k ehp while [\[Citrine\]](/items/arsenal/6066/citrine/) and [\[Trinity\]](/items/arsenal/58/trinity/) sit can around 2 million EHP. 


# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Chyrinka Pillar has a base duration of 35s so having a bit of negative duration still gives over 20s duration. Duration doesn't affect 2 or 3, but does affect the drain of [\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/)

**Efficiency and Energy Economy**
Arcane Universal Fallout causes enemies afflicted with radiation status from abilities to have a chance to drop a universal orb which restores energy. On [\[Qorvex\]](/items/arsenal/6383/qorvex/) this results in a huge amount of energy provided you are getting sufficient kills to offset energy drain. In the right type of map this is enough even to offset 45% efficiency, but if you feel like you have energy issues or don't own Universal Fallout you may need to add [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) or [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) to further help costs. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion adds a bonus 30% efficiency while chanelling [\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/).

**Range**
Range affects the radius of 1 as well as the range of 2 grouping and 4 explosions. We want to maximise this.

**Strength**
Strength most importantly affects the damage of 4 and the damage vulnerability of 2. Containment wall augment requires 200% strength to full strip in one cast and 164% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/). You can further use external sources like Madurai (+40%), Zenurik (+20%), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) (+60%) if you like.

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) reduces the strength needed to full strip

**Exilus**
Completely flexible for power drift, cunning drift etc. Since both 3 and 4 makes you status/knockdown immune, you will not need [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/).

**Arcanes**
Universal Fallout is pretty much MANDATORY for energy economy. You will need [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) otherwise.
Molt Augmented provides free 60% strength after 250 kills
Molt Efficiency provides free duration with shields active
Arcane Energize is optional for energy economy

**Archon Shards**
1 to 2 Amber Cast Speed shards
3 to 4 Topaz +Ability Damage on Radiation Status

**Flexible Options**
If you don't have [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/), just use [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/).

# HELMINTH
Subsume over Disometric Guard since [\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/) makes you invulnerable and status immune already

1. OPHANIM EYES: Strips armor slower but works without needing to exit [\[Fused Crucible\]](/items/arsenal/7264/fused-crucible/) mode, and means you can drop [\[Wrecking Wall\]](/items/arsenal/6556/wrecking-wall/) augment for more strength. Feels prettty thematic for [\[Qorvex\]](/items/arsenal/6383/qorvex/) too.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Mega buff all guns. 

# SURVIVABILITY
**OPTION 1: ACTIVE GATE**
If you don't mind pressing more buttons constantly, you can use active gating by pressing 2 whenever shields break. This is more consistent than relying on passive gate but requires you to actually pay more attention to the state of your shields. Molt has an instantaneous cast and fully resets shields with catalyzing shield. Make sure you have a single Augur mod somewhere on the loadout. If you are running [\[Wyrm Prime\]](/items/arsenal/2241/wyrm-prime/) with [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/) with Augur mods or a pistol with [\[Augur Pact\]](/items/arsenal/673/augur-pact/), you can swap [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) for more duration or strength. Arcane Sculptor allows you to run 45% efficiency and no [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/). Without Sculptor, swap [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/).

**OPTION 2: LAZY GATE**
Use a combination of passive shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) from arcane aegis + [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) + [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) (+[\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) or vazarin optional) and active shield gating from molt + [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/).
Catalyzing Shield is currently bugged to always give 1.33s gate regardless of shield amount regenerated, meaning even if shield recharge regenerates 1 shield you will get the full 1.33s gate. Double shield recharge mods reduces delay to approximately 1s meaning you have a vulnerability window of anywhere between 0s and 1s after shield gate ends depending on if you got hit during the shield gate. Bridge this vulnerability window by active movement (parkour, running), killing stuff before they kill you, molt drawing Aggro and also sources of Overguard such as secondary fortifier [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/) or [\[Dante\]](/items/arsenal/6507/dante/) specter. Further passive gating can come from a sentinel running [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) with [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/) which restores shields. Molt also cleanses statuses. 

# BUILD BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
High duration is for venom dose, toxic lash and roar durations as well as the speed buff from molt.

**Efficiency/Energy economy**
Adjust to preference and depending on whether you are active gating or passive gating. Negative efficiency can be offset by running [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) so you can cast molt on demand for shield gating (full shield restore with [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/)). Energize is optional for even more energy.

**Range**
None of the abilities need range while using weapons. 

**Strength**
Affects the magnitiude of weapon buffs from [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/), toxic lash and roar. Apparently [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) is 1% better than [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) for [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/) due to Roar triple dipping Toxic Lash, above around 300% strength [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) probably becomes better. Precision is easier to slot due to lower capacity too.

**Archon Shards**
Flexible depending on preference:
- 1 Tauforged Amber Cast speed shards is nice quality of life, making Roar recast faster even without external cast speed active. This is flexible for another emerald +toxin shard.
- 2 to 3 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+toxin damage) - applies a multiplicative increase to toxic lash procs (i.e. 1.9x with 2 tauforged shards).
- 1 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+max corrosive stacks) - allows you to apply 13 corrosive statuses instead of the usual 10. At 13 this is 98% armor strip which is equivalent to a 8.8x damage multiplier against armored enemies. If you compare this to the usual 10 stacks (80% armor strip is equivalent to 6x damage multiplier against armor), then the relative boost is 8.8/6 = 1.4667x. If you run two regular +corrosive shards to get 14 corrosive stacks, full strip is equivalent to a 10x damage multiplier against armored enemies, but as a relative difference this is only a 10/8.8 = 1.1364x or 14% damage difference which only applies to armored enemies. In comparison running a third Tau +toxin status shard gives a multiplier of (1+ 3 x 0.45)/(1 + 2 x 0.45) = 1.2368x or 24% difference, which applies to both armored and unarmored enemies. Even if you are running an elementalist mod (which is additive to +tox shards), the relative difference of a third tox vs two tox shards is 16%, still higher than full strip.


# HELMINTH AND MATHS BREAKDOWN
**Roar**
Roar and faction mods DOUBLE DIP the toxic lash damage and TRIPLE DIP the gauranteed toxin status from toxic lash. At 350% strength, we get a Roar of approximately 100% which means with a Primed faction mod on the weapon, Toxic Lash is boosted by a total of (1+1+0.55)^3 = 16.5x. Adding 2 tauforged emerald Toxin Status dmg shards makes this 16.5 x 1.9 = 31.35x. 

Toxin mods also DOUBLE DIP the Toxin status.

Say we take a weapon with 100 base damage and put two toxin mods on (+150% total), activating 350% [\[Venom Dose\]](/items/arsenal/180/venom-dose/), 105% Roar and Toxic Lash with 2 tauforged Toxin shards will boost damage to:
Raw damage: 100 x 2.05 x  (1 + 3.5 + 1.5) x (1 + 0.3 x 3.5 x 2.05 ) = 3877 total damage. This is approximately a 1550% damage buff.
Toxin status: 100 x 2.05 x (1 + 3.5) x 0.3 x 3.5 x 2.05 x 2.05 x 0.5 x (1+1.5) x 1.9 = 9667 toxin dmg / second over 7.5s. This is approximately a 7734% damage buff.

**Expedite Suffering**
[\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/)'s passiive increases status duration by 25%, meaning a normal 6s duration for toxin becomes 7.5s, directly boosting the amount of toxin damage compressed through Expedite Suffering by 25%. 

If we take a primary weapon buiild with 100 base damage, 1 fire rate, add [\[Galvanized Chamber\]](/items/arsenal/5520/galvanized-chamber/), [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/) + arcane, two toxin mods, primed faction mod, [\[Vile Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/584/vile-acceleration/), we can apply 218,347 toxin status dmg in about 1 second of shooting. Casting Expedite suffering compresses the 7.5s of these procs into a single instance of toxin damage, and multiplies it by strength, giving 5.7 million damage. Adding crits and viral priming onto this could push this further by an order of 20x to 114 million damage from just a single second of dealing damage.

The damage instances of the cloud will then proc toxic lash which scales off 350 x damage x element which is a decent amount of damage. **UPDATE DEC 2025**
Arcane Persistence now allows [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) to basically be immortal even up to levelcap. Arcane Persistence prevents enemies dealing more than 500 damage per second as long as you have over 700 armor. Since [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) has between 4000 to 8000 health depending on how many health mod sources you have, you essentially could stand still for 8 to 16s without healing. Sandstorm heals back 50 health per second for each enemy trapped, scaling off strength, and also makes you invulnerable for the whole sandstorm period. Scarab Shell also makes [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) immune to magnetic, heat and corrosive statuses which are things that can make persistence fail meaning you only need to worry about violence and nullifiers. To hit the armor cap, we have a few options:
1. Stand United + Umbral Fiber + Umbral Vitality + Umbral Intensify: always active non-conditional but takes highest investment (needs TWO umbral forma) but also gives highest stats
2. Stand United + TWO Tau Armor shards: always active non-conditional and saves forma
3. Scarab Shell: conditional, requires it to be active and charged so least safe method but saves multiple mod and archon slots

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Keep positive to improve the uptime of Sandstorm and Scarab Swarm.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
Can dump since we run [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) which constantly gives energy when you take damage (although note you need to be outside of sandstorm).

**Range**
Keep neutral or positive for the suction radius of sandstorm, although this does not need to be excessive since you can control the direction of the tornado and pick up enemies. The base range of Scarab swarm and Dessication are quite high.

**Strength**
Strength is needed to boost the armor bonus from Scarab Shell, damage of sandstorm and status chance of [\[Elemental Sandstorm\]](/items/arsenal/178/elemental-sandstorm/) (strength essentially double dips sandstorm's status DPS).

**Arcanes**
Arcane Persistence: needed to make [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) basically immortal in all levels
Arcane Bellicose: gives 72% strength due to high health
Arcane Grace: optional passive health regeneration which scales with max health. You need 8334 health for the 6% health to hit 500hp/s, which exactly counteracts persistence loss rate.

# ARCHON SHARDS
For weapon focused Inaros:
- Two or more Crimson Duration shards for sandstorm and roar uptime
- Two or more Violet primary Elec shards for primary weapon focus or Violet melee crit dmg shards for melee weapon focus
- One Cast Speed for roar and scarab swarm animation

To maximise pure sandstorm DPS:
- Two regular Emerald +corrosive stack for full armor strip
- Three Tauforged Emerald +ability damage on corrosive status 

If NOT running Triumbral: You need TWO Tauforged Azure armor shards or THREE regular armor shards are required to hit the 700 armor threshold for Arcane Persistence.

# ARSENAL
**Primary**
You can run Primary Bulwark arcane on primary weapons when Scarab Shell is charged up giving a total armor of 1500 to maximise 500% primary damage.

[\[Coda Hema\]](/items/arsenal/7324/coda-hema/): This has lifesteal on headshots with is nice to heal Inaros without being in sandstorm AND has multiplicative Galvanized Aptitude (meaning it multiplies with Primary Bulwark/Serration rather than adds). Sandstorm could also prime additional elements for you.
General Use Build: https://overframe.gg/build/917673/
Thrax Killer Variant: https://overframe.gg/build/949502/

[\[Torid\]](/items/arsenal/907/torid/) Incarnon: Blast Torid works well with grouping

**Melee**
The elemental mods placed on your melee and the melees base IPS/elemental distribution affects the elemental weighting of [\[Elemental Sandstorm\]](/items/arsenal/178/elemental-sandstorm/), and changes how often a status is activated. Melee arcanes such as Melee exposure appear to work, while Melee influence has no specific interaction. Melee mods such as damage, crit, attack speed, status duration do NOT affect Sandstorm at all.

Primer:
If you want your sandstorm to be a pure condition overload/viral primer, simply place viral + heat/electric + radiation + magnetic mods on a weapon with innate corrosive, such as Caustacyst. This will allow sandstorm to proc 6-7 statuses (IPS, corrosive, viral, heat, radiation), which can feed into certain guns that work well with priming and grouping e.g. weapons with multiplicative condition overload effect: Coda Hema, Nataruk/[\[Cinta\]](/items/arsenal/6169/cinta/), [\[Lex\]](/items/arsenal/1198/lex/) incarnon, [\[Tenet Arca Plasmor\]](/items/arsenal/5544/tenet-arca-plasmor/).

Blast:
If you want to use Sandstorm alone to passively kill enemies, you can mod a weapon with pure blast and run [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) with [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) priming viral and magnetic.
Silva and Aegis Prime is a weapon with pure heat meaning you can mod it for 100% blast with a single cold mod to maximise blast DPS.

Electric Influence:
If you are running a priming companion such as Panzer/[\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) that can prime viral for you and would like to do a combination of sandstorm DPS and direct melee DPS, you can simply run a pure electric melee with Melee Influence, which doubles as an [\[Elemental Sandstorm\]](/items/arsenal/178/elemental-sandstorm/) DPS statstick AND a DPS melee. Once sandstorm ends, enemies are often grouped and knocked down, making it very easy for the next few melee hits to naturally perform ground finishers. Weapons in the fist, sparring and claws category have the highest ground finisher multiplier of 30x, followed by tonfas at 20x.

[\[Okina Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6546/okina-prime/) is one of, if not THE strongest influence light attack melee in the game and has the bonus of boosting movement speed by 30% which affects sandstorm movespeed.

[\[Healing Flame\]](/items/arsenal/101/healing-flame/) now gives overguard which makes you status immune while overguard is active and clears existing statuses on cast. Overguard also gives you 0.5s i-frames on breaking, meaning every cast of fireblast can generate approximately 1.5s of i-frames (about 1s from shield gate and 0.5s from overguard). This effectively allows [\[Healing Flame\]](/items/arsenal/101/healing-flame/) to replace [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/), [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) and [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/).

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast 4 to set enemies on fire, proccing [\[Ember\]](/items/arsenal/16/ember/)'s passive strength buff, dealing minor DoT and minor crowd control and also increase energy orb drops
2. Once the maximum number of enemies are on fire, hold 1 to give heat buff from [\[Fireball Frenzy\]](/items/arsenal/100/fireball-frenzy/) (and optionally a buff like Nourish subsumed over 2).
3. Spam fireblast whenever overguard goes down to regain overguard and partially strip armor
4. Use a good weapon to kill stuff

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Duration helps up keep of [\[Fireball Frenzy\]](/items/arsenal/100/fireball-frenzy/) and nourish

**Efficiency**
Nourish with [\[Exothermic\]](/items/arsenal/104/exothermic/) OR [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) can sustain energy particularly if the only thing you are really casting is Fireblast. If you have energy issues still consider just dropping [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) or [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/).

**Range**
Positive range helps fireblast radius so you get overguard mroe consistently
**Strength**
Strength boosts [\[Fireball Frenzy\]](/items/arsenal/100/fireball-frenzy/) heat bonus and nourish bonus. [\[Ember\]](/items/arsenal/16/ember/)'s passive also gives free 5% strength for each burning enemy (for example, hitting 20 enemies with inferno and setting them on fire gives the next immediate cast of inferno a bonus 100% strength). 

**Flex/alternative options**
- [\[Exothermic\]](/items/arsenal/104/exothermic/): [\[Exothermic\]](/items/arsenal/104/exothermic/) can make energy orbs independently of your companion and eximus spawns. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is flexible for this as it can actually generate even more energy particularly when paired with synth deconstruct on a companion and eximus kills.
- Augur Reach: can be stretch if you run an augur mod on a pistol or burst laser prime
- Catalyzing Shields: optional but allows a single fireblast to give 1.33s i-frame from shield gate, in addition to the 0.5s overguard gate.


# ARCHON SHARDS
2 Amber Cast Speed 
Rest are flex and can go into :
- 3 Topaz Secondary Crit Chance shards, which give +75% cc when you kill enemies affected by heat status, which ember can consistently cause.
- 3 Parkour velocity for mobility

# ARCANES
Arcane Hotshot - free 300% crit chance
Arcane Concentration - free 60% duration for nourish and fireball frenzy
Arcane Truculence - max viral procs in 30m on overguard gain
Arcane Energize - optional for max energy economy taking advantage of all the energy orb drops.
Arcane Eruption - funny choice that causes huge area of 30m knockdown everytime you pick up an energy orb, which is constantly generated by [\[Exothermic\]](/items/arsenal/104/exothermic/). This basically keeps the entire map knocked down, except for eximus units. Note, this can drastically slow down defense and survival missions in public so don't always equip this.
Molt Augmented - bonus 60% strength
Molt Efficiency - free duration

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
For Endurance, subsume over 2 since you don't need damage reduction and inferno DPS doesn't scale regardless.

- Nourish - gives free viral and boosts energy return, also has NO frame vulnerability while in operator
- Roar - boosts weapon damage and inferno damage, with double dipping on heat DoTs, but has frame vulnerability in operator
- Sickening Pulse - doubles heat DoT damage
- Breach Surge - after full strip breach surge sparks deal much more damage and can be triggered by inferno DoTs 
- Gloom - crowd control, needs slight adjustments: https://overframe.gg/build/229524/ember-prime/the-slow-cooker-gloom-ember/

# ARSENAL
Due to a mechanic called "heat inherit", using heat status weapons is often a BAD idea on [\[Ember\]](/items/arsenal/16/ember/). This is because heat status inherits the +heat mods and +faction mods from the first stack applied. If you cast fireblast or inferno first and apply a heat status THEN shoot with a heat status weapon like [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) incarnon, all subsequent heat procs applied will NOT use any of the heat or faction mods equipped on the furis (i.e. upwards of 3x less heat dot dmg). For this reason it is probably best to just use raw damage weapons (non-DoT) or non-heat status weapons. We also want them to have decent crit stats to take advantage of arcane hot shot.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

This build is for casual solo farming for resources by punching your way to all the loot, specifically for use in survival missions below level 500ish (i.e. 2-3 hours survival). Above level 500 for endurance, you may need more shield gating and armor strip. Rubble Heap augment allows you to cast landslide for free and boosts landslide damage/speed, while [\[Path Of Statues\]](/items/arsenal/89/path-of-statues/) petrifies enemies that walk into where you once slid. This combination allows you to spam [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) infinitely and gain rubble to maintain maximum rubble without even casting petrify. Finally, the addition of [\[Ore Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/88/ore-gaze/) can increase the drop rate of additional loot by approximately 60% (which already matches [\[Nekros\]](/items/arsenal/38/nekros/) and nearly matches [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/) drop rates). This means you can collect more loot while smashing the enemies petrified by either [\[Path Of Statues\]](/items/arsenal/89/path-of-statues/) or Petrify. 

Nourish is an optional subsume over 2 that boosts [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) damage further with Viral damage, gives you an energy multiplier so you never run out of energy even at 45% efficiency and creates AOE viral procs and stuns whenever you get hit.

Note this build is pretty much only usable in high density maps while solo, eg steel path survival. This is because it can be very hard to build up rubble in low density maps or with other players rerouting spawns.

**ALTERNATIVE BUILDS**
SP Endurance variant (for level 500+): https://overframe.gg/build/229083/
Quick Casual Missions/Defense: https://overframe.gg/build/380692/
Non-landslide Ore Gaze looting: https://overframe.gg/build/255850/

## FISTS BUILDS
ELECTRIC INFLUENCE NUKE: https://overframe.gg/build/825694/
GAS AFFLICTIONS: https://overframe.gg/build/825695/

## PLAYSTYLE

1. Find a group of enemies and cast 3 (petrify), try to petrify as may enemies are possible, then kill them with either [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) or your weapons to generate rubble
2. Activate Nourish (2) and keep active on cooldown
3. Once you hit above 1400 rubble, just start spamming 1 ([\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/)) into every enemy. Enemies that walk through the path you just moved through will be petrified
4. Occasionally petrify any large groups of non-petrified enemies for more loot

[[ youtube id="ce8tsp_ScJU" ]]

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Positive duration gives a long petrify duration of over 20s and a decent duration if you run Nourish or Eclipse in helminth.

**Efficiency**
Minimum efficiency can be used in this build since [\[Ore Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/88/ore-gaze/) produces loot and increases the likelihood of energy orbs dropping, which combined with Nourish or Arcane Energize will ensure you stay at full energy after every couple of kills. [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) also becomes free to cast at max rubble, and [\[Path Of Statues\]](/items/arsenal/89/path-of-statues/) petrifies enemies so you may not even need to spend energy to cast petrify. This means you only need to refresh Nourish every half minute and occasionally cast Petrify when you have good enemy density or for crowd control. If you end up dropping Ore Gaze AND Path of Statues for a non-survival mission, you will need more efficiency by either swapping blind rage for transient fortitude, or adding streamline/[\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/).

**Range**
Range is important for increasing the range and AOE radius of [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) to allow you to 'nuke' rooms as well as the cone length of petrify. Range also affects the 'viral retaliation' radius of Nourish. You could add even more range if preferred with [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/)  e.g. drop [\[Path Of Statues\]](/items/arsenal/89/path-of-statues/).

**Strength**
Strength is important for both [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) damage and petrify loot drop chance. At 250% strength, you have approximately a 63% drop chance from [\[Ore Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/88/ore-gaze/), exceeding both [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/) and [\[Nekros\]](/items/arsenal/38/nekros/). This can be further boosted to 100% by adding more strength mods or using Madurai + Nidus specter.

**Flexible Options**
Augments - [\[Path Of Statues\]](/items/arsenal/89/path-of-statues/) and [\[Ore Gaze\]](/items/arsenal/88/ore-gaze/) are of course both flexible, depending on if you want to farm for loot and if you don't mind casting petrify a lot. These can be dropped for any of the flexible options below:

- Adaptation - helps with passive tankiness combined with 1500 armor provided by rubble. Use this if you like to be a bit more casual and are not doing endurance.
- Archon Flow - when combined with cold modded onto the statstick, this can help generate a large energy orb (50 energy) once every 10s

**Aura**
- Steel charge - used in this case mainly for mod capacity, only providing a small ~5% boost to landslide damage
- Growing power - can be used to further boost Ore Gaze
- Enemy radar - great for repositioning and targeting highest enemy density for optimum petrify

**Exilus**
Totally flexible slot:
Cunning drift - extra range for Landslide
Vigilante pursuit - for extra radar to plan your petrify
Power drift - to squeeze more loot drop chance

**Arcane**
- Energize - good to sustain the negative efficiency and still spam petrify if you want
- Augmented - boosts landslide damage, energy multiplier from nourish and loot chance
- Avenger - essential to provide flat crit chance to Landslides low base chance, for a crit-based stat stick

**Archon Shards**
Two cast speed shards are basically mandatory to help Petrify and Rumbler cast speed
Three Tau Violet melee crit dmg shards optional

## HELMINTH
Nourish gives a viral damage boost to Landslide, multiplies energy gained and creates AOE viral procs/stun on getting hit.
Roar double dips Dot and triple dips influence DoT
Wrathful Advance gives the highest possible DPS boost outside of armor strip by forcing red crits.

Other good options are:
- Pillage - regenerate shields and strip armor. 
- Resonator - for great crowd control, meaning you don't have to worry about dying in between punches
- Silence - decent passive crowd control and prevents special abilities of enemies including acolytes

# COMPANION
**[\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/)**
Can do passive priming for [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) and viral status effect

**[\[Helios\]](/items/arsenal/2238/helios/)**
Can use [\[Helios\]](/items/arsenal/2238/helios/) with [\[Deconstructor\]](/items/arsenal/2257/deconstructor/) and [\[Vicious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6270/vicious-bond/) for passive armor strip.
[\[Vicious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6270/vicious-bond/) allows [\[Deconstructor\]](/items/arsenal/2257/deconstructor/) to strip 15% armor every hit, and Atlas Landslide causes this effect to spread within 9m, to all enemies hit by landslide.

**UPDATE 2026**
Arcane Sculptor triggers off both seek and resupply and locks efficiency to 175% for 12s. If you enter [\[Neutralize\]](/items/arsenal/216/neutralize/) during this period it snapshots all subsequent shots to 175% efficiency meaning every bullet only costs 2.5 energy. Archon Stretch alone triggers off electric resupply neutralizer and generates 2 energy/s. This combined with natural energy orb generation is enough to fuel all energy costs without [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) or other energy production. If you feel like you need a bit more energy generation just add [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/).

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Tap 1 to highlight weakpoints through walls in a frontal cone and boost weakpoint damage
2. Hold 2 and select an element of choice and tap 2 to reload your weapon/[\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/). Electric Ressuply is recommended for general use. 
3. Tap 3 to go invisible and get weakpoint kills to constantly prolong
4. Tap 4 to enter Neutralizer sniper exalted mode. Get weakpoint shots to make them ricochet. Alt-fire to lob cold grenades to slow/freeze enemies.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
You want reasonably high duration to keep Evade sufficiently long for periods where you might not be getting headshots, but you will essentially be able to prolong invisibility forever as long as you get a few headshots once every 50s at this duration. You can adjust this to preference anywhere between 150 to 200+.

**Efficiency**
Arcane Sculptor locks you to 175% efficiency basically permanently whenever you use 1 and 2, and also snapshots [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/) efficiency so you spend very little energy. 

**Range**
You will need to adjust this to the tileset as range affects the ricochet range and Seek range/punchthrough bonus. If enemies are frequently in dense groups or the map is small i.e. in corridors on many Grineer maps then you could be fine with 70 to 100 range. If enemies are bit more spread out or the map has huge rooms, then you will want a bit more range i.e. 145 to 175. If it is open world and enemies are very spread out you may want to try 235 to 280 range even.

**Strength**
Strength boosts the weakpoint multiplier from 1, damage buff from 2 and damage multiplier of 4, meaning strength basically triple dips overall [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/) DPS. You want to pump this as high as comfortable.

**Flexible Slots**
Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL but helps cleanse statuses that may still affect you while invisible (e.g. heat from arson/blitz eximus, bleed from trokarians, toxin from eximus) and gives some bridging room in case Evade goes into cooldown.

**Aura**
[\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) gives bonus strength on creating status with weapon
[\[Worthy Comradery\]](/items/arsenal/7187/worthy-comradery/) is worse than [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) for [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/) damage as it is just regular additive crit chance like [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/) and Crit Delay. It is only special and multiplicative on headshots for certain weapons that are bugged with Biting Frost (e.g. tenet diplos, angstrum) - see wiki page for full list https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Worthy_Comradery

**Arcanes**
Arcane Crepuscular - gives flat 3 cd and 30% str while invisible with evade
Arcane Sculptor - locks efficiency to 175% for 12s after casting seek or resupply, and entering Neutralizer during this 12s period snapshots the efficiency for all subsequent neutralizer shots FOREVER.
Molt Augmented - more strength
Arcane Concentration - more duration

**ARCHON SHARDS**
2 to 4 violet +electric damage shards further double dips electric DoT from resupply and potentially frees up a mod slot on [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/) 
1 cast speed optional helps improve overall feel and resupply cast speed
2 parkour shards optional for mobility

# RESUPPLY ELEMENT
Resupply works very similar to [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/)'s Toxic Lash in that it deals elemental damage as a separate hit and forces the matching elemental status. The forced status double dips the matching elemental mod and triple dips faction mods/roar (except you can't run both roar and resupply simultaneously solo). 

**ELECTRIC**
Electric is a good general element because the status procs instantly, has a small AOE effect and also activates [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) when produced by [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/). [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) on secondary weapons also boosts electric DoTs even further, even if combined with other mods on the secondary to form a different element (e.g. magnetic/corrosive). Electric is also the preferred element against murmur. Primary weapons also have access to electric damage violet shards to maximise electric DoT. Missing a headshot causes enemies to become stunned and raise their head, making subsequent headshots even easier. Bodyshots can also kill enemies pretty quickly with electric DoT even at levelcap.

**GAS**
Gas has a persisting AOE that is excellent for maximising KPM (kills per minute) on camping tiles like survival/defense etc. Works fine with both bodyshots and headshots.

**BLAST**
Blast has the best rapid AOE clearance but absolutely requires headshot kills, bodyshots fizzle and do nothing. This would be nice for mobile missions where you require high KPM e.g. exterminate.

**TOXIN**
Toxic may be good against corpus as it bypasses shields.

**HEAT**
Heat is a good single target element and benefits from [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) if using [\[Neutralizer\]](/items/arsenal/7238/neutralizer/). Secondary weapons also have access to [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) to further boost the heat DoT.

# ARSENAL
**NEUTRALIZER**
Neutralizer Raw Damage Oneshot (Use this for strong single targets eg thrax): https://overframe.gg/build/770440/
Neutralizer Electric DoT trash clear: https://overframe.gg/build/771206/

**SNIPERS**
Cyte has synergy with other Sniper Rifles since Resupply gives bonus damage to snipers. Just note Resupply does NOT apply to incarnon modes of any weapon.

# PLAYSTYLE
**MOBILE (with Roar)**
Make sure to have Protea tap/hold controls INVERTED. This will make tapping 4 to cancel instead of rewind.
1. Tap 4 to initiate Temporal Anchor. Casting 2 while 4 is active will lock its timer despite the duration on the UI ticking down.
2. Cast 3 (roar) while the 100% strength passive is active to snapshot a bigger Roar
3. Just before 4 runs out, you should [\[Double Tap\]](/items/arsenal/507/double-tap/) 4 to terminate so you don't rewind and immediately recast 4 to relock the timer on your 2.
4. Depending on what you subsume over, you can tap 1 to gain a large shield gate or cast 3 for on demand energy

**CAMPING**
1. First you need to find a room in a decent tileset with ONE entrance where enemies funnel in through a narrow corridor or door. Pick a spot as your DPS LOCATION where you will camp and pop turrents, making sure the turrets are able to target all the enemies entering the area from that spot. Then pick another spot in the room that is AT LEAST 15m away from this camping spot and designate this as your DISPENSARY LOCATION. This is because Vacuum/Fetch radius is 13.5m maximum and any energy/health orbs you pick up during temporal Anchor are basically "wasted" since you revert back to near max energy at the end. The orbs from dispensary will basically be your "backup" pool of energy in case you run out somehow outside of Temporal Anchor.
2. Use 2 to trigger [\[Protea\]](/items/arsenal/4633/protea/)'s 100% str passive before casting roar to get a 299% str roar.
3. Use 2 three times again to trigger 100% str passive then pick up health orbs from your dispensary spot to refill energy to max, before casting Temporal Anchor.
4. Once you cast temporal anchor, make sure NOT TO MOVE from this location, and just cast three turrets every 8-10s when they expire. Staying completely stationary will cause the resulting rewind to be nearly instantaneous.
5. Turrets cast while Temporal Anchor is active will automatically strip enemies as they take damage, in a few shots per enemy. Huras will keep you invisible as long as you don't attack with your weapon.
