**What is Heat Inherit?**
The status effect of heat causes enemies to take heat damage every second over 6 seconds according to the formula

"0.5 x modded base damage x (1+heat damage) x (1+faction damage) x critical multipliers"

Each additional application of a heat status adds a stack of heat damage AND refreshes the 6 second duration. However, every subsequent heat proc uses the heat damage and faction damage from the very first stack applied. This means if you use a 'heat primer' with max +heat damage mods and +faction damage mods, then switch to a 'DPS weapon' with only one heat mod that can consistently reapply heat status but with damage, crit and faction mods, every heat proc will actually 'inherit' the heat/faction mods from the primer while taking the modded base damage and critical multipliers from the DPS weapon.

Example setup by Dystopia:
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ta_ex7MUDs

Basically this means with 299% strength, Archon vitality, Mecha set, Roar and heat inherit you get the following maximum possible damage:

Raw hit per second: 
1500 dmg/s x 2.99 (strength) x 1.897 (roar) x 4.25 (viral) * 1.25 (cloned flesh bonus) = 45 198 dmg/s which ramps up to 451,980 dmg/s after 10 shots.

Heat DoT per second:
500(base) x 0.5 (DoT multiplier) x 2 ([Archon Vitality]) x 2.99 (from strength) x 4.64 (from double dip roar + faction mod) x 3.25 (from heat inherit mods) x 6.25 (from mecha empowered) x 4.25x (from 10 viral status) x 1.25 (Cloned flesh bonus) = 2.24 million dmg/s, which ramps up to 22 million/s after 10 shots

If we consider this against something without a mecha mark, then we get 350,000 dmg/s which ramps up to 3.5 million dmg/s after 10 shots.

Over 8s of [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/) Artillery, all together we can basically deal between 10 million to 30 million damage per cast of [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/) Artillery

At levelcap, an unarmored corrupted heavy gunner and demolyst have approximately 2 to 4 million health, meaning they would die after 1-2s when armor stripped.

On the other hand, a fully armored corrupted heavy gunner has 3.3 billion eHP, which is halved to approximately 1.15 billion eHp by heat procs, meaning it could take 30+ full casts of [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/) artillery to kill them without armor strip. At level 500, they have approximately 75 mil eHP meaning they should still be killed within a few seconds depending on enemy density and number of turrets.

# PLAYSTYLE

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration provides status duration to all of the statuses created by [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s abilities. At 155% duration, every proc is increased to approximately 9s increasing the overall damage potential of a status. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is used because Toxin procs created by Ophidian [\[Bite\]](/items/arsenal/656/bite/) can then proc corrosive which boosts Catalyze in two ways, due to both minor armor strip (up to 80% at 10 corrosive) and because Catalyze scales with number of elemental statuses (2^status). 

**Efficiency**
While efficiency technically has no effect on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s base cooldowns, efficiency is still very important because it affects the amount of cooldown reduction granted by both Transmutation probe and [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) per enemy hit. At 100% efficiency, Transmutation probe reduces cooldown by 1.5s per enemy hit and [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) reduces cooldown by 4s when at least 4 enemies are hit. This means casting a combination of [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) (4s) followed by Transmutation probe hitting at least 15 enemies, allows you to reset [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) for immediate recast. In total this combo reduces total cooldown by at least 30s, which allows Catalyze to be recast almost immediately after an initial catalyze cast. The second [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) cast also reduces Transmutation probes cooldown so it is basically available for recast as soon as Catalyze finishes casting so you should be able to do the combination almost immediately again, provided there are enough enemies nearby and not dead.

**Range**
Range is essential for all of [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s abilities, including his helminth options such as grouping abilities and Sickening Pulse. 

**Strength**
Strength affects the damage of all abilities so we want to keep this positive and as high as possble allowing for the other stats.

**Exilus**
Flexible:
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Power Drift for more strength
- [\[Coaction Drift\]](/items/arsenal/64/coaction-drift/) double dips on aura, giving Mecha Empowered 198% status damage on marked enemies, which double dips for a final 8.9x multiplier.

**Arcanes**
For health tanking:
- Arcane Blessing - gives health
- Arcane Guardian - gives armor
- Arcane Reaper - gives both armor and healing when paired with melee

For shield gating:
- Arcane Aegis - when this procs you are effectively immortal for 10s

For Catalyze damage
- Arcane Impetus - up to 60% strength and 30% efficiency from [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) potential elements, just need to cast each combination at least once in the mission then you will be able to constantly refresh it by casting any element
- Molt Augmented - up to 60% strength after 250 kills
- Arcane Ice storm - 40% strength and duration, but can be difficult to keep maxed and highly dependent on density, so could sit around half stacks around 20% strength/20% duration

# ARCHON SHARDS
ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed Shards to speed up cast animations
THREE to FOUR Crimson Duration Shards helps increase the duration of gas procs from catalyze
ONE Tauforged Emerald archon shard is OPTIONAL for 13 corrosive stacks which improves armor strip from 80% to 98% which is roughly a 1.5x dmg buff.

# SURVIVABILITY
**Tanking** 
Since Lavos does not spend energy, he is unable to reset shield gate with the normal methods using Brief Respite/Augur mods. For non-endurance content, you can commit to full eHP tanking using a combination of armor, health and adaptation and using Ophidian bite to heal. 

Lavos has a high base health so Archon Vitality/[\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) boosts health to 1480. Transmutation Probe converts all orbs into universal orbs which activate Arcane Blessing so you can gain an additional 1200 health very quickly for a total of 2680 health.

[\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) also has a high base armor of 675, meaning [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) after affecting just 10 enemies in a 30m radius gives a 600% armor boost for 3150 extra armor for 20s. Compare this to [\[Steel Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/808/steel-fiber/) which only gives +100% for another 675 armor. Since Mecha set has a cooldown of only 15s you should be able to upkeep a large armor buff permanently provided you kill dense crowds consistently. If you affect 20 enemies, you can get 1200% armor or 5850 armor for 95.6% DR. This multiplied with [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) gives 99.56% DR and applied to 2680 health gives an effective HP of 609,090. 

**Shield Gating**
**Active Gating**
You can subsume a shield regenerating ability like Pillage or Condemn, and swap [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) for [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/). Pillage gives armor strip which is very beneficial to the [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/)'s damaging abilities, while Condemn gives crowd control which is very useful in Endurance and preventing you from getting hit in the first place. You will also want to run Vazarin protective sling for additional i-frames as well as [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) or [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) for invisibility.  [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) has the added bonus of having [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) + [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/) which allows it to constantly refill your shields passively whenever you get kills on enemies affected by multiple statuses, which is Lavos's specialty. An Endurance oriented variant using Pillage: https://overframe.gg/build/459333/lavos/pillage-lavos/

**Passive Gating/Recharge**
Another niche method is to use multiple sources of shield recharge delay reduction including warframe mods, Vazarin [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) Break and [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) mod [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/), allowing you to minimize recharge delay and just passively recharge shields while staying mobile. Simply swap out [\[Mecha Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/1419/mecha-pulse/) and [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) for [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) and [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) as seen here.  Add [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) too as it is currently bugged to give 1.33s gate on any amount of shield regenerated, which synergizes very well with passive recharge. Precision Intensify is also now optional over Archon Intensify since you wont be healing anymore. https://overframe.gg/build/604826/

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
In most cases we subsume over Vial Rush, unless you really enjoy the mobility of vial rush.

**Ensnare/Grouping**
Grouping is ideal on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) as it lets Gas procs from Gas infused Catalyze overlap and create exponential damage on groups of enemies, and also allows more enemies to get hit at once for both [\[Swift Bite\]](/items/arsenal/5610/swift-bite/) and Transmutation Probe in order to reduce cooldowns more efficiently.  

Ensnare is a bit slower than the other grouping abilities but provides longer crowd control by keeping enemies locked in place for longer durations. This is ideal on [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) as you often need to perform an ability rotation before you can nuke with catalyze, so you need to keep enemies in place for at least a few seconds. Coil Horizon is a good alternative as it provides electric status procs in case you didnt cast 3.

**Sickening Pulse**
This sends a spreading wave that basically doubles heat DoT, doubles toxin DoT, adds 10 stacks of corrosive (to help with full strip from 2 green archon shards) but multiplies gas and electic DoT by 10x. This is the best subsume for smaller maps with tight corridors or where you can force enemies to naturally group up as they come in, or if you have an alternate form of grouping like [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/), Vazarin Snare, [\[Telos Boltace\]](/items/arsenal/1026/telos-boltace/), [\[Nautilus\]](/items/arsenal/5415/nautilus/) [\[Cordon\]](/items/arsenal/5402/cordon/), Melee Vortex etc.

**Roar**
Boosts all DoT status effects and double dips the roar bonus. Less spammy and applies passively to all damage from both your weapons and abilities.

**Expedite Suffering**
Compresses the total duration of slash and toxin procs and deals it in one instance, then applies a multiplier. This is a great tool for disruption when paired with a good natural slash weapon such as [\[Flux Rifle\]](/items/arsenal/913/flux-rifle/), [\[Convectrix\]](/items/arsenal/928/convectrix/), Spectral Vandal or any decent slash Melee weapon (e.g. nikana prime, dual ether, kronen prime etc). 

For a specific Expedite build, use this:  https://overframe.gg/build/458639/lavos/endurance-disruption-lavos-expedite-suffering/

**Thermal Sunder**
The cold cast of Thermal Sunder acts like expedite suffering but for heat procs, so it compresses all heat procs created by Catalyze into one big blast damage instance. This also gives grouping because applying cold sunder to heat procs with sunder causes an implosion. AOE cold procs also contirbute to catalyze damage even in the absence of of Vial [\[Rush\]](/items/arsenal/839/rush/). **UNFORTUNATELY THIS IS IMPRACTICAL IN ACTUAL USE BECAUSE THERMAL SUNDER HAS A 15s BASE DURATION, MEANING THE ABILITY ACTUALLY HAS ABOUT 30s COOLDOWN**

**Pillage**
Pillage lets [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) shield gate more effectively and also strips armor which allows status effects to scale more effectively against armor.

# GAS GROUPING CATALYZE CALCULATIONS
Using a [\[Cedo\]](/items/arsenal/5358/cedo/) Primer giving blast, viral, rad, tox, electric, cold with heat and gas from catalyze gives about 8 unique status effects. If you apply this to a mecha marked enemy with 10 viral statuses, the highest gas proc that can be spread is 

2000 x 1.45 x 0.5 x 2^8 x 4.25 x 6.25 = 9,860,000 gas damage per second

If you then apply this to 10 enemies ensnared together within 3m, each enemy will deal this amount of damage per second to each other enemy in a 3m radius, meaning each enemy actually takes about 99 million gas damage per second.

If you apply Sickening Pulse and use another form of grouping, we can max this to 10 gas procs which deals 99 million damage/s per enemy but in a 6m radius i.e. 990 million damage/s if 10 enemies grouped or about 2 billion damage/s at 20 enemies.

Without Mecha Empowered active, we deal about 1.6 million gas dmg/s per enemy, or 32 million gas dmg/s in 6m area if 20 enemies are ensnared.


# HEAT INHERIT CATALYZE CALCULATIONS
Heat Inherit is a special characteristics of heat procs that causes heat proc damage to inherit the +heat% mods and +faction% mods from the very first heat stack applied to an enemy. This means you can give Catalyze heat procs an additional 5x damage multiplier from weapon mods even though it is not a weapon but priming enemies with a heat primer first.

Catalyze has a base heat damage of 2000 per cast and creates a guaranted heat status proc.
Self infusion with heat basically creates an additional instance of heat damage and a second guaranteed heat status proc per cast.

After casting all abilities and priming with a viral rad heat inherit nukor - you could get magnetic, radiation, viral, heat, elec, tox and possibly cold statuses for a maximum of 7 non-physical status effects to a small group of enemies, which magnifies Catalyze damage by a special multiplier of 2^7 = 128x. If you could swap primers or use secondary encumber to apply all 10 non-physical statuses, then you will get a multiplier of 2^10 = 1024x.

The viral applied by the primer gives a multiplier of 4.25x

On an enemy affected by mecha set mark, the bonus damage of [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) (2.5x) actually applies twice to status effects for a final multiplier of 2.5x2.5 = 6.25x

Using a heat inherit primer, we can give allow catalyze to inherit the +heat% mods giving 1+1.65+0.6 ([\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) + [\[Scorch\]](/items/arsenal/401/scorch/) with no riven) = 3.25x as well as one faction mod of +55% giving a total of 3.25 x 1.55 = 5.03x

Finally Grineer enemies with cloned flesh and many Infested enemies take +25% increased damage to heat giving 1.25x multiplier.

Therefore, the final possible heat proc damage per second inflicted by one cast of Catalyze on a FULLY heat primed enemy (with 10 statuses and max viral) and affected by [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/) is:

2000 (base dmg) x 1.45 (strength) x 0.5 (DoT modifier) x 3 ([\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) + self infused heat) x 2^7 (status modifier) x 4.25 (10 viral stacks) x 6.25 ([\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/)) x 5.03 (heat inherit) x 1.25 (cloned flesh bonus) = approximately 92 million damage per second. With 10 statuses, this becomes 740 million damage per second.

Assuming the enemy doesn't die INSTANTLY (which would probably only be possible against levelcap armored grineer/corrupted enemies - for example a level 9999 corrupted heavy gunner has about 3.2 billion EHP), each cast of sickening pulse would double this allowing it to hit damage cap 2.14 billion dmg/s procs after 3 casts (not really practical due to cooldown).

In comparison, a single cast of cold sunder would compress the 9 seconds of heat procs into a single 8 billion damage instance of blast damage.

[[ youtube id="/IOghRupl81Y" ]]

This is a Celestial Clash focused build for maximising potential damage output of Celestial Clash while spamming most abilities. As a side effect of armor strip and roar buff you can also use weapons to kill effectively although there is a better dedicated weapon platform setup.

You will ideally need [\[Shade Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6128/shade-prime/) or [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) to turn one of your brothers permanently invisible so they can use Arcane Crepuscular which is a huge damage boost to Celestial Clash. I recommend turning Sirius permanently invisible as Sirius deals more average damage due to strength from crepuscular being more valuable on Sirius since it also affects Roar.

**UPDATE AUG 2026** - Sirius now creates a forced heat proc on Celestial Clash which significantly increases overall damage potentially, and benefits from both [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) and Heat Inherit Priming. We can keep [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) at rank 0 since we only need the passive effect of doubling heat procs rather than the health. I have taken off [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) on Sirius since Celestial Clash is line of sight and has a very high base range already. Note that [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) Stars should definitely be removed since it can cause reverse heat inherit (potentially make heat procs weaker) if you are running a primer or sentinel with modded heat/faction.

**UPDATE JUNE 2026** - [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) Stars now activates Arcane Hotshot meaning we can preserve this ability if you want to use Hotshot particularly on a weapon platform setup, so subsume over Sirius 3 now**

# HELMINTH
You cannot cast any abilities while in Celestial Clash meaning you should run helminth abilities that run on duration that benefit both frames e.g. Roar.

Make Sirius your primary son and subsume Roar onto Sirius 3 so you can still use [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) Stars for a Weapon Platform setup. Roar will buff both frames. 

I would suggest subsuming Roar onto Sirius in TWO configs slots as you can also use Roar in a dedicated weapon buff setup as seen here: https://www.arsenyx.com/builds/B78im78Ufy

# CELESTIAL CLASH 
See Spreadsheet for damage calculations (Select FILE -> MAKE A COPY to edit): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CcY9AOad109LR6dMfuY6n-eUE1E6sdq0mmxBTXI1hwc/edit?usp=sharing

According to calculations, [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) is now better than [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) on Sirius due to Roar double dipping heat procs, and strength boosting both Roar and 4 on Sirius.

Things that affect or do not affect damage

- Tenacious Bond NO
- Nourish NO

# PLAYSTYLE
There are a few ways to use Celestial Clash. 

**LAZY MODE**
Inverting controls makes it so you always swap forms on tapping an ability rather than holding. Now you can just simply always tap buttons to build up Constellation stars and then when you hit maximum you just alternate left and right mouse buttons to use Celestial Clash, which is the simplest 'pattern' of use.

1. Tap 1 repeatedly to swap forms and build up stars while simultaneously stripping enemies and picking up drops. Occasionally tap 3 too.
2. Occasionally Tap 2 to recast roar in Sirius and activate Astral Shell in Orion. When Roar is subsumed tapping 2 will not swap out of Sirius but will still swap out of Orion.
3. Once constellations are built up enter 4 and alternative between left and right mouse clicks.

**MAXIMUM DAMAGE POTENTIAL**
If you want to absolutely maximise celestial clash DPS with specific combos then you'll want to snapshot invisibility onto Sirius (see invisibility bug below) and build more stars with Sirius than Orion. i.e. do SSOSSOS or OSSOSSO.

**ORION'S BELT COMBO**
However you will likely not be able to armor strip or apply viral statuses to new enemies while you are floating in Celestial Clash meaning the last 3 to 4 hits will likely do less damage than the first 3 hits. Thus, the best way to consistently kill enemies is actually to do only a three star combo of SSO repeatedly. What this requires is using DEFAULT controls and do the following:
1. Lock Invisibility onto Sirius
2. While starting in Sirius tap 1 TWICE
3. Hold 1 to swap to Orion and strip enemies right in front of you. Use a viral primer at this step optionally. 
4. Enter 4 and click RIGHT LEFT LEFT
5. The last blow will be Sirius at the biggest damage and also end you on Sirius, allowing you to repeat the chain again.  

**MOBILITY**
You can enter Celestial Clash and dash around in the air very fast with roll, which can be boosted with amalgam barrel diffusion. The movement speed while floating is also boosted by Okina Prime/[\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) Incarnon. Exiting refunds the cost making this a free mobility tool.

# INVISIBILITY BUG
There is also currently a bug with [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) where if you make one frame invisible, swap frames then wait for that one to turn invisible too, immediately break invisibility by shooting then swap back, the first frame will be permanently invisible even while attacking or if [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) dies. The other brother will often uncloak when enemies nearby die, if [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) dies or if you shoot.

# SURVIVABILITY
Every time you swap warframes you become invulnerable for 1.5s and then once you enter Celestial Clash every time you attack you become invulnerable for about 0.6s. If you are actively casting abilities to build up constellations and using Celestial Clash you can basically chain i-frames constantly. Your Shield gate will also give you an extra 1.33s i-frame on break and naturally regenerate over time especially while the inactive frame is immortal. 

Finally one brother e.g. Sirius will be permanently invisible if using [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) bug, while Orion's Astral Shell also negates an instance of damage on both frames.

# STAT BREAKDOWN

**Duration**
Duration is really only needed on Sirius for Roar uptime and Light's [\[Sanctuary\]](/items/arsenal/243/sanctuary/) Uptime as well as on Orion for Astral Shell and Event Horizon. However, since you are often casting the combos to charge up Celestial Clash, you will be recasting so often you barely need to actually run much duration on Orion.

**Efficiency/Economy**
The passive gives +45% efficiency on the next two casts after swapping frames and when a frame drops under 50 it will steal energy from the other frame. Arcane Energize triggers 150 energy gain to allies in an AOE meaning having it on Orion and picking up an orb as Orion also restores 150 energy on Sirius. [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is good consistent energy generation on Sirius since it frees the arcane slot for more valuable stat increases e.g. Molt Augmented/Arcane Concentration.

**Range**
This is a useful stat on both Orion and Sirius since is affects the range of Celestial Slash from both frames, as well as range of Event Horizon on Orion and Light's [\[Sanctuary\]](/items/arsenal/243/sanctuary/) on Sirius. Keep in mind that Celestial Clash as an extremely high base range of 26m and is line of sight, so having just [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) gives 37m which is big enough to cover most rooms already. You may want to adjust this to 235% range with [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) if the tileset has much bigger rooms.

**Strength**
Strength is a very important stat on both Orion and Sirius mainly to boost Celestial Clash damage, but is most important on Sirius since it boosts both Roar and Celestial Clash. [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) is mathematically better on Sirius due to boosting both Roar and Clash while Precision is better on Orion. Orion only needs 200% strength to full strip with one cast of Gravitic Slash which is easily reached.

**Aura**
Does not matter which aura goes on which brother:
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) helps reduce armor globally, including enemies NOT hit by Orion 1 especially since you cannot really strip all enemies particularly while you are in Celestial Clash for extended periods. Note that Orion 1 cannot strip armor through overguard, making Corrosive Projection especially valuable against eximus and Thrax.

- Growing Power for more strength for both frames. Having the uncontrolled frame shoot for you procs Growing Power passively.

Orion:
- Power Donation is ideal and gives +30% to Sirius but be careful as it has been reported to bug as client and apply -30% simultaneously to both frames and even stack the negative effect multiple times.

**Exilus**
Completely flexible on both frames
- Ice Spring for parkour mobility while not in Celestial Clash
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Power Drift for more strength
- Primed Sure Footed to prevent knockdowns

# ARCHON SHARDS
2 Cast
3 Strength - for maximising Celestial Clash damage since it double dips on Sirius

Technically Ability Damage shards boost Celestial Clash more than strength but this requires an external primer to apply either radiation, corrosive or electric which is not as consistent as just using strength.

# ARCANES
- Arcane Crepuscular - more strength and critical damage which applies to Celestial Clash but needs you to run an invisible companion e.g. Shade/Huras. With shade invisibility bug you can make ONE of your brothers permanently invisible meaning 100% crepuscular uptime.
- Arcane Concentration - more duration for roar uptime on Sirius.
- Arcane Energize - optional for energy economy, might be sufficient to have it on only one frame so adjust to your needs
-  Molt Augmented - more strength for Celestial Clash damage and Roar
- Arcane Circumvent - allows you to strip overguard and armor while dodging in Celestial Clash but a little buggy
- Arcane Hotshot - [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) stars activates hotshot for crit cance which only affects weapons, not celestial clash

# ARSENAL
**Companion**
Use [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) with [\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/) and [\[Tazicor\]](/items/arsenal/2224/tazicor/) to stay invisible, activate arcane crepuscular and duplex bond clones will AOE prime viral and magnetic to improve damage

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

**UPDATED FOR PERSISTENCE - TEXT MAY BE OUTDATED NOW**

This is a niche face tanking [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) build that lets [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) stand still, take damage and stay alive. This is made posible by the combination of Gloom (subsumed from [\[Sevagoth\]](/items/arsenal/5429/sevagoth/)) and Spores. Gloom gives you lifesteal from all damage sources with an infinite range, meaning as long as spores are doing damage, you can heal back any damage taken. With spores and gloom active, you should be healing approximately 7 to 8% lifesteal/second. At 1000 spore damage, this means you heal at a rate of 80 health PER enemy affected. If 10 enemies are affected at 1000 spore damage, you are healing at a rate of 800 health/second. This means you can basically heal your entire health pool every second, and as long as spores are active and an enemy does not take off all your health in one shot, you are effectively immortal by just standing still.

This differs slightly from other Gloom [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) builds due to the use of [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) and lower strength, with a focus more on taking hits to regenerate energy rather than achieving maximum slow crowd control and relying on arcane energize procs. Note that this build is NOT suited for endurance, where you will probably get one-shot regardless of heal rate at around level 500-1000 if you stand still and get shot.

Polarities are shared with a general use offensive Saryn build: https://overframe.gg/build/207018/

You can alter polarities based on your preference.

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Positive duration helps reduce the energy drain of gloom, but also benefits uptime of toxic lash and reduces decay of spores.

**Efficiency**
It may seem like 100% efficiency is too low, but Saryn's immense energy pool combined with hunter adrenaline +/-arcane energize allows reasonably easy energy maintenence. Feel free to add [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) over [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) if you prefer less drain or don't own arcane energize.

**Range**
As with most [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) builds, range is essential for spreading spores. Gloom also affects more enemies with high range, but note that since energy drain from Gloom is capped at 10 enemies, higher range is unlikely to affect your overall energy drain.

**Strength** 
At 139% strength, gloom gives 49% slow. You can increase this with growing power and/or pax bolt to hit 66% slow. Why do we not want the slow to hit the cap of 95%? WIth the high range that [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) requires, slowing all enemies beyond walls will make missions take forever and be conterintuitive for survival missions. In addition, to regain energy with hunter adrenaline, we actually *want* enemies to shoot us at a reasonable rate.

**Flexible slots**
- [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/) is very useful that could be used in exilus as you can begin the mission with near full energy and therefore cast gloom straight away, although having hunter adrenaline gives easy energy anyway
- Primed sure footed/handspring for knockdown resistance
- [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) and [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) provide higher EHP and healing buffer but can be replaced by more power strength or efficiency if preferred.

**Arcanes**
- Energize is good for energy gain, but if you get hit on purpose, hunter adrenaline will fill energy to max in seconds
- Guardian for improving damage reduction
- Avenger for crits

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Use zenurik or energy pads to gain reasonable buffer of energy (can skip this with [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/))
2. Activate 3 toxic lash and cast 1 spores on an enemy, then shoot them to spread the spores
3. Activate 2 gloom
4. Kill enemies
5. Let spores spread which will heal you, make sure the spore count NEVER runs out otherwise you will stop healing and die easily
6. If energy is running low, let the enemies shoot you to regain some energy or kill enemies faster to drop energy orbs

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate 2 and 4 and keep active. Taking damage while 2 is active will let you quickly regenerate energy.
2. Spam 1 + cold sunder (hold 3) until battery hits 100%. You can also alternate casts of cold and heat while at 100% battery but still waiting for Redline to hit 100%. This will allow you to armor strip and nuke before maximum redline.
3. When at maximum redline, you can start spamming heat sunder (tap 1) as needed. To strip armor just cast a cold sunder after heat sunder. To deal a large amount of damage quickly, spam heat sunder 2-5 times (tap 3) then cast cold sunder (hold 3) to full strip and compress heat procs into one big instance of blast damage.

[[ youtube id="5IeeolUHEc4?si=PbtdCfd6c0GYH5zP" ]]

# INTRODUCTION
This is a general use [\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/) build for steel path and endurance steel path with high range for full strip with Tharros Strike and Final Stand explosions. Survivability in endurance is from a combination of overguard generated by the augment Intrepid stand (which gives extra 0.5s i-frame gate from depleting overguard) and shield gating (another 0.33 to 2.5s gate) which is complemented by the shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) from Rally Point. Axios Javelin has questionable targetting and can be replaced with Nourish to boost energy gain, raw weapon damage, final stand raw damage and allows final stand to have a small chance of creating viral status. You can add [\[Tharros Lethality\]](/items/arsenal/7503/tharros-lethality/) to add slightly more weapon focus to the build.

[\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/)'s passive is not specifically worth building excessive amounts of shield for since it is only additive to mods. Even with 2-3 shield mods, the maximum shield + overshield you can reach is about 4000, which equates to 100% additive crit chance or only half of a single Critical Delay, and 2/3rds of what [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) can [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) by simply jumping without having to maintain shields. 

**UPDATE FEB 2025**
Since the health and armor changes, [\[Styanax\]](/items/arsenal/5927/styanax/) 4 is even worse than before for DPS. Arcane Truculence is a nice choice to help maximise DPS since 10 viral status in 30m can boost damage up to 4.25x more consistently than Panzer priming.

**UPDATE JULY 2023**
The new augment [\[Intrepid Stand\]](/items/arsenal/6221/intrepid-stand/) allows Final Stand to generate overguard on each enemy hit, which scales with strength. Since overguard now has 0.5s gate, Styanax is effectively immortal as long as you are hitting enemies in 4. 

# ALTERNATE BUILDS
Pure Weapon platform (non-Final Stand):  https://overframe.gg/build/1026089/

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Rally Point and Nourish at the beginning to start passively generating energy.
2. Cast Tharros Strike to full strip armor everywhere
3. Cast Final Stand and aim at groups of enemies to kill them while simultaneously generating shields and overguard.

# SURVIVABILITY
1. Overguard
[\[Intrepid Stand\]](/items/arsenal/6221/intrepid-stand/) constantly produces overguard when you hit enemies with Final Stand. In lower levels this Overguard can last long enough that you don't even need to care about any additional survivability. In higher levels where Overguard is oneshot by every bullet, breaking overguard always gives 0.5s of invulnerability. If you immediately regenerate overguard again in that 0.5s gap due to [\[Intrepid Stand\]](/items/arsenal/6221/intrepid-stand/) you are effectively immortal while hitting enemies in Final Stand.

2. Passive Shield Gating
Rally Point generates 50 shield per kill scaling with strength, so roughly 100 shield near 200% strength. If you kill about 11 to 12 enemies in one go due to Final Stand, melee influence or any other AOE weapons this generates over 1100 overshield which gives 2.5s of i-frames upon breaking. This means even after Overguard breaks you often have another 2.5s of leeway to either click Final Stand again or kill a few enemies to generate more shield and continue the cycle. Killing just one enemy restores enough for a 0.33s shield gate which may be sufficient in itself.

3. Active Shield Gating
This is more necessary in endurance situations (i.e. levelcap cascade) where you instantly lose shields and overguard every hit, there are no enemies around to restore shields via Rally Point and you may not want to be casting Final Stand e.g. facing a single strong target. Having Augur mods (+/- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/)) allows you to have on demand shield gate by casting Tharros Strike.

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Duration is important for easier upkeep of Rally Point, Nourish, as well as the duration and therefore total damage output of Final Stand. 
On the other hand Tharros strike is not affected by duration at all.

**Efficiency**
Nourish allows you to run negative efficiency, either at 45%, since we can double energy gain from both Rally Point (approximately 10 energy/s) and other sources such as Equilibrium. Without Nourish, might want to keep efficiency neutral or adjust to preference as you only generate about 5 energy/s with rally point (300 energy/minute). Finally, [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is a huge source of energy since it converts health orbs into energy meaning each health orb is 55 energy. Every eximus kill guarantees 2 health orbs or 110 energy while Synth Deconstruct on Panzer/Hound causes lots of more health orbs to drop.

If you constantly spam 4 at 155% duration which lasts about 4s, this means you could be casting this 15 times per minute. Each cast costs 155 energy at 45% efficiency meaning in minute you would need 2325 energy to sustain. If you are not spamming 4 as much and don't feel like energy is an issue, you can drop Equilbrium and just rely on Nourish boosted Rally Point (which is about 600energy per minute). 

**Range**
High range is needed for the pull range of Axios Javelin (if kept), range of Tharros Strike and Explosion range of Final Stand.

**Strength**
Strength is important for Tharros Strikes armor/shield strip, which requires either 200% strength to full strip in one cast or just 164% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) in aura. Strength also boosts Rally Points shield on kill and energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/), as well as overall damage of Final Stand.

**Flexible Options**
Can swap over Umbral Intensify (if running red strength shards to hi 164% strength) or Equilbrium
- Tharros Lethality - optional to boost weapon crit damage after Tharros Strike for hybrid weapon platforming
- Natural Talent - speeds up cast animations, particularly of Tharros Strike and Final Stand. Use this if you don't have Amber cast speed shards.
- Rolling Guard - grants i-frames and status cleanse.
- Vigorous Swap - affects the damage of Final Stand, acting as a 2.65x damage multiplier, but requires you to swap weapons to activate, before pressing 4, although this is additive to Arcane Arachne.

**Aura**
Corrosive Projection - reduces armor from 100% to 82%, meaning you only need to strip the remaining 82% armor with Tharros strike which is hit at 164% strength. 
Growing Power - boosts all abilities but needs additional aura forma.
Brief Respite - extra shield gating on demand rather than waiting for Rally point [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/)

**Exilus**
Totally flexible for [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/), [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/) etc. [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is optional since you are knockdown immune with overguard active, but are still susceptible whenever it breaks. Ice Spring is excellent for Parkour Velocity and matches Primed Sure Footed polarity.

**Arcanes**
Truculence - spreads 10 viral in big AOE everytime you gain 3000 overguard, which is like every 5s with Intrepid Stand
Arcane Arachne - after wall latch, boosts Final Stand damage by 2.5x for 30s (+150% additive to Vigorous Swap and Naramon's Void Levitation). For weapons, the +150% dmg is additive to Serration etc.
Molt Augmented - gives +60% strength after 250 kills, boosting all abilities. Better used in longer missions.
Molt Efficiency - more duration with shields active (easy with styanax since 3 gives shields)
Arcane Concentration - more duration
Arcane Avenger - adds +45% flat crit chance to weapons, often stronger than Styanax's passive, but might need Combat Discipline in aura to trigger consistently

# ARCHON SHARDS
- ONE to TWO AMBER Cast Speed: Mandatory for speeding up final stand animation time
- THREE CRIMSON Strength or Duration: up to personal preference.
- Any number of parkour shards for mobility up to preference.

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Subsume over 1

Nourish - Nourish actually applies the +45% x strength viral damage bonus to Final Stand since it is coded like a weapon and even creates the occasional viral status proc and finally multiplies the energy gained by Rally Point as well as equilibrium.

Roar - Roar double dips on the forced slash procs but the raw damage boost to initial hits is lower than Nourish (+30% vs +45%). Consider adding Streamline or dropping Blind Rage if energy is an issue. 

# FOCUS SCHOOL
Naramon - Lethal Levitation can replace or ADD to Arcane Arachne as it adds 200% damage in the same layer as the 150% from arachne, meaning a 3x multiplier alone (or a 1.8x multiplier with arachne on). This is easy to proc with Phahd amp as you just need to press 1 and then alt fire to hit 4 levitated enemies.

Madurai - gives bonus cast speed and strength

Vazarin - good backup immortality if doing endurance

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a hybrid light attack/heavy attack melee focused [\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/) build using Shooting Gallery with [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) to provide both crowd control and melee buff and focusing on Fangs of Raksh and [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/) to spread status effects and nuke maps. [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) provides 40+ seconds of passive crowd control, needing only 6 kills (from either you, your abilities or your allies) to charge up a blind that is triggered on your next attack (either melee or gun). This keeps the map perpetually stunned allowing you to run up and use light attack melees without getting damaged. 

Finally, blinded enemies receive an additional 700% STEALTH DAMAGE MULTIPLIER to all melee attacks which itself is additive to Crit Damage (giving approximately +70-80% final melee damage boost after accounting for Shroud of Dynar), in addition to the very minor damage boost of shooting gallery itself (50% additive to [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) for <10% final boost after accounting for status effects)

**UPDATE JAN 2025**
Empty Arcane slot for Arcane Impetus which stacks up to 78% strength and 39% efficiency from just using Fangs of Raksh.

**Update Oct 2024**
Empty slot is for new [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/) augment. This marks an enemy whenever 1 is cast and makes them glow. Casting Fangs of Raksh on that enemy will take 50% more damage at base while also multiplying the final spread of Fangs of Raksh by a fixed 2.5x multiplier. At 250% range this results in a 44m status spread if the marked enemy is killed.

**Update April 2024**
[\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) no longer blinds eximus or thrax through Overguard. This means it is slightly less effective as a crowd control, but continues to be a great option for crowd control that has no line of sight and still gives the 700% bonus stealth melee damage.

**Alternate Builds**
If you are not using light attack or hybrid heavy melees that take advantage of Prey of Dynar/Fangs of Raksh, and prefer to use Heavy Slam, Glaives or Exodia Contagion, use this build instead:  https://overframe.gg/build/737864/voruna/wrathful-wolf-pure-red-crit-voruna-for-zaw-glaive-slam/

If you want to keep Ulfrun and prefer to use pure ability DPS, use this Ulfrun's Descent build: https://overframe.gg/build/410147/

For a niche but extremely strong nuke style, use Blood Altar Voruna with Gas Afflictions: https://overframe.gg/build/790836/

# Playstyle
1. Activate 3 and keep active (kill enemies afflicted by 5 statuses to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) duration passively)
2. Activate 4 and refresh when expires, getting kills to charge it (very easy and passive)
3. Press 1 to go invisible and gain melee crit damage buff (need to refresh buff once roughly every 10s) and also mark an enemy with [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/)
4. Press 2 on an enemy (ideally the marked enemy) to inflict 5 random status effects, then kill that enemy and spread status effects. If the initial 5 status effects matched any status effects you applied via your melee, these will be spread. See STATUS TAXI and ELEMENTS below for more details.
5. Repeat 1 + 2 combo on every new group of enemies

[[ youtube id="RG2qzPsHO-o" ]]

# STATUS TAXI
This refers to using Fangs of Raksh to 'taxi' status procs from your single target melee into the AOE range of Fangs. For example when using an weapon with forced slash on heavy like [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) and other scythes, this requires you to proc SLASH out of the 5 statuses on the INITIAL hit of Fangs. Proccing slash on a second hit or subsequent hits on the same enemy does NOT count. Once you inflict a STRONGER forced slash proc from heavy attack, that STRONG slash proc plus the 10 weaker slash procs will be averaged and then be trasnferred by Fangs to every enemy in an appproximately 18 m radius, OR 44m radius if performed a target marked by [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/), provided the enemy did NOT die to raw damage before the strong slash proc could be applied. If you add Melee Afflictions into the mix, you will be transferring the average of 10 weak slash procs with 7 strong slash procs in up to 44m radius. This also works with other damaging statuses such as electric, gas, toxin and heat however to transfer strong statuses created by heavy attacks consistently you will need the weapon to have extremely high status chance since most weapons do not have forced procs outside of slash.

**Statuses**
Slash is the preferred status on certain weapons with forced slash (scythes, claws, nikanas) since it is consistently guaranteed on every heavy, and melee afflictions can consistently multiply that by 7 again.

Gas is a great status for maximising KPM on a map since Gas procs lingers and have an AOE meaning they can kill new enemies that simply walk into clouds.

Electric is standard with melee influence setups so this goes well if you manage to proc electric with Raksh.

# Survivability
**For Endurance**
Crowd control from [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) provides the bulk of survivability while using light attack spam. If you take any breakthrough damage simple tap 1 to go invisible AND generate some shields for shield gate. Vazarin protective dash can be a final layer of ultimate survivability in an Endurance situation where you find yourself out of energy or unable to cast abilities (e.g. against Violence).

**Health Tanking**
If you prefer to health tank in casual missions rather than shield gate, add Arcane Blessing, Arcane Guardian/Reepar, Adaptation and Health Conversion. Just note this isn't THAT recommended due to high forma/mod cost and limitations of health tanking on a frame that can simply turn invisible, with no innate damage reduction. 

You can also scale the health tanking to levelcap with arcane persistence however this requires heavy investment with multiple umbral mods/umbral forma and armor shards to hit the 700 armor breakpoint and is generally not worth the investment unless you really feel like it.

# Build Specifics
**Duration**
Positive duration helps uptime of 1 and 3, but you don't need to go overboard as the base invisibility duration is very long and you will likely remove it immediately upon melee attacking. Furthermore, getting melee kills is able to increase the duration of both the melee buff of 1 and overall duration of 3. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is **optional** as 2 is able to create toxin procs which subsequently forces 1 corrosive proc even if corrosive was not created by 2, for extra [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) damage and mild armor strip. I would suggest you DON'T use Achon mods initially as you don't want to use up mod capacity since it affects starting energy. You need exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/) at the beginning of the mission.

**Efficiency**
[\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/) is able to run negative efficiency with [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) on a melee focused build due to Lycath's [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/) (3) forcing health orb drops on melee kills and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) giving 55 energy per health orb. In addition Arcane Impetus now gives bonus free efficiency.

**Range**
Range is maximised for the spread radius of Fangs of Raksh (2), giving up to 17m range of status spread (and about 30m with [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/)), as well as the range of [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/). This allows you to nuke maps with either the 'status taxi' mechanic or simply via the damaging DoTs (blast, heat, electric, toxin, gas) created by Fangs of Raksh, as well as prime entire rooms with useful statuses such as viral, corrosive or cold.

**Strength**
Strength is mainly to boost the melee crit damage buffs from 1, status damage from 2 and dmg buff of shooting gallery so you don't need a huge amount of strength unless running a helminth like Roar.

**Passive**
You can swap between passives based on preference and mission type e.g. use parkour velocity for quick missions or to get between points faster, use status immunity when using AOE weapons or for general survivability and use heavy efficiency when using x12 melee builds. Since we subsume off 4, you will not be using 4 passive.

**Aura**
- Corrosive Projection for armor strip (effectively multiplies damage against armor by 1.8x)
- Brief Respite for shield gating
- Growing power for more strength
- Mecha Empowered if using a kubrow
- Enemy Radar for quality of life

**Exilus**
Completely flexible:
- Cunning Drift for range
- Ice Spring for mobility
- Power Drift for strength
- Primed Sure Footed for knockdown immunity if you dont use 2 passive.
- Vigilante Pursuit for radar 

**Arcanes**
Completely optional and up to preference:
- Impetus - gives strength and efficiency and can stack to maximum from Fangs of Raksh
- Crepuscular - only works for certain weapons that can 'hit and run', as you only leave invisibility AFTER hitting with melee but need to recast invis immediately e.g. Slam, Contagion
- Augmented - boosts strength to further boost Crit Damage buff of 1
- Strike - more melee attack speed
- Fury - more melee damage 
- Blessing - if you prefer to tank, which also mega boosts the health of a pet running link health

**Archon Shards**
1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard helps with feel of spamming 1 and 2 constantly
1 Tauforged Azure Energy Max (to hit 500 energy for Violet shard bonus - this is ONLY required on base [\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/), [\[Voruna Prime\]](/items/arsenal/7937/voruna-prime/) can hit the 500 energy without shard)
2 to 3 Tauforged Violet Melee Crit Damage shard optional if using melee weapons
2 Tauforged Violet [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) shards can help replace [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) if you need more mod space e.g. for Augur Reach, Catalyzing Shield, Vigorous Swap etc

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Melee damage boosting options include:
- Wrathful Advance - adds even more flat crit chance bonus to melees, allowing some melees to red crit easily
- Roar - boosts DoT and triple dips on status spread via Fangs of Raksh. This also applies to ulfrun if you are using it.

Crowd control options include:
- Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash - blinds enemies allowing you to freely spam light attacks without invisibility, and also forces stealth melee multiplier (700% crit dmg additive to crit multiplier)
- Silence - Stuns enemies for 2s and shuts off all eximus/acolyte abilities. [\[Savage Silence\]](/items/arsenal/79/savage-silence/) augment also applies the stealth melee multiplier to stunned enemies. Drop range to 100 to 145% so you can permanently stun enemies while mobile since you can keep making enemies exit and re-enter silence range.
- Gloom - Swap [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) and [\[Muzzle Flash\]](/items/arsenal/95/muzzle-flash/) for [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/), [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) for [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/). This is because the drain from Gloom + casting abilities can be unsustainable at 45% efficiency even with Lycaths hunt, and you want more strength to get closer to the slow cap.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

General Use Steel path build allowing [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) to fry enemies through her electric abilities. Coil Horizon is used to group enemies which greatly boosts the effectiveness of electric status since they chain to another 5 enemies. Coil Horizon also deals electric damage + status innately AND triggers Rotorswell discharges for more damage. 

Cathode Grace gives some slow energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) (approximately 180 energy per minute) but also boosts crit chance of both weapons and abilities. The augment [\[Cathode Current\]](/items/arsenal/6058/cathode-current/) is also used to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the duration of Rotorswell indefinitely and provide an additional discharge for more damage.

Rotorswell is the main source of damage with, dealing damage passively in approximately 9m aura (requires line of sight) and also chaining electricity to enemies damage by a critical hit dealt by either your weapons OR abilities such as Coil Horizon (also requires line of sight). 

Good helminth options include Nourish, which multiplies energy gain from both Cathode Grace and Archon Stretch, Armor Strip, which improves the scaling of electric damage/procs against armor, Sickening Pulse which multiplies current total electric proc damage by approximately 10 times or more crowd control. 

Nourish Weapon Platform Variant (Ultra-comfy passive gate): https://overframe.gg/build/837133/
Pillage Variant: https://overframe.gg/build/490498/

# HOW TO PLAY
1. Press 3 to activate Cathode Grace at the beginning of the mission. You will have approximately 10s to start getting kills to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) the duration of 3, which caps at 60 seconds after approximately 13 kills, so don’t activate this when there are zero enemies around to kill otherwise you will enter a long cooldown. As long as you get kills you will not need to recast 3 (unless you get nullified or silenced by Violence). This combined with Archon Stretch will keep you constantly regenerating energy at approximately 5 energy/s or 300 energy / min. 
2. Press 4 to activate Rotorswell at the beginning of the mission. As long as you get kills with Cathode Grace active, Rotorswell will also [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) its duration indefinitely and you not need to recast 4. 
3. Press 2 to group and crowd control enemies whenever possible. This will effectively prevent enemies from shooting you (unless they have Overguard), and also exponentially magnifies the damage from electric status due to the chaining mechanics.
4. Press 1 to shield gate and shoot through the orb to apply [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) buff (forced electric procs and added electric damage)

Gameplay with Pillage Variant on SP Circuit:

[[ youtube id="ggLUFUupD8E" ]]

# SURVIVABILITY
Since [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) doesn’t have much health, armor or damage resistance, she relies heavily on crowd control and shield gating. 

Coil Horizon and Rotorswell both provide soft CC. Coil Horizon drags enemies into a ball preventing them from shooting while Rotorswell is able to passively stun enemies briefly due to electric procs. This should reduce the frequency of you getting shot. 

Whenever your shields break, you can immediately tap 1 or 2 to reset your shields. With [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/), [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) has 130 shield. With [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/), [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) and TWO additional Augur Mods on your secondary primer, one cast of Coil Horizon costs 50 energy which regenerates 135 shield, giving a full 1.33s iframes.

As final backup, it is recommended to run Vazarin protective sling for 5s iframe with no cooldown. [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is optional for 3s iframes.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Roughly neutral duration is all you need to give Cathode Grace about 8 to 10s initial duration. Once you get kills within that time frame, duration doesn’t matter at all since you can [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) both 3 and 4 indefinitely as long as you continue getting kills. Coil Horizon does not scale with duration and most of the helminth options do not need much duration either.

**Efficiency**
[\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) can generate approximately 300 energy per minute with Cathode Grace + [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) or up to 800 energy per minute with Nourish. You will want to be casting Coil Horizon and using a viral corrosive heat primer every 5-10s with each new group of enemies, requiring anywhere between 400 to 800 energy per minute. You can add more passive energy regeneration if you want, i.e. via [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/), [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/), [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) [\[Xata Invocation\]](/items/arsenal/6367/xata-invocation/), Primary Exhilarate or [\[Emergence Dissipate\]](/items/arsenal/5753/emergence-dissipate/).

**Range**
Range is her most important stat since it affects the range of Arcsphere, range of Coil Horizon's grouping and range of passive Rotorswell aura to about 9m and range on on crit rotorswell discharge to over 20m. Use Overextended + Archon Stretch to hit this. Archon Stretch is also nice because it triggers from electric damage and gives 200 energy/min on top of cathode grace.

**Strength**
Strength is her second most important stat since it affects the damage of her electric dicharges from Rotorswell, damage of Coil Horizon as well as energy [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) and crit chance boost from Cathode Grace. Most armor strips also have a strength threshold you need to hit e.g. 200% for Tharros Strike, 167% for Terrify, 200% for Pillage two cast, 400% for pillage one cast, or 328% for pillage in one cast with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/).

After [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/), [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) and Molt Augmented, we hit 223% str, allowing full strip from Tharros Strike.

**Aura**
Brief respite is required for active shield gate (unless you have augur mods on secondary/[\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/))
Use [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) instead if you have augur mods or pillage subsumed

**Exilus**
[\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/), [\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/), [\[Proton Pulse\]](/items/arsenal/2520/proton-pulse/) flexible in exilus
[\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is best for preventing knockdowns, so you may need [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/) or a crimson shard if u want to slot this.

**Flexible Options**
If you don't own any of the above mods or want to make other changes, you can always add:
More strength - transient fortitude, umbral intensify, augur secrets
More range - [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) 

**Archon Shards**
1 Amber cast speed 
OPTIONAL : 2 Parkour Velocity for mobility
OPTIONAL : 2 to 4 Violet +ability dmg on electric status if focusing on Ability DPS
OPTIONAL : 2 to 4 Violet +electric damage on primary if focusing on primary weapon platform

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
Either Arcsphere or Coil Horizon could be subsumed over, depending on if you like to use [\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) or not. I prefer to remove [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) due to how annoying it is to actually use, as it often bounces to the wrong place and requires a second key tap to actually group.

**Nourish**
Gives free viral to your weapons and also multiplies all energy gained via Cathode Grace and [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/). The base energy gain is approximately 5 energy per second at 200 str. WIth Nourish this increases to approximately 13 energy per second or about 800 energy per minute.

**Armor Strip** 
This allows the electric procs to scale against steel path armored grineer and corrupted. At very high levels enemy armor can provide between 90% to 99.9% damage reduction. Removing 90% damage reduction is equivalent to increasing the effectiveness of electric damage by 10x. Removing 99% damage reduction is equivalent to increasing damage by 100x.

There are multiple good AOE armor strip options available:

- Tharros Strike: My preferred option because it is cheap to cast, full strips both armor and shields at only 200% strength and works on Acolytes and Demolysts. Tharros Strike's main issue is the lower range and non-radial area of effect, requiring you to aim towards enemies and missing any enemies behind you. This is somewhat overcome by grouping abilities such as [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/)'s Coil Horizon, which groups enemies radially so you can strip all enemies in one cast. Tharros Strike also heals you.

- Pillage: Another great option, but requires 328% strength with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) to full strip armor, which means you need either Blind Rage or external strength boosts such as Madurai, Archon Shards etc. Pillage also provides shields/overshields back to [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/) allowing you to shield gate without [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) + augur mods, as well as cleansing status. Pillage cannot strip both shields and armor simultaneously, so when facing an acolyte, you must remove shields first (takes 2 casts of pillage, or just shoot with a weapon), then cast pillage. https://overframe.gg/build/490498/

- Terrify: Terrify has the best radial non-line of sight armor strip for regular enemies and only requires 167% strength for full strip, but is NOT permanent and does NOT affect Acolytes or Demolysts. It also does provide crowd control but makes enemies run away from you which can sometimes be more frustrating than helpful, depending on the mission.

**Sickening Pulse**
This creates an expanding pulse with line of sight that effectively multiplies the total electric status damage currently on an enemy by 10x. This works very well when cast into a group of enemies all affected by electric status from rotorswell.

**Crowd Control**
- Shooting Gallery: With the augment Muzzle Flash, you can keep maps completely locked down as long as you get kills and also blinds/stuns Eximus THROUGH overguard. If you 
- Resonator: Shuts down enemy aggression, but does not affect eximus or acolytes.
- Breach Surge: Blinds eximus with line of sight

# ARSENAL
[\[Conductive Sphere\]](/items/arsenal/7265/conductive-sphere/) applies FORCED electric status per shot (scaling with multishot) and multiplies the electric status damage but additively to elementalist mods/multiuplicatively to +electric mods (which is unlike most other similar buffs e.g. [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) [\[Valence Formation\]](/items/arsenal/6483/valence-formation/)). This means weapons with high multishot work well and any weapon you do use, you MUST still mod +electric mods (e.g. stormbringer/[\[Shocking Touch\]](/items/arsenal/361/shocking-touch/)).

**PRIMARY WEAPONS**

## INTRODUCTION
This is an endurance steel path focused build using [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) to deal damage and the [\[Rubble Heap\]](/items/arsenal/4612/rubble-heap/) augment to allow [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) to be spammed for zero energy cost. Helminth option is flexible, e.g. armor strip for scaling the raw damage against armor, crowd control for survivability or breach surge for both crowd control and damage.  Note [\[Rubble Heap\]](/items/arsenal/4612/rubble-heap/) does require upkeep from using petrify onto large crowds of enemies. This means it can be tricky to sustain outside of Solo if your squad keeps nuking enemies before you can petrify them.

**Survivability**
Landslide provides short i-frames (invulnerability frames) during the animation. We can utilise passive shield recharge with Fast Deflection/[\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) so your shields start regenerating within 1s of not taking damage i.e. during the [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) invulnerability, so that whenever you come out of landslide you should hopefully be back to having a 1.33s gate. Active shield gating with augur mods/[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) does NOT work on this build since [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) has 0 cost above 1400 rubble due to [\[Rubble Heap\]](/items/arsenal/4612/rubble-heap/). You also get some aggro draw from Rumblers and crowd control from occasional petrify casts. Armor from Rubble (up to 1500) gives some damage reduction (which falls off in endurance). 

## ATLAS FISTS BUILDS
ELECTRIC INFLUENCE NUKE: https://overframe.gg/build/825694/
GAS AFFLICTIONS: https://overframe.gg/build/825695/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Use petrify to turn groups of enemies into stone, then kill them with your weapons to generate rubble, until you get above 1400 rubble
2. Spam [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) to kill enemies
3. Occasionally cast 3 and 4 to petrify enemies to maintain 1400 rubble

## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Use neutral or positive duration for helminth ability. Otherwise if you are not using helminth you can even have duration negative (70%ish) since Petrify has a long base duration. 

**Efficiency**
Rubble Heap makes Landslide cost no damage, and equilibrium sustains energy for casting of Petrify/Rumbler

**Range**
High Range is needed for increasing the AOE of [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) (approx 14m at 3+ hits), Resonator [\[Charm\]](/items/arsenal/205/charm/) radius, Petrify cone length and Rumbler's petrification radius. [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) has been used here over [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) simply for the shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) set bonus. Swap this out for [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) if you don't need the shield gating.

**Strength**
Needed for [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) damage and damage subsume

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) reduces armor.

**Exilus**
Can run anything you prefer e.g. cunning drift for range, vigilante pursuit, conductor

**ARCHON SHARDS**
1 to 2 cast speed - speeds up petrify and rumbler cast
3 to 4 violet melee crit dmg shards

Helminth Options:
- Nourish - adds viral which boosts all dmg to health by 4.25x and also multiplies energy gain, comfy option
- Roar - double dips DoT and triple dips influence
- Wrathful Advance - flat crit chance boost allows you to easily hit red crits

[[ youtube id="3NNeRbkFOZA?si=rE-5ZikVLkBAKTlO" ]]

**UPDATE JUNE 2026**
Arcane Sculptor triggers off shadowgraph and sets efficiency to 175%, which allows you to build much higher range with Overextended and Blind Rage while having maximum efficiency.

# ABILITIES
Passive - Enemies affected by "inkblot" have 50% slow and a 20% chance to drop a mix of 3 health and energy orbs on death, which basically helps upkeeps energy.

1. Forced perspective - cleanses status and gives 3.5s invulnerability  with a fixed 100m range. This also applies inkblot in a small radius which is useful for detonating barrels and providing energy back.
2. Shadow graph - pretty broken ability that has a multitude of effects. Explosive barrel, arc trap and thermian RPG are all scaling AOE damage options. Arc Trap is the simplest to use and deals 250 base damage + 2.5% enemy HP. Explosive barrel deals 65%hp damage and ignores armor but requires you to detonate it by shooting directly, applying corrosive (eg via inkblot or primer) or teleporting into them (which makes inkblot corrosive). Several shadowgraphs (amphors, death orb) can also apply more statuses for arcane impetus.
3. Self portrait - makes a much larger radius of inkblot than forced perspective which helps with energy production
4. Plein Air - lifts enemies up with balloons and strips armor but quite annoying to use since it moves them out of range of arc traps and barrels and even makes them harder to actually shoot. 

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Keep 3 active in each new zone to passively apply inkblot everywhere, enduring a source of energy
2. For Barrel spam: hold 2 to select Explosive Barrel and then tap 2, aim at it and tap 1 to teleport to it which instantly detonates it 
3. For Arc Trap Spam: hold 2 to select Arc Traps and spam tap 2 everywhere (keep in mind you can only have 3 arc traps active)
4. To kill Acolytes, swap to Thermian RPG and shoot them
5. To survive try to spam 1 everywhere at least once every 3.5s to stay invulnerable, although if you have catalyzing shield + shield gate mods on you can also just survive by spamming 2.
6. Optional - cast 4 to make enemies float, then shoot the balloons to make them drop and take damage OR subsume over 4 with Roar and keep Roar active

# STAT/MOD BREAKDOWN

**Duration**
Duration affects how long shadowgraphs last however Arc Trap has a built in 10 charges that is not changed by duration. Has no effect on Forced Perspective but does affect Self Portrait and Plein Air, although neither really need too much duration. You can keep this positive, or even higher particularly if running a subsume with duration like Roar which is recommended.

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**
This can be anywhere between 45% to 160% depending on enemy density in the mission and how much you will spam abilities. For low density missions where you will be mobile and recast Barrel/Arc Trap ALOT (e.g. exterminate, bounties, cascade etc) you really want to maximise efficiency. Running Arcane Impetus allows you to get 8 stacks for a free 24% efficiency. You can add this to [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) for 154% efficiency which is good for low density missions. For high density missions (e.g. survival) you would be fine running even as low as 45% efficiency meaning you can run [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) (over Catalyzing Shield) and [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) (over [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/)) if you want even more range. The inkblot passive will generate both health orbs and energy orbs. Equilibrium will convert health orbs fom passive or synth deconstruct into energy. Archon Stretch is optional as Arc Trap/Amphors can activate this for very slow but free energy regeneration. [\[Archon Flow\]](/items/arsenal/5925/archon-flow/) is also optional and will trigger when the cold barrel kills enemies for a very small measly orb.

**Range**
Range does not affect the AOE of barrels or arc trap but is helpful to spread inkblot via 1 and 3 which provides health/energy orbs for energy as well as slow for crowd control and armor strip/crowd control from 4. You can keep this positive e.g. around 145% to 235% depending on preference. Plein Air has a sufficiently high base range that you don't need to maximise range for this on most maps.

**Strength**
Strength does not affect the %hp scaling of barrels or arc trap, or the damage of any of the other shadowgraphs, but will boost Roar if you subsume this on. You can boost the barrel to do 100% hp damage ignoring armor by running at least 180% strength Roar (to oneshot through overguard you will need approximately 200% strength Roar). You will need 200% strength to allow Plein Air to full strip, or just 164% strength with corrosive projection. 

**Aura**
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/): backup survivability by regenerating shield gate in between casts of 1 so even when you come out of 1 you will not die to a oneshot and have more leeway to recast 1
- [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/): if you keep Plein Air, reduces the strength for full strip to 164%. Not useful for Barrel Damage since it ignores armor and not useful for Arc Trap since Arc Trap calculates damage off EHP, but would be useful for general weapon use against armor.
- [\[Mecha Empowered\]](/items/arsenal/1418/mecha-empowered/): used in conjunction with [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) to allow gas barrels and arc trap electric statuses to occasionally nuke in a much wider range

**Exilus**
Completely flexible based on preference:
- Ice Spring: great for mobility although you can run Archon Shards and Praedos for more parkour
- [\[Preparation\]](/items/arsenal/4286/preparation/): helps with starting energy so you can immediately start spamming shadowgraphs without waiting for inkblots to start producing energy

**Arcanes**
Very flexible based on preference:
- Arcane Impetus: can be stacked up to 8 stacks (cold, gas, blast from barrels, electric from arc trap, impact from thermian RPG, heat, toxin from amphors and radiation from death orb) for a free 24% efficiency and 48% strength. This allows you to hit any strength thresholds for both Plein Air armor strip (200%) and Roar oneshots for barrel.
- Arcane Aegis: filler arcane that just provides random bits of free survivability, completely optional
- Arcane Consequence: extra mobility upon headshotting
- Arcane Concentration: extra duration, particularly good if Roar is subsumed
- Arcane Guardian/Blessing: for health tanking setups

# ARCHON SHARDS
TWO to THREE Cast Speed shards depending on preference, really speeds up the animation of 1 and 2 and the [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/) of the combo between 2 and 1
Rest are Flexible e.g. Parkour Velocity shards, Duration shards, Equilbrium shards

# SURVIVABILITY
**Invulnerability and shield gating**
Her 1 provides 3.5s of invulnerability meaning if you press 1 every 3.5s you will stay completely immortal. This however is a very high activity playstyle and interrupts whatever you're doing with a long teleport animation, so you need good cast speed to make this feel better. It is also nice to have additional backup i-frame generation from shield gating i.e. running catalyzing shield with at least [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) in the aura OR one augur mod allows all abilities to return shields to max 1.33s gate. This means even if you are spamming 2 (with barrel or arc trap) you can shield gate without interrupting with 1, and also will always come out of 1's invulnerability phase with some shield so you don't immediately die upon exiting.

**Health Tanking**
Self Portrait provides up to 90% damage reduction so if you add armor and health you could sufficiently health tank lower levels (i.e. steel path up to level 500ish) although this is somewhat anti-synergistic with invulnerability provided by 1.

# HELMINTH
Subsume over 4 since it is the most annoying ability to use and armor strip is useless since Barrels deal %hp ignoring armor, and even arc trap doesnt require armor strip to kill easily.

**ROAR**
This is the most common and important subsume since it can boost the %hp damage of Barrels to 100% and guarantee a oneshot on basically all enemies up to levelcap.

**BREACH SURGE**
This can improve kill rate by creating homing sparks that scale off the damage from barrels and arc trap (although sparks are capped at 5 million damage).

**TEMPEST BARRAGE**
Corrosive damage triggers barrels to explode and viral status increases %hp damage to oneshot threshold, but you need to cast a new Tempest Barrage in every area you place a barrel.

# ARSENAL
Enkaus: Follie's signature gun has direct synergy with inkblot since it instantly dissolves enemies below 35%: https://overframe.gg/build/1000871/
