**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION
This is the standard [\[Shield Of Shadows\]](/items/arsenal/144/shield-of-shadows/) health tanking Nekros that has been mostly outdated by shieldgating and helminth abilities, but is still a great option for solo play in non-endurance (e.g. < level 500). Generally people tend not to use shadows in public as they can be annoying when they look like enemies. If you do use shadows in public, please use a very bright energy colour e.g. pink so allies can easily distinguish your shadows.

## BUILD SPECIFICS
Duration reduces the health drain of shadows and keeps blood altar active longer.

Range is useful for desecrate and blood altar range and 145% is comfortable in solo play. 

Strength of 214% is compulsory for 90% DR at max number of shadows. You can hit this breakpoint with blind rage + power drift (or crimson shards), or umbral intensify + transient foritude + augur secrets/[\[Power Drift\]](/items/arsenal/67/power-drift/).

[\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is great to balance energy and health [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) since you can generate so many health and energy orbs.

[\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) for armor, easy to keep up since [\[Despoil\]](/items/arsenal/145/despoil/) drops your health and desecrate generates health orbs consistently, so you are always picking up health orbs.

[\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) to maximise passive tankiness, but this is a flexible slot. I have kept this not maxed to save mod space and keep the build flexible. If you only own max ranked [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/), you could swap [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) out ofr [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) to fit everything.

[\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) is flexible for Natural Talent, (if no Amber shards),  Vitality (if you don't own Arcane Blessing) or Primed Continuity.

**Archon Shards**
- TWO Amber Cast Speed shards to make casting 4 bearable
- 1-2 Crimson Strength shards to help hit breakpoints for [\[Shield Of Shadows\]](/items/arsenal/144/shield-of-shadows/) (optional)

**Damage reduction calculations**
DR from max armor (1350 [\[Health Conversion\]](/items/arsenal/844/health-conversion/) + 900 [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/)) = 88.24%
Total DR with both [\[Shield Of Shadows\]](/items/arsenal/144/shield-of-shadows/) and max armor = 98.8%
Max possible DR with [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) at max stacks = 99.89%
Max possible EHP with Arcane Blessing at max = 1.36 million health.

## HELMINTH OPTIONS
Subsume over 1:
Blood Altar - heal nekros and shadows, keeping them alive constantly
Nourish - boosts shadows, gives viral damage, and boosts energy return
Gloom - for slow and self healing but does NOT heal shadows
Ensnare/Airburst/Larva for grouping
Breach surge for light CC and spark DPS
Roar for general DPS

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Turn on 3
2. Kill stuff
3. Activate 4
4. If NOT subsumed, Use 1 on enemies to make shadows or heal your shadows to full health (only heals when max shadows reached). Using 1 when an enemy is below 25% health wlil insta-kill them and make a shadow. Using 1 when an enemy is not below 25% health will mark them for shadow making once you kill them in other ways, so it's always good to just punch heavy units before you kill them to make a strong shadow.
5. Profit

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

The augment [\[Divine Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6490/divine-retribution/) allows you to spread status among ALL speared enemies, then when spears end, all current status is compressed and multiplied in an "expedite suffering" like effect which is scaled by strength.

[\[Reaping Chakram\]](/items/arsenal/149/reaping-chakram/) doubles the damage of chakram after each enemy hit and throwing chakram into divine speared enemies causes each chakram to duplicate and apply heat procs. [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/) doubles the amount of heat procs applied each hit, and then when divine spears ends all heat procs are expedited killing all speared enemies ideally.

Roar is optional

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Warding Halo (3) when you are surrounded by enemies (can use [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) for positioning so you don't die while you do this). This will let you absorb damage and be immortal for 3s, converting it to halo health and give you a halo health of potentially into the hundreds of thousands. Upon breaking, warding halo gives 2s i-frames.
2. Optional if not subsumed: Keep [\[Firewalker\]](/items/arsenal/843/firewalker/) (1) active for passive heat procs and move speed
3. Cast divine spears (4) to lock down rooms of enemies for crowd control and allows [\[Divine Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6490/divine-retribution/) to spread all status effects. Shoot enemies with a status weapon to nuke all enemies affected by spears in 50+ metre range OR throw Chakram to deal dps.
4. Cast blazing chakram (2) to debuff enemies and spread heat status DPS. When cast on speared enemies, each chakram will multiply into two and the debuff effect will spread rapidly compared to un-speared enemies. Killing debuffed enemies also drops both health and energy orbs.
5. Whenever you lose shields, just cast abilities like chakram and divine spears to reset your shield gate. 

**Survivability**
**CASUAL TANK**
In non-enduance (levels < 500), [\[Nezha\]](/items/arsenal/40/nezha/) can tank using a combination of health, armor and damage reduction (90% from Warding Halo, 90% from adaptation). You will need to swap Stretch or Reaping Chakram for Adaptation, and add Arcane Guardian +/- Arcane Blessing over Molt Augmented/Eruption. For a full commitment Nezha Tank build, see here: https://overframe.gg/build/237159/

**ENDURANCE SHIELD GATING**
Survivability in Endurance (levels 500-1000+) is mainly by using i-frames generated by activation of warding halo (3s) and breaking of halo (2s), combined with **shield gating** as well as crowd control from Divine Spears:
- With [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) and THREE augur mods (can be spread across your warframe and secondary weapon), 150%+80% energy is converted to shields. At 45% efficiency, a single cast of chakram costs 39 energy which generates 99 shield which gives 1.33s iframes with [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) and about 0.8s without. A single cast of Divine Spears however costs 155 energy which generates 418 shield, giving 1.4s i-frames without catalyzing shields.

**Energy Economy**
Nezha can sustain negative efficiency well due to Blazing Chakram and Equilibrium. Flow/[\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is advised but not mandatory.
Blazing Chakram forces a 100% chance to drop a health orb on kill, and a 35% chance to drop an energy orb on kill, while [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) converts health orbs to energy. This means every kill on an enemy affected by chakram gives 55 energy back and every 10 kills gives an average of 575 energy. When you add [\[Reaping Chakram\]](/items/arsenal/149/reaping-chakram/), the chance to drop health orbs is further increased.

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Low duration to neutral is preferred so Divine Spears will naturally end. Duration doesnt affect 3, and Blazing Chakram has a decent base duration of 15s. You could swap [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) for [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) to reduce duration even further.

**Efficiency**
Can be dumped due to [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) converting health orbs generated by Chakram.

**Range**
Max range gives Divine Spears a 53m range, meaning you can spread statuses to enemies over 50m away.

**Strength**
Affects the debuff of chakram, size of warding halo and expedite multiplier of [\[Divine Retribution\]](/items/arsenal/6490/divine-retribution/).

**Flexible Slots**
[\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/): This is a FLEXIBLE SLOT, being only useful for doubling heat procs from [\[Reaping Chakram\]](/items/arsenal/149/reaping-chakram/) and also giving a bit of extra EHP. 
[\[Reaping Chakram\]](/items/arsenal/149/reaping-chakram/): This is another FLEXIBLE SLOT, being only useful for getting extra health orbs and increasing the damage of Chakram. 

[\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) and Catalyzing Shields: You can use one or both of these to improve survivability, particular useful in solo endurance.

# ARCHON SHARDS
- 2 amber cast speed shards
- 1 tauforged azure Shield Capacity shard is optional - this boosts shield capacity so you maximum possible i-frame (without overshield) is closer to 1.3s rather than 0.7s at default. This means you could drop Catalyzing shields for more strength or reaping chakram.
- 2 Crimson Strength Shards.

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
- Roar - this is the preferred ability since Roar double dips DoTs like slash from weapons, triple dips electric from influence melee, double dips heat from chakram and triple dips the final Expedite from Divine Retribution.
- Breach Surge - stuns enemies including Eximus allowing to do deal bonus stealth melee damage to them, and releases sparks on damage or death which 'double dips' with chakrams vulnerability debuff assuming both the initial spark and spark hit occur on enemies hit by chakram.
- Silence - stuns enemies briefly and prevents Violence from dispelling abilties as well as eximus from using abilities
-  Ensnare and other grouping options
- Gloom - crowd control and healing
-  Nourish - boost viral damage and multiplieis energy gain

# ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

PURE SPLINTER

# INTRODUCTION
This is a [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) build focused around splinter storm and building the splinter storm damage as quickly as possible so that you can melt high level enemies on Steel Path and other end game content by running into things. 

Shattered Lash Raw damage for stacking splinter storm : https://overframe.gg/build/954908/

**UPDATE JANUARY 2026**
Added Arcane Circumvent so you can roll through enemies, strip defenses and steal defenses, then kill them immediately with splinter storm. Maximised range so when you roll through enemies and strip armor in 4m, you can still hit them with 7m splinter storm. [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) is flexible over [\[Augur Message\]](/items/arsenal/676/augur-message/).

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
Full armor strip is no longer mandatory for [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) abilities to kill in high level SP and endurance, as just having corrosive + heat without any green shards is enough to allow Splinter Storm to easily kill levelcap enemies after a few stacks. 

ALTERNATIVE BUILDS:
Hybrid Lash spam + splinter storm: https://overframe.gg/build/204674/
Pure Shattered Lash spam : https://overframe.gg/build/194448/

# MOD BREAKDOWN

**Duration**
High duration helps the uptime of Splinter Storm so it doesn't run out prematurely and you lose all stacks.

**Range**
High range helps splinter storm [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) further so you don't need to get as close.

**Efficiency**
Since you will be spamming mass vitrify and breaking it with 1, you need to maintain some efficiency for energy economy. With Arcane Sculptor we can completely ditch efficiency to 45% since we are locked to 175% efficiency and won't even need [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). 

Without Arcane Sculptor you will want to run 100 to 130% with [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/). [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on your pet further helps give free 30% efficiency since it procs while you are expanding 4. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) procs from any electric modded on [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/). 

**Strength**
Strength is important since it affects [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) damage, which subsequently feeds into both Mass Vitrify damage and Splinter Storm stacking. In addition, strength also boosts the damage vulnerability of crystallized enemies via 4 and the effect of any helminth abilities such as Roar/Nourish.

**Options**
*Aura slot* is flexible :
- Stteel Charge provides the most mod capcity and adds about 5-10% to shattered lash/splinter storm damage.
- [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) for endurance runs where you need to abuse shield gating (in addition to decaying dragon key, you may want to change fleeting expertise to streamline to reduce efficiency further)

*Exilus slot* is flexible - If you don't have primed sure footed, can use handspring, vigilante pursuit,  power drift etc

Flexible options:
- *Rolling Guard* - useful mod for high levels giving i-frames on roll and clearing harmful statuses.
- *Adaptation* - for casual tanking, increases the tankiness of shields gained (90% splinter storm DR + 90% adaptation + 50% innate shield DR = 99.5% DR), giving a shield EHP of approximately 300k at max overshield.

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Sculptor - locks efficiency to 175% for 12s after casting 3 or 4, solving all energy issues while at 45% efficiency
- Arcane Circumvent - rolling strips armor, shield and overguard and steals them for you, quite nice for splinter storm
- Molt Efficiency - free 36% duration to improve splinter storm duration
- Molt Augmented - free 60% strength to further boost shattered lash damage, useful in longer missions where you expect to get 250 kills
- Arcane Fury - similar to blade charger but doesn't require a primary, is easier to proc but provides slightly less stack
- Arcane Blade Charger - if you have a good primary weapon, AOE primary or high DPS sentinel weapon (e.g verglas), you can easily get this buff, which will boost the damage of mass vitrify explosion
- Arcane Aegis - If you have problems with surviving

**Helminth**
- *Roar*: Gives a multiplicative damage buff to Shattered Lash
- *Nourish*: Gives Viral damage boost which applies to [\[Shattered Lash\]](/items/arsenal/7438/shattered-lash/) (additively to elements so much less than Roar) but also gives energy multiplier to allow you to sustain energy, less important if running with Arcane Sculptor
- *Silence* : Provides passive CC, blocks eximus abilities and acolyte abilities, particularly against Violence so you don't lose all your stacked splinter storm. 

**Archon Shards**
- One to Two Amber Cast Speed
- Three Crimson Duration Shards OR Melee Critical Damage Violet

# PLAYSTYLE
- Cast 2 on yourself (making sure you don't aim at an enemy, object or companion) to initiate splinter storm and achieve 90% damage reduction
- Cast 2 on your companion for 90% damage reduction and for second layer of splinter storm
- Cast 3 to activate buff
- Cast 4 and quickly stop it from expanding by pressing 4 again
- Tap or hold 1 to shatter the wall (tap for puncture if you modded for puncture which is one-handed cast and quicker)
- Repeat 4 + 1 combo constantly to stack damage into splinter storm, and make sure to refresh splinter storm duration by casting 4 before it runs out

# OTHER TIPS
Use a sentinel as a companion rather than a moving pet. You can cast splinter storm on your sentinel and give it 90% damage reduction as well as creating a second damage source that gains the same stacks as [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/). Since the sentinel moves with you and overlaps your splinter storm radius, you effectively do twice the damage per tick compared to when splinter storm is on [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) alone. To cast on your sentinel, point your cursor directly up and press the *reverse camera* key (check key bindings) then spam 2 as the crosshairs pass over the sentinel. Furthermore, since the sentinel never runs away like other pets, you can keep 100% uptime on its splinter storm whenever you cast mass vitrify.

Recommended sentinels:
- Diriga - passive primes in close range and helps consistently produce health orbs for equilibrium
- Nautilus with Cordon and Manifold bond - allows you to passively group enemies so you can kill them quicker with splinter storm. https://overframe.gg/build/540870/
- Wrym prime with negate - prevents status procs including knockdown, very useful if you don't own primed sure footed. https://overframe.gg/build/545608/
- Dethcube prime with energy generator - makes energy orbs every couple of kills, very useful if you don't own a full set of arcane energize. https://overframe.gg/build/224301/
- Helios Prime with Vicious Bond and Deconstructor - allows you to passive armor strip enemies recently damaged by abilities, which is exactly what [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/) specializes in. This allows you to use Nourish as subsume instead. You can also equip Seismic Bond which will trigger while Mass Vitrify is expanding, giving free 30% efficiency for 12s. https://overframe.gg/build/542050/

# INTRODUCTION
[\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) focused [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/) build utilising MINIMUM duration for Lull spam to erode Restraint and high range Pull to crowd control and rapidly group enemies into melee range allowing direct building of combo on [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/). [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) can be triggered by electric modded [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/), and all the electric procs due to reactive storm work well with grouping.

Alternate main build using Pillage and melee guidance: https://overframe.gg/build/402137/baruuk-prime/pillaging-punch-general-use-and-steel-path-endurance-baruuk/

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate Desolate Hands (3), always keeping Desolate hands above 9 daggers for max damage reduction.
2. Spam Lull (2) on Enemies to quickly erode Restraint, then recast necessary ( to keep restraint at minimum) as well as create minor crowd control
3. Activate [\[Serene Storm\]](/items/arsenal/7444/serene-storm/) (4) and spam light melee to kill enemies
4. Spam Pull to group enemies and attack with [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) to build combo

[[ youtube id="8LIEUzXgar8" ]]
.

# SURVIVABILITY
In endurance content, you will need to shield gate actively with Pillage or Catalyzing Shield + augur mod, or passively shield gate with shield recharge e.g. run Fast Deflection + Vigilante Vigor.

In non-endurance content, [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/) has multiple layers of innate damage reduction that multiply together making him extremely tanky

**Damage Reduction Calculations**
At minimum restraint - 50% damage reduction
At 9 or more Desolate Hands daggers - 90% damage reduction
With Serene Storm active - 40% damage reduction

Max total damage reduction witrhout [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) = 97% damage reduction
With [\[Adaptation\]](/items/arsenal/1431/adaptation/) = 99.7% damage reduction
Accounting for base armor = 99.8% damage reduction to health only.

# BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Minimum Duration (12.5%) allows Lull to be spammed for quick erosion of Restraint. Duration does not affect Pull, Desolate Hands or Serene storm.

**Efficiency/Energy**
Positive efficiency (100-135%) is needed to help Lull spam, Pillage spam and recasting of Desolate Hands. [\[Serene Storm\]](/items/arsenal/7444/serene-storm/) does NOT consume energy, instead using [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/)'s Restraint meter. [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/) is required to offset [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/). [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is also optional addition to help with overall energy economy if you require and also helps double violet shards

**Range**
High Range is needed for Pillage radius especially at low duration and big Lull radius.

**Strength**
Strength boosts [\[Serene Storm\]](/items/arsenal/7444/serene-storm/) damage and Reactive Storms status chance, meaning [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) effectively double dips DPS. Pillage also requires strength but you don't need to focus on achieving full strip in one cast.

**Aura**
Completely flexible depending on preference:
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) reduces global armor
[\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) for shield gating in endurance
[\[Swift Momentum\]](/items/arsenal/2730/swift-momentum/) helps with combo duration so you dont lose [\[Desert Wind\]](/items/arsenal/2272/desert-wind/) combo
[\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/), [\[Steel Charge\]](/items/arsenal/312/steel-charge/), [\[Growing Power\]](/items/arsenal/300/growing-power/) are all fine

**Exilus**
Completely flexible depending on preference:

Primed sure footed prevents knockdowns.
Alternatives include handspring, cunning drift, vigilante pursuit etc

**Arcanes**
Fury/Strike - for Desert Wind DPS
Augmented - for Desert wind damage and Pillage 
Energize - for energy if needed

**Archon Shards**
Mix and match any number you prefer
1 Cast Speed
2 Parkour
2 Violet Crit Damage (may want [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) to double value)

# HELMINTH 
Subsume over Elude. You want to pick abilities that either work well with LOW duration or are independent of duration.

Pillage: strips armor/shield and steals shields, works well with low duration high range

Omamori: more chill survivability



# ARSENAL

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

## INTRODUCTION

Equinoxes 3 and 4 abilities in both day and night forms synergize well with gloom to control the [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/) of time or create a room of near permanently stunned enemies. With the augment [\[Peaceful Provocation\]](/items/arsenal/198/peaceful-provocation/), the day form 3 ability boosts equinoxes ability strength by 70% to hit a gloom slow of 94%, very close to the gloom cap. Equinoxes day form 4 ability creates a brief stun when enemies first enter the ability range which can be prolonged by gloom slow. Alternatively, the night form 3 ability creates up to 80% slow which can multiple with gloom to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) close to 99% slow, practically freezing time entirely.  While in night form, 4 also allows you to regenerate shields to stay alive from any gunfire you might take from outside the slow zone. This means you have a choice between running in day mode for 95% slow, stun locking and nuking or night mode for time freeze (99% slow) and effective immortality.

Here is a more conventional steel path equinox build:  https://overframe.gg/build/212520/

## PLAYSTYLE
1. Start off in DAY mode, and activate 3 to get an initial 40% boost to ability strength. 
2. Activate gloom while 3 is active for an initial 83% slow. Activate 4 to stun enemies and build up damage.
3. Damage and kill enemies until you hit a 70% total boost to ability strength (shows in the UI)
4. Dispel and recast gloom to hit 94% slow.
5. Deactivate 4 when you want to nuke after building sufficient damage, and immediately reactivate it to restun enemies (not that enemies that have been stunned once cannot be stunned again within the same cast of 4, you must dispel and recast it)
6. Switch over to NIGHT mode, activate 3 and 4, and take some damage until the [\[Peaceful Provocation\]](/items/arsenal/198/peaceful-provocation/) buff displays 80%. At this point, you will have 79% on top of 94% slow giving 99% slow. (try not to take any health damage as you might die. Kill enemies while 4 is active to generate lots of shields, which can be hit safely to charge up [\[Peaceful Provocation\]](/items/arsenal/198/peaceful-provocation/))

Here is a video demonstrating the playstyle and how to achieve max slow in both day and night forms.

[[ youtube id="WrXjt-0spKE" ]]


## BUILD SPECIFICS

**Duration**
Duration can be dumped since we can hit the channelling cap using efficiency. To [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) the minimum drain, we just need to make sure duration stays above 40%. This can be done with a single [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/).

**Efficiency**
Max ranked [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/) and [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) are required to hit 190% efficiency to offset the negative duration while still achieving the minimum drain for channelled abilities. Since we have up to THREE channelled abilities active in this build, this is absolutely essential. Note that the game will still show 175% efficiency but calculate it as 190% efficiency. [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is optional but I have not found this to be essential as long as you can maintain a decent kill rate.

**Range**
We would like as high a range as possible but cannot fit many more mods. 175% can be hit with [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) and [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/). You may find 145% comfortable or add [\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) to hit 190%.

**Strength**
A minimum of  202% str is required. When in day form, [\[Peaceful Provocation\]](/items/arsenal/198/peaceful-provocation/) on top of pacify and provoke allows you to boost ability strength by 70% to [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) 272% strength, which is 95% slow from gloom. If you then switch to night form while gloom is active, [\[Peaceful Provocation\]](/items/arsenal/198/peaceful-provocation/) now gives an additional  80% slow after taking damage. This additional 80% slow actually multiplies with gloom's 95% slow to become (1 - 0.20x0.05) or 99% slow.

*NOTE*: With new Focus and Arcanes, you can a combination of Madurai or Zenurik with Molt [\[Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/798/vigor/) or Molt Augmented to boost ability strength by between 45% to 100%. E.g. Using Madurai + Molt Augmented (100% str) allows you to drop strength mods for [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) and Rolling Guard.

If you don't own Molt Augmented, replace Primed flow or Augur reach with Umbral Intensify.

**Flexible Options**
	- Primed flow - if you have energy issues despite minimal drain and means you can channel for much longer
	- Rolling Guard - for better survivability from stray bullets that enter the field
	- Energy Transfer augment - you can stay in night mode to gather power while staying effectively immortal, then switch to day mode to nuke
	- Adaptation + Arcane guardian - for lazy tanking in low levels, maim allows you to passively heal back any health taken

Exilus
	- Primed sure footed is preference and only if you own it, handspring is an alternative
	- Cunning drift to get range to 190%
	- Vigilante pursuit for even more radar
	- Preparation for starting energy, best used in combination with primed flow

**Arcanes**
Energize - essential for energy maintenance
Molt Vigor/Molt Augmented - for strength boosts
Consequence - you will be getting easy headshots, helps get around the map very fast

**Archon Shards**
2 cast speed shards mandatory
3 energy max allows you to replace [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) for [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/)


## WEAPONS
[\[Zenith\]](/items/arsenal/1081/zenith/) is a fun weapon that has infinite punchthrough meaning it can shoot through any amount of walls, although sometimes the wallhack indicators don't work right. Since [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) produces slash damage which display through walls, you can aim [\[Zenith\]](/items/arsenal/1081/zenith/) at slash damage instances and hit enemies through walls even without the indicators active.

## SENTINEL
[\[Dethcube\]](/items/arsenal/2236/dethcube/) with [\[Energy Generator\]](/items/arsenal/1388/energy-generator/) augment is a great help to energy economy.

**Note**
I have added extra unnecessary forma to hit exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/) at the beginning of the mission and start generating energy immediately. If you don't use Archon Mods or just run energy pads/Preparation/energy on start shard, you can save multiple forma (only 3 forma needed).

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate 3 and keep active, kill enemies with melee to drop health orbs which generate energy via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) and kill enemies afflicted by 5 statuses to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) duration passively and indefinitely
2. Press 1 to go invisible and gain melee crit damage buff (need to refresh buff once roughly every 10s) and also mark an enemy with [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/). Attacking will remove invisibility meaning you need to go immediately back into invisibility if you are using '[\[Hit And Run\]](/items/arsenal/2820/hit-and-run/)' tactics with heavy attacks, heavy slam, exodia contagion, or if you are spamming light attacks only return to invisibility and shield gate if you get hit.
3. Press 2 on an enemy (ideally the marked glowing enemy) to inflict 5 random status effects, then kill that enemy and spread status effects. If the initial 5 status effects matched any status effects you applied via your melee, these will be spread. This means for everytime you use 2 you have a 5/13 chance or 39% chance to match one status and spread. See STATUS TAXI and ELEMENTS below for more details.
4. Repeat 1 + 2 combo on every new group of enemies
5. OPTIONAL if you keep 4, enter 4 and get kills by attacking. Rebuild stacks by spreading bleed procs.

# MELEE AFFLICTIONS + STATUS TAXI
This refers to using Fangs of Raksh to 'taxi' status procs from your single target melee into the AOE range of Fangs. For example when using an weapon with forced slash on heavy like [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) and other scythes, this requires you to proc SLASH out of the 5 statuses on the INITIAL hit of Fangs. Proccing slash on a second hit or subsequent hits on the same enemy does NOT count. Once you inflict a STRONGER forced slash proc from heavy attack, that STRONG slash proc plus the 10 weaker slash procs will be averaged and then be transferred by Fangs to every enemy in an approximately 18 m radius, OR 49m radius if performed a target marked by [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/), provided the enemy did NOT die to raw damage before the strong slash proc could be applied. 

If you add Melee Afflictions into the mix, you can rapidly multiply all damaging statuses such as slash, electric, gas, toxin and heat as long as you proc those on the initial 5 statuses, and then spread all multiplied statuses. Dual Daggers such as [\[Okina Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6546/okina-prime/) Incarnon or Tonfas such as [\[Praedos\]](/items/arsenal/5839/praedos/) are the best melees for Melee Afflictions application due to the heavy applying 2 instances of knockdown in one hit, meaning each hit adds 14 statuses.

**Statuses**
Slash is the preferred status on certain weapons with forced slash (scythes, claws, nikanas) since it is consistently guaranteed on every heavy, and melee afflictions can consistently multiply that by 7 again.

Gas is a great status for maximizing KPM on a map since Gas procs lingers and have an AOE meaning they can kill new enemies that simply walk into clouds.

Electric is standard with melee influence setups so this goes well if you manage to proc electric with Raksh.

# SURVIVABILITY
**For Endurance**
Crowd control from spread status effects from 2 or subsumes like Muzzle Flash/Silence can prevent enemies attacking you as often. If you take any breakthrough damage tap 1 to go invisible and generate some shield for shield gate, making sure to equip some Augur Mods ([\[Augur Pact\]](/items/arsenal/673/augur-pact/), [\[Augur Secrets\]](/items/arsenal/678/augur-secrets/)) on a pistol to help with shield generation (which stacks with [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/)). For certain weapons like Contagion Zaw and Slam you can pop in and out of invisibility constantly by pressing 1 immediately after attacking. Vazarin protective dash can be an optional final layer of survivability in an Endurance situation where you find yourself out of energy or unable to cast abilities (e.g. against Violence).

**Health Tanking**
If you prefer to health tank in casual missions rather than shield gate, add Arcane Blessing, Arcane Guardian/Reaper, Adaptation and Health Conversion. Just note this isn't THAT recommended due to high forma/mod cost and limitations of health tanking on a frame that can simply turn invisible, with no innate damage reduction. 

You can also scale the health tanking/healing to level cap with arcane persistence however this requires much more investment with multiple umbral mods/umbral forma or armor shards to hit the 700 armor breakpoint: https://overframe.gg/build/1015916/

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Positive duration helps uptime of 1 and 3, but you don't need to go overboard as the base invisibility duration is very long and you will likely remove it immediately upon melee attacking. Furthermore, getting melee kills is able to increase the duration of both the melee buff of 1 and overall duration of 3. [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) is **optional** as 2 is able to create toxin procs which subsequently forces 1 corrosive proc even if corrosive was not created by 2, for extra [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) damage and mild armor strip. I would suggest you DON'T use Achon mods initially as you don't want to use up mod capacity since it affects starting energy. You need exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/) at the beginning of the mission.

**Efficiency**
[\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/) is able to run negative efficiency with [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) on a melee focused build due to Lycath's [\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/) (3) forcing health orb drops on melee kills and [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) giving 55 energy per health orb. In addition Arcane Impetus now gives bonus free efficiency.

**Range**
Range is maximized for the spread radius of Fangs of Raksh (2), giving up to 20m range of status spread (and about 49m with [\[Prey Of Dynar\]](/items/arsenal/6745/prey-of-dynar/)). This allows you to nuke maps with either the 'status taxi' mechanic or simply via the damaging DoTs (blast, heat, electric, toxin, gas) created by Fangs of Raksh, as well as prime entire rooms with useful statuses such as viral, corrosive or cold.

**Strength**
Strength is mainly to boost the melee crit damage buffs from 1, status damage from 2 and dmg buff of shooting gallery so you don't need a huge amount of strength unless running a helminth like Roar.

**Flexible slot**
Equilibrium is flexible if you can replace it with equilibrium shards if you don't care about maximising Fangs range:
- Ulfrun Endurance: If you want an Ulfrun ability focused build
- Catalyzing Shield: Maximizes consistency of shield gating as it gives 1.33s on any amount of shield break
- Vigorous Swap: If you are focusing on Contagion Zaw or Glaives as this double dips vigorous swap
- Nira's Hatred: If you are focusing on Slam melee, make sure to add Nira's Anguish in exilus too
- Muzzle Flash/[\[Savage Silence\]](/items/arsenal/79/savage-silence/): if you are subsuming Shooting Gallery or Silence respectively

**Passive**
You can swap between passives based on preference and mission type e.g. use parkour velocity for quick missions or to get between points faster, use status immunity when using AOE weapons or for general survivability and use heavy efficiency when using x12 melee builds. Since we generally subsume off 4, you will mostly not be using 4 passive.

**Aura**
- Corrosive Projection for passive armor strip (effectively multiplies damage against armor by 1.8x)
- Brief Respite for shield gating if not running catalyzing shield and you want to maximise shield gate iframes
- Growing power for more strength
- Mecha Empowered if using a Kubrow and Mecha set
- Enemy Radar for quality of life

**Exilus**
Completely flexible:
- Cunning Drift for range
- Ice Spring for mobility
- Power Drift for strength
- Primed Sure Footed for knockdown immunity if you don't use 2 passive.
- Vigilante Pursuit for radar 

**Arcanes**
Completely optional and up to preference:
- Impetus - gives strength and efficiency and can stack to maximum from Fangs of Raksh
- Crepuscular - only works for certain weapons that can 'hit and run', as you only leave invisibility AFTER hitting with melee but need to recast invis immediately e.g. Slam, Contagion
- Augmented - boosts strength to further boost Crit Damage buff of 1
- Strike - more melee attack speed
- Fury - more melee damage 
- Blessing - if you prefer to tank, which also mega boosts the health of a pet running link health

**Archon Shards**
1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard helps with feel of spamming 1 and 2 constantly
2 Tauforged Violet [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) shards can help replace [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) if you need more mod space 
If focusing on Melee Weapons: 2 Tauforged Violet Melee Crit Damage shard 
If focusing on Ulfrun: 2 +ability damage on corrosive status, corrosive status has the higher chance to proc from Fangs of Raksh since [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) can make it via Toxin status too

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
**MELEE PLATFORM**
For regular melee use, subsume over 4
Melee damage boosting options include:
- Roar - boosts DoT and triple dips on status spread via Fangs of Raksh. 
- Wrathful Advance - adds even more flat crit chance bonus to melees, allowing some melees to red crit easily

Crowd control options include:
- Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash - blinds enemies allowing you to freely spam light attacks without invisibility, and also forces stealth melee multiplier (700% crit dmg additive to crit multiplier)
- Silence - Stuns enemies for 2s and shuts off all eximus/acolyte abilities. [\[Savage Silence\]](/items/arsenal/79/savage-silence/) augment also applies the stealth melee multiplier to stunned enemies. Considering dropping range to 100 to 145% so you can permanently stun enemies while mobile since you can keep making enemies exit and re-enter silence range.

**ULFRUN**
Since you can't subsume over 4 if using Ulfrun, you can only really subsume over 3.
- Brightbonnet - replaces energy generation aspect of Lycath but also boosts strength allowing you to snapshot Ulfrun
- Roar - boosts Ulfrun, double dips slash procs made by Ulfrun and double dips statuses made by 2 BUT since you lose Lycath energy will be a huge issue. You will need to run [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) + Synth Deconstruct and maybe additional sources like Zenurik, Dethcube etc

# ARSENAL
**SECONDARY**
Use a primer secondary (e.g Epitaph/[\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/)) with 2 augur mods ([\[Augur Pact\]](/items/arsenal/673/augur-pact/) and [\[Augur Seeker\]](/items/arsenal/674/augur-seeker/)) to help with backup shield gating. Dedicated primers allow you to max viral status consistently relative to using Fangs of Raksh, and potentially add even more additional status effects if Fangs procs a different set of statuses (e.g. for total of 10-12 statuses).
- Epitaph - https://overframe.gg/build/235422/
- [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/)

**MELEES**
[\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/)'s Dynar ability gives a flat 100% crit chance AND flat 100% status chance to melee weapons while also boosting flat crit damage, which helps weapons use melee influence and status builds even if they traditionally have low status chance and/or low crit chance. This means if a melee only has 5% base status chance, while mods like [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/) would only bring this up to 27%, Dynar brings this to 105%. Fangs of Raksh also apply many statuses which helps with [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/).

**LIGHT ATTACK SPAM**
If you just want to mindless spam light attack and still nuke maps, just use good melee influence light attack melees:
[\[Keratinos\]](/items/arsenal/5114/keratinos/) fits thematically, deals innate viral, has 5x multiplier forced slash procs on heavy attack, and has an innate property where performing a x12 heavy give 2-3 m of range to all attacks for 3 minutes: https://overframe.gg/build/398797/

**INFLUENCE CONTAGION**
This probably has the most synergy with [\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/) as Contagion projectiles normally don't proc influence that well but Dynar gives a flat status boost. In addition contagion has multiplicative Condition Overload meaning Condition Overload multiplies with Primed Pressure Point/Arcane Fury, benefitting from all the statuses created by Fangs.

This includes nikanas (5x multiplier e.g. [\[Skiajati\]](/items/arsenal/1186/skiajati/), [\[Nikana Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1177/nikana-prime/), [\[Sepfahn\]](/items/arsenal/2553/sepfahn/)), scythes (6x multiplier e.g. hate, reaper prime), claws (5x multiplier e.g. venka prime, keratinos).

**UPDATE 2025**

2. Armor Strip : Haste mote allows sol gate to apply corrosive status.
 1 tau forged green shard increases max corro procs to 13 but the speed of this is quite slow, with most enemies dying way before you hit 10 corrosive
3. Heat Inherit: Using a heat inherit primer first allows Sol Gate's heat procs to inherit the +heat mods (eg up to 225% from non-riven secondaries) for 3.25x more damage as well as one primed bane mod for 1.55x more damage. 
4. Viral status: 10 viral status increases damage by up to 4.25x 
5. Motes: Health and shock motes provide a 25% damage increase for 1.25x
6. [\[Archon Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/5924/archon-vitality/): doubles heat procs per application
7. Archon Shards: 5 Tauforged Topaz +15% ability damage on radiation status effect for a final 1.75x multiplier to damage

**BREACH SURGE**
Heat proc damage ramps up over time and each tick of heat status damage and kill of enemies then feeds into Breach Surge sparks which scale off the damage that produced it. The spark is capped at 5 million damage however, there are additional factors that can apply to push this way OVER 5 million damage.
1. Roar: applies a final multiplier to breach surge
2. [\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/): swapping weapons constantly will multiply spark damage by 2.65x for 3s. This is OPTIONAL
3. Arcane Crepuscular: while invisible (by jumping) or by Shade/[\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/), surge sparks gain an additional flat +3 crit damage onto the original 1.5x multiplier for a final multiplier of 4.5x. 
4. [\[Worthy Comradery\]](/items/arsenal/7187/worthy-comradery/): applies a +75% critical chance bonus to breach surge on headshots, which occassionally happen since breach surge seek heads.

**MANIFOLD AND CONTAGIOUS INHERT**
Shock motes for some reason inherits [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/) equipped on your companion and allows shock motes to proc the statuses contained on sentinel weapons. If you mod heat onto that weapon then shock motes will proc heat. If enemies subsequently die to heat procs, these will be spread via [\[Contagious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6277/contagious-bond/) within 9m since the game treats the heat proc as originating from your companion. If roar is active, each spread multiplies by the roar amount in a positive feedback loop until the final spread heat procs deal damage cap. Normally the heat procs created by shock mote/manifold are very weak and cannot kill, however, you can stack heat procs from Sol Gate [\[Cataclysmic Gate\]](/items/arsenal/7267/cataclysmic-gate/) ONTO the initial heat proc from [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/) and kills via heat procs will still count as companion kill.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# PLAYSTYLE
MAKE SURE BEFORE YOU START THE MISSION, THE EMISSIVE IS SET TO A BRIGHT COLOUR FOR DAY MODE.
1. Activate [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) (tap 4) then kill enemies with a weapon to 'store' damage for [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) (displays in top right of screen). 
2. Once you build up enough damage, cast Terrify (tap 1) immediately followed by deactivating [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) (tap 4), then immediately reactivate [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/).
3. After getting 250 kills, keep 3 active at all times to boost strength to allow terrify to full strip in a single cast.
4. Optionally, you can cast [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) at enemies to increase the damage they take from all sources including [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/)

# [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) DAMAGE
The amount of damage stored by [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) is equal to 75% of the amount of health and shields LOST by the enemy (rather than the total damage you actually display). This means if you deal 200 million damage to an enemy with 1 million health and maximum armor (so 10 million ehp), you only store 750k damage. If you then release this damage against another fully armored enemy with 1 million health standing right next to you, you will only be dealing 750k damage out of their 10 million ehp (i.e. 7.5% of their health bar). [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) also has linear falloff to 0% damage at 50m. If you full strip with Terrify first, then you are dealing 75% of their health bar to an enemy standing right next to you but only 16% health bar to the same enemy standing 40m away. In order to consistently oneshot enemies at the very edge of terrify radius, you will therefore need to store at LEAST the health of 7 identical enemies to kill that same enemy at 40m. Since enemies do not all have the same health, you will probably want to try to store the health of about 10 to 20 enemies to be safe before releasing [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/). Since enemy health increases with level, the number shown on the UI will not be a reliable indicator of when you need to release unless you memorise a few rough benchmark numbers to hit.

if we assume the health of a steel path corrupted heavy gunner, these are the rough values needed to kill them at 40m.
Level 150: 561,605 health, needs about 3 mil stored [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) damage
Level 500: 1,313,210 health, needs 7 mil stored [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) damage
Level 1000: 2,121,915 health, needs 11 mil stored [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) damage
Level 9999: 10,317,272 health, needs  52 mil stored [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) damage

# SURVIVABILITY
Survivability is via active shield gating, crowd control from Terrify and quickly killing enemies with weapons + [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/). Currently, [\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) is bugged to give the full 1.33s shield gate after regenerating ANY Amount of shield, meaning a single [\[Augur Reach\]](/items/arsenal/677/augur-reach/) while at max efficiency is enough to provide full gate after a cast of any ability e.g. Terrify. You want to be pressing Terrify and [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) very often to shield gate. Arcane Aegis is a flexible arcane that can provide backup survivability. Rolling Guard is a final layer of backup survivability, giving i-frames and status cleanse with cooldown. 

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Both Terrify and Rest & [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/) have long base durations, meaning you still have around 8 to 10s to kill something before they wear off which is long enough. 
Duration has no effect on Pacify and Provoke. Duration does affect the drain of channeling abilities like [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) but if you maximise efficiency to 190%, you still minimise drain to 25% of normal even at 40% duration. 

**Efficiency and Energy Economy**
At 40% duration, drain of channelling is minimised at 190% efficiency which requires rank 5 [\[Fleeting Expertise\]](/items/arsenal/791/fleeting-expertise/) PLUS either rank 5 [\[Streamline\]](/items/arsenal/805/streamline/) or [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/). Having [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) means you can free up a slot. 

**Range**
Maximising range gives [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) the highest possible coverage. Note, [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) has falloff that scales linearly with distance, meaning at about 50m (assuming 280% range), you deal 0 damage, while at 40m which is roughly the range of Terrify, you deal 21% of the stored damage. This means to consistently kill an enemy at the furthest range of terrify and assuming a map full of identical armored enemies, you need to kill about 7 to 8 enemies worth on average before releasing the [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/).

**Strength** 
Strength does NOT affect how much damage is stored by [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) or multiple how much damage is released when [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) ends. It only boosts the tiny slash procs that get created when you first cast [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/). Strength also boosts the damage vulnerability of [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/).

Terrify now full strips at just 167% ability strength with a base duration of 25s. Adding [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) lowers this even further to 137%. After getting 250 kills with molt augmented and a single tauforged strength shard, we have a strength of 115%. Casting Pacify and Provoke gives 20%x1.15 = 23% strength, for a final strength of 115% + 23% = 138% strength, exactly enough to full strip with terrify in a single cast.

**Aura**
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) is required to reduce strength requirement of terrify to full strip

**Exilus**
[\[Cunning Drift\]](/items/arsenal/65/cunning-drift/) maximises range
[\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) if using AOE guns to prevent knockdown

# FLEXIBLE SLOTS
[\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) is flexible for something else if you don't feel like energy is an issue.

# ARCHON SHARDS
TWO Tauforged Cast Speed Shards to speed up animations
ONE Tauforged Strength Shard to hit full strip with terrify in a single cast
TWO Tauforged Parkour Velocity shards for mobility/quality of life

# HELMINTH
- TERRIFY has a radius that nearly matches Maim (42m vs 50m) and also ignores line of sight like Maim. As a bonus Terrify crowd controls and stops non-overguarded non-immune enemies from shooting you. 

- PILLAGE has line of sight and requires multiple casts for full strip, cleanses status and also returns shields for a big shield gate (up to 2.5s currently at over 1150 overshield). 

- FIREBLAST requires two casts and is line of sight

# ARSENAL
You want to use strong AOE weapons that can collect lots of enemy health quickly in order to build up maim and therefore release quicker. 

Slam melees have high AOE and damage to oneshot enemies
- Magistar Slam: https://overframe.gg/build/668910/
- Arca Titron (x5 heavy slam): https://overframe.gg/build/601678/

Some incarnon primaries can clear trash well:
Torid Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/472389/
Strun Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/465699/
Boar Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/546897/

Any good influence melee can kill enemies in 20m quickly:
- Falcor/Xoris: https://overframe.gg/build/618917/
- Furax Wraith Incarnon (influence): https://overframe.gg/build/642135/
- Dual Ichor Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/572811/
- Okina Prime Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/668223/
- Nami Solo Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/679575/
- Tenet Agendus: https://overframe.gg/build/251031/
- Prisma Ohma: https://overframe.gg/build/601313/
- Ninkondi Prime: https://overframe.gg/build/601315/
- Wolf Sledge (influence: https://overframe.gg/build/621744/

# COMPANION
Dethcube with Tazicor equipped to tag enemies for:
- Synth Deconstruct: drops health orbs with 25% chance, which is converted to 55 energy by equilibrium
- Energy Generator: drops energy orb after 10 kills, giving 25 energy every 10 kills of tagged enemies
- Seismic Bond: gives free 30% efficiency while 4 is active, giving minimised ability drain
- Viral status: boosts all damage by up to 4.25x at 10 viral
- Magnetic status: boosts damage to shield and overguard by up to 4.25x at 10 magnetic

Other companions like [\[Wyrm Prime\]](/items/arsenal/2241/wyrm-prime/) with [\[Tazicor\]](/items/arsenal/2224/tazicor/), [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) with [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/) or Panzer can also run [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) and [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) while priming viral.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[\[Excalibur\]](/items/arsenal/18/excalibur/) has recent been buffed as [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) can use acolyte mods and melee influence arcane, and in turn Slash Dash has been buffed as it uses [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) stats and can also use melee influence.

This maximum comfort variant build utilises 'passive shield gating' with Catalyzing Shield + [\[Fast Deflection\]](/items/arsenal/837/fast-deflection/) + [\[Vigilante Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/701/vigilante-vigor/) and Arcane Aegis (optional). This combination causes ANY amount of shield restored provide the maximum 1.33s shield gate, while reducing shield recharge delay to approximately 1s. This means if you do not get hit in a window of 1s approximately, you will passively recharge 1 shield which is sufficient to full gate again. Press 1 to become invulnerable to damage while dashing which further helps. Use ANY rank Arcane Aegis e.g. rank 0. This is flexible for Arcane Strike if you prefer. This allows you to mindlessly attack in any combination of slash dash or [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) spam without watching your shield levels. If you add [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) with [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) and damage enemies with [\[Grimoire\]](/items/arsenal/6429/grimoire/) and use slash dash to kill, you can proc [\[Fass Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6360/fass-canticle/) and turn completely immortal for 15s duration each time.

The following build is a more 'active gating' variant where you must press 1 to actively restore shield / turn invulnerable whenever you have your shields depleted. This requires a more active attentive playstyle but frees up more slots to allow for better stats:

![](https://imgur.com/RXdvj0S.png)

**[\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) BUILDS**
BUILD 1 LIGHT SPAM WITH x12 TENNOKAI HEAVY INFLUENCE
If you are not running arcane [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/), you could consider [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) over [\[Voltaic Strike\]](/items/arsenal/334/voltaic-strike/) to help the multiplicative CO on heavy attacks. Primed Smite is flexible for Primed Pressure Point especially if using Roar helminth.

https://overframe.gg/build/389076/

![](https://imgur.com/hrpVV0o.png)

BUILD 2 HEAVY SPAM INFLUENCE
There is no galv reflex because combo does not apply to the heavy attack waves. Condition overload is multiplicative to primed pressure point/[\[Killing Blow\]](/items/arsenal/383/killing-blow/) on heavy waves
![](https://imgur.com/rUvXga9.png)


# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
No specific need for duration unless you run a subsume like Roar, Nourish, Wrathful, then you should add Primed Continuity over Streamline

**Efficiency**
You need a bit of duration and/or efficiency to reduce channeling cost of [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) and efficiency to make Slash Dash cheaper to spam. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion activates while [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) is active giving you a free 30% which really helps with energy management. 

**Range**
Radial Blind has a very high base range of 25m so you can either keep this neutral or add [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/). Slash Dash also has a decent base targeting range of 20m but you could add more range if you prefer better slash dash chaining.

**Strength**
Only [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) really needs strength so we can use [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/), and supplement with Molt Augmented. Strength double dips influence DPS since it affects chromatic blades status chance boost and exalted blades base damage, so if you want more DPS you can add more strength like [\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/), [\[Transient Fortitude\]](/items/arsenal/793/transient-fortitude/) etc.

**[\[Chromatic Blade\]](/items/arsenal/110/chromatic-blade/)**
This is mandatory for melee influence builds since it boosts status chance by a huge amount and can make [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) innate electric. Make sure to use a BLUE emissive.

**[\[Furious Javelin\]](/items/arsenal/107/furious-javelin/)**
This is an optional augment.  [\[Furious Javelin\]](/items/arsenal/107/furious-javelin/) is currently bugged to not apply to [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) on light attack waves (works normally for heavy waves). This also has a very low base duration so is annoying to upkeep, and is pretty much overkill damage (which may even be bad for melee influence since statuses don't spread if the initial enemy is oneshot).

**ARCANES**
- Arcane Aegis helps with lazy survivability
- Molt augmented boosts strength
- Arcane [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/) boosts melee damage by another 180% (additive to condition overload for light attacks, but multiplicative to condition overload on heavy wave)
- Arcane Strike for more attack speed to spam exalted blade

# HELMINTH
Subsume these abilities over 2 or 3:
1. Roar - Roar double dips status procs on single target and triple dips any spread influence procs, giving the highest boost to influence DPS
2. Wrathful Advance - gives flat CC to slash dash, giving the highest boost to raw single target damage
3. Nourish - good for energy economy, mild boost to raw single target damage, adds viral procs which can multiply damage up to 4.25x without needing to mod viral on [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/)

**ARCHON SHARDS**
1 Tau Cast Speed optional
1 Tau Energy Max to hit 500 energy (Only needed if use Base [\[Excalibur\]](/items/arsenal/18/excalibur/), add another Melee Crit dmg or parkour Velocity shard if using Umbra)
3 Tau Violet Melee Crit Damage

# ARSENAL
[\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) with [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) or Hound helps prime enemies for [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) and [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) for orbs.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# STATS/SHARDS

Duration is the main required stat since it makes mind control last as long as possible and also minimises the drain of [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/). With 280% duration you can run 100% efficiency with [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) on a companion to hit minimum drain. Molt Efficiency or Duration shards lets you hit 280% duration easily.

Range is not required at all as nuke range scales with damage (see below).

Strength is for Roar only and also helps mind freak.

Exilus is flexible
- Ice Spring for more parkour velocity for rolling
- Preparation for energy on start

Arcanes are flexible 
- Arcane Agility or Consequence boosts parkour velocity
- Arcane Concentration/Molt Efficiency gives more duration
- Arcane Strike speeds up heavy attack recovery animation

Aura is flexible 
- Ready Steel if slamming with Ruvox
- Corrosive Projection for global armor strip without pressing 2

Shards
- 3 Duration
- 2 Parkour Velocity optional to make moving in [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) feel better

# HOW DOES ABSORB NUKE?
While absorb is active all damage dealt to you, all damage dealt by your mind control ally and all damage dealt by enemies affected by Chaos to each other is stored as a number (shown in the UI). Upon ending, all damage is dealt to enemies in a maximum range of 50m, which itself scales with both the modded range AND the damage absorbed.

The range of Absorb Nuke is given by the formula : 15 x range% + ( SQRT (5 x damage absorbed) / 50 ) and is capped at 50m. This means even at 34% range, after absorbing or having your mind control deal about 1 million damage (1,125,751 exactly)  you will hit the 50m cap. 

If you can therefore buff Mind Control to ridiculous levels where each shot can deal millions to even billions of damage, you can nuke up to damage cap in a 50m range without line of sight given long enough.

You can buff mind control by:
1. Shooting enemies with strong weapons e.g. [\[Prisma Angstrum\]](/items/arsenal/945/prisma-angstrum/) incarnon, [\[Felarx\]](/items/arsenal/5872/felarx/), [\[Kunai\]](/items/arsenal/1249/kunai/) incarnon, [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) incarnon, [\[Laetum\]](/items/arsenal/5841/laetum/).

# ARSENAL
**COMPANION**
Choose any ROBOTIC companion e.g. Sentinel, Hound, Moa because [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) makes them 100% immortal (but does not apply to beast pets). Make sure to equip [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) to get free 30% efficiency to hit the 160% efficiency threshold.
Diriga : Arc coil does consistent melee range priming and for synth deconstruct: https://overframe.gg/build/541464/
[\[Nautilus Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6628/nautilus-prime/): Passive grouping pulls enemies closer to you so you don't have to move around as much, also can run Reinforced bond: https://overframe.gg/build/717504/
Hound: https://overframe.gg/build/540825/
Moa: https://overframe.gg/build/541443/

** WEAPONS**
[\[Nyx\]](/items/arsenal/28/nyx/)'s new passive gives up to 200% crit chance additive bonus to Primary and Secondary Weapons. Weapons can also be used to deal damage to mind control on initial cast to buff their damage.

**PRIMARY WEAPONS**
Burston Prime Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/505444/
Felarx Incarnon:  https://overframe.gg/build/328134/

**SECONDARY WEAPONS** 
We can use strong secondary weapons with multiplicative [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) weapons + priming to charge mind control. Note that many things on weapons do not affect mind control damage absorption (check wiki) e.gg element mods, viral status, enemy armor although just a normal weapon build is sufficient since you can use it for normal shooting and mind control buffing. 
For a special build only for maximising mind control use Ballistica Incarnon with Outburst + x12 crescendo Furax : https://overframe.gg/build/1050590/

[\[Ballistica\]](/items/arsenal/1204/ballistica/) Incarnon, [\[Prisma Angstrum\]](/items/arsenal/945/prisma-angstrum/) Incarnon, [\[Kunai\]](/items/arsenal/1249/kunai/) Incarnon, [\[Kuva Seer\]](/items/arsenal/2851/kuva-seer/), [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/) can all hit approximately 20,000% to 40,000% with multiple factors stacked e.g. primary status primer (such as bubonico), arcane precision + arcane velocity + reinforced bond + amalgam furax + buff (e.g. roar/nourish) you can hit upwards of 40,000% mind control. 

Amalgam Barrel Diffusion is optional to boost roll speed while in assimilate.

Ballistica Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/1026904/
Prisma Angstrum Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/675455/
Kunai Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/462089/
Furis Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/465709/
Dual Toxocyst: https://overframe.gg/build/472561/
Laetum (crit): https://overframe.gg/build/315013/

**SECONDARY IRRADIATE**
Chaos allows you to consistently apply 10 radiation status to enemies, which makes Secondary Irradiate usable without needing to mod radiation on the weapon. Good options for this include strong single target pistols like furis incarnon, laetum (crit) - same builds as above but swap arcane to irradiate and run arcane precision.

**MELEE WEAPONS**
[\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/): incarnon passives can give up to 60% movement speed and an extra mid air jump which greatly improves the feel of mobility in [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/). [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) Slam and influence with the passive spears can allow you to trigger a large mind control amount (approximately 10,000% to 80,000%): https://overframe.gg/build/821372/

[\[Jat Kittag\]](/items/arsenal/974/jat-kittag/) and [\[Sampotes\]](/items/arsenal/6171/sampotes/) with slam influence can achieve a similar thing with the same build as [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/), but does not give passive mobility benefits.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is an Endurance focused Rhino Build that uses a combination of spamming Stomp to AOE stun enemies and restore iron skin, as well as rely on i-frames from Iron Skin activation and breaking for survival. If you can get targeted by a strong enemy such as [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) eximus then absorb damage, you could potentially gain hundreds of millions of iron skin which could last a while if you keep refreshing it with [\[Reinforcing Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/177/reinforcing-stomp/), even at levelcap.

On casting Iron Skin, you have 3 seconds of invulnerability where you absorb damage and convert that to Iron Skin. This should then last at least 3 seconds since it absorbed 3s worth of equivalent damage. Upon breaking you have a further 0.5s iframes from Overguard and another 1.33s of iframes from Shield Gate.

Therefore, the total amount of i-frames from a single cast of Iron Skin is about 5 to 8s. This means if you stand still and just take damage, you only need to cast Iron Skin once every 5 to 8s. If you then add in the insane crowd control of Stomp, you will only need to recast Iron Skin once every 30s to a minute of so when randomly get hit. This style of surviving should last all the way to levelcap (lvl 9999) and even has the potential to ignore toxin damage.

**UPDATE FEB 2025**
Arcane Truculence is optional and adds 10 viral stacks in 30m everytime you cast iron skin or regain overguard with [\[Reinforcing Stomp\]](/items/arsenal/177/reinforcing-stomp/).

# STAT BREAKDOWN

**Duration**
We want positive duration for uptime of Nourish and Roar.

**Efficiency**
Keep neutral as stomp costs alot of energy. Nourish + [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) upkeeps energy. [\[Archon Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/5922/archon-stretch/) is optional when running [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) or other companion that procs electric.

**Range**
Stomp has a ridiculously high base range, so 145% range is sufficient for a 36m stomp. If you want you can go even higher up to 235 to cover 58m. Just note if you go too high, this can reduce KPM since you stop enemies from even reaching you in the first place.

**Strength**
Need high strength for Nourish and Roar.

**Flexible Slots**
Flexible options include:
- More efficiency: Streamline
- More range: Augur Reach
- More strength: Augur Secrets
- More duration: Constitution

**Aura:**

- Brief respite is best default for backup shield gating
- Ready Steel if doing initial combo slam (no crescendo build up)
- Growing Power for more strength

**Exilus**

- Power Drift for more strength

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**ARCANE PERSISTENCE**
Gives easy survivability between the i-frames provided by passive, and allows you to [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) energy much easier with [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/). [\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/) has 1000 armor at base which is already enough to proc persistence without additional mods. [\[Gladiator Resolve\]](/items/arsenal/684/gladiator-resolve/) + [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/) + [\[Umbral Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/693/umbral-vitality/) give you exactly over 2000 health for 4s of arcane persistence before needing to heal. [\[Valkyr Talons\]](/items/arsenal/2400/valkyr-talons/) heal you instantly so you don't even use up your passive very often, and are able to maintain maximum uptime of melee damage buff. [\[Gladiator Resolve\]](/items/arsenal/684/gladiator-resolve/) also gives an extra 110cc at 12x combo but could be replaced with [\[Umbral Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/694/umbral-fiber/) which boosts strength more and gives enough armor to shrug off heat procs which would normally turn off arcane persistence, except this would require a second Umbral Forma.

**DURATION/EFFICIENCY**
Duration and efficiency both affect channelling drain. High Duration helps with subsumed buff uptime and [\[Eternal War\]](/items/arsenal/83/eternal-war/). 
Energy economy is very good with arcane battery + [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/).

**RANGE**
Having a little bit of range gives ripline still some mobility utility. At 79% range you still have a decent 59m ripline range.

**STRENGTH**
[\[Blind Rage\]](/items/arsenal/792/blind-rage/) is optional depending on how your energy economy feels between 45% efficiency and 100%. You may have a hard time at 45% efficiency in lower density maps but be fine in high density survival etc.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This [\[Yareli\]](/items/arsenal/5532/yareli/) build focuses purely on dealing big AOE slash procs with Aquablades, supported by the damage vulnerability of Sea Snares, free cast while on Merulina, damage accumulation from Surging Aquablades augment, Roar helminth which double dips slash DoT and the Mecha set which also double dips DoT on a [\[Marked Target\]](/items/arsenal/1453/marked-target/) and helps nuke occasionally in AOE. Using a [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) also allows you to stay invisible as long as you don't shoot your weapon, with a short cooldown in between periods of invisibility. When you are on Merulina, [\[Yareli\]](/items/arsenal/5532/yareli/) is invisible but Merulina stays visible so you are basically a ghostship flying around throwing water bombs. 

[[ streamable id="7tec07" ]]

# PLAYSTYLE 
1. Activate roar before getting on merulina. To reactivate roar you need to get off merulina first.
2. Spam Aquablades (consider binding 3 to a mouse button instead)
3. Spam Sea Snares to give damage vulnerability to enemies
4. Dont shoot your weapon so you don't break invisibility
5. When invisibility ends, get off and on Merulina twice for i-frames until invisibility restarts again

Use Huras Kubrow to stay invisible: https://overframe.gg/build/268129/huras-kubrow/huras-mecha-synth-stealth-doggo/

# BUILD SPECIFICS 
**Duration** 
Max duration is required to allow surging aquablades to build up maximum amount of damage and gives roar almost 2 minutes of duration

**Efficiency**
Minimum efficiency is viable because Aquablades costs 0 energy to throw while on Merulina, you only cast roar once every 2 minutes, Merulina costs no energy to ride, and the only ability that you need to spam are Sea Snares which have the cheapest cost.

**Range**
Aquablades and merulina are not affected by range. Roar does not need range in a solo situation where we are just using it to boost Aquablades. Sea Snares at minimum range still has a 10m seeking range, which is still bigger than aquablades personal range. If you prefer a bit more range for Sea Snares you can add [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/).

**Strength**
Strength is required to scale the build up of Aquablades damage, damage vulnerability of Sea Snares and buff of roar.

**Archon Shards**
1-2 Amber Cast speed
Rest into duration

# DAMAGE CALCULATIONS

Assuming the following factors:
- 50,000 damage built up from Surging Aquablades
- 82% Roar = 1.82 x 1.82 = 3.3124x damage to DoT (due to applying once to initial base dmg and again to DoT)
- 6.25x to DoT from mecha empowered
- 274% Sea Snares vulnerability 

Hitting an enemy marked by mecha set and sea snares and killing with the slash proc (not the initial hit raw damage) spreads the following slash proc per second in a 30m range:
- 50,000 x 0.35 x 3.124 x 6.25 x 3.74 = 1,277,900

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

The new arcane, Arcane persistence now limits damage taken to 500 per second if your armor is above 700. To hit 700 armor, you will need to slot THREE TAUFORGED Azure Amor shards ideally or [\[Steel Fiber\]](/items/arsenal/808/steel-fiber/) + TWO Tau shards to save shard slots.

**Why Gloom?**
At minimum range on [\[Mesa\]](/items/arsenal/14/mesa/), Gloom has a max radius of 5.4m. Gloom only drains energy when enemies enter that range and since [\[Mesa\]](/items/arsenal/14/mesa/) is generally a ranged warframe, Gloom basically has zero energy cost while giving free lifesteal on your [\[Regulators\]](/items/arsenal/2399/regulators/). This means you can be extra lazy and stand still in peacemaker while healing any damage taken. As long as you can heal more than 500 hp per second with Gloom, [\[Mesa\]](/items/arsenal/14/mesa/) basically can't die.

**Exilus Flexible Slot**
Primed sure footed can be Synth Reflex or Preparation.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[[ youtube id="86FQSFPMQh4?si=rJ5ljcb6vfLlcrgc" ]]

342% duration gives 30s [\[Critical Surge\]](/items/arsenal/5259/critical-surge/) and 17s Energized Munitions.

[\[Critical Surge\]](/items/arsenal/5259/critical-surge/) buffs can be stacked infinitely as long as the buff is LESS than 250%. If you hit the 250% cap, this instance will NOT stack with the existing buffs.
For example, if you get four 200% [\[Critical Surge\]](/items/arsenal/5259/critical-surge/) buffs, each will be on their individual timer of 30s but will NOT disappear or be overriden by each subsequent buff, resulting in at least 20s of overlapping buffs giving 800% cc. The minimum distance you need to be from a mote in order to teleport is 10m. This means you need to be sufficiently far away (>10m) but not TOO far otherwise you will exceed the 250% cap. This is why Rank 1 [\[Critical Surge\]](/items/arsenal/5259/critical-surge/) is used, because at rank 1 each meter travelled only gives 5% cc x strength. At 224% strength, you need to exceed 22m teleport distance to hit 250%, giving you plenty of leeway (10m to 22m) to hit a value under 250%.

To speed up stacking, you can plant a mote, waypoint it, then travel exactly 20m away and plant another one, then proceed to ping pong teleport between them. Each teleport should get you roughly 200% cc, 5 teleports giving 1000% cc.



Arcanes:
Molt Efficiency to maximise duration
Arcane Energize flexible for Molt Augmented, just make sure you teleport within 17m distance instead of 22m.

Archon Shards:
2 amber cast speed
3 crimson duration

## INTRODUCTION

More mobile gun focused [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) build not focusing on tornado use meaning you don't need to recast tornado every time you move to a new zone

**Helminth**
An ability that benefits from both duration and strength is ideal:
- Nourish - free viral modded and energy multiplier
- Roar - good for running and gunning, roar also double dips electric procs frequently paired with tornados
- Pillage - shield/armor strip and returns shields
- Silence -  helps with crowd control and turning off special enemy abilities e.g acolytes and ancients
- Firewalker/molt/infested mobility - for even faster travelling

**Flexible mods**
Aura - always flexible. [\[Enemy Radar\]](/items/arsenal/306/enemy-radar/) helps guide you to enemies and plan your ability casts. [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) for more backup survivability. Aerodynamic can be used if you leave default polarity. Combat discipline and arcane avenger is also a fun combo.

Exilus - always flexible. [\[Primed Sure Footed\]](/items/arsenal/801/primed-sure-footed/) is usually best in slot if you own it, with [\[Handspring\]](/items/arsenal/825/handspring/) as next best alternative. Preparation may be useful to speedruns. Vigilante Pursuit for additional radar. 

Rolling guard - while turbulence essential blocks all projectile damage, you can still be hit by AOE effects and environmental status effects. [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/) is useful for status cleanse and to stay alive between casts of turbulence. If you don't feel like this is necessary for you, you could always switch this out for more range, duration or strength (with augur mods) or [\[Natural Talent\]](/items/arsenal/811/natural-talent/).

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[\[Target Fixation\]](/items/arsenal/183/target-fixation/) allows you stack the damage of divebomb infinitely with each enemy hit. The base damage of divebomb is given by 4500 x 0.2 x height x strength, with 15m height being the cap giving a final damage of 13,500 at 100% strength, or 19,400 damage at 144% strength. After you hit 1000 enemies which should take around 10 to 20 minutes depending on map type and density, you will be dealing 19.4 million damage on every divebomb in a 10m radius.


**Arcane Steadfast is currently bugged to allow you to RETAIN [\[Target Fixation\]](/items/arsenal/183/target-fixation/) bonus indefinitely while on the ground, as long as you have some stacks of Arcane Steadfast.**

OLD VIDEO SHOWING SP CIRCUIT LEVELCAP (BEFORE ARMOR NERF):
[[ youtube id="myerJBlGpkI?si=AGj2p6Vtu1VBMNXg" ]]


# STAT BREAKDOWN
**Duration**
Keep high for turbulence mainly.

**Efficiency**
Neutral to high for 1 spam and casting 3/4

**Range**
Keep medium to high for range of Divebomb explosion, turbulence deflection range and airburst radius.

**Strength**
Positive strength is nice to help the speed of scaling, since it scales off the base damage, meaning you need to hit less enemies to achieve the same level of damage. Strength does NOT affect the actual % bonus from [\[Target Fixation\]](/items/arsenal/183/target-fixation/) and does not have any effect on airburst, turbulence or tornado.

# ARCHON SHARDS
2 cast speed
3 duration

A companion that can passively prime useful statuses like viral (damage multiplier to health up to 4.25x if not using nourish), heat/corrosive (partial armor strip) and magnetic (for bonus dmg against overguard) can significantly improve the damage output of Divebomb. Sentinels are the best choice for [\[Zephyr\]](/items/arsenal/54/zephyr/) since that are covered by turbulence and cannot be killed.
