**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**VYTHELAS BUFF**
Vythelas's heat buff is identical to Cyte's resupply (and a cousin of Saryn/[\[Oraxia\]](/items/arsenal/7400/oraxia/)).

Note that HEAT MODS are mandatory as they double dip the heat DoT and FACTION MODS are ideal too as they TRIPLE DIP the heat DoT.

Vythelas Heat DoT = 0.5 x 30% x stregnth x base damage x (1 + HEAT MOD + other elements) x (1+ HEAT MOD) x (1+FACTION)^3

# HELMINTH OPTIONS
**THERMAL SUNDER**
Thermal Sunder with [\[Thermal Transfer\]](/items/arsenal/5751/thermal-transfer/) augment gives +75% heat x strength buff on casting heat sunder, which feeds into Vythelas heat buff twice.

**NOURISH**
Nourish boosts raw damage by +45% viral x strength, that still affects Vythelas heat DoT while viral status boosts all damage by up to 4.25x, and allows you to drop viral mods on weapon. 

**ROAR**
You can subsume Roar over 3 and still benefit from Vythelas passive BUT this will remove the strength scaling meaning it is stuck at the base 30% heat and fire rate buffs. Roar triple dips the heat DoT as it counts as faction. This overall probably ends up the weakest option since you also lose the damage vulnerability of 3.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

**Arcanes**
- Arcane Concentration: maximising duration helps the uptime of Vythelas buff and Thermal Transfer buff.
- Arcane Camisado/Augmented: more strength
- Arcane Hotshot: +300% cc but needs you to fly into enemies with 1 to proc heat

# ARSENAL

You should ideally be invisible 0% of the time with Huras Kubrow .

**Archon Shards**
Amber Shards - 2 cast speed shards helps speed up recasting of 3, casting of 1


# PLAYSTYLE
1. Activate as many unique allies as possible, allowing Prismatic Gem to hit the most enemies. The more "allies" you have, the more beams can spawn. Allies include: 1 companion (+3 [\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/) clones, can split into 3 hound clones if you use diversified denial), 1 tenno specter, air support charge (kahl spawns 3), 1 on call crew, allied invasion specter (up to 6), 1 lich/sister (for total of 18 active beams).
2. Keep 3 active and spam 1. Keep 2 active optional (depending on which you subsume over)
3. If using Sickening Pulse - cast sickening pulse whenever many enemies hit at least 4 corrosive procs to full strip
4. If using Expedite Suffering - spam 1 and use expedite or shoot toxin bubonico and use expedite
5. If using Roar - keep roar active

[[ youtube id="bjO3HxmhRAE?si=0hckd0YS4vZhpfOF" ]]
.

# HELMINTH
1. Roar - passive buff to 1 and 3 damage, allowing you to spam 1 to kill enemies. This is great with [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) because you can stay invisible while spamming 1 since it does not count as weapon damage which breaks stealth.

2. Expedite Suffering - allows you to compress the slash procs built up by 1 to insta-kill enemies, or compress toxin procs built up by 3 + your weapon. Bubonico alt-fire with toxin is recommended for this because it has a passive 15s status duration which can be boosted to over 30s by Citrine's 3. Compressing 30s of toxin procs can deal tremendous amounts of damage in an AOE.

3. Sickening Pulse - add 10 stacks of corrosive, great for use with 2 emerald shard. Also multiplies electric status damage by 10x, doubles heat status damage and doubles toxin status damage.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Nourish provides free viral damage/status to your weapons, viral damage buff to your mind control ally and multiplier to all energy gained.

[[ youtube id="7rLNOtR1yFk?si=dQkdpdw4H04LsaD_" ]]

There are two ways to run this build, Assimilate and non-[\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/).

**[\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/)**
Staying in Assimilate makes you and your sentinel completely invulnerable and also immune to knockdowns, allows you to shoot/attack, while severely limiting your mobility to jumps and rolls (i.e. preventing parkour and sprinting). You can somewhat help overcome the mobility problem by boosting parkour velocity (which affects roll speed) and movement speed:
- Ruvox: Running Ruvox allows you to gain +60% movement speed at 12x combo and also 1 extra mid-air jump.
- Dispatch Overdrive on Ruvox further contributes to movement.
- Arcane Phantasm - boosts movement speed by 45% on melee block
- Arcane Agility/Consequence - boosts parkour speed 
- Mobilize - parkour velocity
- Amalgam Barrel Diffusion - increase dodge speed for further rolls
- Molt/Firewalker subsumes

**Non-[\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/)**
Pressing Absorb without [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) locks you into a floating animation and prevents attacking, but absorbing over 64,000 damage upon ending provides 6s of i-frames and 400% additive damage buff. This means at higher levels, you can simply double tap absorb whenever you need on demand 6s i-frames while also being fully mobile. 

Note that you can still run the [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) augment and simply turn off [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) when you want to be mobile. This still let's you enter [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) on demand when required and also control your nuking.

# BUFFING MIND CONTROL
1. Use high single target raw damage weapon e.g. [\[Felarx\]](/items/arsenal/5872/felarx/), [\[Phenmor\]](/items/arsenal/5837/phenmor/), [\[Burston\]](/items/arsenal/1226/burston/) incarnon, [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) incarnon and shoot mind control in head after priming

2. Use blast electric influence slam  e.g. [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/), [\[Sampotes\]](/items/arsenal/6171/sampotes/), [\[Jat Kittag\]](/items/arsenal/974/jat-kittag/) with [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/) or [\[Nautilus\]](/items/arsenal/5415/nautilus/) for grouping

3. Release existing [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) on next mind control target

# BUILD SPECIFICS
**Duration**
Higher duration gives long uptime for mind control so you don't have to keep swapping targets and finding new enemies as often. Duration also affects channelling efficiency of [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/), where minimum drain can be hit at 280% duration and 130% efficiency. [\[Narrow Minded\]](/items/arsenal/790/narrow-minded/) + [\[Primed Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/800/primed-continuity/) + Molt Efficiency lets you hit 290% duration, and molt efficiency has 100% uptime due to [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) making you invulnerable to shield damage. [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) can give bonus 30% efficiency to hit 130% efficiency and is activated by using 4.

**Efficiency**
High duration with nourish is sufficient to sustain energy.

**Range**
Mind control has a very high base range, so even at 34% range you can cast on enemies in 20m. Psychic Bolts and Dispensary are not affected by range. The range of Absorb is affected by both damage absorbed and modded range, by the following equation 7.5 x range% + ( SQRT (5 x damage absorbed) / 50 ) and is capped at 50m.This means will hit the 50m cap even at 34% range as long as you absorb over approximately 1 million damage.  NOTE: The range equation only counts damage absorbed by enemies shooting you and ignores damage dealt by mind control or confused enemies, meaning low range is only effective above a certain level where enemies start dealing 1 million damage almost instantly (e.g lvl 1000+).

**Strength**
Strength helps [\[Mind Freak\]](/items/arsenal/125/mind-freak/) and Nourish, but only 125% strength threshold is required for full strip so any extra you add is just minor bonus.

**Aura and Exilus**
Flexible:
- [\[Ready Steel\]](/items/arsenal/6368/ready-steel/) and Nira's are designed to use with [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) to maximise Mind Control building. Ready Steel lets you hit 6x combo on Ruvox with Galvanized Reflex and activate incarnon mode. Nira's Anguish boosts slam damage.
- Motus Signal : boosts double jump height which you get from Ruvox

**Archon Shards**
1 cast speed
2 duration tauforged - further boosts uptime of mind control and reduces drain of assimilate
2 parkour velocity tauforged

# HELMINTH
1. Nourish
- adds raw damage bonus to you mind control if you cast nourish within range of them, which feeds into absorb, and easy to recast on any new mind control allies
- adds viral damage/status to your weapons so you dont need to mod viral on your weapons
- multiplies all energy gained from energy orbs and via equilibrium so you can sustain absorb easily

2. Roar
- boosts mind control ally if you cast within range, but cannot be recast mid-duration without augment
- boosts weapon damage and double dips status
- boosts companion damage particularly if using verglas + contagious bond, as faction damage can create a cascading effect to hit damage cap

3. Molt/Firewalker
- makes you go faster while in [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/)

# ARSENAL

**COMPANION**
Choose any ROBOTIC companion e.g. Sentinel, Hound, Moa because [Assimilate] makes them 100% immortal (but does not apply to beast pets). Make sure to equip Seismic Bond to get free 30% efficiency.
Diriga : Arc coil does consistent melee range priming and for synth deconstruct: https://overframe.gg/build/541464/
[\[Nautilus Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6628/nautilus-prime/): Passive grouping pulls enemies closer to you so you don't have to move around as much, also can run Reinforced bond: https://overframe.gg/build/717504/
Hound: https://overframe.gg/build/540825/
Moa: https://overframe.gg/build/541443/

**WEAPONS**
[Nyx]'s new passive gives up to 200% crit chance additive bonus to Primary and Secondary Weapons. In addition you will need weapons to add damage multiplier to mind control, which feeds back into Absorb damage.

**Influence Slam Melee**
The main weapon required is a slam influence weapon with innate blast and modded electric e.g. [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/), [\[Sampotes\]](/items/arsenal/6171/sampotes/) or [\[Jat Kittag\]](/items/arsenal/974/jat-kittag/). When paired with grouping e.g. [\[Magus Anomaly\]](/items/arsenal/2291/magus-anomaly/), a single x5 slam can give up to 40,000% to 90,000% damage buff to Mind Control.

[\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) also increases movement speed and gives double jump which improves mobility in Assimilate if you decide to stay in the bubble: 
https://overframe.gg/build/821372/

[\[Sampotes\]](/items/arsenal/6171/sampotes/) and [\[Jat Kittag\]](/items/arsenal/974/jat-kittag/) all use the same build

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[[ youtube id="VQGOasR-rEM?si=l97ejU9S2jD2tWda" ]]

# ELEMENTAL WARD
Use Toxic elemental ward for additional damage on holster to boost breach surge and glaives/contagion a tiny bit more.

# SURVIVABILITY (PASSIVE SHIELD [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/))
[\[Catalyzing Shields\]](/items/arsenal/6284/catalyzing-shields/) sets shield gate to 1.33s regardless of how much shield is generated. Shield recharge delay reduction mods reduce recharge delay to 1s. When shields break you have 1.33s i-frame to get out of enemy fire/reposition or kill enemies, then if you don't get shot for 1s you will starting generating shield. Even just generating 1 shield and getting shot again will give another 1.33s gate. Note, if take constant damage during the 1.33s shield gate it will reset the 1s recharge delay timer so you could be vulnerable after the shield gate ends (e.g. if you get shot at 0.5s into the shield gate, you will recharge at 1.5s which is 0.2s after shield gate ends). 

#  HELMINTH SYNERGY
Vex Armor's [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/) is a weapon damage buff that is additive to +dmg mods on weapons (like serration, primary merciless etc) but also boosts Breach Surge since it is coded as a weapon, thereby "pseudo-double dipping" breach surge since it boosts it twice. Note however, since Breach Surge is now capped at 5 million pre external multipliers, Vex Armor will only apply to a 5 million damage instance rather than boosting it to easy damage cap like previous.

# ARSENAL
Vex Armor's [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/) buff also for some reason applies twice to Glaives and Contagions (i.e. Double Dipping). This means a 600% damage buff is actually a 4800% damage buff (49x) to Glaives and Contagion.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# ARCHON SHARDS

THREE TAUFORGED ARMOR SHARDS ARE MANDATORY TO ACTIVATE ARCANE PERSISTENCE (700 armor required)
TWO PARKOUR SHARDS OPTIONAL can be anything else

# WHY GLOOM AND WHY OVER ENERGY VAMPIRE?
Energy Vampire cannot restore energy while gloom is active and [\[Hunter Adrenaline\]](/items/arsenal/690/hunter-adrenaline/) keeps you at maximum energy permanently.
Gloom heals based on damage dealt and Link reflects enemy damage back at enemies, and counts for Gloom healing. 
This means everytime you take damage you heal. Arcane Persistence limits health loss to 500hp per second so essentially OUTHEAL all damage you take while Gloom and Link are both active.

If you somehow slip up and link drops you still have a free life if you have a well of life active.

# WHY NO HEALTH MODS??
[\[Trinity\]](/items/arsenal/58/trinity/) has a passive that gives 50% of energy max as health max to you and allies, meaning [\[Primed Flow\]](/items/arsenal/802/primed-flow/) boosts health to 690 on [\[Trinity Prime\]](/items/arsenal/59/trinity-prime/). This is enough for exactly one persistence gate which is actually all you need to be immortal since you always outheal. If you feel unsafe you can slot [\[Vitality\]](/items/arsenal/824/vitality/) or Arcane Blessing for a bit more buffer room.

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
[\[Champion's Blessing\]](/items/arsenal/5609/champions-blessing/) is optional over [\[Stretch\]](/items/arsenal/806/stretch/) but you basically need to run [\[Coda Hema\]](/items/arsenal/7324/coda-hema/) to make this stack.

# [\[Landslide\]](/items/arsenal/7451/landslide/) BUILD
Similar to normal build but are using Primed Pressure point and Condition Overload together since they multiply on direct hits:
https://overframe.gg/build/925944/

# RUMBLED QUIRKS
- Costs 0 energy to throw rocks
- Rocks deal 100 direct damage and 75 radial damage in FIXED 3m AOE NOT affected by range mods
- Has 35% critical chance but 1x base critical damage and 15% status chance, therefore needs flat crit multi bonuses like Crepuscular and Tenacious Bond
- Affected by mods on Landslide 
- Is not boosted by Rubble Heap above 1400 rubble
- Condition Overload is MULTIPLICATIVE to Primed Pressure Point and other base damage (e.g. Arcane Fury) on direct hit. 
- Condition Overload does NOT affect the AOE component
- Direct hit component can headshot (triple damage and double dip Xata) and benefits from the headcrit bonus (double critical multiplier)
- Does NOT break invisibility from Shade/Huras and can benefit from Arcane Crepuscular
- Can trigger Melee Influence, Melee Afflictions (on non-overguard), Melee Vortex, Melee Duplicate, Arcane Fury
- Throwing does NOT stack Melee Exposure
- Not affected by Attack Speed mods
- Cast speed affects throwing speed
- [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) boosts the damage

# COMPANION
Need either [\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) or [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) to keep you invisible.

Huras has the benefit of [\[Primed Pack Leader\]](/items/arsenal/2512/primed-pack-leader/) generating overguard keeping it alive more consistently. Mecha set is also optional.

[\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) has the benefit of [\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/) priming statuses for you via [\[Tazicor\]](/items/arsenal/2224/tazicor/) to take advantage of multiplicative CO and maximise damage.

# ARCHON SHARDS
2 Cast speed + 3 Violet melee crit damage shards

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

With the armor changes, slash procs from Seeking [\[Talons\]](/items/arsenal/1248/talons/) are not even as required for [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror to nuke.

[\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) Mirror adds the health of enemies (10% health) and is multiplied by both Nourish (1+0.45 x strength) and Weapon Damage buffs e.g. [\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/) (2.65x) or Arcane Arachne (2.5x).
[\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) also reduces enemy armor.

If you take the health of a single enemy once, you get 10% of their health. Charging 1 increases the current absorbed damage by 100% per second you hold down 1. 

# PLAYSTYLE

1. Keep Nourish active
2. Tap 4 to shield gate (make sure to have some augur mods on pistol) and prime enemies for forced slash procs
3. Tap 1 on enemy to gain [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) mirror + [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) heart, charge [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) heart by holding 1 for a few seconds and just before you finish charging swap weapons to activate [\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/), release 1 to throw ball to nuke

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**ARCHON SHARDS**
- two regular emerald +corrosive stack for full armor strip
- three tauforged +ability damage on corrosive stack

**MELEE**
Blast:
If you want to use Sandstorm alone to passively kill enemies, you can mod a weapon with pure blast and run [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) with [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) priming viral and magnetic.
Silva and Aegis Prime is a weapon with pure heat meaning you can mod it for 100% blast with a single cold mod to maximise blast DPS.

Electric:
If you are running a priming companion such as Panzer/[\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) that can prime viral for you and would like to do a combination of sandstorm DPS and direct melee DPS, you can simply run a pure electric melee with Melee Influence, which doubles as an [\[Elemental Sandstorm\]](/items/arsenal/178/elemental-sandstorm/) DPS statstick AND a DPS melee. Once sandstorm ends, enemies are often grouped and knocked down, making it very easy for the next few melee hits to naturally perform ground finishers. Weapons in the fist, sparring and claws category have the highest ground finisher multiplier of 30x, followed by tonfas at 20x.

[\[Okina Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6546/okina-prime/) is one of, if not THE strongest influence light attack melee in the game and has the bonus of boosting movement speed by 30% which affects sandstorm movespeed.
Okina Prime Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/668223/

[\[Furax Wraith\]](/items/arsenal/1121/furax-wraith/) is the strongest fist melee in the game and can use both melee influence and perform ground finishers for 30x multiplier
Furax Wraith Incarnon: https://overframe.gg/build/642135/

Prisma Ohma is the strongest tonfa melee for melee influence (and one of the strongest non-incarnons too) and is innate electric meaning the effect on electric weighting for sandstorm damage is highest. Tonfas also have a 20x ground finisher multiplier.
Prisma Ohma: https://overframe.gg/build/601313

**COMPANION**
Huras Kubrow can keep you invisible and run mecha mods to contribute to nuke: https://overframe.gg/build/268129/

You also run a Primary Statstick for Kubrow to allow it to DPS and even nuke independently, e.g. Paris prime incarnon : https://overframe.gg/build/843480/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a variant of [\[Vauban\]](/items/arsenal/56/vauban/) specifically for high mobility missions and catered to a very high activity shield gating playstyle in endurance e.g. Cascade levelcap.
You will essentially be spamming all abilities particularly Photon Strike once every second to nuke and shield gate simultaneously, casting Bastille every 20s or every new area/group of enemies to strip and crowd control simultaneously, and using Overdriver/Vector mines to boost weapon damage and movement speed. [\[Flechette\]](/items/arsenal/727/flechette/) mines are good stationary scaling DPS you can pop down a few of to lock down an area (e.g. one exolizer) while you are off at another one.

**MOD BREAKDOWN**
- Corrosive Projection - reduces armor by 1.8x on armored enemies, without needing to wait for Bastille to fully strip since it strips so slowly
- Primed Sure Footed - best in slot for knockdown prevention but can run Ice Spring/Lightning dash instead for mobility
- Fleeting Expertise - maximise efficiency so you can spam all abilities CONSTANTLY, particularly Photon Strike and Bastille, flexible for streamline
- Primed Continuity + Arcane Concentration - recover the loss of duration a bit so Nourish, Minelayer and Bastille still have a decent duration
- Umbral Intensify + Augmented - strength boosts all abilities
- Archon Stretch - gives range for all abilities, more would be best but we don't have the space, and if you are extremely mobile you may be only facing small groups of enemies that are covered by the range already
- Primed Flow + Equilibrium/Energy Nexus - for maximising energy economy and regeneration, [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) is flexible for [\[Energy Nexus\]](/items/arsenal/6378/energy-nexus/) particularly if running external energy sources, energize or equilibrium shard as this will allow you to generate energy even while moving between groups of enemies or rooms
- Catalyzing Shield - locks shield gate to 1.33s regardless of how much shield is generated but you MUST be running an Augur Mod either on your secondary or Burst Laser Prime on Sentinel since we do not have space for it on the frame
- Rolling Guard - extra i-frames and status cleanse (optional if you run Wyrm Prime or Vazarin Protective Sling), flexible for Augur Reach


**ARCHON SHARDS** 
- 2 cast speed
- 2 parkour velocity
- 1 duration shard for quality of life, 1 strength shard for more dmg, or just another parkour shard

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Pure Weapon Platform Persistence Tank Melee Platform Variant

This variant allows you to fully tank with arcane persistence, which limits health loss at 500hp/s as long as armor is over 700. This can be reached with three umbral mods as [\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/) has decent base armor. [\[Voruna\]](/items/arsenal/5985/voruna/)'s passive also makes her immune to status which blocks heat, corrosive and magnetic that normally disrupts arcane persistence. With Arcane Blessing + Physique + Gladiator Resolve we can hit a final health of 3000 which is equivalent to 6s of i-frames before needing to heal.

This means you can use weapons that break invisibility e.g. spamming melee influence light attack melees without needing to think or shield gate. Lycath allows you to generate health orbs to heal. For example, killing 10 enemies with a melee influence will drop 10 health orbs, healing 50 health each. If you run [\[Restorative Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6274/restorative-bond/) on your companion, you can boost this to 110 health per orb meaning killing 10 enemies restores 1100 health. If you can kill 5 enemies per second on average you should be able to offset the maximum health loss of persistence.

All of this however comes at the cost of needing TWO Umbral Forma to fit everything at max rank, but you can make do with one umbral forma if you simply remove the exilus and run [\[Steel Charge\]](/items/arsenal/312/steel-charge/) in aura.

# ARCHON SHARDS
1 cast speed
2 violet [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) shard
2 melee crit dmg

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Why Nourish over chrakram?
Chakram has terrible targetting and sometimes hits one enemy then bounces away. If you press it again too soon hoping to retry, you may end up teleporting to somewhere you didn't want to go. It also has limited effectiveness at low strength on this build, as low strength is used to take maximum advantage of Warding Halo breaking and iframes. Finally it can cause 'reverse heat inherit' which is where if you apply a heat status from chakram then shoot that same enemy with [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/), all subsequent statuses applied via [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) ignores any +heat mods on the weapon (e.g. [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) + [\[Scorch\]](/items/arsenal/401/scorch/)) which is effectively a 3.25x REDUCTION in status damage. Nourish somewhat helps the energy economy aspect while viral status multiplies all damage to health by up to 4.25x which is spread via divine retritbution, and finally in cascade, Nourish has no frame vulnerability (i.e. cannot be knocked back to frame while in operator).

# ARSENAL 
Divine Retribution is best paired with status weapons like pure heat Furis or melee weapons with influence/afflictions.
- Furis: https://overframe.gg/build/492085/
- Coda Mire Slam: https://overframe.gg/build/829452/
- Arca Titron Slam: https://overframe.gg/build/601678/

**Companion**
[\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) will help you prime [\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/) for [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/) and [\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) (which procs while Divine Spears is active).

# SURVIVABILITY
1. Active shield gating: Spam 1 constantly to shield gate actively since it has a very fast cast. With Catalyzing Shield this resets your 1.33s gate on demand.
2. Warding Halo: At low strength, Warding Halo will be as small as possible and therefore break easier than normal. Upon breaking warding halo gives 2s iframes. Immediately recasting will give a further 3s iframes.
3. Passive shield gating: Arcane aegis and [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) on a pet are additional OPTIONAL layers of passive survivability

# PLAYSTYLE
1. Cast 4 and shoot one enemy with [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) until all enemies are dead
2. Tap 1 frequently to gain speed boost and actively shield gate
3. Tap 3 whenever it breaks to gain 3s iframe and knockdown immunity (you have a long 2s window to do this)
4. Keep nourish active as needed

# ARCHON SHARDS
Flexible:
- 2 Cast Speed - helps speed up Halo and Divine Spears cast
- 3 Parkour Velocity - for mobility

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

See this for both Sirius and Orion matching builds: https://www.arsenyx.com/builds/B78im78Ufy

# PLAYSTYLE
This build uses Orion as the 'main' weapon platform and Sirius as the 'buffer'. This is because Orion's 1 and 3 abilities require maximising range with [\[Overextended\]](/items/arsenal/794/overextended/) which reduces maximum duration and strength, while Sirius can run maximum duration and strength for a buff. 

Keep default controls as you will mostly stay in Orion.
1. Spam 1 everywhere to strip armor
2. Keep 2 active for free damage negation
3. Cast 3 sparingly for grouping, or not at all since this carries enemies away from you, prevents headshots for incarnons and also ragdolls thrax specters into it prevent amp headshots.
4. Hold 1 to swap to Sirius to get on-demand 1.5s i-frame if needed. On swap you will activate arcane concentration, then immediately tap 3 for the buff (e.g. Roar) to snapshot the boosted duration. Hold 1 to swap back to Orion. Once your buff on Orion runs out, repeat step 4.

# STAT BREAKDOWN
**SIRIUS**
The only role here is to apply the buff and then return to Orion. Therefore we want to maximise duration first with all available mods and arcanes that boost duration meaning you don't need to switch frames very often, then maximise strength for the buff value. Efficiency, energy and range don't matter at all.

**ORION**
Orion just needs to cast Gravitic Slash and Event Horizon which both require maximum range and needs to hit 164% strength for Gravitic Slash to full strip in 1 cast with [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/). The rest can go into survivability (shield recharge, catalyzing shield, [\[Rolling Guard\]](/items/arsenal/1430/rolling-guard/)), quality of life ([\[Ice Spring\]](/items/arsenal/845/ice-spring/)), damage ([\[Vigorous Swap\]](/items/arsenal/1429/vigorous-swap/)) and energy economy (equilbrium, [\[Flow\]](/items/arsenal/832/flow/)) which are all generally flexible and dependent on personal preference. 

Arcane wise run Crepuscular if abusing [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) invisibility but, Hot Shot for use with [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) Stars to boost crit chance or whatever matching damage arcane you want (e.g. Precision, [\[Rage\]](/items/arsenal/820/rage/), Velocity, Fury etc).

# HELMINTH
You will need to use buffs that apply to allies if you are casting from Sirius to apply to Orion
- Roar: best general damage buff which double dips status damage and doesn't mess with status weighting for status weapons, and also triple dips melee influence. This is best used for weapons like [\[Torid\]](/items/arsenal/907/torid/) incarnon, [\[Furis\]](/items/arsenal/1193/furis/) incarnon, any melee influence weapon as well as most weapons modded with viral while paired with armor strip from Orion 1.
- Nourish: adds viral damage to weapons allowing you to mod corrosive +/- heat/blast/cold. Good for raw damage weapons that run raw corrosive damage e.g. dual toxocyst incarnon which will strip armor passively with corrosive without needing to use Orion 1.
- Thermal Transfer: adds non-combining heat, cold or blast elemental buff to weapons
- Shock Trooper: adds non-combining electric damage buff to weapons. Especially good for melee influence on weapons

To match with the main Celestial Clash build you can keep Roar subsumed over 3 on SIRIUS as the Primary Son. We will use Sirius as a dedicated 'buff' holder. You can activate Roar from Orion at any time by holding down 3 or swap manually to Sirius then activate Roar (this is preferred if running Arcane Concentration).

If not using Roar you can consider subsuming over Sirius 4 and run [\[Precision Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/6377/precision-intensify/) instead of [\[Umbral Intensify\]](/items/arsenal/695/umbral-intensify/). Drop [\[Piercing Roar\]](/items/arsenal/175/piercing-roar/) for either more strength or the other augments.

# [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) INVISIBILITY
Currently (likely due to a bug), turning invisible with [\[Shade\]](/items/arsenal/2244/shade/) then swapping brothers, waiting for second brother to turn invisibility then immediately shooting to break invisibility and finally swapping back to first brother, will make the first brother permanently invisible not even breaking from attacking. 

This means to make Orion permanently invisible what you want to do is start in Orion and wait till he is invisible, swap immediately to Sirius and then wait until Sirius turns insvisible. As soon as Sirius turns invisible, BREAK the invisibility by shooting your weapon then immediately swap back to Orion. From now on, nothing can break Orion's invisibility state.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Torid Incarnon turns into a chaining beam with a small 2-3meter AOE at site of impact that creates chains.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024: With Status changes, Blast now applies 5m AOE and Corrosive allows armor strip and has bonus against grineer. If you have external armor strip, swap [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) out for either [\[Rifle Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6569/rifle-elementalist/), [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/), [\[Primed Firestorm\]](/items/arsenal/5331/primed-firestorm/) or [\[Hammer Shot\]](/items/arsenal/590/hammer-shot/).**

Quick Video demonstration of [\[Torid\]](/items/arsenal/907/torid/) gameplay in Simulacrum and Levelcap Cascade for clearing trash enemies:

[[ youtube id="TK_uP5k3pP8" ]]

# EVOLUTION GUIDE

Evolution II: Final Fusillade gives +51 damage. The last shot bonus doesn't apply to incarnon mode. The other option Plentiful Mayhem only gives +31 dmg and consumes all your ammo rapidly. 
Evolution III: Pick any, but i prefer Swift Deliverance +50% projectile velocity to allow you to hit targets easier for charging of the incarnon form
Evolution IV: Survivor's Edge - increases both CC and SC. This benefits natural status based builds such as blast or toxin. This is approximately 10% better than Commodore's Fortune.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

Serration/Amalgam Serration - gives additive damage to Primary Merciless but very useful when at 0 stacks of merciless i.e. during periods of low enemy spawn or between rotations so you don't constantly drop to 0 +damage. Amalgam variant is optional as it gives mobility quality of life.
Galv Chamber: Mandatory multishot
Crit Delay: Mandatory CC. Flexible for [\[Galvanized Scope\]](/items/arsenal/5519/galvanized-scope/) if you are okay with getting headshots.
[\[Vital Sense\]](/items/arsenal/625/vital-sense/): Mandatory CD.
Vile accel: Boosts fire rate. Flexible for other fire rate mods. If you can offload this to [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/), Arcane Acceleration or frame buffs, swap this for a flexible option below.
Elements: See ELEMENTAL VARIANTS below

Primary Merciless: Gives +360% base damage and can proc on DoT kills. 
Primary Deadhead: Optional, stacks last longer and you get a headshot bonus, but requires you to jump and aim at heads to trigger, which can be tricky. This is also nearly impossible on certain enemies such as murmur.

**Why not Galvanized Aptitude?**
Currently Galvanized Aptitude only applies to the base damage before the base damage boost from Final Fusillade/Plentiful Mayhem evolution, meaning it only has 50% of the advertised effect i.e. approximately 80% damage at 2 statuses (vs 165% from [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/)). It is multiplicative on the incarnoff mode direct hit and doesn't apply to the AOE component of incarnoff, but does apply to the AOE component of the incarnon mode.

**Flexible options**
1. Primed Bane: multiplicative to +dmg, double dips status damage for 2.4x. You need to swap this depending on the mission, and note some factions like Scaldra and Techrot do not currently have faction mods.
2. Rifle Elementalist - 1.9x multiplier to the blast status damage.
3. Primed Firestorm - increases the AOE at the end of the primary beam, which potentially increases how many total enemies can be hit (by approximately 1.5 to 2x)
4. Hammer Shot - more crit dmg and status chance
5. Magnetic Capacity - magnetic status significantly boosts damage against overguard (e.g. thrax and eximus).

**RIven**
Positives: MS, CD, CC, FR, DMG
Slot over Vile accel if roll FR
Slot over Crit Delay if roll CC only
Slot over Vital Sense if roll CD only

# ELEMENTAL VARIANTS
Blast Corrosive: Best for trash clearing against armored enemies (e.g. grineer/corrupted). Use [\[Primed Cryo Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/611/primed-cryo-rounds/) for raw damage, blast status has a 5m AOE at 10 stacks or on death which accelerates trash clearance while [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) forms corrosive with innate toxin which allows you to strip some armor to boost damage against armored enemies. If you have external electric e.g. from a violet shard, you could drop [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) for [\[Rifle Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6569/rifle-elementalist/), Primed Bane, [\[Magnetic Capacity\]](/items/arsenal/7192/magnetic-capacity/) etc.

Viral Electric: Better against single targets compared Corrosive Blast but slightly slower trash clear, however once you add violet primary electric shards this can become much stronger.  https://overframe.gg/build/572414/

Pure Blast: Use this for trash clearing against enemies without armor or if using armor strip from another source. You can drop [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) for [\[Rifle Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6569/rifle-elementalist/) or another flexible option.

Pure Toxin: This gives theoretically the highest single target DPS but only with some external priming and armor strip (e.g. viral + heat + corro): https://overframe.gg/build/492817/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Raw viral magnetic heat damage variant for grineer and corrupted enemies. With current update due to armor and health changes, this scales higher than Viral Slash.

# Evolutions
- Evolution I - Incarnon form - 12 headshots (less with multishot) lets you switch to Incarnon mode after alt-fire which has about 408 rounds

- Evolution II - Void's Guidance - +50% Accuracy and -50% Recoil. The combination of this perk with Primary Deadhead gives -100% recoil. If you run stabilizer in exilus as well as primary deadhead, you can run Rapid Wrath (+20% fire rate) instead.

- Evolution III - Ready Retaliation - +100% reload speed for 6s when reload from empty. This actually also affects the transformation time, cutting it down from 3.4s to approx 1.7s if you manage to reload from empty.

- Evolution IV - Elemental Excess - +20% status chance, -10% critical chance. This drops the final crit chance to 10% to synergize with Devouring Attrition and makes the final status chance approximately 70%.

- Evolution V - Devouring Attrition - 50% chance to deal 2000% damage on non-critical hits. This 2000% multiplier is currently a *separate* multiplier to base damage mods such as serration, deadhead, galvanized aptitude

# Mod Explanations
- Galvanized Chamber - +230% multishot at max stacks

- Galvanized Aptitude - +80% dmg per status, so +320% with slash, radiation, viral and heat, or even more if you use an external primer. 

- Primed Shred  - gives fire rate and punchthrough

- Viral - Raw viral damage has a 1.5x multiplier for Corrupted. Since [\[Primed Cryo Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/611/primed-cryo-rounds/) exists for rifles, this gives the largest boost in raw damage which is also beneficial against overguard. In addition, a single viral status proc doubles the damage of all subsequent damage, while 10 stacks of viral multiplies all damage to health by 4.25x. 

- Heat (hellfire) - optional element that applies damaging status and also strips 50% armor after 2s. Even just 50% armor strip is effectively a 3.7x damage multiplier on armor capped enemies. If you are fighting unarmored enemies or murmur enemies, you could consider swapping this to Electric.

- Magnetic Capacity - magnetic status helps against overguard and shields

- Amalgam Serration/Serration - can use amalgam or normal version, where amalgam gives some free sprint sprint at minimal damage loss. [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/) is additive both Galv Aptitude and Primary Deadhead so is the WEAKEST link, and can be swapped out for any of the followiing FLEXIBLE options:

**Flexible Options**
- Vile acceleration - additional fire rate
- Primed Bane of Grineer/Corrupted - additional 1.55x multiplier. If you don't like bane you can replace with a flexible option below
- Primed Fast Hands - cuts a further 1 second from the transformation time (3.4s to 2.4s without Ready Retaliation active, or down to 1.5s when stacked with Ready Retaliation) and improves feel of non-incarnon mode. 
- Radiated Reload - gives some reload boost as well as radiation damage.
- Riven - look for +ms, +dmg, +fire rate, +tox, +reload speed with negative crit chance.
- Rifle Elementalist - boosts heat status DPS, but heat status only accounts for 5-10% of total DPS, meaning Elementalist only adds about 5% to total DPS.
- Vigilante Armaments - slight boost to multishot

## ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS
For trash clearing: Use pure blast with [\[Rime Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/591/rime-rounds/) + [\[Thermite Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/589/thermite-rounds/) and add [\[Rifle Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6569/rifle-elementalist/) 
For Murmur: Use Radiation Cold  or Viral Electric
For Corpus: Use pure Toxin elements

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION

Felarx is a full-auto projectile shotgun that feels like an automatic Exergis, that transforms into semi-automatic dual pistols. We will mostly be using the Primary Shotgun mode due to the higher base damage, innate multishot and better feel of full-auto trigger, but the build would also work well for the incarnon mode. The non-incarnon mode also has infinite body/enemy punchthrough.

Due to the Devastating Attrition perk giving 2000% damage multiplier on 50% of non-crits, we build Felarx for a raw damage non-crit build and take advantage of shotgun's access to TWO Primed elemental mods ([\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) and [\[Primed Chilling Grasp\]](/items/arsenal/5401/primed-chilling-grasp/)). You can either build for raw Viral + Electric or raw Corrosive + Cold. Corrosive has a 50% bonus against Grineer while Viral has a 50% bonus against Corrupted enemies, however Corrosive Cold can be used alongside the common subsume Nourish to get Viral Corrosive Cold. Viral or Corrosive Heat is a slightly less effective alternative due to lack of primed heat mod and relatively low status chance.

An alternative playstyle that I prefer, that may not be for everyone, is to use a secondary or melee primer and constantly swap to reload (only 1.7s for full 13 clip reload with Evolved Autoreloader perk) and prime for mega boosting the multiplicative [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/).

# EVOLUTION CHOICES

1. Incarnon Form : Land headshots to build up charge. 
2. Frictionless Flight : +50% Projectile Flight Speed OR Kinetic Baffle -50% recoil (combines with Deadhead to be 100% recoil reduction). This is mostly personal preference, if you are okay with the minor recoil it has.
3. Evolved Autoreloader: allows you to bypass the insane reload time, allowing full reload in 2s of swapping weapons (or just 1.7s with two Synth mods). Combine with a Primer or use a melee to quickly switch between weapons. Mounting Momentum is an alternative that gives +10% fire rate for each shell reloaded. If you reload 13 shells from empty, you can get up to +130% fire rate for the next 13 bullets, but the total reload is still about 3s long. If you want this, drop shotgun spazz for primed tactical pump. The non-incarnon form actually has infinite body punchthrough, making the dual mode chamber perk useless. 
4. Wracking Wrath: +20% status chance, -10% crit chance. Improves chances of Devastating Attrition proc
5. Devastating Attrition: 50% chance to deal 2000% damage on non-crits. Presumable similar to Devouring Attrition, being multiplicative to base dmg sources.

# MOD CHOICES

- Galvanized Hell : +230% multishot at max stacks, 
- [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/): +80% dmg per status, so potentially +400% dmg after 5 statuses, or even more with priming. Apparently multiplicative with +dmg sources like Primed Point Blank and Primary Deadhead
- Primed Ammo Stock : turns magazine size from 6 to 13. If you reload from empty, you can gain +130% fire rate from full clip.
- [\[Primed Tactical Pump\]](/items/arsenal/5495/primed-tactical-pump/) : cuts long reload speeds. Use [\[Shotgun Barrage\]](/items/arsenal/738/shotgun-barrage/) instead if you use Evolved Autoreloader perk (stack with Synth set for about 60% reload per second of holster, or basically full reload in 1.7s upon switching to a primer or melee).
- Shotgun Barrage: gives fire rate, can swap out if you have external fire rate e.g. Reinforced Bond.
- [\[Primed Cleanse Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/4353/primed-cleanse-grineer/) : Multiplicative 55% to other +dmg sources. Flexible for Primed Point Blank (only slightly worse overall DPS, best used for Acolytes/Thrax/Factionless or if you don't like swapping faction mods).
- Primed Charged Shell/Contagious Spread/[\[Primed Chilling Grasp\]](/items/arsenal/5401/primed-chilling-grasp/) : maximum elemental damage for raw corrosove + cold. Switch order to make viral + electric if desired, or add Incendiary Coat or Blaze over Primed Chilling Grasp to make Corrosive/Heat. Add [\[Incendiary Coat\]](/items/arsenal/736/incendiary-coat/) over [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) and reorder mods to make viral heat. [\[Primed Chilling Grasp\]](/items/arsenal/5401/primed-chilling-grasp/) is flexible for Chilling Reload. Contagious Spread is alternative to Toxic Barrage (needs more forma for tiny damage boost). Can use non-primed versions or 60/60 versions of any elementals if you don't own them or can't fit them.

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**
- Primed Cleanse: multiplicative bonus against specific faction, use this for endurance disruption over shotgun barrage especially if you have external fire rate
- Blaze: gives +heat and +damage

**Arcane**
Flexible choice
- Primary Deadhead : +360% dmg after just 3 headshot kills which multiplies with Galv Savvy, recoil bonus and extra 30% headshot multiplier. 
- Primary Merciless : +360% dmg but needs 12 kills and drops stacks quickly, ammo maximum and reload bonus go very well with [\[Felarx\]](/items/arsenal/5872/felarx/)

**Other factions**
For Murmur: make RADIATION + COLD. 
For Index: Make MAGNETIC

**Riven**
A riven is usually NOT recommended due to the very low disposition meaning most rivens you roll will simply give you less DPS than other shotgun mods. 
Desired positives include +dmg, +multishot, +fire rate, +magazine capacity, +element and desired negative is -critical chance.

# SYNERGIES 
Magnetize and [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s bubbles synergize with the infinite punchthrough property

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a standard Viral Electric [\[Phantasma\]](/items/arsenal/1440/phantasma/) build which is best used for general use and against groups of enemies, as electric procs have a small AOE (3m), are uncapped and scale with elemental mods. Armor strip helps against higher level Steel path grineer/corrupted enemies.

Heat is an alternative option which scales higher against single targets and can benefit from Heat inherit mechanics. Simply swap [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) for Incendiary Coat.
If you plan on using a Viral Primer, swap the viral mods for Shell Shock + Vigilante Armaments.

# Mod Breakdown

- [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) : Gives +80% damage per status effect. [\[Phantasma\]](/items/arsenal/1440/phantasma/) procs impact, radiation, electric and viral giving a maximum of +320% dmg without external priming. Also gives +80% status which is essential for status effects, the key damaging component of phantasma, but is additive to Primary Merciless.
- [\[Galvanized Hell\]](/items/arsenal/5522/galvanized-hell/): Gives +230% multishot at max stacks.Multishot is essential on beam weapons as it increases both beam damage and status chance thereby basically double dipping in the damage of status effects (such as electric).
- Viral ([\[Toxic Barrage\]](/items/arsenal/713/toxic-barrage/) and [\[Frigid Blast\]](/items/arsenal/712/frigid-blast/)): viral status boosts damage of electric procs by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. You want to use maxed mods for the bonus to status chance.
- Electric ([\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/)): this is the key damaging elemental mod giving +165% electric damage to each electric proc and increasing electric bias
- Primed cleanse grineer/corrupted: this double dips on status effects, multiplying the damage of electric procs by +140.25% (i.e. 2.4x). Ths is flexible for vigilante armaments or magnetic strafe if you dislike faction mods.
- Shotgun Barrage/Repeater Clip: firerate directly multiplies DPS by 1.9 to 2.05x. 
- [\[Shotgun Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6571/shotgun-elementalist/): boosts status damage by 90% and also increases clip size which is a nice bonus.

Exilus:
Personal preference but [\[Phantasma\]](/items/arsenal/1440/phantasma/) can be an ammo hog. Use primed ammo mutation if you feel ammo is an issue.
Otherwise leave the default polarity and use Galvanized Acceleration.

Arcane:
Up to preference as many options are viable.
- Primary Crux: gives ammo efficiency and huge status chance, very nice quality of life since you reload less. Overall DPS is the lowest but this would **feel** the best to use.
- Shotgun Vendetta: +180% multishot is better than merciless after only 2 status effects due to how multishot double dips status damage, however is only better than deadhead with headshots after 6 statuses (i.e. using an external primer). Use this if you aren't planning on aiming at heads or not using electric.
- Primary Deadhead : The bonus 1.3x headshot multiplier double dips when electric procs hit the head, dealing 1.69x damage (note elec procs no longer double dip the usual 3x headshot multiplier and instead have a base multiuplier of 1x). Use this is you are planning on aiming at heads AND using electric.
- Primary Merciless : Fine alternative when not aiming at heads.

# ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS
- Heat: Great for single target as heat procs constantly refresh the duration of all previous heat procs meaning it can stack infinitely. Simply swap the two electric mods for [\[Incendiary Coat\]](/items/arsenal/736/incendiary-coat/) and either [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/) or [\[Scattering Inferno\]](/items/arsenal/711/scattering-inferno/). Can also work with heat inherit but you don't really get much additional DPS out of it unless you drop both virals and one heat mod for crit mods + vigilante armaments.
- Toxin: Optional for steel path corpus as electric works fine too, but toxin completely bypasses shields. Simply swap out electric mod for toxin mods and cold mod for [\[Vigilante Armaments\]](/items/arsenal/696/vigilante-armaments/). Works well with expedite suffering.

# ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS
- ELECTRIC: Best 'general use' element because it ticks INSTANTLY when procced meaning it has the potential fastest TTK, has a small AOE which helps with clearing groups of enemies, benefits from electric mods and is best used alongside Roar or Shock subsume with Shock Trooper. Electric also has a bonus against murmur enemies.
- HEAT: Best element against armored enemies but has a 1s delay, but strips armor by up to 50% after 2s which is equivalent to a 3.6x damage boost. Can benefit from heat inherit meaning if you prime first with a secondary weapon with Faction Mod bonuses and Heat mod bonuses, they can be inherited by Nataruk. This is the way to maximise single target DPS but requires setup. Best used with Roar subsume.
- TOXIN: Best against corpus since toxin completely bypasses large shields and directly oneshots health.
- GAS: Nice AOE clearing element as it creates persisting zones of damage, but requires two mod slots and does not benefit from elemental mod bonus. Nice for stationary or camping missions where new enemies will continuously walk into clouds.
- BLAST: Has the fastest AOE clearing potential but is also the most inconsistent since it requires you to either proc 10 blast statuses within 1.5s (which is impossible on [\[Nataruk\]](/items/arsenal/5725/nataruk/)), or have enough raw damage to oneshot enemies while also proccing one blast proc (mostly possible against lower level trash).

Evo 2: Fortress Salvo +42 damage and if armor >450, you get 2 bonus puncthrough
Evo 3: Kinetic Battle -50% recoil
Evo 4: Absolute Valor +22% CC makes the final CC 50%

# ACUITY VS [\[Galvanized Chamber\]](/items/arsenal/5520/galvanized-chamber/)
[\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/) mod states it gives +350% headshot multiplier but this is actually +525% multiplier additive to the base 300% headshot multiplier and also gives +350% critical chance on headshots which is additive to other crit mods. Since it locks multishot to 1, it will charge the incarnon charge slightly slower but still not feel too bad to use. If you really dislike the charging rate, just swap Primary Acuity to Galvanized Chamber instead.

Burston Prime Incarnon form has a 50/50 split between direct hit and a small AOE component. This AOE component does NOT benefit from either the headshot multiplier (from either base or [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/)) OR from Multishot, however it does benefit from the critical chance from [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/).

Overall, [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/) is stronger for a single target use where you are getting a high proportion of headshots  e.g. killing select strong targets such as Thrax, Demolysts e.t.c, while [\[Galvanized Chamber\]](/items/arsenal/5520/galvanized-chamber/) is better for general use where you expect to get a decent amount of body shots too.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

**NOTE**: [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/) is NOT used because it ignores the 40 base dmg bonus of evolution 2 which makes up about 75% of total base damage (although it does apply to the AOE component due to it being hitscan). This means it has approximately only about 25% as effective as it should be meaning its equivalent to gaining 20% dmg per status effect rather than 80%. With the base 2 statuses on incarnon mode you are getting only 40% damage instead of 155% from amalgam serration.

- Serration/[\[Amalgam Serration\]](/items/arsenal/2384/amalgam-serration/): flexible when running Primary Deadhead since you get base damage from the arcane, although sometimes it is nice to have non-conditional base damage eg when there is downtime between kills. Amalgam serration also boosts sprint speed which is nice mobility bonus.
- [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/): gives headshot damage (additive to headshot multiplier) but is currently bugged to give 5.25x extra headshot multiplier on top of the 3x base, as well as +350% critical chance on headshots. FLEXIBLE for Galvanized Chamber when you don't want to focus on headshots or don't like the slower charge rate.
- [\[Critical Delay\]](/items/arsenal/582/critical-delay/) + [\[Primary Acuity\]](/items/arsenal/7194/primary-acuity/) + Galv Scope: on headshots gives a final cc of 485% which means you have a high percentage of tier 5 red crits.  Technically swapping Crit Delay out for [\[Bladed Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/604/bladed-rounds/) or [\[Hammer Shot\]](/items/arsenal/590/hammer-shot/) would give more final DPS however crit delay helps maintain a level of crit when you are only hitting bodyshots. Galvanized Scope is flexible instead since it relies on stacks and can be inconsistent - e.g. for hammer shot or magnetic capacity
- Vital Sense: mandatory CD
- Viral ([\[Malignant Force\]](/items/arsenal/592/malignant-force/) + PCR): raw viral damage has 50% bonus on corrupted, and any viral status you proc further boosts damage to health up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. See below for different elemental combinations
- [\[Gilded Truth\]](/items/arsenal/755/gilded-truth/): 80% fire rate and you can proc truth effect (25% parkour velocity for 30s, a bit of healing and gas procs), and you can get punchthrough via Fortress Salvo evolution if you have armor >450. Primed Shred and Vile Acceleration are alternatives.

**Flexible Options**
Swap Galv Scope:
- Magnetic Capacity: adds magnetic dmg which has a boost against overguard
- Primed Bane: multiplicative 55% DPS boost, which double dips on any heat statuses you proc
- Hammer shot: more crit damage and status chance
- Hellfire/thermite rounds - boosts heat status DPS by a little bit

# ELEMENTAL COMBINATIONS
- RAW VIRAL (Primed Cryo + [\[Malignant Force\]](/items/arsenal/592/malignant-force/)) : good for general use since it uses primed cryo round for high raw elemental damage, and viral status boosts all damage to health by 4.25x
- RAW MAGNETIC (Primed Cryo + Stormbringer) : best for Thrax killing in combination with Nourish 
- RAW CORROSIVE (Stormbringer + Infected Clip):  best for Grineer demolysts with external viral priming
- BLAST: Decent trash clear option, best combined with either corrosive for armor strip or nourish providing viral status.

**UPDATE 2025** - Primary Crux is best for incarnoff mode since you get ammo efficiency which helps maintain Hata Satya for a larger portion of the magazine.

**UPDATE 22 JUNE 2023 - Hata Satya now works on incarnon mode**

# EVOLUTIONS:

**Evolution II**: Both evolutions work well:

- Fortifying Bloodshed is very nice for constant passive shield gating as every kill via Bleed DoT generates 100 shield.  This is amazing for shield gating and endurance setups. 

- Fortress Salvo gives +4 puncthrough which is AMAZING, but requires you to either mod armor or run a frame with high base armor. The following frames require NO additional armor mods or abilities to hit 450 (Atlas/Atlas Prime, Lavos, Nidus/Nidus Prime, Valkyr/Valkyr Prime), while the following frames need can hit >450 armor with an ability active (Chroma/Chroma Prime with Vex Armor or Cold Ward active, Oberon with Iron Renewal/[\[Hallowed Reckoning\]](/items/arsenal/158/hallowed-reckoning/), [\[Wukong\]](/items/arsenal/37/wukong/) with Defy, [\[Vauban\]](/items/arsenal/56/vauban/) with Bastille, [\[Inaros\]](/items/arsenal/51/inaros/) with Scarab Swarm, [\[Rhino\]](/items/arsenal/49/rhino/) with Ironclad Charge). Other universal sources of armor that easily exceed 450 armor include any of the base armor mods, Warcry/Defy/Elemental Ward/Parasitic armor subsume, Arcane Guardian/Reaper/Ultimatum/Tanker, Mecha Pulse with Mecha set/kubrow, 

**Evolution III**: Down to preference but Kinetic Battle -50% recoil feels the best.

**Evolution IV**: After maths, Fresh Havoc gives on average 30% more DPS compared to Fatal Aflection and Zeroed in. This simply requires you to reload from empty 2 times for a persistent +12 flat base dmg buff that lasts until you die.

![](https://imgur.com/fg9jeFW.png)

**TL:DR - Highest possible DPS on most frames is incarnon Soma Prime running Hata-Satya and no Galv Aptitude**

# MOD BREAKDOWN

- Damage: Currently [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/) is BUGGED on Incarnon's, not taking into account any flat base dmg buffs such as from Fortifying Bloodshed (+10) or Fresh Havoc (+12), meaning Galv Aptitude only has approximately 30% of its intended effect (+24% dmg per status). At 5 statuses, this is equivalent to only +120% damage. Therefore we use Serration/Amalgam Serration which provides overall more damage which is non-conditional. Amalgam variant is optional but gives better mobility for quality of life.

- Multishot: [\[Galvanized Chamber\]](/items/arsenal/5520/galvanized-chamber/) alone provides +230% multishot at maximum stacks. Do NOT stack [\[Vigilante Armaments\]](/items/arsenal/696/vigilante-armaments/) as you are getting diminishing returns and run out of mod space, getting from only 230% to 290%. At 230%, every bullet now produces 3 bullets with a 30% chance for 4 bullets.

- Crit Chance: [\[Hata-Satya\]](/items/arsenal/5170/hata-satya/) augment increases CC by 1.2% per bullet hit. With max multishot, each shot produces 3 bullets minimum meaning a 3.6% increase per hit. From full spool, you need to land at most 42 hits to match point strike which is +150%. With 30% chance to get 4 bullets, this could be cut down to about 30-40 hits. By 60 hits, your crit bonus will be +252% which equates to 106% crit chance, or Guaranteed yellow crits.  This means you want to aim and make sure you hit your target to maximise the crit gain on remaining bullets in your magazine. The maximum possible crit bonus of +500% or 180% final CC (mostly orange crits), can be reached after hitting about 100-140 enemies or after more than half the clip has been emptied. Stacking [\[Point Strike\]](/items/arsenal/624/point-strike/) on top of this gives a +53% difference at 60 hits or +45% difference at max bonus, which is nice but doesn't produce as great an effect as other mod options. 

- Crit Dmg: Vital Sense - mandatory crit damage

- Viral: Raw viral damage At max viral stacks (x10), we magnify damage to health by slash procs by 4.25x. 

- Heat: [\[Wildfire\]](/items/arsenal/595/wildfire/) gives occasional heat procs that strip armor, deal damage . Wildfire also gives a bit of extra magazine size whicih makes incarnoff feel better.

- Primed Shred/Vile acceleration: Punchthrough lets you hit more enemies and build up Hata-Satya even faster. If you have Fortress Salvo activated, you can swap this to Vile Acceleration instead if you prefer

- Arcane: Primary Crux gives extra status chance but most importantly gives ammo efficiency for incarnoff use. Primary Merciless provides the base damage and procs on bleed DoT kills, while Deadhead does not. Primary Plated Rounds gives a higher possible dmg buff +466% but this only lasts for 10s and doesn't affect the Incarnon mode. This means you will need to empty the entire clip in one go to take full advantage of the buff which is bit of ammo waste.

**ALTERNATIVE SLASH**

- Slash: [\[Hunter Munitions\]](/items/arsenal/688/hunter-munitions/) over [\[Wildfire\]](/items/arsenal/595/wildfire/) can be used to create slash procs and requires crits to function. Slash procs bypass armor so you will mostly be relying on slash procs to kill heavily armored enemies like Grineer/Corrupted. This means you don't need to keep shooting them, even just a short burst of 10 bullets could be enough to let slash procs build up and kill an enemy. Kills via bleed also trigger Fortifying Bloodshed which regenerates shields constantly for shield gating. If you don't care about shields, you could swap this to Hellfire which technically deals higher total raw DPS.

- Faction mod: [\[Primed Bane Of Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/609/primed-bane-of-grineer/) is multiplicative with damage mods meaning it results in a separate +55% damage bonus with +360% from merciless, giving  11.73x damage (compare this to [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/) which only adds 165% to 360%, giving 625% total). Furthermore, banes 'double dip' on slash procs, meaning slash procs actually receive a 2.401x multiplier. If you don't own the *primed* version, you should still use regular [\[Bane Of Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/633/bane-of-grineer/) since slash procs receive a 1.69x bonus. 

Riven: 
Generally due to the poor disposition, you do NOT want more damage or multishot since they just add with diminishing returns. 
MS/CD/CC/punchthrough/firerate are the most desired stats for soma. Ideally, you coul also have toxin +/- cold so you can replace one or both of the elemental mods.

# ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS FOR FACTIONS
- Grineer/Corrupted: Use Viral Heat or Viral Hunter munitions
- Corpus: Use pure toxin to bypass shields.
- Murmur: use Raw radiation or Viral Electric

# [\[Braton Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1225/braton-prime/) VS VANDAL
Very similar overall results

![](https://imgur.com/6Yd5v6S.png)

A raw damage [\[Braton Vandal\]](/items/arsenal/1235/braton-vandal/) has 3% higher average DPS than [\[Braton Prime\]](/items/arsenal/1225/braton-prime/), but not accounting for the benefit of status effects like viral and heat.

# EVOLUTIONS:
**UPDATE OCT 2023**
Prelude of Might as now been fixed to not be active at all critical chance values. This makes Critical Parallel the best choice.

**Evolution II: Daring Reverie** - increases base damage (pre-mod), with a much bigger boost when using a chanelled ability (e.g. Gloom) and also gives +50% ammo efficiency (which only applies to non-incarnon mode ammo). Chanelled Abilities that work with Daring Reverie include the following: Gloom but only when enemies are in range (Sevagoth/Subsumable), Effigy (Chroma), Immolation (ember - but only at 90% heat), Prowl ([\[Ivara\]](/items/arsenal/48/ivara/)), Prism ([\[Mirage\]](/items/arsenal/25/mirage/)), Absorb with [\[Assimilate\]](/items/arsenal/126/assimilate/) augment ([\[Nyx\]](/items/arsenal/28/nyx/)), Renewal ([\[Oberon\]](/items/arsenal/43/oberon/)), [\[Exalted Blade\]](/items/arsenal/7440/exalted-blade/) ([\[Excalibur\]](/items/arsenal/18/excalibur/)), [\[Hysteria\]](/items/arsenal/7447/hysteria/) ([\[Valkyr\]](/items/arsenal/11/valkyr/)), Mend and [\[Maim\]](/items/arsenal/429/maim/) ([\[Equinox\]](/items/arsenal/62/equinox/))

Munitions Grit causes your multishot to consume ammo which gives a higher potential DPS boost, but makes you lose all your ammo and exit incarnon mode extremely quickly, reducing your overall available damage while in incarnon form, so don't choose that one.

**Evolution III: Void's Guidance**- increases accuracy and reduces recoil by 60%. This is excellent for a high fire rate spamming weapon like [\[Braton\]](/items/arsenal/1229/braton/), and stacks with Steady Aim to become zero recoil. Mercenary Chamber is also decent if you have ammo issues, but this can be circumvented with vigilante supplies/ammo mutation + Daring Reverie's ammo efficiency perk. Gunsmoke Pick up doesnt seem worth it at all.

**Evolution IV:** 
- Critical Parallel - increases PRE MOD base CC by 18%/16% (prime/vandal) and base CD by 0.2/0.4 multiplier, making the new base CC 48% and base CD 3.2 on Prime and 54%/3.6 on Vandal. After Crit Delay and [\[Vital Sense\]](/items/arsenal/625/vital-sense/), we end up with final CC of 144% and final tier 1 crit multiplier of 7.04 and tier 2 crit multi of 13.08 on Prime and 162% CC with Tier 1 multi of 7.92x and Tier 2 multi of 14.84x on Vandal.

- Prelude of Might increases your base CD by at flat 3x to a whopping 6x, meaning after [\[Vital Sense\]](/items/arsenal/625/vital-sense/) you get 13.2x CD, however, this is at the cost of running <50% cc, which actually reduces total average damage to half of Critical Parallel.

- Survivor's Edge - increases CC by less than Critical Parallel and boosts status chance so final SC is roughly 80-100% All this means is slightly more consistent viral procs and more heat procs but does not result in higher DPS ceiling since Viral is capped at 10 and status chance does not affect slash procs created by Hunter Munitions.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- Amalgam Serration/Serration: This is a FLEXIBLE option. Serration provides additive base damage to Primary Deadhead/Merciless, but does not require ramp-up and stacks so is nice to keep on for quality of life. The Amalgam version also gives bonus sprint speed at a negligible loss of additive base damage. Note, we do NOT use [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/) because it ignores the base damage gained via evolution 2 which is particularly significant if you use channelled abilities.

- [\[Galvanized Chamber\]](/items/arsenal/5520/galvanized-chamber/) : +230% multishot, does not apply to the AOE component. Flexible for Primary Acuity if you prefer a pure headshot focused build.

- [\[Critical Delay\]](/items/arsenal/582/critical-delay/) + Galv Scope: Pushes crit chance to 298% on Prime and 335% on Vandal. Galv scope is flexible for Magnetic Capacity, Bladed Rounds or Hammer Shot.

- Vital Sense: Pushes crit damage to 7.04x on prime and 7.92x on vandal after Critical Parallel.

- Primed Shred/Vile Acceleration: Boosts firerate and shred gives punchthrough.

- Primed Cryo Round + [\[Malignant Force\]](/items/arsenal/592/malignant-force/): Creates raw Viral damage (has 50% bonus to corrupted) and increases the status chance so Viral status is easier to proc. Viral status boosts all damage to health, up to 4.25x multiplier at 10 stacks.

- Exilus : personal preference. [\[Vigilante Supplies\]](/items/arsenal/699/vigilante-supplies/) gives ammo for base form and has a chance to boost crit tiers. Stabilizer reduces recoil to zero if you really dislike recoil.

- Arcane: Primary Deadhead gives +360% dmg and headshot multipplier

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**
- Bladed Rounds: crit damage with aiming
- Hammer Shot: crit damage and status chance
- Primed Bane: Multiplicative 55% which doubles dips on any heat procs created. Flexible for other options.
- [\[Primed Firestorm\]](/items/arsenal/5331/primed-firestorm/): Increases the 3m AOE to 4.32m, thereby increasing the total blast RADIUS from 9m2 to 18.5m2. This is a sizeable increase but is difficult to slot, so this is up to you.


**ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS**
Corrosive: Swap to corrosive if using Nourish
Radiation: Add electric mod to make radiation fighting murmur

**IDEAL RIVEN:**
CD/MS/CC/DMG.

# [\[Strun Wraith\]](/items/arsenal/1242/strun-wraith/) VS PRIME?

[\[Strun Prime\]](/items/arsenal/5599/strun-prime/) is about 13% better than [\[Strun Wraith\]](/items/arsenal/1242/strun-wraith/) for overall AOE DPS and higher final status chance (400% on prime and 317% on wraith with same build)

# EVOLUTIONS

**EVOLUTION II** : Blazing Barrel - gives multishot

**EVOLUTION III** : Rapid Reinforcement gives +60% reload speed to the insanely long base reload speed of the non-incarnon form of 4.6s. Stacks with +30% from Primary Merciless so the final reload speed is 2.4s. Reload speed also affects the transformation speed into incarnon mode. Alternatively, Galvanic Reload is very nice if you also enjoy the incarnoff mode since its basically ammo efficiency.

**EVOLUTION IV** : Elemental Balance gives +11.3% status chance to EACH pellet on the base form. Since [\[Strun Prime\]](/items/arsenal/5599/strun-prime/) has 12 innate multishot, you end up with a total base status chance of 46 + 12*11.3=182% upon transforming since the incarnon form only has 1 base multishot. This means with just two 60% status mods, we can hit 182 x (1+0.6+0.6)=400.4 % status chance, i.e. guaranteed FOUR status effects per shot, before multishot. With 3 multishot we basically get TWELVE guaranteed statuses per trigger pull. At approximately 40% slash bias, we can get approximately 4 to 6 slash procs every fire.

Coup De Grace actually ONLY works when [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/), [\[Despair\]](/items/arsenal/1250/despair/) and [\[Hate\]](/items/arsenal/1155/hate/) are all equipped, and ONLY builds up in incarnoff mode. # MOD BREAKDOWN
- Galvanized Chamber - mandatory multishot mod

- Galvanized Aptitude - mandatory damage mod, giving +80% dmg for each unique status affecting the target. Having just three status effects from [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/)'s innate elements gives +240% dmg (3.4x multiplier), and on Dread Incarnon specifically, this is MULTIPLICATIVE to other base damage sources like Serration/Arcanes. Note this is ADDITIVE on Incarnoff mode.

- Spectral Serration/Amalgam Serration - this is mandatory if you decide to run Longbow Sharpshot. Unseen Dread makes you invisible for Spectral Serration

- Critical Delay - mandatory crit mod

- Unseen Dread or Vital Sense - mandatory crit mod. [\[Unseen Dread\]](/items/arsenal/6764/unseen-dread/) gives 175% cd while invisible and makes you invisible for 5s if you hit more than 3 enemies at once. Best used with an invisible frame for maximum consistency, otherwise use Vital Sense

- Primed Bane of Corrupted/Grineer- double dips DoT for final +140.25% dmg boost (2.4025x multiplier), separate to Serration, G.Aptitude and Longbow. If you don’t like banes, you can swap this out for Rifle Elementalist

- Vile Acceleration - Fire rate makes the draw speed more tolerable and affects the overall DPS.  Alternatives include Primed Shred 

- Vigilante Supplies - small chance to boost crits to next tier, otherwise just use terminal velocity

**Element**
- Hellfire: keeps Dread Incarnon mode pure heat and boosts heat DoT, Thermite rounds is acceptable alternative

- Primed Cryo Rounds: combines with heat to make blast, has good crowd clearing at lower levels but much worse single target DPS

- [\[Malignant Force\]](/items/arsenal/592/malignant-force/): combines with heat to make gas, has good persisting crowd clearing for more stationary missions or smaller maps and much worse single target DPS than both heat and blast

**Arcane**
- Longbow Sharpshot - gives +300% final multiplicative dmg on the next shot after a headshot. The wide projectiles of [\[Dread\]](/items/arsenal/1076/dread/) make headshots very easy so this bonus can be kept active quite easily. If you don’t like to aim or find it difficult to upkeep, just use a different arcane like Primary Merciless/Deadhead. 

NOTE: Without longbow or deadhead arcane, you have NO reason to aim at heads in incarnon dread mode because it has NO headshot multiplier.

**Why not Viral?**
Viral 60/60 mods is a good option to give raw damage and status chance, as well as a useful status effect, however, all other mods are essential and give higher overall value from two slots particularly if you consider external sources of viral e.g. companion priming from [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/), Hounds, [\[Tazicor\]](/items/arsenal/2224/tazicor/). If you really want you could offload [\[Vile Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/584/vile-acceleration/) to Arcane Acceleration or warframe abilities, and drop Primed Bane to fit viral.

**Riven**
Crit Chance, Crit Damage, Multishot, , Damage, Fire rate, Tox+Cold - would ideally slot over [\[Critical Delay\]](/items/arsenal/582/critical-delay/). A viral riven (has both tox and cold) would be a great space saver.
