**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

DPS CALCULATOR (click copy and test): https://www.underframe.site/vshare/701760/lizzie-blasttox-calc

This builds looks weird at first glance and may raise many questions:

**Where is the heat damage?**
Temple's 3rd ability Ripper's Wail applies heat damage as a separate non-combining mod (similar to [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) and other augments) and boosts heat DoT but additively to other +heat mods like [\[Thermite Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/589/thermite-rounds/) and [\[Hellfire\]](/items/arsenal/635/hellfire/).

**Why there is no modded critical damage? **
The critical damage comes from Primary Blight which gives 144%, even higher than [\[Vital Sense\]](/items/arsenal/625/vital-sense/). This stacks almost instantly from the toxin procs on [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/).

Critical chance comes from the combination of Arcane Hot Shot on the Warframe (even just r1 gives 100% cc while r5 gives 300% cc modded), [\[Critical Delay\]](/items/arsenal/582/critical-delay/) (200%) and flat critical chance from Overdrive (around 100 to 200% flat depending on strength). The final CC we end up with should be over 300% which is guaranteed red crits. 

**Why Blast + Toxin?**
Toxin is modded to activate Primary Blight which gives both multishot and critical damage. Multishot is VERY important on beam weapons like [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) because multishot DOUBLE DIPS status DPS on continuous weapons. Blast is modded into order to allow Toxin to not combine with innate heat to make Gas, and Blast itself can be a useful trash clearing status that helps kill densely packed enemies. As a final bonus, [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) modded on the warframe causes toxin procs from [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) to simultaneously proc Corrosive status which contributes to both armor strip and [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/).

**Why not viral?**
If you aim down sight on [\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) you can simultaneously shoot the priming waves and primary flamethrower without interruption.  For general use you will want to just spam Viral waves (aim and tap 1) everywhere to boost all damage to health up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. You could also subsume on Nourish for free viral without needing to use alt-fire.
Against eximus and thrax you can tap 2 for magnetic which boosts damage to overguard and shields
Since you have corrosive status coming from [\[Archon Continuity\]](/items/arsenal/5921/archon-continuity/) already, this means you don't need to mash so many keys at once and can focus on just priming viral.
Cold priming can be somewhat helpful in giving flat CD boost of 1x at 10 stacks but this is not mandatory. Cold may also be useful to build stacks of Primary [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/), in case you don't own any Primary Blight. This means you just need to spam both viral and cold into enemies.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- Galvanized Chamber: mandatory multishot, which double dips beam status DPS
- [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/): boosts status chance and also gives +80% damage per status, additive to strength on [\[Temple\]](/items/arsenal/7285/temple/). With 300% additive equivalent damage, [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/) with Blast Toxin Heat Corrosive Viral (5 statuses) provides a further +400% damage, which is a relative 2x multiplier on top of the existing strength multiplier.
- [\[Critical Delay\]](/items/arsenal/582/critical-delay/): gives critical chance, optional if you run Hotshot but is nice to have so you still have a base level of crit chance in case hotshot has 0 stacks and if 2 is not active
- [\[Thermite Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/589/thermite-rounds/) + [\[Rime Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/591/rime-rounds/): Makes blast and adds status chance. [\[Primed Cryo Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/611/primed-cryo-rounds/) would give more raw damage but Ripper's Wail already gives way too much additive elemental damage, and this comes at the cost of status chance which is more important.
- Infected Clip/Malignant Force: Makes toxin and adds more status chance, toxin is needed to proc Primary Blight and Archon Continuity
- Primed Bane or Elementalist: multiplicative to damage, smite double dips status against a specific faction and elementalist multiplies status damage by 1.9x
- [\[Vile Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/584/vile-acceleration/): Gives firerate which directly multiplies damage by 1.9x. This can be flexible if you offload with external firerate boosts (e.g. abilities, arcane acceleration, reinforced bond)

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- Vital Sense/Hammer Shot: add even more critical damage, hammer shot also provides status chance
- Magnetic Capacity: gives magnetic without needing to shoot the alt fire, could be good quality of life for pure thrax killing
- Vigilante Armaments: gives more multishot which double dips status DPS
- Serration/Amalgam Serration: more additive damage which is overall a pretty small boost

# ARCANES
- Primary Blight: gives multishot and crit damage, procs from toxin status modded on but if you are having issues with stacking this due to killing enemies too quickly from raw damage or way too much heat weight from maximum Ripper's Wail, try using other options
- Primary [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/): also gives multishot and crit damage, can proc from either the altfire OR from a companion priming cold + shivering contagion e.g. via Tazicor equipped on a sentinel modded with Corrosive Cold
- Primary Merciless: additive to strength and galv aptitude, reload bonus has no effect
- Primary Crux:  gives up to 300% status chance after headshot, ammo efficiency has no effect

**[\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) QUIRKS**
[\[Lizzie\]](/items/arsenal/7354/lizzie/) seems to be almost exactly like [\[Ignis Wraith\]](/items/arsenal/909/ignis-wraith/). It is a flame thrower beam weapon with a 10m range that can be boosted by [\[Sinister Reach\]](/items/arsenal/620/sinister-reach/) to have a final range of 22m. At the end of the beam there is 4m spherical AOE that like all hitscan AOE will IGNORE multishot entirely. This effectively means the actual final [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/) of the beam is 26m but the enemies at the final 4m end will only receive about half to a third damage, while the enemies between 18 to 22m will actually receive about 1.5x more damage.

- Hammer Shot: more crit dmg and status chance to improve proc consistency
- Rifle elementalist: multiplies status dmg by 1.9x and adds a bit of punchthrough

**ELECTRIC**
- Electric DoT procs instantly and has a small 3m AOE, and also double dips [\[Target Acquired\]](/items/arsenal/616/target-acquired/) bonus. - Both High Voltage and Stormbringer (if you offload vile acceleration to external fire rate and have no violet shards on)
- [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) + vile acceleration (if running violet electric shards or shock trooper since they are additive to electric mods)

**BLAST**
- Blast DoT has wider AOE clearance but slightly worse single target DPS. Works best alongside Roar to. Swap [\[Vile Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/584/vile-acceleration/) and High Voltage for Primed Cryo Rounds + Thermite Rounds to make blast, ideally offloading fire rate to external fire rate- Elemental mods: see below for element options, but usually you will run between 1 to 2 element mods depending on the combo and any shards. 

To make Blast:
- Primed Cryo Rounds + Thermite Rounds (need to drop vile accel) - primed cryo gives higher blast weighting and more raw damage vs rime rounds which gives a bit more status chance. Ultimately it is best to have higher raw dmg

# ARCANE
- Longbow Sharpshot: multiplies final damage by up to 4x after headshots
- Primary Deadhead: optional alternative, deadhead provides a 30% headshot bonus that is additive to Target Acquired and also double dips elec status on headshots

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- Vile acceleration: increases charge rate significantly - can offload if you run external fire rate eg reinforced bond, arcane acceleration, buffs
- Primed Bane gives the highest DPS against a specific faction if applicable and double dips status DPS
- [\[Point Strike\]](/items/arsenal/624/point-strike/) and [\[Galvanized Scope\]](/items/arsenal/5519/galvanized-scope/) can give even more crit chance but is additive to acuity

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a hybrid primary/secondary fire Bubonico build, using the alt-fire to both prime enemies with viral + electric status, create AOE electric DoT that chains and kills weaker enemies and switching to primary fire to finish off heavier units with raw corrosive damage.

**Progenitor**
Magnetic and Radiation are both good as they provide another element for [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) and don't mess up elemental combinations you wish to make. 
Magnetic status is great against shields and overguard and means you can run [\[Shotgun Barrage\]](/items/arsenal/738/shotgun-barrage/) instead of [\[Magnetic Strafe\]](/items/arsenal/7197/magnetic-strafe/) for more fire rate, while also running [\[Atomic Fallout\]](/items/arsenal/6375/atomic-fallout/) for a little extra magazine capacity which helps with overall feel.
Radiation status is only useful for Galvanized Savvy and means you can replace Atomic Fallout for Magnetic Strafe or Primed Ammo Stock/[\[Tactical Pump\]](/items/arsenal/744/tactical-pump/). Note that some enemies such as Demolysts are immune to radiation status entirely so if you are using Bubonico against these, a radiation progenitor would be useless.

**Electric/Corrosive**
The key element is electric from Primed Charged Shelll, which combines with toxin on primary fire to make corrosive damage, which is effective against Grineer and also electric to the viral damage on secondary fire. This ultimately gives Galvanized Savvy up to 6 different elements split between primary and alt-fire. 

When combined with a grouping ability such as Nidus Larva, Khora's ensnare or Vauban's vortex, the electric procs from the alt-fire create tons of chaining arcs of electricity whch deals massive damage to a group. Any heavily armored enemies that survive the electical storm onslaught can be easily finished off by primary fire's high crit chance projectiles boosted by the viral procs created by the secondary fire.

If you prefer to only use alt-fire to nuke trash mobs with Electric, replace Galvanized Savvy with Shotgun Elementalist, Critical deceleration with Shell Shock and Primed Ravage with primed ammo stock

**Cold/Viral**
Adding Chilling Reload or Primed Chilling Grasp creates viral on the primary fire and adds cold on the alt-fire. (note Primed Chilling Grasp would NOT fit unless you change the innate - polarity to a D). Cold on the alt-fire allows you to slow enemies by up to 80%, applying even through Overguard (but capped at 4 stacks), as well as boosting crit damage by a flat 0.5 to 1x. You can consider using Primary Frostbite in the arcane slot too.

**Pure Toxin**
An anti-corpus version uses pure toxin on both primary and altfire to bypass shields, simply replace Primed Charged Shell with Contagious Spread.
See anti-corpus version: https://overframe.gg/build/217932/bubonico/bubonico-anti-corpus/

Here is a brief rundown of the mods:
- Galvanized Hell : Gives up to +230% multishot
- Galvanized Savvy:  Adds 80% extra status chance, good for alt-fire, and increases damage of primary fire based on amount of status procs - giving up to +80% damage for each status. Since alt-fire has such high status, all enemies will be afflicted with viral and electricity equating to +160% extra damage. After a few shots of primary fire, it will likely proc IPS + corrosive,  giving a maximum damage bonus of +480% damage at 6 statuses. Note that as of writing this (Update 30.7), [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) damage bonus does NOT apply to secondary fire AOE, but does apply to the primary fire, and is infact multipicative to primary merciless and primed point blank.
- Primed Point Blank: Adds 165% damage which is multiplicative to Galv Savvy, but additive to Merciless/Deadhead.
- Critical Deceleration : +200% crit chance, much greater than that offered by blunderbuss, but at the cost of fire rate
- Shotgun Barrage/[\[Magnetic Strafe\]](/items/arsenal/7197/magnetic-strafe/): to offset the fire rate penalty from critical deceleration and increase DPS. Magnetic adds an extra element for Galv Savvy and has good bonus against shield/overguard.
- Primed Ravage : Critical damage
- Atomic Fallout: magazine capacity improves the feel of shooting so you reload less and radiation adds another element for Galv Savvy
- [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) : gives high raw corrosive damage for primary fire and electric procs for secondary fire. Use **[\[Shell Shock\]](/items/arsenal/710/shell-shock/)** if no [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/).

**Flexible Options**
You can replace any of the above mods if you dont own them or prefer not to run them with the following:
- Primed Tactical Pump/Seeking Fury - improves quality of life and reload increases recharge speed
- [\[Primed Cleanse Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/4353/primed-cleanse-grineer/): Double dips on slash and electric procs by increasing base damage and DoT proc amount. Use regular **Cleanse Grineer** if no primed version. Can swap out for cleanse corrupted or infested if required depending on faction.
- Primed Ammo Stock - improves quality of life as you can dump more magazine before needing to recharge

**Arcane**
Primary Crux: ammo efficiency on headshot really improves the feel of [\[Bubonico\]](/items/arsenal/5293/bubonico/) which suffers from very small clip size and very slow recharge.
Primary Merciless: Adds reload which affects recharge rate and +360% dmg which is multiplicative to Galv Savvy
Primary Deadhead: Adds headshot bonus 1.3x , and +360% dmg but requires headshots from primary fire mode, each stack lasts longer than merciless

**Riven**
Slot over [\[Atomic Fallout\]](/items/arsenal/6375/atomic-fallout/):
Best Positives: +Crit Damage, +Crit Chance, +Multishot, +Fire Rate 
Decent Positives: +Damage,  +Magazine Capacity, +Reload

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# ACUITY VS CHAMBER
Acuity is INTERCHANGEABLE with Galvanized Chamber.
- Acuity hits hardest on headshots by applying +350% headshot damage (additive to base 3x headshot multiplier but actually applies 525% bonus rather than the listed 350%, meaning a final multiplier of 2.75x on headshots) and +350% critical chance (additive to other crit chance mods). This also applies to lightning strikes when created from a headshot, however, you do get punished greatly for missing headshots.
- Multishot allows you to spawn more potential lightning strikes per shot and is more consistent in DPS particularly if you are NOT hitting consistent headshots

This is largely up to personal preference and how much you want to oneshot single targets (use acuity) vs clearing crowds (use multishot). 

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Serration\]](/items/arsenal/626/serration/): Mandatory base damage, amalgam version gives extra sprint speed and is OPTIONAL. Galvanized Aptitude does NOT apply to lightning strikes.
- Vital Sense: Mandatory crit damage
- Primary Acuity/Galvanized Chamber: see above, interchangeable with each other depending on preference
- Critical Delay: Crit delay is mandatory if using Galv Chamber, not mandatory if using acuity 
- [\[Galvanized Crosshairs\]](/items/arsenal/5516/galvanized-crosshairs/): even more additive critical damage, synergizes with headshots and can be stacked by lightning strikes that headshot, but is limited by stack issues as all stacks drop off when one expires. Flexible slot.
- [\[Stormbringer\]](/items/arsenal/627/stormbringer/) + [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/): gives raw elemental damage multiplier (i.e. 1.9x multiplier) and also boosts electric status damage (also 1.9x mutliplier). [\[High Voltage\]](/items/arsenal/588/high-voltage/) helps electric damage and status chance further if you have a free slot. High Voltage is flexible if using lots of +Violet Electric Damage shards (e.g. 3 or more) for Hammer Shot
- [\[Primed Shred\]](/items/arsenal/593/primed-shred/): boosts fire rate and adds punchthrough which helps build sniper combo and spawn lightning strikes. Flexible for Vile Acceleration if using more single target or can even swap off if using reinforced bond and external fire rate sources.

- Vigilante Supplies: gives a tiny chance of boost crit to next tier, rank 0 saves forma. use max rank if you can fit

# ARCANE
- Primary Crux: gives huge status chance boost to improve electric status proc consistency and ammo efficiency improves overall feel and quality of life.
- Primary Deadhead: gives big base damage boost (+360%) on headshot kills and headshot multiplier (1.3x) is additive to target acquired and also double dips electric status on headshots

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- Primed Bane: Highest DPS option: multiplicative to all other bonuses by 1.55x and double dips status damage for 2.4x , need to swap to appropriate faction and is additive to Roar
- [\[Target Acquired\]](/items/arsenal/616/target-acquired/): multiplicative 1.6x multiplier on headshots (additive to primary deadhead) and double dips electric statuses that occur on headshots (2.56x multiplier). 
- [\[Hammer Shot\]](/items/arsenal/590/hammer-shot/): gives critical damage and status damage

# EVOLUTIONS

Evolution II: Final Fusillade gives +51 damage. The last shot bonus doesn't apply to incarnon mode. The other option Plentiful Mayhem only gives +31 dmg and consumes all your ammo rapidly. 
Evolution III: Pick any, but i prefer Swift Deliverance +50% projectile velocity to allow you to hit targets easier for charging of the incarnon form
Evolution IV: Survivor's Edge increases both CC and SC

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
If you have external fire rate, can drop Vile acceleration for Rifle Elementalist.
Magnetic Capacity can be useful for killing eximus/thrax, slot over vile acceleration.

# ELEMENTS
The damaging element you use is flexible between Electric or Heat:

- Electric has +50% bonus against Murmur and is a strong DoT status for both single target and multiple targets as it has a small 3m AOE effect. Electric can also be boosted by [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) and Violet Archon Shards. Having Shock Trooepr or Violet Archon shards for +primary electric damage allows you to drop Stormbringer for Rifle Elementalist (more damage in general) or Magnetic Capacity (stronger against Thrax/eximus)

- Heat has a +50% bonus against Infested and is strong single target status which constantly refreshes all existing stacks upon application and also slowly strips armor by 50% after 2s. Swap Stormbringer for Hellfire. 

- Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 viral

Best damage subsumes are Roar which double dips status DPS and Shock with [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) which boosts electric and allows you to replace [\[Stormbringer\]](/items/arsenal/627/stormbringer/).

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This variant helps gaurantee one shots on levelcap Thrax for cascade while still allowing [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) to oneshot enemies on spreading.

This is a build specifically to be used with [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/)'s Toxic Lash + either Roar or Full strip with spores. This is because by itself, Acid Shells isn't very good in Steel Path, as it currently ignores SP modifiers and scales off the max health of a non-SP enemy (i.e. it is 2.5x weaker than advertised in SP). Also while [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) scales with HP, it deals corrosive + blast damage in AOE which require full armor strip to be effective. When used with [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) however, [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) is capable of inducing a chain reaction that can spread across an entire map. When an enemy is killed with Toxic Lash active, [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) will deal 450 corrosive dmg + 45% HP blast dmg in a 15m radius, and each enemy hit will have a toxin DoT created that scales off the [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) damage. If this new enemy hit subsequently dies from the Tox DoT, it will create another [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) explosion centered on this new enemy. As long as enemies stand within 15m of each other, this chain reaction can spread across a map.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Saryn TOXIC LASH with ROAR
- Tauforged Emerald Shards for +45% toxin status damage (additive to elementalist which is why it isn't slotted)
- Arcane Rage on Primary Slot
- COLD Progenitor to create Viral

With everything at maximum stacks ([\[Clip Delegation\]](/items/arsenal/6551/clip-delegation/), Primary Blight, [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/), [\[Galvanized Hell\]](/items/arsenal/5522/galvanized-hell/)), a single [\[Point Blank\]](/items/arsenal/731/point-blank/) headshot can onetap a levelcap thrax before the toxin from toxic lash can even proc and a bodyshot will onetick (requires 1s for toxin status tick). Without full stacks it might take two headshots or 1-2 extra seconds of waiting for toxin statuses.

# PROGENITOR
The Progenitor type is completely optional since it DOESN'T affect [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) or Toxic Lash. You could do MAGNETIC which is the most flexible element (allows you to run all elemental combos for any use case particularly if you plan on using it outside of Saryn/Oraxia/Cyte) or COLD (allows you to make viral with just Toxin mods for Saryn/Oraxia or magnetic with just electric mods/violet shards which is good for Cyte). 

# CALCULATIONS
After testing, the Progenitor Bonus, Critical Multiplier and Base Damage all do NOT affect the Toxin DoT of Toxic Lash when triggered by [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) AOE explosion. The formula for Toxic Lash DoT scaling from [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) AOE is :

(450 + 45% HP) x  (1+toxin mods) x ( 1+ toxin mods + other elemental mods) x (1+faction mods)^3 x (1+status damage)

As you can see faction mods TRIPLE DIP, toxin mods DOUBLE DIP while elemental mods and status damage mods single dip on the Tox Lash DoT.

Note the HP is for base starchart values, ignoring the steel path 2.5 modifier.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
Galvanized Hell - mandatory multishot

Galvanized Savvy - helps get the initial kill to start chain reaction, but does NOT affect [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/) or Acid Shell Tox Lash DoT. If you prefer not to rely on building stacks, or maintaing a duration, use Primed Point Blank. If you run primary merciless, this slot should be replaced with Elementalist or Shotgun Barrage.

Toxic Barrage/Contagious Spread - Toxin mods *DOUBLE DIP* on toxic lash procs by multiplying the toxic lash damage and toxic DoTs

Shotgun Elementalist - boosts toxic lash status dmg by another 1.9x, but this is additive to emerald +toxin status shards. The magazine capacity also feels nice.

Magnetic Strafe - adds fire rate and magnetic status. Magnetic status helps oneshot Thrax as magnetic has a bonus against overguard.

Clip Delegation - optional but helps guarantee Thrax one-shot while at full stacks. Flexible for Toxic Barrage, Primed Cleanse

Critical Deceleration - adds critical chance

**Exilus**

Narrow Barrel - increases accuracy when aiming allowing you to hit things from further away. [\[Galvanized Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/5523/galvanized-acceleration/) should not be used in conjunction with [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) as for some reason [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) ignores falloff altogether on [\[Sobek\]](/items/arsenal/1237/sobek/) specifically. If you use Primed Point Blank instead of Galvanized Savvy, you can use Galvanized Acceleration.

**Arcane** 

- Primary Merciless is needed for base damage if not running Galv Savvy or external arcane source e.g. arcane rage
- Primary Blight is a great option when running [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) since Toxic Lash triggers primary blight meaning you don't need any ramp up if using merciless.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- Amalgam Serration/Serration: mandatory +damage, amalgam version is optional for sprint speed
- [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/): mandatory +damage that is multiplicative with serration (specifically in the case of hema and coda hema), increases by +80% dmg with each status i.e. 360% at 4 statuses
- Galvanized Chamber: mandatory multishot. 
- Necrophagic Vigor: mandatory augment that gives +360% cc and cd if you reload from an HP of at least 720. 
- [\[Primed Shred\]](/items/arsenal/593/primed-shred/): mandatory fire rate and punchthrough allowing you to hit more enemies. If no primed shred, swap for Vile acceleration

# ELEMENTAL COMBINATION
- Corrosive Heat: highest single target DPS option against armored enemies. Element mods gives raw elemental damage that multiplies with damage. Corrosive strips some armor by up to 80% at 10 procs, heat strip armor even more (multiplying with corrosive to 90% strip maximum) and also applies damage over time. Hellfire is flexible for Magnetic Capacity, Galvanized Scope, Vital Sense.
- Blast: helps with AOE clearance, best used alongside [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s whisper to boost the blast procs, add Primed Bane to maximise this

# ARCANE
Primary Crux: highest comfort option, gives huge status chance boost and ammo efficiency meaning needs to reload less
Primary Deadhead: highest DPS option particularly with headshots, +360% dmg is multiplicative to galv aptitude
Primary Bulwark: highest DPS option if not getting headshots AND you can hit the threshold of 1500 armor

# WARFRAME SYNERGIES
[\[Coda Hema\]](/items/arsenal/7324/coda-hema/) consumes health on reload and [\[Necrophagic Vigor\]](/items/arsenal/7506/necrophagic-vigor/) gives maximum buff if your frame has at least 720HP. [\[Coda Hema\]](/items/arsenal/7324/coda-hema/) also heals you to maximum on headshot.
To take full advantage of Coda Hema then we want a frame that naturally builds high health and benefits form healing:
- Inaros (persistence)
- Oraxia (persistence)
- Grendel (persistence)
- Chroma (persistence)
- [\[Nidus\]](/items/arsenal/27/nidus/) (persistence)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Specifically for use with Cyte Resupply ELECTRIC Ammo, ideally with Violet +Primary Electric Damage shards. 

Progenitor bonus doesn't really matter since it doesn't affect resupply or [\[Acid Shells\]](/items/arsenal/716/acid-shells/), but having COLD gives you magnetic status which is very good against Overguard and is shared with [\[Saryn\]](/items/arsenal/52/saryn/) while TOXIN is ideal as it combines with electric to make corrosive which can strip armor. Otherwise MAGNETIC progenitor is a flexible option for global use.

Galv Hell - helps get the initial kill to start chain reaction, but does NOT affect Acid Shells or the chaining Resupply DoT.

Galv Savvy - helps get the initial kill to start chain reaction, but does NOT affect Acid Shells or the chaining Resupply DoT. If you prefer not to rely on building stacks, use Primed Point Blank.

Primed Ravage - helps get initial kill. Cyte has +300% cc on headshots as his passive which is where crit chance comes from. 

Primed Cleanse Grineer/Corrupted/Corpus/Murmur - faction mods TRIPLE DIP on Resupply procs. If you want to use this against thrax or narmer which currently do not have a faction mod, consider dropping this for Magnetic Strafe, Shell Shock, Clip Delegation, Frail Momentum

Primed Charged Shell +/- Shell Shock - Electric mods DOUBLE DIP on electric Resupply DoTs but would be additive to any Violet shards you run.

Shotgun Elementalist - boosts Resupply status dmg by another 1.9

Shotgun Barrage - more fire rate so you can spam shots through walls. Add arcane tempo on frame for even more fire rate.


**Exilus**
Narrow Barrel - increases accuracy when aiming allowing you to hit things from further away. [\[Galvanized Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/5523/galvanized-acceleration/) should not be used in conjunction with [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) as for some reason [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/) ignores falloff altogether on [\[Sobek\]](/items/arsenal/1237/sobek/) specifically. If you use [\[Primed Point Blank\]](/items/arsenal/724/primed-point-blank/) instead of [\[Galvanized Savvy\]](/items/arsenal/5525/galvanized-savvy/), you can use [\[Galvanized Acceleration\]](/items/arsenal/5523/galvanized-acceleration/).

**Riven**
Riven: +electric, +multishot, +faction , can slot over Galv Savvy

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# PROGENITOR
Magnetic boosts damage against shields and overguard, making it especially useful for strong enemies such as Eximus/Thrax. Magnetic also doesn't fuse with other elements like the innate electric or any mods meaning you have maximum flexibility over final elements.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Galvanized Aptitude\]](/items/arsenal/5521/galvanized-aptitude/): gives base damage at least 3 x 80% with three statuses for +240% damage, or more with external statuses, and also +80% status chance. Flexible for Serration if you don't like maintaining stacks
- Galvanized Chamber: mandatory multishot, multishot double dips status DPS on beams
- Crit Delay + Vital Sense: mandatory crit mods
- [\[Malignant Force\]](/items/arsenal/592/malignant-force/) + [\[Rime Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/591/rime-rounds/): gives viral status that boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x and also provides +120% status chance. If running external Viral e.g. low strength Nourish (small Nourish means smaller viral weighting to not mess with electric statuses), companion priming, viral abilities, can swap Malignant Force and Rime Rounds for any combination of Rifle Elementalist, High Voltage, Primed Bane, Hammer Shot
- Stormbringer: increases electric weight and multiplies electric DoT
- Primed Shred: fire rate and punchthrough, flexible for vile acceleration if you don't own this

**ARCANE**
- Primary Overcharge: highest potential DPS but requires upkeep of energy
- Primary Crux: best quality of life as the clip will last forever without needing to reload, and decent DPS boost with huge status chance
- Primary Deadhead/Merciless: good middle of the road options

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Ideally run with Arcane Tempo + [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/) + [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) and Energized Munitions

**WHY MAGNETIC?**
The two primed elemental mods on shotguns ([\[Primed Chilling Grasp\]](/items/arsenal/5401/primed-chilling-grasp/) and [\[Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/732/charged-shell/)) each provide a +165% raw damage boost, while an [\[Incendiary Coat\]](/items/arsenal/736/incendiary-coat/) is equivalent to a 90% x 1.5 = 135% raw damage boost, which is lower than a primed elemental despite the weakness of hemocyte to heat. If you however do NOT own Primed elemental mods, you should run [\[Incendiary Coat\]](/items/arsenal/736/incendiary-coat/) + [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/) instead.

For example final damage multipliers between different combinations of mods are as follows:
[\[Primed Point Blank\]](/items/arsenal/724/primed-point-blank/) + [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) + [\[Primed Chilling Grasp\]](/items/arsenal/5401/primed-chilling-grasp/): (1+1.65)x(1+1.65+1.65)=11.395 
[\[Primed Point Blank\]](/items/arsenal/724/primed-point-blank/) + [\[Primed Charged Shell\]](/items/arsenal/1428/primed-charged-shell/) + Primed Cleanse: (1+1.65)x(1+1.65)x1.55=10.8849 
[\[Primed Point Blank\]](/items/arsenal/724/primed-point-blank/) + [\[Incendiary Coat\]](/items/arsenal/736/incendiary-coat/) + [\[Blaze\]](/items/arsenal/703/blaze/): (1+1.65+0.6)x(1+0.9x1.5+0.6x1.5)=10.5625

You can free up even another Primed Element mod if you run any Violet +elec primary shards and replace this with atomic fallout, shotgun elementalist for more magazine capacity, or Primed Tactical Pump/Chilling Reload for more reload speed.


**ARCANE**
- Primary Merciless - gives 30% reload without conditions, and also some bonus damage on kill
- Shotgun Vendetta - best in slot but slightly annoying to proc also harder to obtain than merciless
- Fractalized Reset - big boost to reload but requires conditional cast
- Primary Frostbite - can be activated by sentinel modded with cold on the weapon (e.g. [\[Tazicor\]](/items/arsenal/2224/tazicor/))

# EVOLUTIONS
Evo II: Reified Bane +10 dmg, and another +10dmg after reload from empty OR Fortress Salvo if you have armor > 450 (punchthrough is great for crowd clear).
Evo III: Ready Retaliation +100% reload after reload from empty
Evo IV: Critical Parallel +20% cc, +0.5 cd

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

One of the strongest weapons in the game currently. The primary fire feels like a lex prime but hits a truck. Getting 12 headshots charges up it's Incarnon mode (can be shortened to about 3-4 shots with multishot). Switching to Incarnon mode with alt-fire makes it feel like a pocket Acceltra with small AOE on impact but with significant damage. This build is a raw damage non-crit build using Devouring Attrition. 

**UPDATE SEPT 2024**
Swapped arcane to Secondary Fortifier for free overguard and bonus against eximus/thrax.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**
With the armor/health scaling changes, status rework and damage vulnerability rework, Viral Heat and Corrosive Heat are now the top status combinations. This is because heat is able to strip 50% armor after 2 seconds which currently reduces a 90% DR from armor cap to about 63% DR, which is equal to a 3.7x damage boost. Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks and 2x at 1 stack. In addition, corrupted enemies are now weak to viral by 50%. On the other hand Corrosive strips armor too and has a bonus against Grineer, and has access to [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/).

**UPDATE APRIL 2024**
[\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper double dipping Devouring Attrition has been officially nerfed. 

Other build options:
Crit Viral Heat Overwhelming Attrition (higher potential single target DPS): https://overframe.gg/build/315013/

# Evolution Choices
- Evolution I - Incarnon mode

- Evolution II - Rapid [\[Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/7986/wrath/): +20% Fire rate. Can use recoil perk if you don’t use one of Secondary Deadhead or Steady hands, or prefer to use Lethal Momentum in exilus.

- Evolution III - Lethal Rearmament: +90% reload speed on headshot at 3 stacks. This also shortens the transformation animation to Incarnon mode from approx 3s to 1.5s. 

- Evolution IV - Elemental Excess +20% status, -10% crit chance. Reducing crit chance increases the likelihood of Devouring Attrition boosted shots.

- Evolution V -  Devouring Attrition: 50% chance to do 2000% damage on non-critical hits. This is currently **multiplicative** to base damage mods such as [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) 


**DEVOURING VS OVERWHELMING ATTRITION AVERAGE DPS COMPARISON**
This table compares average DPS calcs between Devouring Attrition vs Overwhelming Attrition. Calculations made with underframe.

![](https://i.ibb.co/nMzrmV3X/Laetum-Calcs2026.png) 

**TL,DR**
Use Devouring Attrition if you don't want to aim at heads and just spam AOE shots and are not running any external crit buffs.
Use Overwhelming Attrition if you want to be more precise and aim at heads consistently or have external crit buffs (e.g. crepuscular, warframe buffs)

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): Mandatory +230% multishot at max stacks, meaning you get at least 3 bullets per shot with a 30% chance for 4. This allows you to basically do 3x more damage AND charge incarnon mode 3x faster. If you want the mobility boost you can just run Amalgam Barrel Diffusion instead.

- Hornet Strike: Mandatory +220% damage which is multiplicative with devouring attrition and additive with secondary deadhead/flare. Galvanized shot is not used here since it does NOT work on the AOE component (which is responsible for 75% of total damage). 

- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Brings multishot to 3.9 so 90% of shots give 4 bullets, and gives fire rate (combined Rapid Wrath gives +80% fire rate total)

- If viral: [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) + [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/): makes viral and adds status chance so you can proc both viral and heat faster. Each viral proc boosts damage to health and viral dmg also has a bonus against corrupted. 
- If corrosive: [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) + Pistol Pestilence makes corrosive heat with high raw damage, and a little status chance from pistol pestilence to proc useful statuses

- [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): Big elemental mod bonus on pistols to multiply raw damage. Heat procs also strip armor by 50% and can stack indefinitely, with each new stack refreshing all existing stacks.

- Augur Pact - useful for Augur set bonus for shield gating and gives minor additive damage boost. This is FLEXIBLE - see below.

- Accelerated Isotope - more fire rate and radiation damage. This is FLEXIBLE - see below.

Exilus:
Flexible
- Lethal Momentum - boosts projectile speed
- Steady Hands - recoil

**Flexible Options**
Augur Pact is your flexible slot:
- Primed Expel (flexible option): A further 1.55 multiplier to hornet strike/deadhead and Devouring Attrition and double dips on heat procs giving them 2.4x multiplier. Use regular expel mod if no primed version as it is still a 1.3 or 1.69x multiplier. No effect on Thrax/Archon/Acolytes etc
- Anemic Agility - increases sustained DPS but additive to lethal torrent and accelerated isotope
- Magnetic Might: adds magnetic damage and crit damage. magnetic status helps damage against overguard/shields. The crit dmg isn't very impactful on a non-crit build.
- Primed Fulmination - increases small AOE 
- Magnum Force - more additive damage but reduces accuracy/increases spread, which can make getting headshots to charge incarnon mode more difficult but also allows incarnon mode to spread to a slightly wider area
- Galvanized Shot - this is a LAST RESORT option because it is a) additive to hornet strike and secondary deadhead and b) only applies to the non-AOE component which is only 25% of total damage. This basically means galv shot is effectively only a +40% dmg per status boost and only to a single enemy at a time. You could potentially use this if offloading viral from nourish since there just arent many other mod choices.
- Riven: 
           Best Positives : multishot, damage, fire rate 
           Okay positives : status chance, toxin, reload speed
           Best Negatives : crit chance

## Arcane
- Secondary Fortifier: nice quality of life since it steals overguard (which blocks knockdown from the AOE) and [\[Laetum\]](/items/arsenal/5841/laetum/) is generally strong enough already, and very good for killing Thrax and Eximus. This is the recommended general quality of life option.

- Cascadia Flare: Gives an extra +120% additive damage bonus compared to deadhead (i.e. a +20% final DPS increase on bodyshots) but at the loss of -recoil and multiplicative headshot multiplier (reducing final headshot DPS by 10%). This is the recommended option for maximum DPS when not aiming for heads.

- Secondary Deadhead: Long upkeep times of +360% damage and gives -recoil and +headshot multiplier. Notably, this forces a 1.3x headshot multiplier that is multiplicative with the 3x base headshot multiplier on direct hit component (making it 3.9x) and the 1x base multiplier on AOE component. This is the recommended option of maximum DPS while aiming for heads.

- Secondary Merciless: Doesn't need headshots to upkeep, but stacks fall off quicker, and you get a neat reload bonus that helps with transform speed. Not as recommended 

## ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS
Corrosive Heat: good general use with highest raw damage, particularly when used alongside nourish since you get all good elements
Vira Heat: in a [\[Vacuum\]](/items/arsenal/250/vacuum/) this is the best elemental combo against armored enemies as heat strips some armor and viral multiplies all dmg
For Archon/Angel/Eidolon/Murmur: Use pure radiation or viral radiation

  - Slot 10 — Secondary Deadhead — R5 — —(no forma)
- **Resulting stats:** Range 300 · Ammo Max 60 · Magazine 12 · Fire Rate 1.6 · Crit Chance 0.144 · Crit Damage 5.1 · Reload Speed 1 · Base Damage Mult 1

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a raw damage build which allows you to hit orange or red crits depending on your arcane preference, external buffs or riven. Incarnon form becomes a fully automatic dual pistol with ricochet which retains part of the Frenzy Buff (on headshot, 3s buff of +150% fire rate (multiplies with fire rate mods), +100% toxin (acts like a 9th mod and additive to +elements) and -recoil by approximately 60%). Note the infinite ammo buff does NOT work on the Incarnon ammo. 

Also note the ricochets from incarnon mode tend to easily hit the head REGARDLESS of whether your initial shot was a body shot or headshot, likely due to high spread and coverage as the ricochets do not actually 'seek' headshots. This makes the frenzy buff, crosshairs buff and deadhead buffs extremely consistent.

[[ youtube id="DfGYQkyRS1s" ]]

# EVOLUTIONS

**Evolution II**: With Merciless on, Fevered Frenzy (+100% ms after 20 ability cast) gives ALOT more final DPS after 5 status effects (almost 250% more) compared to Carnage Reign. Without merciless on, Fevered Frenzy is 2% better. With Encumber on, Fevered Frenzy is identical to Carnage Reign. This is because like [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/), the +33% damage from Carnage Reign is currently bugged in that it does not count the extra 60 base dmg. If one day this is fixed, Carnage Reign should be a bit better when running Overcharge or Encumber (by about 6-8%).

**Evolution III**: Marksman's Hand combines with Frenzy buff to completely [\[Negate\]](/items/arsenal/238/negate/) recoil even without Steady Aim in exilus. This frees up the exilus for anything of your preference.

**Evolution III**: Commodore's Fortune (+20% base cc) increases base CC to 31%, making final CC after mods 89%.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): Mandatory multishot +230%. You can swap this to Amalgam Barrel Diffusion if you want stackless and enjoy the rolling speed.

- [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/): Base dmg mod +120% for every unique status, so +480% after impact, puncture, viral, slash. Note that currently, Galv Shot only applies its damage bonus to the original base dmg of 75 rather than 125. Also gives status chance which helps apply useful statuses like corrosive to apply strip. Can swap this to Hornet Strike if you want stackless damage.

- [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) + [\[Galvanized Crosshairs\]](/items/arsenal/5516/galvanized-crosshairs/): Boosts final CC to 188% after max stacks while aiming down sights. Adding Cascadia Overcharge or Secondary Outburst boosts final CC to above 200% for red crits. Finally adding Arcane Avenger to this can give guaranteed red crits. NOTE, stacking this many crit chance source is always an overall REDUCTION in total DPS. 

- Primed Target Cracker: Mandatory CD mod brings CD to 6.3

- [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/): Combines with the innate tox from Frenzy to form +190% Corrosive dmg. This saves a slot allowing you to run a bane more crit chance or damage.

- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Boosts fire rate and multishot. This is approximately a 46% final DPS boost with Frenzy active and 89% DPS boost without Frenzy active.

- [\[Merciless Gunfight\]](/items/arsenal/7189/merciless-gunfight/):  Punchthrough causes the initial enemy hit to STILL ricochet, and the second enemy hit creating a new ricochet instance. Every enemy punched through basically adds an additional instance of ricochet, basically doubling or tripling the amount of enemies hit potentially. Even the ricochet bullet appears to be able to puncthrough and reaches FURTHER than it would without puncthrough, basically extending the overall range of ricochet. This is flexible if you are using it more for single target. 

**Flexible options**
- Magnetic Might: gives magnetic and critical damage. Magnetic status is very good against overguard e.g. Thrax and Eximus

- Primed Expel: Boosts raw dmg by 55% which is multiplicative to Galv Shot/Deadhead (optional). Can slot over [\[Seeker\]](/items/arsenal/444/seeker/) or [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/) if you like.

**Exilus**: Currently there is no real need to run an exilus because Steady Aim isn't necessary. This is totally up to personal preference, but you could run [\[Targeting Subsystem\]](/items/arsenal/408/targeting-subsystem/) to reduce spread or [\[Spry Sights\]](/items/arsenal/466/spry-sights/) to increase movespeed while aiming, or just leave it empty to save forma.

**Riven**
Ideal roll is MS, DMG, CD, CC, Punchthrough, FR with any harmless negative. If you roll dmg, replace [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/). If you roll CC replace Galvanized Crosshairs. 

You can check exactly which slot to take with your riven by running through a damage calculator: https://underframe.onrender.com/vshare/381473/dual-toxocyst-inc

# ELEMENTAL VARIANTS
Corrosive: Use against armored Grineer due to each corrosive status stripping armor as it is applied and Corrosive having a +50% damage bonus. 

Viral: Use against Corrupted and any ARMOR STRIPPED Grineer. Raw Viral damage has a 50% bonus against corrupted and any viral status procs multiply damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Replace [\[Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/426/convulsion/) with [\[Deep Freeze\]](/items/arsenal/433/deep-freeze/) or [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) if you have no capacity.

Toxin: Use against Corpus because toxin bypasses shields to hit corpus +50% dmg. Replace [\[Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/426/convulsion/) with [\[Pathogen Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/449/pathogen-rounds/).

Radiation: Use against Murmur, swap [\[Seeker\]](/items/arsenal/444/seeker/) or [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) for [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/)

# ARCANES
Secondary Deadhead: Simplest option, procs from direct headshot kills which is very easy via ricochet, and gives extra 1.3x headshot multiplier, separate to the 3x normal headshot multiplier. 

Secondary Fortifier: Removes overguard extremely quickly and gives it to your frame. Very good survivability quality of life and also kills Thrax/Eximus extremely quickly. Doesn't require stack maintenance.

Secondary Outburst: Absolute highest overkill DPS option but requires a bit of buildup/maintenance with either a weapon with Melee Crescendo + Finishers (to have permanent x12 combo) e.g. Furax Wraith and Vazarin snare ground finisher, Heavy Slam Magistar that can maintain 8-9x combo, Ceramic Dagger (for permanent x8-12x combo but needs primary kills instead of finishers) or just a gunblade/regular melee that you can build combo to x12 quickly but manually.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/) is a beam weapon that creates up to four homing tendrils that appear upon getting kills. Normally these disappear and need to be rebuilt upon reload, but having the new augment [\[Sentient Surge\]](/items/arsenal/6191/sentient-surge/) should allow you to indefinitely maintain your magazine without reloading, thereby maintaining maximum tendrils while also gaining bonus crit and status chance.

[[ youtube id="QhDzVaSvgds" ]]

# MOD BREAKDOWN
[\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/): Mandatory +120% dmg per unique status, i.e. +480% dmg after proccing puncture, radiation, heat and viral.

[\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): Mandatory +230% multishot at max stacks. Double dips status damage on beam weapons like [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/)

[\[Sentient Surge\]](/items/arsenal/6191/sentient-surge/): Mandatory augment, allows you to maintain four tendrils without reloading and increases both CC and SC by up to +240% at 4 tendrils active.

Primed Target Cracker: For crit damage. this is flexible for Primed Expel Grineer/Corrupted or [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/). Note: with Puncture changes, [\[Ocucor\]](/items/arsenal/1435/ocucor/) can now give itself +25% flat crit chance after 5 puncture procs, which makes [\[Primed Target Cracker\]](/items/arsenal/413/primed-target-cracker/) about 3% better than Primed Expel even without Arcane Avenger. If you run external crit damage eg [\[Dagath\]](/items/arsenal/6285/dagath/)'s Grave Spirit or [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/), Primed Expel would give higher DPS.

[\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Mandatory for fire rate and additional multishot which double dips status damage. If you run external fire rate eg  [\[Wisp\]](/items/arsenal/2525/wisp/)'s Haste mote, [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/)'s Penance,  Arcane Velocity or [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/), Primed Expel would give higher DPS.

[\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) + [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/): Gives both status chance and viral status which boosts all health damage by 4.25x at 10 stacks. [\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/) increases the amount of ammo reloaded per kill.

[\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): Boosts raw DPS and heat status DPS, which is your main source of damage. Heat procs have infinite scaling because they do not have a limit on most enemies.

Exilus: Either [\[Ruinous Extension\]](/items/arsenal/421/ruinous-extension/) to [\[Extend\]](/items/arsenal/265/extend/) beam length or Primed Ammo Mutation if you have ammo issues.

# VARIATIONS
For corpus or murmur enemies, you can consider swapping Primed Heated Charge for Primed Convulsion to make Viral Electric since certain corpus/murmur enemies take bonus damage to electric. You will also need to chance Cascadia Flare for Merciless.

# RIVEN
The ideal riven is MS, CD, FR with tox/dmg/cc as secondary options.  Having CD allows you to replace [\[Primed Target Cracker\]](/items/arsenal/413/primed-target-cracker/) which is the weakest option in the build. Having tox on the riven allows you to replace [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/).

# ARCANE
Cascadia Flare: Easiest to maintain +480% dmg, you lose all stacks if it expires but you can build it back up to max in seconds

Secondary Fortifier: Great option for increasing survivability as you steal overguard without aiming. Swap Primed Heated Charge for Primed Convulsion.

Secondary Encumber: Theoretically gives 13 unique status effects after 2-3 seconds, meaning you get +1560% dmg from [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) (1080 on top of the innate statuses), but only after a ramp up. Note however, only one enemy out of the initial target + four tendrils can be affected by encumbers status proc at any one instance so the overall effectiveness is reduced. This is a good option on single target applications in endurance where enemies take longer than 2-3 seconds to kill.

Secondary Merciless: Third best option, giving +360% dmg which decays every 3s

# ARCANE

• Secondary Fortifier: strips overguard much quicker and also steals overguard which gives better survivability and quality of life, but much weaker DPS than enervate

- Heat: best for armored enemies, synergizes with Arcane Hotshot and Archon Vitality

# HORNET STRIKE/CASCADIA FLARE OR [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)?
[\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) has a strange damage formula where [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) scales a separate 200 base damage that is NOT affected by strength:

250 x strength% x (1+damage%) + 200 x (1+[\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)%)

What this means effectively is that if you run [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) with Secondary Encumber, the effect of strength becomes less significant on [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) damage (which means arcane impetus doesn't provide much boost to noctua), and conversely if you run high strength and damage sources like Arcane Precision/Cascadia Flare, the effect of [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) becomes less significant on [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) damage (although note you still need to build strength for Pageflight which has a huge effect on status DPS).  Ultimately the max DPS difference between the two options ([\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) + Encumber vs [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/) + Flare) is very minimal with Elementalist + Flare coming out only 2% better (assuming 13 statuses). However since Secondary Encumber takes a long time to stack to 13 statuses, the immediate burst DPS of elementalist + flare is significantly higher. 

TLDR: 
- If you want to boost all of Dante's abilities while still having high enough Noctua DPS, use Galvanized Shot + Secondary Encumber + Arcane Impetus
- If you want to focus PURELY on Noctua DPS, use maximum ability strength and +damage sources like cascadia flare/hornet strike/arcane precision: see viral heat DPS build https://overframe.gg/build/639677/

# ARCANE
Secondary Encumber can proc up to 13 statuses which gives up to 1560% damage boost from [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) and also procs Arcane Impetus for maximum of 78% Strength and 39% efficiency boost.

Note, wordwarden ignores fire rate and multishot but benefits from Secondary Encumber.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**UPDATE 2025**
Now that Arcane slots are available we can use either
- Secondary Outburst: this provides the maximum possible DPS but requires you to run either crescendo Furax Wraith and get finishers or Ceramic Dagger melee and get primary kills first
- Secondary Fortifier: this is the most "chill" option since it can generate overguard as you hit eximus enemies which helps with survivability, and also deletes overguard from eximus/thrax much quicker
- Cascadia Flare: provides decent amount of base damage but again this is additive to both galv shot and [\[Mesa\]](/items/arsenal/14/mesa/)'s strength multiplier

This is best used in combination with Nourish on Mesa, since Nourish provides Viral damage, and is good for both Grineer and Corrupted enemies.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- Galvanized Diffusion - mandatory multishot multiplies damage by up to 3.3x
- Galvanized Shot - this gives +120% damage per status which is additive to the damage bonus provided by ability strength. Having a maximum of 5 statuses (IPS + heat + viral) after a few seconds of shooting gives +600% dmg, which is approximately a 69% DPS boost. Having just 3 status will allow Galv Shot to be better than Anemic Agility or another element mod.
- Primed Pistol Gambit - CC  - flexible for Anemic Agility if running lots of external CC
- Primed Target Cracker - Mandatory CD
- Lethal Torrent - gives more ire rate and multishot. 
- Primed Convulsion + Pistol Pestilence  - gives raw corrosive damage which has +50% bonus against Grineer and also partially strips armor up to 80% at 10 stacks. The minor status chance boost from pistol pestilence helps statuses like viral from nourish, corrosive, heat and for galvanized shot.
- Primed Heated Charge - gives raw Heat damage which contributes to total damage, and heat procs can also strip a further 50% armor which is multiplicative with corrosive (giving 90% maximum possible partial strip). This can be swapped for [\[Magnetic Might\]](/items/arsenal/7190/magnetic-might/) if running Zid an Uskos for cascade endurance.

Use this spreadsheet calculator to check specific external factors: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-m2RKQTHGD7klGEBxBZr0h9mSP77wmL1xTE0iQvqB50/edit?usp=sharing

# Flexible Options:
- [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/): This is better than [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) once you add THREE or more TAUFORGED TOPAZ secondary crit chance shards on top of both arcane hotshot and 12x combo secondary outburst in the context of maximum external fire rate boosts e.g. furax amalgam, reinforced bond and arcane velocity.

- Lethal Torrent vs Primed Expel :
Lethal Torrent is 21% better than Primed Expel if you DON'T OWN ARCANE VELOCITY but only 3-5% worse about than Primed Expel WITH Arcane Velocity. Note Lethal Torrent is effective against acolytes and thrax while Expel mods do not affect them. If you want to min-max Regulator damage against a specific faction eg in disruption, then you can use Primed Expel over Lethal Torrent.
Lethal Torrent is always better than NON-PRIMED EXPEL. 
Lethal Torrent is better than Galvanized Shot above 335% ability strength when accounting for 5 status effects.

- [\[Creeping Bullseye\]](/items/arsenal/395/creeping-bullseye/) if you don't own Primed Pistol Gambit.
Primed Pistol Gambit is 4% better than Creeping Bullseye (with velocity) and 10% better without velocity.

- [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) is a last resort if you don't own [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/) or [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/).
[\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) is the worst option, being 8% worse than [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/), 16% worse than [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/).

# Variants:
For Corpus : Switch [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) for [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) and [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) to [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/) for pure Toxin (Bypasses shields)
For Murmur: Swap [\[Pathogen Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/449/pathogen-rounds/) for [\[Accelerated Isotope\]](/items/arsenal/6370/accelerated-isotope/) to make pure Radiation
For Thrax: swap [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/) for [\[Magnetic Might\]](/items/arsenal/7190/magnetic-might/)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# PROGENITOR: MAGNETIC

Magnetic is used for both DPS and Priming as it allows you to run pure single elements such as electric, heat and toxin and swap between them without it combining. Magnetic status also boosts damage against overguard and shields and can create a corresponding strong electric proc upon breaking overguard that SCALES with enemy level. 

# MODS
- Damage: At max stacks, [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) provides +120% damage per status. Since [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) can proc 4 different statuses itself (hidden microwave status doesn't seem to count for nukor itself), the total damage becomes 4x120% = 480%
- Multishot: [\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/) and [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/) together gives +290% Multishot, Lethal torrent also provides Fire rate bonus. Multishot double dips beam status DPS making multishot the MOST important stat.
- Primary status (Electric/Heat): [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/), boosts heat DoTs which can stack infinitely and refresh prior stacks, doing the bulk of damage. Primed Convulsion adds electric damage and status.
- Secondary status (Viral): [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) and [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) create viral procs which boost damage to health (up to 4.25x at 10 stacks) and boost status chance. Ice storm is optional for magazine capacity
- Crits : [\[Primed Target Cracker\]](/items/arsenal/413/primed-target-cracker/) is used to boost the high base CD, but ONLY when used in combination with a flat crit booster like Secondary Enervate, Arcane Avenger or puncture procs from Encumber. You should NOT slot Primed Pistol Gambit/Crit chance mods due to the abysmal base CC.
- Pistol Elementalist: adds multiplicative status damage and improves reload

- Exilus: Primed ammo mutation or normal ammo mutation is mandatory since [\[Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/992/nukor/) chews through ammo

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS:
Nourish means you could swap out the viral mods.
Lethal Torrent is flexible if you have alot of external fire rate boosts.

- [\[Merciless Gunfight\]](/items/arsenal/7189/merciless-gunfight/): Adds punchthrough which greatly helps crowd clearing as it increases the overall chaining of nukor, while also providing further crit damage
- Faction: Primed expel double dips DoTs (2.4x boost) and is multiplicative to other dmg sources, but only applies to a specific faction. Use this if you want to absolutely maximise DPS while fighting one faction type.

# ARCANES
- Secondary Enervate allows [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) to hit orange crits to take advantage of the massive critical multiplier. The average added flat crit chance is approximately 80 to 100%.
- Secondary Fortifier is nice quality of life as it steals overguard
- Secondary Encumber is able to proc almost every single status (10 in addition to the 4 from nukor to give 1020% extra damage from galvanized shot, compared to +480% from cascadia flare).
- Cascadia flare gives +480% dmg which ramps incredibly quickly
- Cascadia Empowered gives additional 750 raw damage for every status afflicted. Since [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) can afflict about 10 to 20 status per second, you can get potentially up to 15,000 raw damage per second in addition to the base beam.

# ELEMENT VARIATIONS
**Electric vs Heat:**
Electric Status: 
• Deals status damage instantly
• Double dips external headshot multipliers like deadhead (1.3x1.3=1.69x)
• Has a small AOE of up to 3m, improving crowd clearing ability
• Modded electric applies into the electric status created by magnetic status breaking Overguard/Shield
• Has bonus against Murmur

Heat Status:
• Deals status damage after 1s delay
• Stacks infinitely as each new status refreshes the duration of whole stack
• Benefits from heat inherit (inherits faction and heat damage bonuses from the first proc)
• Strips armor by up to 50% after 2s, which is equivalent to a 3.7x damage boost against armored enemies

TLDR:
• Electric is best against clearing crowds of weaker enemies or single unarmored enemies quicker
• Heat is best against bulky armored single target enemies that take a while to kill (e.g. unstripped demolyst)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

One of the strongest weapons in the game currently. The primary fire feels like a lex prime but hits a truck. Getting 12 headshots charges up it's Incarnon mode (can be shortened to about 3-4 shots with multishot). Switching to Incarnon mode with alt-fire makes it feel like a pocket [\[Acceltra\]](/items/arsenal/2717/acceltra/) with small AOE on impact but with significant damage. This build is a raw damage crit oriented build using Overwhelming Attrition. 

**UPDATE 2025**
Secondary Enervate is likely best in slot for arcane now since it allows you to proc Overwhelming Attrition with non-crits (22% starting cc) and ramps up to orange crits before resetting. The AVERAGE final cc sits around 100% which is more than what you get from just Primed Pistol Gambit or Galvanized Crosshairs.

# Evolution Choices
- Evolution I - Incarnon mode

- Evolution II - Rapid Wrath: +20% Fire rate. Can use recoil perk if you prefer

- Evolution III - Lethal Rearmament: +90% reload speed on headshot at 3 stacks, but only affects untransformed. Currently the Feather of Justice perk is bugged in that it applies to other weapons 
too, but I expect this will get patched

- Evolution IV - Caput Mortuum: +50% headshot damage

- Evolution V -  Overhwleming Attrition: non-crit and non-status hits trigger a +400% bonus for 20s, up to 1200% which is additive to Hornet Strike/Deadhead. 

**DEVOURING VS OVERWHELMING ATTRITION AVERAGE DPS COMPARISON**
This table compares average DPS calcs between Devouring Attrition vs Overwhelming Attrition. Calculations made with underframe.

![](https://i.ibb.co/nMzrmV3X/Laetum-Calcs2026.png) 

**TL,DR**
Use Devouring Attrition if you don't want to aim at heads and just spam AOE shots and are not running any external crit buffs.
Use Overwhelming Attrition if you want to be more precise and aim at heads consistently or have external crit buffs (e.g. crepuscular, warframe buffs)

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): +230% multishot at max stacks, meaning you get at least 3 bullets per shot with a 30% chance for 4. This allows you to basically do 3x more damage AND charge incarnon mode 3x faster.

- Primed Target Cracker: Adds +110% crit multiplier to hit 4.6x

- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Brings multishot to 3.9 so 90% of shots give 4 bullets, and gives fire rate (combined Rapid Wrath gives +80% fire rate total)

- [\[Magnetic Might\]](/items/arsenal/7190/magnetic-might/): Gives critical damage and magnetic damage. Magnetic status is very useful against Overguard e.g. possessed by Eximus and Thrax.

- [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) + Pathogen Rounds: makes corrosive, high raw damage against ferrite armor and armored enemies, corrosive status strips armor

- [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): Big elemental mod bonus on pistols to multiply raw damage. Heat procs also strip armor by 50% and can stack indefinitely, which each new stack refreshing all existing stacks.

- [\[Steady Hands\]](/items/arsenal/445/steady-hands/): Reduces recoil to help with charging incarnon mode. Lethal momentum is an alternative but this requires changing polarity.

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- [\[Galvanized Crosshairs\]](/items/arsenal/5516/galvanized-crosshairs/) (only used if not running Secondary Enervate): At max stacks gives +320% critical chance making a final crit chance of 92%. Even at such as high crit chance, you still have approximately 5% chance per shot to activate a stack of Overwhelming, meaning approximately one shot in every 20 shots activates the buff (consider you can shoot about 12 shots per second with multishot and fire rate, meaning you will have a 20s buff refreshed every 2s). [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) is an alternative to Crosshairs. *NOTE* You only get the +320% crit chance when AIMING down sights. This means you can actually exceed 100% crit chance with stacking [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) or Cascadia Overcharge, but still activate overwhelming attrition by shooting while not aiming down sights. If you run Secondary Enervate you can completely drop all crit chance mods.

- We do not *need* to run [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) because Overwhelming Attrition is additive to it, but if you have empty slots these can be added. You should basically NEVER run Galvanized Shot because 75% of laetum's damage is AOE and completely ignores galvanized shots +dmg bonus.

- Primed Expel: A further 1.55 multiplier to hornet strike/deadhead and Devouring Attrition and double dips on heat procs giving them 2.4x multiplier. Use regular expel mod if no primed version as it is still a 1.3 or 1.69x multiplier. Flexible if you dont like faction mods.

- [\[Primed Fulmination\]](/items/arsenal/5330/primed-fulmination/): boosts the small base AOE

# RIVEN
A riven could be difficult to slot due to the low disposition, but you would try to roll for some combination of +Critical Damage, +Fire Rate, +Toxin, +Damage

# ARCANES
- Secondary Enervate is likely best in slot for general use since it allows you to proc Overwhelming Attrition with non-crits (22% starting cc) and ramps up to orange crits before resetting. The AVERAGE final cc sits around 100% which is more than what you get from just Primed Pistol Gambit or Galvanized Crosshairs.

- Secondary Outburst is best in slot if you can run x12 combo on your melee eg manually build once every 30s or use Ceramic Dagger with riven. This gives +240% CC and CD.

- Secondary Fortifier is great qol for getting overguard and killing thrax/eximus even faster.

- Scondary Deadhead is mainly run for the -recoil and +headshot bonus.


## Red Crit Laetum - Harrow + Xata's Whisper
The void damage instance of Xata's Whisper currently counts as as non-crit non-status component of [\[Laetum\]](/items/arsenal/5841/laetum/)'s damage and therefore will proc Overwhelming Attrition regardless of your crit chance. This means you can run [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) with [\[Xata\]](/items/arsenal/2834/xata/)'s Whisper and achieve **RED CRITS** while still getting the +1200% dmg of Overwhelming Attrition.

At 308% crit chance (achievable with [\[Harrow\]](/items/arsenal/47/harrow/) Covenant + Arcane Avenger + [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) + Deadhead) on headshots, your final average multiplier actually becomes approx 1200x and you get guaranteed red crits.

![](https://imgur.com/bzs3XsW.png)

With [\[Galvanized Crosshairs\]](/items/arsenal/5516/galvanized-crosshairs/) fully stacked, Cascadia [\[Overcharged\]](/items/arsenal/561/overcharged/), Covenant and Avenger active, you can hit 403% final crit chance, meaning guaranteed tier 4 red crits (although you need to drop Secondary Deadhead and run the -recoil perk to maintain -100% recoil which actually reduces overall average DPS with final multiplier of approx 1100x). This is an example of a case where forcing yourself into the next tier of crits actually reduces your DPS.

General Use Primary/Hybrid Fire [\[Glory\]](/items/arsenal/6602/glory/) build for Grineer and Corrupted
Viral STATUS boosts damage to health and viral DAMAGE has a 50% bonus against corrupted. 
Heat DAMAGE is used because [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) adds a large amount of raw damage and [\[Glory\]](/items/arsenal/6602/glory/) has innate heat. Heat STATUS also applies 50% armor strip after 3s (not very important since [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) can armor strip).

Corrosive Heat is an alternative option which is good if you have viral priming via panzer or external viral via Nourish. Swap [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) for [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/).

**UPDATE 2025**: Secondary Enervate now provides an average flat crit chance boost of approximately 90 to 100%, which far exceeds what is possible from [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/). In fact, even if you stacked [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/) and 5 Tauforged Topaz Shards you would only end up with 99% final crit damage which is on average equivalent to Enervate.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
[\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): Mandatory +230% multishot at max stacks. 

[\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/): optional additive to Deathbringer, but also means you could swap to a different buff (for example shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/)) and still have base damage

[\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/): Adds crit chance (no longer needed if you run Secondary Enervate)

Primed Target Cracker: Adds crit damage

Lethal Torrent: Adds more multishot and fire rate. Flexible for Primed Expel Grineer/Orokin IF you are running external fire rate sources such as Arcane Velocity, Amalgam [\[Furax\]](/items/arsenal/1120/furax/) or [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/).

[\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) + [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/): Makes viral and boosts status, allowing you proc viral status which boosts damage by 2x afte 1 single proc and up to 4.25x at 10 procs. Viral damage itself also has a bonus against Corrupted by 50%. 

[\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): Boosts raw total DPS and occasionally allows heat procs to occur. Note, Glory has a low overall status and heat STATUS DPS only counts for about 8% of total DPS.

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- Anemic Agility - even more fire rate
- Primed Expel - maximises dmg against a faction
- Magnetic Might - adds magnetic status and more crit dmg, magnetic status helps against overguard
- Accelerated Isotope - more fire rate and some extra elemental dmg

# ARCANES
- Secondary Enervate is best in slot for DPS (see above for explanation)
- Cascadia Flare is next best
- Secondary Fortifier is optional to improve survivability and have lazy overguard gating, although [\[Jade\]](/items/arsenal/6572/jade/) is already nearly immortal with her shield [\[Regen\]](/items/arsenal/239/regen/) + shield recharge mods



# VARIANTS:
Corrosive Heat: For grineer, particularly with Nourish subsumed.
Magnetic Heat: For corpus, swap Pistol Pestilence for Primed Convulsion:  https://overframe.gg/build/691363/
Radiation: For murmur, swap frostbite and pistol pestilence for Primed Convulsion + anemic agility: https://overframe.gg/build/691369/

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# PROGENITOR: MAGNETIC

Magnetic is the most flexible element since it allows you to build heat, electric or toxin DoT without it combining, while also giving a bonus to overguard and shields (especially good against Eximus and Thrax).

# MOD BREAKDOWN

- Galv Shot: Adds 120% base damage per status (e.g. 600% dmg after 5 statuses), flexible for Hornet Strike if you prefer not needing to build stacks or are running Arcane Precision
- Galvanized Diffusion: mandatory for +230% multishot at max stacks
- Primed Pistol Gambit: mandatory critical chance
- Primed Target Cracker: mandatory critical damage
- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): optional fire rate + multishot. Flexible if running external fire rate e.g. arcane velocity, amalgam furax, reinforced bond
- Supportive element (viral): Raw viral damage has a 1.5x bonus against corrupted enemies. Viral status also boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Ice Storm is optional but increases magazine size which improves overall sustained DPS.
- Damaging element (heat/electric): The Primed elemental mods ([\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) or [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/)) both add a large amount of raw elemental damage, while the damage over time from heat or electric also contribute a bit to overall DPS. 

- Steady Hands: helps with recoil, flexible for ammo mutation

**Electric vs Heat:**
Electric Status: 
- Deals status damage instantly
- Double dips external headshot multipliers like deadhead (1.3x1.3=1.69x)
- Has a small AOE of up to 3m, improving crowd clearing ability
- Modded electric applies into the electric status created by magnetic status breaking Overguard/Shield
- Has bonus against Murmur

Heat Status:
- Deals status damage after 1s delay
- Stacks infinitely as each new status refreshes the duration of whole stack
- Benefits from heat inherit (inherits faction and heat damage bonuses from the first proc)
- Strips armor by up to 50% after 2s, which is equivalent to a 3.7x damage boost against armored enemies

TLDR:
- Electric is best against clearing crowds of weaker enemies or single unarmored enemies quicker
- Heat is best against bulky armored single target enemies that take a while to kill (e.g. unstripped demolyst)

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS:
- Merciless Gunfight: Adds punchthrough which greatly helps crowd clearing, while also providing further crit damage
- [\[Galvanized Crosshairs\]](/items/arsenal/5516/galvanized-crosshairs/): adds more critical chance than primed pistol gambit but requires direct headshot kills to upkeep, and all stacks drop simultaneously if you lose one stack
- Accelerated Isotope: adds fire rate and radiation dmg, which gives another status for galvanized shot if equipped
- Anemic Agility: more fire rate
- Primed Expel: multiplicative damage against a specific faction, double dips status damage

# ARCANE
- Secondary Deadhead: gives more base damage after direct headshot kills, and also applies a multiplicative 1.3x headshot multiplier to the regular 3x headshot multi. Electric status can double dip this on headshots for a 1.69x multiplier.
- Secondary Fortifier: strips overguard much quicker and also steals overguard. Best against Thrax and Eximus, while also giving free survivability. Good overall quality of life.
- Secondary Encumber: applies random statuses which helps maximise the damage bonus from [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/), but takes a while to ramp up meaning most enemies are dead before you see any benefit. Would be best on extremely bulky targets like demolyst.
- Secondary Outburst: gives the highest possible DPS boost but is a little annoying to upkeep since you need a melee with either initial combo from [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/) (5x on most slam melees, 8x on [\[Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1138/magistar/)), 12x from Melee Crescendo which requires finishers or 12x from [\[Ceramic Dagger\]](/items/arsenal/1109/ceramic-dagger/) which requires primary kills.

This a general use steel path build for [\[Akarius Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6476/akarius-prime/)

Best used with some form of Ammo Efficiency e.g. Arcane Pistoleer, Energized Munitions, or Akimbo Slip Shot. Despite being an AOE, it is actually quite easy to randomly headshot and proc Arcane Pistoleer.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

- Galvanized Diffusion: Mandatory multishot
- Primed Pistol Gambit/[\[Creeping Bullseye\]](/items/arsenal/395/creeping-bullseye/): Mandatory Crit chance, would prefer Primed Pistol Gambit but creeping bullseye fits the innate polarity and is easier to get
