- Lethal Torrent: Gives fire rate and extra multishot. Flexible for Anemic Agility.
- Pistol Pestilence + Frostbite/[\[Ice Storm\]](/items/arsenal/404/ice-storm/): Gives viral and status chance. Viral status increases all damage to health, 2x at one viral status and 4.25x at 10 viral status. Viral damage has a 75% damage bonus against cloned flesh possessed by most Grineer/Corrupted units. Ice storm adds an additional shot in the magazine.
- [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): Gives raw heat damage which has a 25% damage bonus against cloned flesh, heat procs which deal damage over time and procs Cascadia Flare to provide base damage
- [\[Primed Fulmination\]](/items/arsenal/5330/primed-fulmination/): Boosts 7.8m AOE radius to 11.2m, which is a 2x increase in horizontal area. Flexible for: Primed Expel, Hornet Strike, Anemic Agility

- Cascadia Flare: Gives +480% base damage easily stackable with heat procs allowing you to drop Hornet Strike. Flexible for Primary Merciless.
- Akimbo Slip Shot: gives ammo efficiency, but requires you to mod base damage with hornet strike e.g. over Lethal Torrent
- Outburst: highest damage but needs stacking crescendo, need to swap Primed Target Cracker for Hornet Strike
- Enervate: good for stackless damage (not relying on conditionals like flare), need to swap Primed Pistol Gambit for Hornet Strike

# RIVEN

- Ideal riven positives are DMG, CD, MS, TOX, CC, FR. Can slot over [\[Primed Fulmination\]](/items/arsenal/5330/primed-fulmination/) or [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) depending on the roll.

Corpus: Swap [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) and [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) for [\[Pathogen Rounds\]](/items/arsenal/449/pathogen-rounds/) and either [\[Primed Expel Corpus\]](/items/arsenal/1405/primed-expel-corpus/) or [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/) to make pure toxin which bypasses shields
Murmur: Swap [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) and [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) for [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) and Expel Murmur or [\[Anemic Agility\]](/items/arsenal/398/anemic-agility/) to make Radiation which murmur are weakest to.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Furis Incarnon tuns into a Athodai alt-fire like wide beam but with a huge magazine. With multishot, elemental balance and beam mechanics, it outputs a TON of status effects such as heat in a short time and is capable of melting even levelcap demolysts in seconds. 

Heat Inherit Endurance Variant: https://overframe.gg/build/492085/

# EVOLUTIONS

**Evolution II**: Stormburst - gives up to +120% multishot on hitting enemies affected by electric status. Best used in conjunction with abilities that proc electric or a primer.

**Evolution III**: Extended Volley -  Increase magazine capacity by +25

**Evolution IV**: Elemental Balance - increases base SC to 52%,. Prelude of might gives overall less DPS especially if we rely on stacking heat DoT to deal damage, which is what furis can do really well.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

- Galv Diffusion: Mandatory multishot
- Primed Pistol Gambit: Mandatory crit chance
- Primed Target Cracker: Mandatory crit damage
- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Mandatory fire rate and bonus multishot. Although multishot is additive to galv diffusion, multishot double dips status damage on beams so it is extra beneficial. Fire rate is self explanatory.
- [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/) + [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/): Adds status chance and viral. Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Raw viral damage also has a 1.75x modifier against most grineer.
- Primed Heated Charge: Increases raw damage, heat status damage and heat status weighting.
- [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/): multiplies heat status damage by 1.9x. This is flexible for merciless gunfight to improve crowd clearing, primed expel to maximise damage against a specific faction

- Primed Expel Corrupted/Grineer: multiplicative to +dmg sources and double dips heat status DoT for 2.40125 final multiplier. 

Note [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) has not been slotted here because currently Galv shot ignores the +28 damage of Evolution 2, it is additive to Cascadia Flare and viral heat only provides two statuses, but you can use it if you have a free slot with nothing better to use.

- [\[Lethal Momentum\]](/items/arsenal/443/lethal-momentum/): reduces beam fall off at end of beam (normally 80% at 16m), but does NOT change the beam length. Note this weapon cannot equip Ruinous Extension. 
- Other exilus options include Ammo mutation or Energizing Shot

Arcanes:
- Cascadia Flare: adds +480% damage not requiring kills
- Secondary Outburst: highest DPS option but requires crescendo to maximise
- Secondary Fortifier: boosts damage against eximus/thrax overguard and steals overguard, very good quality of life. Need to add Galv Shot or Arcane Precision to add base dmg.

• Supportive element (viral): Raw viral damage has a 1.5x bonus against corrupted enemies. Viral status also boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Ice Storm is optional but increases magazine size which improves overall sustained DPS.
• Damaging element (heat/electric): The Primed elemental mods ([\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/) or [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/)) both add a large amount of raw elemental damage, while the damage over time from heat or electric also contribute a bit to overall DPS. 

Why not [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)?
Currently [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) is bugged on most Incarnon weapons, only applying to the base damage (60) and ignoring the dmg from the perks eg +50 from Fatal Affliction. Additionally, Galv Shot does NOT apply to the AOE component which actually accounts for approx 65% of total damage (excluding headcrits and headshot multi). The +120% dmg per status is also additive to +40% dmg per status from Fatal Affliction, slightly reducing the overall impact of Galv Shot. Finally, [\[Despair\]](/items/arsenal/1250/despair/) has a very lopsided weighting with 80% puncture at base, meaning after mods we have final weights of approximately 1% impact, 4% slash, 20% puncture, 31% viral and 43% heat. The chances of proccing impact or slash are so minimal that we effectively consider [\[Despair\]](/items/arsenal/1250/despair/) as having 3 statuses to boost [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) in most cases. Using an external primer and applying at least 5 statuses total does allow Galv Shot to overtake Hornet Strike and Primed Expel.

Flex choices:
- Magnetic Might: magnetic dmg and crit dmg
- [\[Primed Fulmination\]](/items/arsenal/5330/primed-fulmination/): increases 4m AOE to 5.76m.

**Arcane**
Cascadia Flare gives a large amount of base damage
Secondary Deadhead gives the highest multiplier if you aim at heads alot (5.98x) and also forces a 1.3x headshot multiplier on the AOE component when you get headshots.
Secondary Fortifier gives free overguard

# EVOLUTIONS

# MOD BREAKDOWN

This is because you only have TWO status effects at base to power [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) AND currently the damage bonus of galv shot ignore's the flat base dmg bonuses from Evolution 2.

[\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): Compulsory multishot
[\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): Compulsory more multishot and fire rate

Viral 60s: gives status chance and viral status which multiplies all damage to health by 4.25x at 10 stacks
[\[Scorch\]](/items/arsenal/401/scorch/) + [\[Primed Heated Charge\]](/items/arsenal/416/primed-heated-charge/): increases status further, increases heat weighting, increases heat DoTs and increases raw damage

This build minimises the requirement of kills to maintain stacks of mods (e.g. galv shot, merciless/deadhead)

# HORNET STRIKE/CASCADIA FLARE OR [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)?
[\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) has a strange damage formula where [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) scales a separate 200 base damage that is NOT affected by strength:

250 x strength% x (1+damage%) + 200 x ([\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/)%)

What this means effectively is that if you run [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) with Secondary Encumber, the effect of strength becomes less significant on Noctua damage, and conversely if you run high strength and damage sources like Arcane Precision/Cascadia Flare, the effect of [\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) becomes less significant on [\[Noctua\]](/items/arsenal/6525/noctua/) damage (although note you still need to build strength for Pageflight which has a huge effect on status DPS). Ultimately the max DPS difference between the two options ([\[Galvanized Shot\]](/items/arsenal/5518/galvanized-shot/) + Encumber vs [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/) + Flare) is very minimal with Elementalist + Flare coming out 2% better (assuming 13 statuses). However since Secondary Encumber takes a long time to stack to 13 statuses, the immediate burst DPS of elementalist + flare becomes significantly higher.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
[\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/) : mandatory multishot
[\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/): mandatory CC, although you can drop this if running arcane hotshot, topaz shards or outburst
[\[Primed Target Cracker\]](/items/arsenal/413/primed-target-cracker/):  mandatory CD
[\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) + [\[Pistol Pestilence\]](/items/arsenal/405/pistol-pestilence/): adds viral status and status chance. Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 status. 
[\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): adds fire rate and multishot, flexible for options below
Pistol Elementalist: boosts heat status damage by 1.9x

# FLEXIBLE MODS
- Anemic Agility: more fire rate 
- Primed Expel: double dips DoT, increasing DoT by 2.1425x against a specific faction
- [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/) can be swapped for [\[Magnetic Might\]](/items/arsenal/7190/magnetic-might/) if fighting Thrax and you have multiple external sources of fire rate e.g. Arcane Velocity, Amalgam Furax, Reinforced Bond
- [\[Lohk Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6363/lohk-canticle/) is interchangeable with [\[Jahu Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6361/jahu-canticle/). [\[Lohk Canticle\]](/items/arsenal/6363/lohk-canticle/) gives fire rate, which is best for single target focus. [\[Jahu\]](/items/arsenal/2833/jahu/) gives armor strip per kill in affinity range which is 50m at base and up to 400m with flares, but would not really help when fighting a single enemy.

# ARCANE
- Cascadia Flare: Required for base damage, if you don't run this you require Arcane Precision or Hornet Strike
- Secondary Outburst: Highest DPS option but is finnicky and requires use of either finishers to stack Crescendo (e.g. on [\[Furax Wraith\]](/items/arsenal/1121/furax-wraith/) with also provides fire rate to Noctua) or Ceramic Dagger with initial combo riven and after 100 primary kills, then frequent use of weapon swapping.
- Secondary Encumber: Will take a while to stack sufficient statuses for Galvanized Shot to be worthwhile, but can help stack Arcane Impetus on warframe
- Secondary Enervate: frees up critical chance slot

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**What is Heat Inherit?**
The status effect of heat causes enemies to take heat damage every second over 6 seconds according to the formula

**0.5 x modded base damage x (1+heat damage) x (1+faction damage) x critical multipliers**

Each additional application of a heat status adds a stack of heat damage AND refreshes the 6 second duration. However, every subsequent heat proc uses the heat damage and faction damage from the very first stack applied. This means if you use a 'heat primer' with max +heat damage mods and +faction damage mods, then switch to a 'DPS weapon' with only one heat mod that can consistently reapply heat status but with damage, crit and faction mods, every heat proc will actually 'inherit' the heat/faction mods from the primer while taking the modded base damage and critical multipliers from the DPS weapon.

This interaction can also allow abilities that deal heat status to inherit heat and faction mods that they normally do NOT possess, thereby boosting their damage significantly. For example, the following abilities can make use of heat inherit:
- Gauss: Thermal Sunder (heat cast)
- Ember: fireball, fireblast and inferno
- Hildryn: Blazing Pillage
- Citrine: Pristmatic Gem
- Voruna: Fangs of Raksh
- Nova: Neutron star
- Protea: Blaze Artillery
- Excalibur: Exalted Blade (with heat)
- Baruuk: Serene Storm (with heat modded)
- Nezha: Chakram/fire walker

Example setup originally described by Dystopia:
Video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ta_ex7MUDs>
Tysis heat Primer : <https://overframe.gg/build/188777/> 
Skana heat DPS: <https://overframe.gg/build/188778/>

**SWAP POLARITY FROM EXILUS AND LEAVE EXILUS EMPTY IF YOU WANT TO SAVE A FORMA**

See this for DPS calculation: https://www.underframe.site/vshare/070829/ballistica-incarnon

# EVOLUTIONS
Evo 2: Headcracker - up to 70% fire rate for 4s (has a 50% chance to activate on headshot) or Prolific Perforation for up to +80% cc if you hit enemeis with punchthrough. I would use headcracker if using Ballistica as a single target boss killer and Prolific Perforation for crowd clearing.
Evo 3: Rapid Reinforcement - +50% reload speed affects incarnon transformation speed and we already run lethal momentum for projectile speed
Evo 4: Critical Parallel - for raw damage variant OR Elemental Balance for status variant. With elemental buffs like Nourish, you would be best going with raw damage variant like Corrosive Heat. With Roar you might be better with status variant like viral heat, blast, gas.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
• Galv Shot: Adds 120% base damage per status (e.g. 600% dmg after 5 statuses). On Incarnon form this is MULTIPLICATIVE to other base damage sources such as [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/) Cascadia Flare, Secondary Deadhead
• [\[Galvanized Diffusion\]](/items/arsenal/5517/galvanized-diffusion/): mandatory for +230% multishot at max stacks
• [\[Primed Pistol Gambit\]](/items/arsenal/415/primed-pistol-gambit/): mandatory critical chance
• [\[Primed Target Cracker\]](/items/arsenal/413/primed-target-cracker/): mandatory critical damage
• [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/): fire rate + multishot. Flexible if running lots of external fire rate in addition to fire rate evolution e.g. arcane velocity, amalgam furax, reinforced bond

# RIVEN
Desired: dmg, cc, cd, ms, fr

# ARCANES
- Cascadia Flare is the most convenient for base damage not requiring direct headshot kills and able to start stacking itself without kills
- Secondary Deadhead is the highest possible DPS but only a little bit more than Flare and only on headshots
- Secondary Fortifier is the most comfortable option giving you overguard but requires you to swap [\[Lethal Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/402/lethal-torrent/) for [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/)

# ELEMENTS
CORROSIVE HEAT
Highest single target damage on enemies that take less than 2s to kill, which is basically 99% of enemies up to levelcap. As pistols have two primed elemental mods, running Corrosive + Heat gives you the highest raw elemental damage multiplier and is able to oneshot basically everything in the game, while also providing useful statuses as corrosive partially strips armor, heat partially strips armor and deals damage over time. Adding Nourish to this makes it even stronger.

VIRAL HEAT
You can swap [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) for [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) and evolution 4 to Elemental Balance for a more heat status focused build, which becomes stronger than raw damage once enemies take longer than about 2s to kill due to the accumulation of heat procs. The only enemies that might fit this criteria would be a levelcap demolyst and eximus units. Run Roar for buff.

VIRAL ELECTRIC
If you have external armor strip or are fighting unarmored enemies, Viral Electric would be clearing groups slightly faster and has slightly quicker single target damage than viral heat (as electric ticks at 0s, then at 2s, rather than only after 1s like heat). Use 60/60 tox + cold to make viral and [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) for electric. Run Elemental balance evolution. Swap arcane to Deadhead or Fortifier. Run Roar or Shock Trooper for buff.

BLAST
Has best immediate AOE clear as blast status explodes in a 5m radius. Swap Pistol Pestilence/[\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) for [\[Frostbite\]](/items/arsenal/403/frostbite/) + Primed Expel, [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/) or [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/). Swap arcane to Deadhead. Run Elemental balance evolution. Run roar for buff.

GAS
Has best lingering AOE clear as gas status deals damage in 3m going up to up to 6 m radius (at 10 stacks). Swap [\[Primed Convulsion\]](/items/arsenal/6478/primed-convulsion/) for Primed Expel, [\[Pistol Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6567/pistol-elementalist/) or [\[Hornet Strike\]](/items/arsenal/425/hornet-strike/). Swap arcane to Deadhead. Run Elemental balance evolution.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

The [\[Praedos\]](/items/arsenal/5839/praedos/) has many passives and perks that allow you to save mod spaces and tends to push towards a hybrid x12 combo build, which means you spend the majority of your time spamming light attacks to build combo mixed in with heavy attacks at x12 combo against heavy units such as demolishers, acolytes, bosses, eximus units etc. With priming, a x12 heavy attack is strong enough so that single heavy attack can cause a steel path demolyst to bleed out.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
With health and armor changes, slash has been relatively nerfed while raw damage has better TTK, particularly if you end up using a viral heat or corrosive heat primer. Melee Influence allows you to spread non impact/puncture/slash status effects in a 20m radius, after being activated by electric status. This effectively allows you to clear maps fast. For single target damage, use [\[Primed Fever Strike\]](/items/arsenal/353/primed-fever-strike/) over [\[Shocking Touch\]](/items/arsenal/361/shocking-touch/) and Melee Duplicate. 

**UPDATE DEC 2023**
For a more light attack slash focused build, use Melee Duplicate, you want to sit around 137% critical chance to maximise the damage from melee duplicate. This means you should NOT slot [\[Sacrificial Steel\]](/items/arsenal/692/sacrificial-steel/) or a riven with +cc. This is because Melee Duplicate triggers on any tier 1 crit but the duplicated hit has a chance to be a tier 2 crit. This means you want slightly higher than 100 CC with a balance of low enough CC that tier 1 crits happen but high enough CC that enough Tier 2 crits occur on the second hit. The formula for maximising the final multiplier can be found by CC = (3 x CD - 4)/(2 x CD - 2). At 5 crit damage we get 137.5% CC. If you add cold status (from [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/) priming for example), we get 5.5 crit damage which gives 139% CC. If we add [\[Dreamer's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/6356/dreamers-wrath/), we get 6.14 for 140% CC. Rank 10 [\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/) + [\[Gladiator Might\]](/items/arsenal/679/gladiator-might/) hits 130cc and every puncture status adds 5cc until 155cc. This means you will be floating within the right range depending on puncture procs.

For a more x12 heavy oriented Tennokai build, use Melee Animosity to get an additional +420% CC, giving a total of 302% final CC or guaranteed red crit on heavy.

## EVOLUTION GUIDE
- Evolution I : Incarnon mode - heavy attack at 5x combo to transform into Incarnon mode, where you will receive a passive +40% attack speed and +2 range. This basically allows you to drop attack speed and range mods on the melee.

- Evolution II:  Whirling Fury - additional +20% attack speed to bring total of +60% attack speed without mods OR Drifting Grace for sprint/slide if you prefer the mobility boost. 

- Evolution III: Shockwave Synergy - gain 4 combo for each enemy hit by a slam attack. Helps regain combo quicker, particularly on the last attack of forward block combo of Soverign Outcast.

- Evolution IV: Evolved Ascension - +30% parkour velocity. Gives a good boost to bullet jump. 

- Evolution V: Universal Readiness - 5 combo on ammo pickup. This allows you to keep at x12 combo at all times even when predominantly using guns. Kinetic Harmony is an alternative if you DON'T use Tennokai.

## MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Sovereign Outcast\]](/items/arsenal/900/sovereign-outcast/) Stance: Arguably the most important mod. The neutral light attack combo (Rogue Edict) has a ridiculous average damage multiplier of 859.6%/s, one of the highest in the game (behind [\[Final Harbinger\]](/items/arsenal/890/final-harbinger/)) that also has FOUR forced slash procs on every 3rd hit each with a 200% multiplier. The forward block combo (Villain Rule) also has a Slam attack on 4th hit which helps gain more combo via Shockwave Synergy, so you can seamlessly weave in slams into your combos.

- [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/): +80% damage per status effect. This is NOT capped by the number of unique statuses i.e. with impact, puncture, slash statuses alone you get +240% damage per hit. Paired with a primer such as Kuva Nukor or Epitaph, you can get up to 8 unique statuses for +640% damage per hit.

- Galvanized Steel: boosts crit chance by 110% and crit damage by 120%

- [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/): +440% status chance at x12 combo, giving 108% status. This means with each hit you are guaranteed a status (in addition to forced slash status procs from Rogue Edict). 

- Blood Rush: +440% critical chance at x12 combo allows crit chance to hit 108%.

- Primed Smite Grineer/Corrupted: multiplicative to base damage (condition overload) and triple dips procs spread via influence (1.55 x 1.55 x 1.55 = 3.72x)

- Galvanized Elementalist: boosts status damage by 80% and status chance by 120%

- Voltaic Strike + Shocking Touch: adds electric to proc Melee Influence and boosts elec DOT by 150%, as well as status by 60%

- Discpline's merit: consistently gives tennokai every 4 hits, can also use [\[Dreamer's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/6356/dreamers-wrath/)

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/): Gives +80% dmg per status effect for up to +320% dmg after 4 status effects, although note this has a slight reduced effect on [\[Reaping Spiral\]](/items/arsenal/891/reaping-spiral/) stance multipliers (approximately 60% effective atm). **Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# INTRODUCTION

[\[Innodem\]](/items/arsenal/5874/innodem/) is one of the top 5 melee weapons for light attack melee influence due to its high base damage (360), high range (1.8m base + 3m incarnon activation + 1m perks + 3m primed reach = 8.8m while airborne) and high follow through (0.9 - meaning each enemy hit only causes the follow-through damage to be 90% against the next enemy).

Build combo by spamming light attack (neutral combo of [\[Pointed Wind\]](/items/arsenal/861/pointed-wind/) or [\[Stinging Thorn\]](/items/arsenal/860/stinging-thorn/)) until x12, then heavy attack Tennokai when prompted to activate Incarnon form as well as deal forced bleed status on heavy attacks (from x12 multiplier + 250% slash). Keep jumping while using light attack to take advantage of the aerial based perks, or even jump and aim attack for throw projectiles.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**
With health and armor changes, slash has been relatively nerfed while raw damage has better TTK, particularly if you end up using a viral heat or corrosive heat primer. Melee Influence allows you to spread non impact/puncture/slash status effects in a 20m radius, after being activated by electric status. This effectively allows you to clear maps fast. 

# EVOLUTION CHOICES

1. Incarnon Form : Heavy attack at 5x combo to activate Incarnon form. This gives +3m range, +40% attack speed, aerial projectiles and Incarnon Resilience buffs on finisher
2. Orokin [\[Reach\]](/items/arsenal/384/reach/): +0.5m range to maximise range. Feel free to swap to +30% sprint speed if you prefer the speed boost.
3. Skyborne Hunter: Increase range of aerial attacks by 0.5m.
4. Swooping Lunge : up to +150% dmg at 3 stacks after airborne kills. Kills from slash DoT while you are airborne count, making this very easy to build up by simply jumping around a bit.
5. Armed Inspiration or Stunning Brutality: Armed inspiration gives passive combo gain without even attacking, which can be useful if you plan on using guns more than melee. Stunning Brutality is pretty niche and provides a 10m stun when you perform a finisher. Blood annointed is now the least useful evolution due to Tennokai, since you can now perform x12 heavies without spending any combo.

# MOD CHOICES
Range and attack speed are optional since the Incarnon bonuses are enough to replace them (+65% attack speed and +3m range), but you can double stack them if you prefer.

- Pointed Wind : Neutral combo Parting Edge has high multiplier of 774% dmg/s with short animation duration. NOTE, CURRENTLY [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) is bugged with stances, and Parting Edge only has 50% effectiveness with Condition Overload (meaning only about 387% dmg/s. The Foward combo Viper's Bite 560% dmg/s but with 100% effectiveness with CO, meaning you should probably stick to forward combo until this bug is fixed.

- [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/): +80% damage per status effect. This is NOT capped by the number of unique statuses i.e. with impact, puncture, slash statuses alone you get +240% damage per hit. Paired with a primer such as Kuva Nukor or Epitaph, you can get up to 8 unique statuses for +640% damage per hit.

- Galvanized Steel : gives +110% critical chance and +120% critical damage

- [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/): +440% status chance at x12 combo, giving 108% status. This means with each hit you are guaranteed a status (in addition to forced slash status procs from Pointed Wind). 

- Blood Rush: +440% critical chance at x12 combo allows crit chance to hit 108% on light attacks.

- Galvanized elementalist : status damage and more status chance

- [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/): Makes [\[Innodem\]](/items/arsenal/5874/innodem/) have a devastating final range of 8.3m (8.8m while airborne), which doesn't suffer as much with [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/) due to the high innate 0.9 followthrough of daggers (this means each enemy hit reduces the damage to the next enemy by only 10%).

- [\[Primed Smite Grineer\]](/items/arsenal/2883/primed-smite-grineer/): 55% final multiplicative damage , double dipping on procs to +140% (i.e. 2.4x multiplier) and triple dips melee influence procs (i.e. 3.72x multiplier)

- Shocking touch: needed to add electric for melee influence and boosts both raw dmg and electric DoT by 1.9x

- Melee Influence: allows you to nuke maps with electric DoT.

# FLEXIBLE OPTIONS
- Voltaic Strike: add 60% electric dmg and 60% status further boosting influence damage

- Spring Loaded Blade: adds more range so you can hit even more enemies each swing, and daggers have high follow through of 0.9 to take advantage of range

- Organ Shatter: +90% crit damage. We no longer need amalgam since Tennokai heavy are independent on wind up.

- [\[Quickening\]](/items/arsenal/327/quickening/): +40% attack speed for final 80% extra attack speed, which really helps since the dagger is very slow at base. Extra combo count also means you can build to x12 incredibly quickly.

- Gladiator Might: +60% crit damage with +110% crit chance at x12 combo allowing crit chance to hit 143% cc on light attacks. 


# RIVEN
- Range, Attack Speed, Electric are ideal positives. Critical Damage, Critical Chance, Status Chance and Damage are less ideal but still good.

# SYNERGIES
Add Amalgam [\[Argonak\]](/items/arsenal/968/argonak/) mod onto an [\[Argonak\]](/items/arsenal/968/argonak/) statstick and every hit you make with direct hits or influence procs will strip armor.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**PROGENITOR ELEMENT: ELECTRIC**

This is one of two specific [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) playstyles where you wind up, throw and heavy detonate when the [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) gets close to a group of enemies. [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/) allows you to stay permanently at 5x combo which boosts each heavy attack by a 5x multiplier. [\[Volatile Quick Return\]](/items/arsenal/5269/volatile-quick-return/) increases the maximum radius of explosion. Pathocysts heavy forces a single viral proc which can be rapidly spread by melee influence to give a group of enemies 10 viral instantly. [\[Coda Pathocyst\]](/items/arsenal/7328/coda-pathocyst/) has the highest base damage of all existing glaives meaning its raw damage on heavy explosion hits the absolute hardest, however the area of damage is very small at a base of 4.9m. We use Melee Influence to improve its AOE clear capability since any statuses created can be spread in 20m.

- Amalgam Organ Shatter: Mandatory crit damage and also gives wind up speed which is crucial

- [\[Galvanized Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6851/galvanized-elementalist/): multiplicative 1.8x buff to electric status damage as well as 120% status chance which is important to improve proc consistency
- Volatile Quick Return: adds 3m to blast radius
- Galvanized Reflex: gives 5x initial combo and heavy attack efficiency
- Primed Smite: multiplicative to [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/), DOUBLE DIPS status effects (1.55 x 1.55) and TRIPLE DIPS statuses spread via melee influence (1.55 x 1.55 x 1.55)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

**EMPTY SLOT FOR [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/)**

[\[Ceramic Dagger\]](/items/arsenal/1109/ceramic-dagger/) transforms into Incarnon form after using heavy attack after reaching 6x combo. Gun and Blade and Adept Reflexes evolutions give 120 initial combo after 100 kills which is equivalent to 7x combo. Adding [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/) to this gives you permanent 11x combo (or 12x with [\[Ready Steel\]](/items/arsenal/6368/ready-steel/)). Heavy attacking while incarnon mode is active throws a projectile with approximately 5m AOE with forced impact and innate heat status. You can make gas electric or blast electric to proc influence OR if using Volt/[\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/) you can mod pure blast or pure gas and rely on external electric to proc influence.

This is specifically for using the incarnon heavy attack projectiles to kill enemies. Grouping + armor strip is ideal to make this scale, otherwise the damage isn't very good against armored enemies. Armor strip can be applied by Amalgam [\[Argonak\]](/items/arsenal/968/argonak/) passively or actively through warframe abilities.

At the time of testing, Condition overload works while Sacrificial Pressure/[\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) DO NOT seem to apply any damage to the projectiles. Once it works, [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) is flexible over [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/). Ability based damage buffs like Vex Armor, [\[Rift Torrent\]](/items/arsenal/141/rift-torrent/), Eclipse seem to work fine.

**UPDATE**
Melee Influence + Amalgam [\[Argonak\]](/items/arsenal/968/argonak/) makes this even stronger for AOE nuking, at the cost of a bit of crit chance. You must slot three elemental mods to force blast/gas + electric due to the innate heat on the projectile.

# MOD BREAKDOWN

**PRIMED PRESSURE POINT/SACRIFICIAL PRESSURE + SACRIFICIAL STEEL/[\[Galvanized Steel\]](/items/arsenal/6836/galvanized-steel/)**: 
The choice of variants depends on external factors like rivens, wrathful advance and violet archon shards. 
1. Primed Pressure Point + Galvanized Steel: best combination when used with a crit chance riven/best in slot riven i.e. CC/DMG or CC/DMG/IC or Wrathful Advance.
2. [\[Sacrificial Pressure\]](/items/arsenal/691/sacrificial-pressure/) + [\[Sacrificial Steel\]](/items/arsenal/692/sacrificial-steel/): best combination if no crit chance on riven but you are running multiple Violet crit damage shards (i.e. 2 or more)

Use this spreadsheet to check exactly which versions of pressure point/steel are better, in addition to other mod choices and riven stats since everything is dependent on your frame buffs, shards and other external factors: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1L4i6Ax36sfdZoIAMQl5HAmR3K0IfpfRoELrZP6OH6S8/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Use this calculator to check actual damage and simulate if you can one-shot levelcap Thrax: https://underframe.onrender.com/vshare/816376/magistar-slam-calc

**[\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/)**: At 8x combo, [\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/) gives +280% CC, which pushes [\[Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1138/magistar/) into higher crit tiers for higher consistency and average DPS.

**[\[Organ Shatter\]](/items/arsenal/358/organ-shatter/)**: Gives 90% Crit damage. NOTE: This is the flexible slot if you have violet shards.

**[\[Primed Fever Strike\]](/items/arsenal/353/primed-fever-strike/)**: Gives +165% toxin damage which contributes to raw damage, and toxin damage bypasses shields which is important because enemies with shields like corpus/corrupted have a shield gate that cannot normally be bypassed by slam damage.

**SEISMIC WAVE**: Gives 200% damage which is multiplicative to Pressure Point/[\[Sacrificial Pressure\]](/items/arsenal/691/sacrificial-pressure/)

**[\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/)**: At maximum stacks gives 80 initial combo which combines with 30 from [\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/) and 30 from incarnon form bonus to hit 140, giving 8x permanent heavy multiplier which multiplies heavy slam damage by 8x. Also gives heavy attack efficiency which effects how much combo is consumed each slam and therefore how quickly you regenerate combo back to 8x before you are ready to slam at maximum damage again.

**[\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/)**: This is flexible and depends if you have any outside source of initial combo. This is because without [\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/), [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/) fully stacked only gives 5x combo before incarnon mode is activated, and you need to hit 6x combo to activate the incarnon mode. Running [\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/) allows you to hit 6x combo immediately and activate incarnon form to jump to 8x initial combo. Alternatively you can run [\[Ready Steel\]](/items/arsenal/6368/ready-steel/) in the Aura, use [\[Rauta\]](/items/arsenal/6213/rauta/) to gain combo by shooting, block to gain combo or just swing the [\[Magistar\]](/items/arsenal/1138/magistar/) manually each time you need to reactivate the incarnon form. If you prefer this, swap [\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/) out for Organ Shatter, Focus Radon or Riven.

**MELEE EXPOSURE**: high raw elemental damage bonus

- [\[Focus Radon\]](/items/arsenal/6369/focus-radon/): Gives more heavy efficiency which stacks with [\[Galvanized Reflex\]](/items/arsenal/6847/galvanized-reflex/), allowing faster spamming of slams. Also gives some Radiation damage. Slot this over Organ Shatter if you have CD on riven or violet shards
- Gladiator Might: gives a bit more crit dmg and crit chance

**RIVEN**
Ideal riven positives are CD/DMG/CC/IC/TOX/heavy efficiency and slot over [\[Organ Shatter\]](/items/arsenal/358/organ-shatter/) (if you roll CD) or [\[Corrupt Charge\]](/items/arsenal/333/corrupt-charge/) (if you roll IC). Other elements are not ideal but also useable. You need about 28.5 initial combo from riven to replace corrupt charge (seems to round up in game).

The best overall riven is CC DMG -negative and replace Primed Pressure Point 
OR CC DMG IC -negative and replace Corrupt Charge (but you need a minimum IC roll of 28.5)

Use [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) on a pet. [\[Corrosive Projection\]](/items/arsenal/303/corrosive-projection/) is also mandatory in most cases.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Primed Smite gives the highest possible DPS boost since it double dips standard DoT and triple dips influence DoT however is only limited to one faction at a time. If you know you are fighting a specific faction in an endurance mission you can consider adding this over [\[Galvanized Elementalist\]](/items/arsenal/6851/galvanized-elementalist/) to maximise DPS, or over [\[Shocking Touch\]](/items/arsenal/361/shocking-touch/) if running [\[Shock Trooper\]](/items/arsenal/195/shock-trooper/), or over [\[Primed Fury\]](/items/arsenal/349/primed-fury/) if running external attack speed boosts.

[\[Nami Solo\]](/items/arsenal/1163/nami-solo/) Incarnon is currently one of the strongest if not THE strongest melee weapon when considering multiple enemies, primarily due to THREE reasons:
1. The Lone Blade evolution which gives it a **[\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/) OF 1**. The [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/) stat refers to how much damage is preserved on a single swing after passing through each enemy. For example, most melees have a [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/) stat of 0.6, meaning for each enemy hit, the second enemy to be hit in the same swing will only take 60% of the initial damage while the third enemy will take 60% of 60% (i.e. 36%) and so on until the damage drops close to 0 on the tenth enemy if you hit 10 enemies. Having a [\[Follow Through\]](/items/arsenal/560/follow-through/) stat of 1 however means NO DAMAGE IS LOST. Note you must HARD SWAP melee (i.e. hold weapon swap) rather than quick melee swap.
2. Passive range bonus of 3m giving a final range of 8.5m with [\[Primed Reach\]](/items/arsenal/352/primed-reach/), second highest base in the game (behind [\[Bo\]](/items/arsenal/1160/bo/) Incarnon).
3. High base status chance with status chance incarnon evolution

EVOLUTIONS 
Evo II: Brigand's Frenzy +80 base dmg, on equip +30% attack speed for 4s
Evo III: Lone Blade: Increase fall off by 60% (to 1) on equip.
Evo IV: Versatile Creed: +14% CC and +14% SC

RIVEN
RANGE>>ELECTRIC, ATTACK SPEED, DMG, CD, CC. Slot over attack speed if you roll attack speed

# ELEMENTS
+Elemental damage bonuses ([\[Primed Fever Strike\]](/items/arsenal/353/primed-fever-strike/) and Melee Exposure) do not actually affect the component of 'true damage' on Bladestorm that bypasses armor and is instead bonus damage that is attenuated by armor (i.e. reduced by 10 at max 2700 armor). Spoiled Strike + Berserker Fury = 75% - 20% = 55%.

If you don't like the initial ramp up/slowness and don't plan on using status priming, you can swap Berserker Fury for Primed Fury and Condition Overload for Magnetic Rush.
Spoiled Strike + Primed Fury + Magnetic Rush = 55% + 20% - 20% = 55%

# ARCANE
Crescendo in arcane slot, any rank is fine. If no Crescendo, alternatives include Melee Exposure or Melee Retaliation

# BUIILD BREAKDOWN

- Progenitor: 60% electric, we want to maximise electric weighting 

- [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/): +80% damage per status effect. This is NOT capped by the number of unique statuses i.e. with impact, puncture, slash statuses alone you get +240% damage per hit. Paired with a primer such as [\[Kuva Nukor\]](/items/arsenal/4249/kuva-nukor/) or [\[Epitaph\]](/items/arsenal/5439/epitaph/), you can get up to 8 unique statuses for +640% damage per hit. Even without a primer we have about four innate statuses.

- Galvanized Steel: boosts crit chance by 110% and crit damage by 120%

- Weeping Wounds: +440% status chance at x12 combo. 

- Blood Rush: +440% critical chance at x12 combo

- Primed Smite Grineer/Corrupted: multiplicative to base damage (condition overload) and triple dips procs spread via influence (1.55 x 1.55 x 1.55 = 3.72x)

- Galvanized Elementalist: boosts status damage by 80% and status chance by a further 120%

- Shocking Touch: adds electric to proc Melee Influence and boosts elec DoT by +90%

- Berseker Fury: attack speed - flexible for Primed Reach if you have external attack speed e.g. arcane strike

- Discpline's merit: consistently gives tennokai every 4 hits, can also use [\[Dreamer's Wrath\]](/items/arsenal/6356/dreamers-wrath/)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is a hybrid light attack spam + x12 heavy slam Tennokai Influence nuke build. This means you spam light attacks until the tennokai symbol pops up, then jump and immediately perform a heavy attack while aiming slightly toward the ground. Heavy slamming with incarnon mode active impales enemies on spears similar to [\[Nezha\]](/items/arsenal/40/nezha/), and attacking speared enemies gives a 35% multiplier to status chance, which helps Melee Influence DPS greatly.

Currently, Revox spears allow recursive growth of electric and gas DoTs applied via ANY source.

**UPDATE 2025**
Use Galvanized Elementalist over Primed Fury if running Arcane Strike

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/): Mandatory base damage. [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) does NOT work on the slam AOE, but does work on the direct light attacks or direct heavy attacks. If you can run external base damage eg Arcane Fury, Vex Armor, consider swapping Primed Pressure Point for Condition Overload.

- Blood Rush: Mandatory crit chance boosting CC to 140% at x12 combo

- Weeping Wounds: Mandatory status chance boost SC to 108% at x12 combo, increasing the chances of electric procs per hit

- Primed Fury: Mandatory attack speed. The incarnon mode forces a -35% base penalty, but evolution 2 gives +45% bonus, meaning Primed fury ends up at a net positive of about 1.3. This is flexible for Berserker Fury or Quickening.

- Primed Smite: Mandatory for maximising Influence DPS because this TRIPLE DIPS the final DoT damage spread via Melee influence, for 3.72x multiplier.

- [\[Shocking Touch\]](/items/arsenal/361/shocking-touch/): Mandatory to add electric to proc influence and adds 1.9x multiplier to electric DoTs. If using with [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/) and [\[Valence Formation\]](/items/arsenal/6483/valence-formation/), swap shocking touch for Primed Fever Strike and infuse Electric, which will make Ruvox deal Corrosive status and force Electric status.

- [\[Seismic Wave\]](/items/arsenal/385/seismic-wave/): Multiplicative with [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/) on slam damage, giving 3x multiplier to each slam. Flexible for Primed Reach if you don't plan on slamming too much.

# EVOLUTIONS:
Evolution I - Heavy attack above 6x combo unlocks +3m range, -35% attack speed, changes imp to puncture dmg
Evolution II - Lethal Impetus +15% Attack Speed per kill for 15s, stacks to 45% after 3 kills OR Gathering Momentum gives up to +60% movement speed at 12x combo, great for mobility
Evolution III - Seismic Slam +60% slam radius, increases base heavy slam radius of 9m to 14.4m
Evolution IV - Swift Transmute reach 3x combo for incarnon form
Evolution V - Vulnerability Serum - impaled enemies are +35% more vulnerable to status chance, meaning you boost SC by 1.35x on impaled enemies.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

[\[Verdilac\]](/items/arsenal/5734/verdilac/)'s special Tactical Combo (block + melee) shoots innate toxin projectiles which currently have an unusual damage calculation where [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) is *multiplicative* with other +dmg sources ([\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/), Nira's mods, arcane [\[Fury\]](/items/arsenal/366/fury/)). In addition the projectile damage scales off your combo counter but does *not* consume combo to use. 

**INFLUENCE UPDATE**
Now that Melee Influence exists, we mod electric so it deals electric status on light attack direct hits but turns the innate toxin projectiles from Neutral Block combo into Corrosive, which means you deal Corrosive + Electric simultaneously with block combo and spread this in 20m. With green shards, this lets you full strip the map and nuke with electric procs.

**Mod Breakdown:**
- Condition Overload - compulsory mod since it is multiplicative to +dmg for the projectile, and increases with more status effects e.g. +600% damage at 5 statuses (which can be achieved with Verdilac alone) or +1200% at 10 statuses (which can be achieved with combining a primer and Verdilac's innate statuses).

- Organ Shatter - compulsory mod for crit damage

- Weeping Wounds - useful to increase status chance to 126% at max combo

- Blood Rush - compulsory for crit chance (162% at max combo)

- Primed Fury - attack speed affects regular combo gain and the animation of projectile throwing. Flexible for [\[Berserker Fury\]](/items/arsenal/359/berserker-fury/) or drop from build entirely if you run external attack speed (e.g. arcane strike or warframe ability buffs like volt, gauss, warcry).

- Primed Pressure Point - Condition overload is *MULTIPLICATIVE* with other +dmg sources. If you have any +dmg source from outside e.g. Arcane Fury/blade charger, you can drop this mod entirely for Nira's Contempt or Gladiator might

- Primed Smite Grineer - further multiplier to both [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) and +dmg, meaning with +600% from CO (5 status),  and +55% from smite. In addition, smite double dips DoT proc damage to give it a second +55% boost, or 2.401x final multiplier and triple dips on the spread influence DoTs.

- Shocking Touch - required to make electric + corrosive

Other flexible options - if you drop Primed Fury due to external sources, or hate faction mods, you can run any of the following alternatives:
- Galvanized Elementalist - increases status dmg by 85% and also boosts status by 120%
- Gladiator might - increases crit chance by 110% at max combo and crit damage by 60%
- Sacrificial Pressure - further boosts crit chance
- Primed Reach - helps build combo but does not increase the radius of projectile or gas clouds

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

This is one of two specific [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) playstyles where instead of exploding the [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) with heavy attack, you just repeatedly throw it and wait for it to bounce around then come back. [\[Kestrel Prime\]](/items/arsenal/7566/kestrel-prime/) has a innate effect of bouncing 8 times vs most other glaives that only bounce 3 times. By letting it bounce around it can slowly build combo eventually hitting 12x, where it can benefit from combo mods like [\[Weeping Wounds\]](/items/arsenal/347/weeping-wounds/) and [\[Blood Rush\]](/items/arsenal/345/blood-rush/). With the mod [\[Volatile Rebound\]](/items/arsenal/5270/volatile-rebound/), each time the [\[Glaive\]](/items/arsenal/1126/glaive/) bounces into an enemy it will cause a mini explosion which due to melee influence will cause damaging electric status to spread exponentially. Each mini explosion deals about half the damage of a full heavy but does not scale off heavy combo, which puts each explosion at about 10x weaker than a x5 heavy explosion but since you can [\[Rebound\]](/items/arsenal/370/rebound/) multiple times per throw this overall averages out in a dense crowd. This playstyle is not quite as immediately devastating as a heavy detonation spam build but offers a fun alternative that is equally as good at killing large groups of enemies.

# MOD BREAKDOWN
- [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/): Mandatory base damage, cannot use Killing Blow since that only applies to heavy attacks and we are not heavy attacking
- Amalgam Organ Shatter: Mandatory crit damage and also gives wind up
- Weeping Wound: gives +440% sc at 12x combo
- Blood Rush: gives +440% cc at 12x combo
- Shocking Touch: adds electric so you can proc influence
- Melee Elementalist: multiplicative 1.9x buff to electric status damage, also gives wind up speed
- Volatile Rebound: enables the rebound playstyle so every bounce explodes
- Primed Smite: multiplicative to [\[Primed Pressure Point\]](/items/arsenal/351/primed-pressure-point/), DOUBLE DIPS status effects (1.55 x 1.55) and TRIPLE DIPS statuses spread via melee influence (1.55 x 1.55 x 1.55). IF YOU DONT LIKE FACTION MODS, SWAP THIS FOR [\[Galvanized Steel\]](/items/arsenal/6836/galvanized-steel/).

## EVOLUTION GUIDE
- Evolution I : Incarnon mode - heavy attack at 5x combo to transform into Incarnon mode, where you will receive a passive +40% attack speed and +2 range. This basically allows you to drop attack speed and range mods on the melee.

- Evolution II:  Drifting Grace for extra moibility (+20% sprint and slide) OR Seismic Slam +50% slam radius if you are constantly slamming to trash clear or want to build up Shockwave Synergy even faster

- Evolution III: Shockwave Synergy: Gain 4 combo per enemy hit with a normal slam. This means if you slam 20 enemies you can gain 80 combo which is equivalent to 4x multiplier. If you just light slam a big group of enemies 3 times you will hit 12x combo. This means you can launch a huge 12x heavy slam every 3 normal slams.

- Evolution IV: Evolved Ascension - +30% parkour velocity

- Evolution V: Universal Readiness - collecting ammo increases combo

# MOVEMENT TECH
If you want to use [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) as a full movement stick, [\[Gaia's Tragedy\]](/items/arsenal/869/gaias-tragedy/) or [\[Seismic Palm\]](/items/arsenal/870/seismic-palm/) are required and you need to slot about three attack speed mods. The three attack speed mods are for stance momentum inherit (aka "Mexian" named after conclave player who discovered it). You may also want to swap Melee Influence to Melee Crescendo and perform finishers to get x12 combo: https://overframe.gg/build/1024285/?saved=1781609245862

To perform Mexian:
1. Hold aim + Forward + quick melee to perform forward block attack which should make you charge forward
2. Press swap weapon mid animation
3. Jump
4. Roll/dodge

If you rebind quick melee to mouse wheel up and swap weapon to mouse wheel down
On PC the inputs should be roughly: right mouse, wheel up, wheel down, space, shift

If you have mouse 4 and mouse 5 buttons could use those instead.

Primed Fever Strike optional if running melee afflictions to allow you to break through overguard easier.

# ARCANE 

Melee Duplicate - multiplies all damage by 2x on a yellow crit and does work on overguard
OR 
Melee Afflicitons - multiplies forced slash by 7x but does not work on overguard

# EVOLUTIONS

Evolution II : Gathering Momentum
Evolution III: Seismic Slam
Evolution IV: Ternary Vault
Evolution V: Vulnerability Serum

# MOVEMENT TECH
If you want to use [\[Ruvox\]](/items/arsenal/6521/ruvox/) as a full movement stick, [\[Gaia's Tragedy\]](/items/arsenal/869/gaias-tragedy/) or [\[Seismic Palm\]](/items/arsenal/870/seismic-palm/) are required and you need to slot at least two to three attack speed mods. The attack speed mods are for stance momentum inherit (aka "Mexian" named after conclave player who discovered it) which allow you convert the forward momentum from a block attack which is affected by attack speed, into forward movement. If you can perform finishers e.g. with vazarin or grouping you can get x12 crescendo and benefit from +60% movement speed from Gathering Momentum.

To perform Mexian:
1. Hold aim + Forward + quick melee to perform forward block attack which should make you charge forward
2. Press swap weapon mid animation
3. Jump
4. Roll/dodge

If you rebind quick melee to mouse wheel up and swap weapon to mouse wheel down
On PC the inputs should be roughly: right mouse, wheel up, wheel down, space, shift

If you have mouse 4 and mouse 5 buttons could use those instead.

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

Update Nov 2024:
Bite is now placed on the separate claws.

Claw build: https://overframe.gg/build/919801/

MANDATORY MODS:
Viral Quills - spreads AOE viral procs and minor damage
Martyr Symbiosis - sacrifices itself to save you. 
Panzer Devolution OR momentous bond 
- [\[Panzer Devolution\]](/items/arsenal/5144/panzer-devolution/) makes panzer have a set 30s revive timer but while down you have constant uptime of Reinforced bond and tenacious bond. If you want max uptime of these buffs run devolution. In larva state it also still primes viral.
- [\[Momentous Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6273/momentous-bond/) lets you potentially revive it quicker than 30s when you get about 3 eximus kills meaning you can use it to activate martyr symbiosis immediately again

OPTIONAL MODS:
Resourceful Retriever - bonus loot 

Synth deconstruct - OPTIONAL for mass producing health orbs, as any enemy touched by [\[Viral Quills\]](/items/arsenal/4971/viral-quills/) has a 25% chance to drop health orb. also gives holster reload bonus.

[\[Primed Pack Leader\]](/items/arsenal/2512/primed-pack-leader/): OPTIONAL if you are using a melee, since this gives overguard which keeps the pet alive more foten

Primed Animal Instinct is OPTIONAL since you now get universal radar, but loot radar is still useful

Tenacious Bond - gives free 1.2x flat crit damage to your weapons. Headshots also reduce revive timer by 3s.

Tek Assault - 60% chance to not die, OPTIONAL mod

Seismic Bond - OPTIONAL, but gives 30% bonus Ability Efficiency on warframes with "CHANNELLING ABILITIES" as [\[Viral Quills\]](/items/arsenal/4971/viral-quills/) deals damage. Note that the game has a VERY generous definition for channeling abilities as nearly every frame has an ability that seems to count. See Arcane Intention wiki page for a full list: https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Arcane_Intention

Hunter Recovery - optional mod for free healing. Viral quills constantly heals your health while active since it deals damage.

Calculated Redirection + Reinforced Bond -  bonus 60% fire rate

Tandem bond - good on frames requiring melee combo eg [\[Baruuk\]](/items/arsenal/1462/baruuk/), [\[Gara\]](/items/arsenal/24/gara/), [\[Khora\]](/items/arsenal/30/khora/), [\[Atlas\]](/items/arsenal/13/atlas/). [\[Viral Quills\]](/items/arsenal/4971/viral-quills/) count as an extra 3 melee combo per spore, meaning Panzer attacking gains up to 18 combo per enemy hit (assuming up to 6 spores). You can reach x12 combo in 10 seconds if you add grouping.

Mystic Bond - allows free casts on frames that don't use brief respite for shield gating, and viral quills helps trigger mystic bond

Medi pet kit - reduces revive timer if you don't use [\[Panzer Devolution\]](/items/arsenal/5144/panzer-devolution/)

**Guide / how the build works (verbatim from Overframe):**

# MANDATORY MODS
Arc Coil - zaps 7 enemies in 10m with electric damage/status, which can carry other elements via Manifold Bond. Seems to have little or no cooldown.

Guardian - completely refills shields which auto refreshes your shield gate. Manifold bond can reduce this cooldown.

Manifold bond - allows [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) to also apply any statuses from the weapon (e.g. viral + heat from [\[Verglas\]](/items/arsenal/5420/verglas/) equipped), giving AOE viral and [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) priming. Additionally, killing enemies afflicted by 3 statuses or more reduce cooldown of guardian by 5s, meaning after just 6 kills, Guardian is ready to refresh shield gate.

Synth Deconstruct - enemies tagged by the 10m AOE of Arc Coil can drop health orbs, which can be converted to energy by equilibrium

Vacuum - self explanatory

Primed Regen - reduces recovery time

Momentous Bond - reduces recovery time with each eximus kill, basically a guaranteed revive every 2 eximus kills. Also adds additional statuses to arc coil after eximus kills.

# FLEXIBLE/OPTIONAL MODS

[\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) is used because a SURPRISING amount of abilities satisfy the condition to activate a free 30% efficiency, which shares a list with Arcane Intention: https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Arcane_Intention

Primed Animal instinct - loot radar and more enemy radar

Sacrifice - can revive you

Tenacious Bond - OPTIONAL but requires vulklok, vulcax or prime laser rifle with riven, gives flat 1.2x crit multiplier.

Electro Pulse - zaps 1 enemy in 15m, but also appears to activate Melee Influence (?bug). This is FLEXIBLE

Contagious Bond - enemies killed by verglas will spread all status effects on that enemy

Duplex Bond - every 100 energy spawns a clone,  kills by clone can drop energy orbs and clones also contribute to priming

Mystic Bond - OPTIONAL can give nearly constant free casts with [\[Diriga\]](/items/arsenal/2234/diriga/) + [\[Arc Coil\]](/items/arsenal/226/arc-coil/) but then prevents shield gating that relies on [\[Brief Respite\]](/items/arsenal/299/brief-respite/) etc. 

# WEAPON OPTIONS
1. [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/): [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) Priming + [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) + Shield gating: [\[Burst Laser Prime\]](/items/arsenal/6130/burst-laser-prime/) gives innate IPS for condition overload, has enough crit for tenacious bond and provides extra utility via Augur mods that helps with shield gating: https://overframe.gg/build/737345/

2. [\[Prime Laser Rifle\]](/items/arsenal/2252/prime-laser-rifle/): [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/) Priming + [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) + Utility: [\[Prime Laser Rifle\]](/items/arsenal/2252/prime-laser-rifle/) gives innate IPS (impact,puncture,slash) for [\[Condition Overload\]](/items/arsenal/360/condition-overload/), has enough crit chance for [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) and provides extra utility via Aero Periphery (for finishers) and Shivering Contagion (which applies to your other weapons and abilities): https://overframe.gg/build/722838/

[\[Huras Kubrow\]](/items/arsenal/2230/huras-kubrow/) is ideally used with warframes that primarily deal damage with abilties as it provides invisibility that breaks with weapon use but not ability use. It is also able to nuke maps byitself with claws.

MANDATORY MODS:
Stalk - makes you and huras invisible, which breaks when you attack with a weapon (or exalted) but not when you cast abilities
Fetch - [\[Vacuum\]](/items/arsenal/250/vacuum/) effect

FOR DEALING DAMAGE:
Contagious Bond: allows huras to spread status effects and nuke
Mecha Recharge: for use in conjunction with Mecha Empowered/Pulse on warframe for ability status DPS focused warframes e.g. [\[Lavos\]](/items/arsenal/5346/lavos/), [\[Grendel\]](/items/arsenal/2840/grendel/), [\[Citrine\]](/items/arsenal/6066/citrine/), [\[Gauss\]](/items/arsenal/2716/gauss/), [\[Ember\]](/items/arsenal/16/ember/), [\[Gyre\]](/items/arsenal/5776/gyre/). Can swap these out on frames that do not use status ability DPS (e.g. [\[Xaku\]](/items/arsenal/5002/xaku/)).
[\[Synth Deconstruct\]](/items/arsenal/1421/synth-deconstruct/): enemies damaged by huras (either spread via mecha or [\[Contagious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6277/contagious-bond/)) has a chance to produce health orbs for energy via [\[Equilibrium\]](/items/arsenal/831/equilibrium/).
[\[Vicious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6270/vicious-bond/): allows it to strip armor with attacks which also spread when you damage them with abilities
[\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/): extra clones help deal more damage with claws
[\[Hunt\]](/items/arsenal/213/hunt/): makes huras charge enemies occasionally dealing damage

**NOTE** Hunter mod set bonus currently do NOT work: boost companion damage by 50% on enemies affected by slash 

OPTIONAL MODS:
[\[Medi-Pet Kit\]](/items/arsenal/654/medi-pet-kit/): reduces recovery time

Any of the above options can be swapped for any of the following:
Loyal Retriever: more loot, flexible for Resource Retriever etc 
Seismic Bond - free 30% efficiency on certain frames
[\[Primed Pack Leader\]](/items/arsenal/2512/primed-pack-leader/): melee attacks generate overguard which helps keep huras alive, but just note if you are using melee attack you will be losing stealth.
[\[Calculated Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/671/calculated-redirection/) + [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/): OPTIONAL for +60% fire rate
Tenacious Bond: OPTIONAL for extra crit damage, needs bite on claws

Restorative Bond - helps revive when dead
Aerial Bond - helps revive quicker by jumping and killing
Tandem Bond - helps generate melee combo for certain exalted frames like Baruuk
Link Vitality/Link Armor - for use with high ehp frames eg lavos, inaros etc

**UPDATE 2024**
[\[Negate\]](/items/arsenal/238/negate/) is now affected by Manifold Bonds cooldown reduction
[\[Coolant Leak\]](/items/arsenal/230/coolant-leak/) has been buffed to 10m and benefits off status application from Manifold bond, meaning you can crowd control enemies, passively prime enemies and apply synth deconstruct.

Guardian + Manifold Bond - [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) completely refills your shield on depletion, resetting your shield gate. Killing enemies with 3 or more statuses reduces cooldown of [\[Guardian\]](/items/arsenal/233/guardian/) by 5s, meaning every 6 kills on statused enemies resets Guardian's 30s cooldown, allowing you to essentially shield gate passively.

Negate - effectively gives status immunity, preventing dangerous toxin or heat procs at high levels and also preventing knockdown, particularly when run with Manifold Bond.

Reinforced Bond + Calculated Redirection - Boosts [\[Wyrm\]](/items/arsenal/2246/wyrm/)'s shield to above 1200, making [\[Reinforced Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6268/reinforced-bond/) constantly active regardless of current shield level giving a +60% fire rate boost for free. [\[Calculated Redirection\]](/items/arsenal/671/calculated-redirection/) is optional on frames that can make your sentinel immortal (eg Zephyr), as you can simply reload to hit >1200 then.

Mystic Bond - OPTIONAL mod that allows free ability casts after the sentinel uses abilities with cooldowns, which is accelerated through the use of Guardian + manifold or negate. This is only suggested on frames that don't require Brief Respite/Augur mods for shield gating as Mystic Bond will interfere. Works particularly well on Zephyr.

Momentous Bond - OPTIONAL mod that allows you to quickly revive sentinel after eximus kills. 

Tenacious Bond - OPTIONAL mod that gives free flat 1.2x crit multiplier, requiring you to equip a sentinel weapon with >50% CC (Vulklok or Vulcax with Crit delay, or Prime Laser Rifle with Crit delay + CC riven).

Primed Animal Instinct - optional loot radar

[\[Seismic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6269/seismic-bond/) is used because a SURPRISING amount of abilities satisfy the condition to activate a free 30% efficiency, which shares a list with Arcane Intention: https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Arcane_Intention

[\[Crowd Dispersion\]](/items/arsenal/231/crowd-dispersion/) is OPTIONAL crowd control and can proc [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/), but usually NOT recommend because it throws enemies away making it hard to actually shoot them.

Sacrifice is an optional mod that allows sentinel to revive you

**WEAPON**

[\[Aerial Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6272/aerial-bond/) lets you quickly revive your sentinel by jumping and killing
[\[Momentous Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6273/momentous-bond/) lets you quickly revive by killing eximus AND allows [\[Blast Shield\]](/items/arsenal/4745/blast-shield/) to apply multiple statuses via [\[Manifold Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6271/manifold-bond/)


FLEXIBLE OPTIONS:
Use [\[Contagious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6277/contagious-bond/) if using [\[Verglas\]](/items/arsenal/5420/verglas/) for a bit of occasional priming. 
[\[Duplex Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6280/duplex-bond/) is flexible for companion DPS if you run a frame that spends alot of energy.
Use [\[Tenacious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6279/tenacious-bond/) over [\[Contagious Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6277/contagious-bond/) if you run [\[Vulklok\]](/items/arsenal/2256/vulklok/) or a weapon with > 50% cc.
[\[Mystic Bond\]](/items/arsenal/6276/mystic-bond/) is flexible on frames that DON'T rely on energy expenditure for shield gating.
